tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 25 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan stu ra ba gtso go gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khu / ra gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang gozhu dag dang dkar chag/ sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mgo phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring cho 'an/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'bru/ga rgyas/ ca 5 —

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpa' brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad rtswa rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig sdogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yan/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying g.yin pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo digs su grags chen gyi slob grwa wo mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi bee ro ska cog zhung / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhud lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

chi rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang chabs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtsho ni na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhud bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/— 3 —

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'gyung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhyen/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/

bsdu sgrig gsal ba4/da/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi bandi dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/ —3 —

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yi ga dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen tshu du 7 5 pa / sge ༵du 3 byung gnas dang / paṇḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos padma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dzwa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi spyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug 'e ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang / rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ārya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhud bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug pū hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lanta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591 )la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yo ngas rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab bshus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon padma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta sdi rta nanda dang pra yā mā nanda gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni rbu ṇa shrī dang puṇḍa badzra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du shambha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dgag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras skrungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635)la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

dpal ga tshu po khro bo chen po mi g.yo bla med kyi sgrub thabs brda kyid 05bro / rnam sbyo①05 bsdo spya/spre/ 1dpal ga tshu po khro bo chen po'i dkyil wor gyi cho ga 'e rdo rje 3ngo 9spru ba bas kyigs/ 16dpal 'bor lo chen po'i sgrub thabs srid gsum shan dog95/ dre mod bsdob/rba5/ 44dpal phyag na rdo rje wor lo chen po'i dkyil chog srid gsum 'dul byed bzhugs/ 67dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil wor gyi cho ga bdud 'joms rol ba bzhugs/ 116slob ma la dbang bskur bar byed pa'i tshul bzhugs/ 176dpal khro na rgyal po rta mchog rol ba'i las byang dregs pa ṭa/na 'di kyi95 bzhu kyigs/ 191thams cad rig pa'i brgyud yig gsol 'debs su sbyar ba bzhugs/ 210dpal thams cad rig pa'i cho ga 'khore ba kun grol bzhugs/ 215thams cad rig pa'i cho ga khor ba kun grol gyi jagazi pa ḍā/de bza5 rnga / sdo nub/spro5/ 275—1—

bdud las rnam par rgyal ba bzhugs/tseX( snya skyi/ dpal gtum po khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs bdud las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan srid zhi'i lam gnyis mngon rbacom nas/ / 'gyur med bde ba'i rang bzhin dkyil 'khor las/ /dpag yas rigs kyi dkyil 'khor tshogs spro ba/ /mi g.yo mgon pos srid 'di skyong bar mdzod/ /gang gi gnyis med ye shes ni/ /gdod ma'i mgon po mi g.yo ba/ /ma bcos rim pa mngon gyur phyir/ /bcos ma'i rim pe'i sgrubathabs mtshar/ /'dir dpal gtum po khro bo'i rgyud mi g.yo ba rnal 'byor bla na med par yongs su grags pa'i rim pa las 'ongs pa lha dgu'i bdag nyid kyi bskyed rim bsgom par 'dod pas/ mchod pa la sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs par byas nas/ /bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya'i sgom bzlas rnams kyang ji ltar rigs par bya'o/ / de nas/ legs par sbyangs pa'i maṇḍal la dri bzang gi thig le bkod/ mdun du mchod pa bshams/ thal mo sbyar te/ khro bo gtum po khros pa'i mig can ral gri g.yas pa'i phyag mdzes shing / thegs parabacas pa'i khu tshur sdig mdzub bsgreng bar bcas pa gzhan pa'i phyag gis te/ pus mo sa la gtod pa'i sku ni nges par sprin nag dang 'dra ba/ bgegs rnams 'joms mdzad mgon po mi g.yo khyod kyis srid 'di'i bgegs zhi mdzod/ oX hūṃ n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa utpa ko ྅ haX lkoX badzras tā haX/ rang nyid mi g.yo bar gyur/ —rdog pa gnyis su zla ba la gnas pa'i hāX

yig re re/ badzra padma ha sto3haX/ lag pa g.yas ral gri'i phyag rgya byas lka snying gad sprulabaspyi bo rnams su reg cing / tseX( huX traX hri khi hūX/ phrag pa la sogs pa rnams su regacig phrag pa g.yas su ya mun ta kri ta skyoX/ g.yon du pratswanta kri ta huX/ khar padmanta krita guXgasang bar bi grwarnyan kri ta huX/ oṃ hūX swāhā badzraX/ rdo rje blangs/ oX āXgrwahwa sti naXdrilabublangs/ rdo rje gsor zhing / dril bu snying gar rdzo brgyad dkrol/ lkoX āXtsaṇḍa ma hwa roṣa ṇa skyoXphaṭa/ lan bdun gyi bsang chu byin gyis brlabs/ tseX( āXbi kū nu ta sma ra ya hūX phaṭa/ cesaganas dang yo byad la bsang chu gtor/ oX ā badzra purmye huX/ sogs kyis mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ thod pa'i nang du dam rdzas rnams hūX dang maX las byung ba'i mi bskyod pa yab yum du gyur/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes bdud rtsir bzhu/oX sarba bhakṣa kā mi ni bhakṣa sho dha ni gu phya badzre ṇi kro dhi shwa ri sarba dra byaX bya bi ni shwa dha ya shwa dha ya huX/ oX a mṛ te a mṛ taX pra we sha ya hūX/ zhes nang mchod byin gyisabarlabs/ ral gri'i phyag rgya bsnun stabs su byas la/ tseX( badzra yakṣa sarba pā sa no ta smos ya hūX phaṭa kyis bgegs bskrad/ phyag rgya de nyid g.yas su bskor/ oX shrī tsaṇḍa ma hwa roṣa ṇa rakṣarakṣa maX hūX phaṭa/ rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ oX nga ni ra guX grihā grihā guX grihā pāya gro hā pā ya huX/ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bdu ra dzā huX phaṭa/ oX āXzheX zhes gnasagasum du me tog reg oX āXbadzra sa ne hūX/ sa la dor/ gdong la'ang sngags des dor/maṇḍalal dri bzang byugs tshul bya/ oṃ ā tiṣṭha badzra huX/ oṃ āXbadzra bhu mi huX/ maṇḍal 'gyung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i gzhal med khang du gyur/ hūX lan dgu dri'i thig lo'i gnas su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dgur gyur/ rang gi snying kha'i huX las 'od zera'aphros/ gdod ma nas grub pa'i gtum po lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/—2—

oX tsaṇḍa ma ha ro ṣa ṇa sa pā ri lda ra sa hi ta ā ga tsā ā ga smo dzaXhūX zhes maṇḍal gyi steng du bzhugs par bsams/ baX zhes pas rang gi gdan la chen zhid bzhugs/rdeho zhes pas bdag la dgyes te dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir de 'phangs mtho bar bzhugs par bsam/ a tra maṇḍa le a dhi je na ku ru phaṭa swāhā/ zhes gsol ba btab/ oX shrī tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa bhaṇḍa ra ka sa pa ri wā re pra wa ra sa tta rā ya pu byaX prati tstsha swāhā/ añtsa ma naX/ bro kṣa naX/ arghaX rnams kyis chu bzhi phul/ na maX sarba ta thā ga ta su la li ta na mi ta na ma tai bha ga wantaX dzaXskyoX baX hoXku su ma añdza li nā tha hoX lko me tog gtor/ oX kra nyi a tsa la purmye pra tismo huX phaṭa de bzhi du/ shwe te a tsal/ bi ta a tsa la/ rakta a tsa la/ shā saX a tsa la/ de ṣa ba dri lha / / mo ha ba dri sti rdo/pi shu ṇa badzi ni/ ra ga badzre ṇi/ rngu badzi ṇi/ lko pa rnams 'don pa spos nas so sorame tog phul/ de bzhi du/ nai we du bar du phul/ oX badzra sa tu su saX gra ha ta/ badzra ratna ma nutta raX/ badzra dharma gā ya nī/ badzra karma ka rod bha we/ khyab 'as/phyi mara'athag par byed cing bdud kyi khengs pa rab bcil dbang phyug kyang ni 'joms//tshangs pa'i sgo ra dum bur mdzad de sa chu byin za rlung gi khams rnams nyams byed pa/ /'jigs byed ri rab gza' tshogs bcas pa'i mtho ris sa steng sa'og skyong dang phyogs skyong klu/ /'jig rten gsum gnon rnam rgyal sku mā dpalaldan mi g.yo gtum chen khro bo rgyal gyur cig so sor mtheb srin gyis nang mgo gongazhing / oX kṛ ṣṭa a tsa la na maX de bzhi du/ shwe ta a tsa'akhogs/rngu badzi khri'i sa du so so'i mtshan spel la 'bul/ lha rnams yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen pos thugs rgyud gang / dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mo tshe/ khos/—3—

yan lag bdun pa bya/ spro na skabs 'dir 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dkyil 'khor gyi gtor ma dang/cha gsum nas 'byung ba ltar phyogs skyong bcu'i gtor ma dang / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rnams kyang 'bul lo/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang / /gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang nongs pa/ /de kun mgon pos bzod mdzad rigs/ /tshul khrims tsandan lus la byugs/ /bsam gtan gyi ni gos gyon te/ /byang chub yan lag tshe tog bkram/ /ji ltar bde b.razhugs su gsol/ dzaXhuX paṃ hoX zhes dkyil 'khor thams cad bdaganyid laganyis su med par thim/ mngon rtogs mdor bsdus su sgom pa'i tshe/ oX āXtiṣṭha badzra/man chad maṇḍal gyi mchod pa 'di bor la/ bsod nams tshogs gsog spyi dang mthun pa zhig byasapas kyang rung ngo / /de nas tshad med bzhi sgoms la/ oX shā n+ya tā sogs/ rang gi snying ge'i hūXyig las 'phros pa'i me lces bdag lus khams gsum snod bcud dang bcas pa cig car bsregs te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bar do'i rnam shesasgyu ma lta bu'i lus dkar po mtshan dpes spras pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na padma dkar po 'dzin pa/ rang snang gi shes rab mas 'byud cing/ pad dkar dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa steng gi nam mkha' la 'khor bar gyur/ 'ogatu yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raX las me'i dkyil 'khor/ baX las chu zhi dkyil 'khor/ laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/de'i steng du suX las ri'i rgyal po ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa lcog brgyad dang ldan pa/ gser gyi ri bdun rol pa'i mtsho bdun gling bcu gnyis rgya mtsho chen po khor yug dang bcas pa/ ri rab kyi rtse mor e las chos 'byung—4—

dkar po'i nang du/ paX las sna tshogs padma'i lte bar/ huX las sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog can las 'od zer 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhir gur mi byed cingabastan pa phyi rol ye shes kyi me dpung drag tu 'bar bas bskor ba/ sna chogasardorje'i nye bar/ bhuX ser po las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang / 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang / pha gu dang / grwa phyed dang / shar bu dang / rmad 'a yab kyi mdzes pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun na kabasabategs pa'i rta babs/ snam/ bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khoralo'i phyi rol dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'o//gzhal yas khang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser / nub dmar/ byang ljang dbusasngo ba/ 'phar ma gcig dang bcas pa/ dbus su sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dgu /de rnams kyi steng du raX las nyi ma'i dkyil ge nar dgu dbus kyi gdan gyis steng du huX las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra ba'i yum mā ma gī la 'khu/da pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba sgyu maltabu'i sgras/ rang nyid bar do'i rnam shes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de nyid nā do)rnam par gyur te skar mda' 'pho ba ltar yab kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ byang chub kyisems su bzhu ste lha mo'i padma ra spros pa huX mthing kar gyur/ de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad zhe sdang rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangasargyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ hūX la thim pa las/zang nyid mi g.yo ba nag po lto/ po khro bo'i skur gyur te/ yum gyi mkha'i g.yas—5—

phyogs kyi mtha' las phyir phyung / oṃ kriṣṭha a tsa la hu phaṭa/ rang nyid migayo ba zhe sdang rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa la rdo rje ral gris brdegs pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu/ mā ma kyi dang lhan cig bdud rtsi de nyid gsol bas tshim zhing dgyes pa chen pos rjes chags kyi gdung bas yongs su 'byud pa las/ mā ma gī zhe sdang rdo rje ma'i rnam para'agyur/ o de ṣa badzi hu phaṭa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bdag gnyis ge tsobo rdeyab yum gyi skur gyur pa ni mthing ka inda nī la'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i sku brgyad gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa can/ 'phreng bag chags shir grims pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis tshes cher khros pa/ rab tu gtu'/ pas khro gnyer bsdus shing/ shin tu rno bas mche ba dang bcas pa/ ya sos ma mchu'i sgros mnan pa/ steng 'ogatuphyogs par yo ba'i g.yas g.yon gyi spyan gnyis dang sbyan dbus ma thad kar gzigs pa ste gsum ka'ang dmar sa zhang zlum pa/ zur phud lnga dang ldan zhing zin po che'i cod pan can/ phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub 'og tu nor 'dzin ma la gtod pa/ zhabasagayas pa gyen du 'degs shing brdabs pas bdud bzhi'i rang bzhin tshangs pa dbang po nye dbang drag po rnams skrag par mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yon gyi pusamogadan la btsugs pa/ g.yon ngos su 'gying bag dang bcas te me dpung 'baraba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhabs g.yas g.yon go bzlog kyang rung ngo / /de la 'khyud pa'i yum zhe sdang rdo rje ma lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa can lang tshol babs shing nu ma rgyas pa phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar zhing / g.yon bdud bzhi khro —6—

khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa yab la stob pa dbu skra ltag par phyed bcings su byas pa byin pa gnyis kyis dgyes par 'khril ba'i sku can bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa'i shes rab ma ste/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che'i dbu rgyan snyan gyon mgul rgyan 'og pag gdu bu do shal do shal phyed pa rkang gdub kyi g.yer kha la sogs pas nye bar brgyan pa/ bde ba chen po dang stong pa nyid zung du 'phun pa'ingo bor dag pa'o/ /shes rab kyi mkha' a las padma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ bzhukaltabu'i rdul gyis mtshan pa'i ze'u 'khru la as mtshan pa/ thabs kyi bsang ba hūlas rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa nor bu la o gyis masno pa/ lha mo'i spyi bor o.āstsorjes chags kyi rol pa chen po dang bcas pas snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan dra pas/yab kyi spyi bo nas zhugs byang chub kyi sems a wa dhu ti'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa dkar dmar ro gcig tu 'dres pa las thig le'i gong bu brgyad du gyur/ de rnams hū yig brgyad du gyur/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/sems can thams cad rigs bzhi yab yum gyi go 'phangs la bkod/ slara'adus te thim pa las lha brgyad du gyur/ yab rnams yum gyi bha ga'i g.yas kyi mtha' dang yum rnams g.yon gyi mtha' nas spros/ o shwe ta a tsal tu phaṭa/ migayo ba dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa shar gyi gdan gyi steng pa'i gri )/ga 'dzi/ rdo rdo rno spre ṭa'i ga/dan ༵ s+ho rje/ ༵ byi ta~X sbyi rlo tri//lja —7—

g.yo ba ser po rin po ches mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa lho'i gdan la 'khod/lkoX bī shu na badzre huX phaṭa/ phra ma rdo rje ma ser mo rin po ches mtshan pa'i gri guga'adzin pa lho nub kyi gdan la 'khod/ oṃ rakta a tsa la huX phaṭa/ migayo ba dmar po padma'i mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa nub kyi gdan la 'khod/ oX rā ga badzi hāX phaṭa/ 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo padmas mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa cub byang gi gdan la 'khode/ oX shā ma a tsa la huX phaṭa/ migayo ba ljang khu sna tsho gosarna.utpa las mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa byang gi gdan la 'khod/ oX int+ra badzi huXphaṭa/ phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu utpa las mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa byang shar gyi gdan la 'khod/ khro bo bzhi po ni bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ 'on kyang g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub gyen du bsgreng pa'o/ /lha mo bzhi po ni bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs te 'on kyang phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon bdud bzhi'i khrag gis rim pasagang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas kyi mthil dang g.yon gyi pus mo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gtad pa'o/ /de nas gtso bo yab yum rjesasuchags pa'i bde ba chen po 'dod chags chen po'i dam tshig gi sbyor ba las byang chub sems su zhu bar gyur/ de nas lha mo bzhis 'gro ba'i don la bskul ba ni/gti mug rdo rje mas/ khyab bdag byams pa rnams spangs nas/ /stong pa'i rangabazhin du ma mdzad/ khyod dang rnam bral bdag 'gum pas/ /'gro kun stong par ma mdzad cig phra ma rdo rje mas/ snying rje'i sems bral bdag 'gum pas/ /khyab bdag stong par ma mdzad cig /bdag gi lus 'di sdug bsngal bas/ /'tshob —8—

dang bral ci ste mdzad/ 'dod chags rdo rje mas/ ci ste mkhas pa khyod kyi ni/ /dga' ba spangs nas stong par 'jug /'jig rten ma lus pa rnams dang / /bdagagoyid ni khyod la gtad/ phrag dog rdo rje mas/ lang tsho dang ldan btang snyoms pa'i/ /mig ni stong pa 'bras med can/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spong la/ /bdagalamanyam nyid sbyor ba mdzod/ ces pa'i glu sgra snyan lta bu'i yongs su sad de/ thigale las skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das yan lag ma dang bcas pa sngon bzhin du grub par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po oX gyisamatshan pa/ mgrin par padma dmar po āXyis mtshan pa/ thugs kar rdorje sngon po hūX gis mtshan pa/ thugs ka'i hūX gi 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' gtum po lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pas bskor ba oX badzra sa mā dzaX pursha sogs kyis mchod/ oX tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sa pa ri lha rwas hi ta ā gasnro ā ga smo dzaXhāX baX hoX a tra maṇḍal rje naX ku ru hūX phaṭa grwa sma lan gsum gyis mthar/ dzaXhūX tshu hoXganyis su med par thim/ slar yang dbang lha dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaX pursha sogs kyes mchod/ tseXrsha a bhi khri nyu rte māX sarba ta thā ga tā/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/dbang lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrusagasol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag sku khrus gsal/ oXsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūX zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas lha thams cad kyi sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ shar dang shar lho pa la rnam snang —9—

lto dang lho nub pa la rin 'byung nub dang nub byang pa la 'od dpag med byang dang byang shar pa la don grub kyis dbu brgyan/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nye ge spyod lhamo brgyad dang bcas pas mchod/ nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs la so so'i sngags(〈〈②〉rgi re'i mthar 'bru gsum gyi nang mchod 'bul )kyis sbyangs/ dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis gtso bo la bstod par bsams la/ 'od 'phreX gtum/ pa'i spyan dang 'jigs ru5khroganyer dang ldan tshems kyis ma mchu mnan/ g.yon pa'i pus mo sa la rnamabakod gzhan pa'i zhabs kyis gdul dka'i bdud rnams gnon/ srid gsum 'jigs 'phro rdog mchog gis ral gri'i phyag dang khu tshur sdigs mdzub zhags pa can/ rtag par inta nī la ltar 'bar gtum chen khro bo mi g.yo rgyal ci gyuragazhes bstod par bya'o/ /de nas rlung kha spyor drag tu bzung la/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i sgo nas gti mug rdo rje mi g.yo ba dkar po la rdo rje ral gris sdigs pas 'od kyi phung por gyur nas bdag la thim/ rang nyid migayo ba dkar po'i gzugs su gyur nas gti mug rdo rje ma dang lhan cig 'dod chags chen po'i dam tshig gi sbyor ba la gnas par bsams/ slar yang rang snang gi ye shes las grub pa'i mi g.yo ba dkar po dang gti mug rdo rje ma shar dang shar lhor sngar bzhin 'khod/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje'i gzugs kyi dbus su gnasapar bsams/ de bzhin du rigs lhag ma gsum la'ang sbyar/ de ltar na zla ba gcig nyid kyi gzugs brnyan du ma chu dang me long sogs la 'char ba bzhin du/ ranganyid dpa' bo gcig pu'i rang bzhin lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du 'char ba snang la —10—

rang bzhin med pa la mnyam par bzhag de nas dag pa dran pa ni/sgom tyā ri5shigapa dang thos pa rgyas par rgyud kyi rgyal po nyid las 'a ba de nyid sdi ga ba bzhi sa pa'am/ phya/len la mdo zu ra ye mi par mdzad pa ni/gru 'a 'i zhe ge pa' gnas bzha ste//sgo ba dkyi pa bzha po'o/rde/bsam sta thabaci bzha ya rta babs dang //'phags/lamardebargyad sa ka ba rnams//sems sga tsho//ga pas 'phar ṭā dang //padma skye gnasadag pa nyad//sprul pa kha dog sna sa pa//bza/sa na /ḍi/nga rab yan 'ag/rdedagu/'a chags chen pos phyogs shed gā//gas ba dbye bas mtshamasardernams na//ser dang 'a ser nag pa ste//nya zla khu khrag dag lo//gzugasardesogs phung po lnga po na//'gyu/ra med ye shes lnga dag pa//gtum/ chen lnga shā khams lnga po//stong pa lnga dag yum rnams so/khres rab thabs de ngos ral gri zhags//dbyer med rdo rje sdigs mdzub ste//tshangs dang sa 'og skyong ba'i phyag/0ri yiristeng dang 'og 'a 'phyar zhang gtod//zhabs stabs bdud bzha rnams nyed pa//'a she nu ma ya bde dro ༷la//dgyes spyod zhabs gzhan 'dzin mar gtod//de phyar rda rje byang chub ba gci// sa 'i gyiston pa rgyal ba gag pu nyad//lnga ༵tshul gyis yang dag gnas/khresarab pha rol phyin gcig pu'ang //rnam lnga tshul sa yang dag gnas/denasabazlas pa ni/snying gar pad nyi la huX yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab ste/de las sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung /'khor lo ltar 'bor ba'i tshul spyi dang 'dra bar bsgoms nas/oX tsaṇḍamahā ro ṣa ṇa huX phaṭa/ces bya ba gsang sngags yi ge bcu po 'di nyid gtso bor bzla zhing /ga༈ yang /oX a tsa la skyoXhaX/zhes pa dang /oX huX phaṭa/ces pa dag hāXhuX huXzhes pa rnams

kyang snying po'o/ /rgyud las 'phreng ba'i sngags gzhan yang gsungs mod/ phyag len la 'di kho na baglabar mdzad/ oX hreX hreX hroX tsaṇḍa rū pe tsa ṭa tsa ṭa/ pra tsa ṭa pra tsa ṭa/ ka ha ka ha/ pra phu ra pra phu ra/ pra phu ra ya pra phu ra ya/ ha na ha na/ gra sa gra sa/ banta banta/ nga ya nga ya/ nga ya nga ya/ mo hā ya mo hā ya/ sarba sha blu nāX/ mu kha banta nāX/ kuruku sa sarba ṭā ki ni nāX/ gra ha bhu ta/ pi shā tsa bya dhi/ yaktaṇaX tra sa ya tra sa ya war ma ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ ru ru tsaṇḍa/ tsaṇḍa ru ka rakṣa rakṣa/ lha spyin la tsaṇḍa ma hā se naX sarbaX ā dzña pa ya ti/ oX tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa skyoX phaṭa/ rtsa ba'i sngags go na maXsarba a sha pa ri pū ra ko bhyoX sarba ta thā ga ta khyuX sarba traṭa a mo gha tsaṇḍa mahāro ṣa ṇa spro ṭa ya hūX/bhra ma ya bhra ma ya huX/ traṭa mo haX/ zhes waṃ migayo ba rigs lnga spyi'i sngags so/ / oX badzra yo gi ni hūX phaṭa/ oṃ pradzñā pa ra mi tā huX phaṭa/ mchen he ri skyoXphaṭa/ ces pa gsum ni yum gyi snying po'o/ /oX pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā wadhe ni tshwal tshwa la me warbhani/dhi ri dhi ri bu lha wadhe ni swāhā/ lko pa ni yum gyi rtsa sngags dang 'phreng ba byin gyis rlas/pa'i sngags kyang yin no/ /gong du bshad pa'i so so'i mngal 'byin gyi sngags rnams kyang ci rigasapar bzla'o/ /de nas mthar dkyil 'bor bsdu bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i skyoX dang sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer 'phros te/ snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du byas/ de rnams 'od du zhu sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor la thimaphyogs kyi dpa' bo bzhi po bdag nyid la thim lha mo bzhi po'ang yum la thim ste yab yum rjes chags kyi bde ba chen pos rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa 'od gsal du skad cig gis thim par gyur/ de las rang nyid dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnam par gyur pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngos nas/ thun mtshams kyibya—12—

ba la 'jug gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ kha zas bzang dgu las byas pa'i gtor ma/nyer spyod lnga dang / nang mchod sogs 'dus byas/ maṇḍal mchod pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin a mṛ tadang bsang chus sbyangs/ mchod pa rnams kyang sngags tsam gyis byin gyis rlabs/ de nas snya( swa/bha nywa/ka nā~X ༵ ma sto skyed spre ༵ ṭā~X/ ṭā rnyi dā rdo nga/ ༵ sdu ༵dhi snod ya/༵shi~X/ che ba'i nang du/ bhu a dzi kha hu las sha lnga/ ma la pa ta ba las bdud rtsi lnga rnams ༵ḍi ༵ ༵ / ༵ dho ༵smug ༵༵rdo/bus rjo ༵ shā sdi~X ༵'i snro~X shā ༵ bstan pa steng du hū yig dang bcas pa/ de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin garsha/gas pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thams cad dang 'jig rten khams kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug nas hu la thim/ hū yig ralagri dang bcas pa lhungs nas rdzas rnams dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa las bdud sngu snro ༵rdo /rang rnyi dzi dhi ༵ ༵ sngu ༵༵ rlo/ pas u pho ni por po rlo rnyi dkyil 'khordo ra mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ o tsaṇḍa nas dza hū ba ho'i dza tsamangagasol/ ༵ / rdzu~X /kyi dhi~X bha dhi~X sgi ba gle sna sna ༵ / sngu dhi smra de ༵ ༵ rlo mnu nyu drwa sa nā ya/ sam bha ma ra sa la bi nā sha nā ya/ ratna mu ku ṭa kri ta siragerdo ༵/ dī li~X bha ma kṛ/ tshe / myi bi/ kyai ༵ ra bi lha ḍi/ je/ dho kau rno pa//sni~X dho~X//rnyi ṣa —13—

ya sho ṣa ya/ ru tstsha da/ bhe da bhe da/ duXni sa twaX mā ma bi rus tsitta kun/ bhasmi kun co ku ra kyi hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun la sogs pas phul/ chu bzhin sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ badzra lā phye hāX/ lkoX badzra mā le traX/ oX badzra gyi rti rmiX.oX badzra dri rti āX oX badzra dhu pe huX/ oX badzra pursha traX/ lkoX badzra u lo te hriX lkoX badzrag rnye āX kyai mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang / /sprul pa'i gzugs kyisa'agro don dpag med mdzad/ /'jigs byed chen pos 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing/ /srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad de/ /srid pa'i chu bo skems shing bdud rnams 'joms/ /srid pa'i rlung gis mi ga ldo thugs rjes mgon/ /rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/— gong bzhin nang mchod 'bul/ dngos grub blangs la yi ge brgya pas bzod par gsol/ phyogs skyong bcu dang mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtorama'ang phul la/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa'i bar du byas nas/ ma rnyed yongs sumatshangadang / sogs dang / rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras/ /mchod 'os lha dang tshangasapa sogs/ /'jig rten skyong rnams cho ga 'dis/ /bya ba nongs nams bzod par mdzod/ dzaXhūX baX hoX ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bdag nyid la thim se gol cha gtogs cing / tseX( ga smo ga smo swa bhā wa nāX/ zhes pas 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams dgyes po dang bcas te rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ thun mtshams thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral par spyod cing / de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa dang bzlas brjod la brtson pas de thams cad kyang spros med kyi ye shes mchod la reg pa'i phyir 'di nyid rgyud las 'byung ba'i rim pas rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom par bya ste/ rim gnyis kyi ye shes brtan pa na rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pas 'bras bu mchog la sbyar bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang ye shes kyi stobs rnyed nas rang gzhan gyi don —14—

du 'phrin las rab 'byams rnams kyang sgrub par bya'o/ /ma lus bdun sde klad pa 'gems byed pa/ /gang 'di srid gsum g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /bla med rgyal thabs mchog gyur deng 'dir speg/srid las rgyal 'dod rnams kyis 'di long shig /'dir 'bad dge bas mtha' dag 'gro 'di yi/ /'ching ba gcod byed de yi snying rje che/ /byang chub mchog la myur bar 'dren mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan/ tsho gtum po'i go 'phang myur thob shog /dpal ldan gtum po khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba lha dgu'i sgrubathabs bdud las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba 'di yang / sems can mang po la phan par mthong nasargyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nye bar sbyar nas bskul ba po dang yi ge pa ni sde snod 'dzin pa shākya bstan 'dzin no// // ma ṅga la// zhus dag /—15—

cho ga rdo rje rol ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/tseX( khyu sti/ sems kyi rdo rjer ba6ga kyang mi g.yo ba/ /gzung 'dzin dri lan mar bcas rdo rje bzhi/ /sgyu mas rmongs gang dbang bzhi'i chu thigs kyis/ /rnam par gso mdzad dpa' bo gang des srungs/ /de la slob dpon dam tshig dang ldan zhing bsnyen pa yongs su dag pas/ slob ma rjes su bzung bar 'dod na de'i bya ba ni 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ sa'i cho ga dang / sta gon du gnas pa dang / thig tshon gyi bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor mngon par sgrub pa dang / dam tshig gi gtor ma 'bul ba dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blangs pa dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba dang /rjes kyi bya ba'i rim pa rnams so/ /de ltar brgyad las dang po ni/ dkyil chog rdo rje 'phreng ba las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas yo byin rlabs spyi dang 'dra/ de rjes bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sar sa lha'i tshom bu mchod gtor dang bcas pa bsham/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rus sbal gyi steng du/ pad zla'i gdan la paX las sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can/ phyag g.yon pas gser gyi bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas pa rang gi dpung pa'i rtsa bar thal mo mdzad pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX lkoX badzra arghaX swāhā/ dzaXhūX baX hoX oX pri thi lī pukhye pra titsā baX hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du sha lta'i bar du sbyar/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang/ /—16—

sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur/ shwakya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde/ /bcom nas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /gtum chen drag po mchod pa yi/ /sna tshogs rin chen 'dzin pa'i sa/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang gyur gyi/ /rdo rje 'dzin bdag dkyil 'khore 'bri/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khore gyi 'a sa ci bde bar gyis shig dza : ba ho sa'i phyogs gcig tu bzhugs par gyur/nor 'dzin ma lhag par gnas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi gnas thams cad dri bzang gis byugs te/ lha gnas dgur thig le'i zlum po tshom bur bcas pa dgod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor ro/ /bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ya las rlud gi dkyil 'khor ra/ zhes pa nas/ padma 'dab brgyad pa/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed/ de'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la hū yig rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das khro bo gtum po sku mdog mthing ka iṇḍa ni la zhes pa nas/ ngo bor dag pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin/ shar du mi g.yo ba dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa/ lto ru mi g.yo ba ser po rin po ches mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu mi g.yo ba dmar po padmas mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang du mi g.yo ba ljang khu sna tshogs utpa las mtshan pa'i ral gri 'dzin pa/shar lhor gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo 'khor los mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa/lho nub tu phra ma rdo rje ma ser mo rin po ches mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa/ nub byang du 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo padmas mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa/ byang —17—

shar du phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu utpa las mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa/ khro bo bzhi po rnams nas dkyil 'khor la bstod pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin no/ /rang gi snying gar pad zla dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hāX las 'od zer 'phros 'og min gyi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa' gtum po lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/zhes pa nas/ gnyis su med par thim gyi bar mngon rtogs bzhi no/ /de nas mchod pa rnams/ tseX( āX bigha nu ta sma da ya ༷ phaṭa/ gyis bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ bla med spyi dang mthun par byin gyis bsas nas/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa bhaṭa rā ga sa pā ri wa ra sad ka ra ya pu rgyuX pra titsā swāhā/ añtsa ma ṇaX/ pro kṣa ṇaX/ argha rnams kyis chu bzhi phul/ o shrī tsaṇḍa sogs kyi mthar/ pursha nas shaga'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ oX badzra sa twa su/ zhes pa nas/ bde ba chen pos thugs rgyud gang gi bar sgrub thabs bzhin te lha lhag par gnas pa'o/ /lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa bcu dang / /las thams cad pa'i bum pa ste bcu gcig gam/ ma rnyed na rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis kyis kyang rung ste/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du bhuX las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba mchu 'phyang ba lha'i gos kyis mgul chings dang dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis gang ba'o/ / dung chos steng du bzhag ste/ oX āXhāX/ ye shes bdud rtsi lngas gang bar gyur/ hāX me tog gi phreng ba bcing ba'i rdo rje bzhag rla/ oX ta bhe ta bhe ma hā ta bhe swāhā/ lha'i chu dza gaṅgā bkug ste 'dres par gyur/ bum pa bcu yod na dbus kyi gnyis la gtso bo yab yum gzhan rnams la phyogs mtshams kyi lha brgyad bskyed/ bum —18—

pa gnyis yin na rnam rgyal du dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs pa dang / las bum du slar yang mi g.yo ba ljang khu bskyed pa yin te/ de yang / rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su chos 'byungadakar po'i nang du nas/ 'dab ma brgyad pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das khro bo gtum po mthing ka sogs dang / shar du mi g.yo ba dkar po/sogs gong dang 'dra ba las/ byang dang las bum du mi g.yo ba ljang khu zhes 'don pa spo/ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs te bstim pa yang gong gi lha sta gon bzhin no/ / bum pa'i mtshan ma rnams kyang rigs lnga dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i ngo bor gyur/ ngu bye nas/shabha'i bar gong bzhin mchod/ lha rnams dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu 'dres par gyur/ lag pa g.yon pas me tog gi 'phreng ba nas bzung ste/so so'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig la sogs pa ci rigs pa bzlas te/ me tog dkar po bdun gzhug par bya'o/ /las bum gyis bum pa thams cad la bsangs te/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs thams cad bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/hūX zhes brjod de/ dung chos kyi chu bum par blug par bya'o/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o//sta gon gyi rjes chog ni/ de nas gong bzhin dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod byas la/ bdug spos thogs te/ dpal ldan mi g.yo gtum pa'i lha/ /zhe sdang rdo rje ma dang ldan/ /brtse ba'i stobs kyis 'gro don du/ /'khor lo bdag ni bri bar bgyid/ /mchod pa'i don dang dbang bskur na/ /'gro ba'i don la gzhol ba yi/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro mas/ /rab tu dgyes pa mdzad pa'i rigs/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan rnams/ /bdag la 'dir ni dgongs su gsol/ /gtum po drag —19—

po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /'gro ba'i don du bri bar bgyid/ rdo rje 'dzin pa che ge bdag /ji ltar nus pas mchod bgyid de/ /slob ma rnams dang bdag la yang //rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /dkyil 'khor bar bcas thams cad kyis//nges par brtag par rigs pa lags/ /khyed cag sems can don mdzad pa'i/ /rang gi dam bca' dran par bajodi/ ces lan gsum gsol ba btab pas legs so zhes gnang ba spyin nas de nyid du mi snang bar bsam mo/ /bdag nyid kyi gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs pa dang / smon lam gdab pa dang / shis brjod rnams bya'o/ /de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas gnas pa la/ kye kye bzhin bzang rnams srid pa'i bde ba dag kyang yid brtan med pa 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can yin pa de'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsum gyi go 'phang kho na don du gnyer bas dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya'o zhes bsgrags nas/ skye rga 'chi ba na kra yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba'i/ /srid pa'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod/ /dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag stsole la/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ de nas skyabs 'gro sbyin pa ni/ ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /dam pa'i chos la'ang bdag skyabs mchi/ /dge 'dun la'ang mi phyed dad/ /zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos bya/ srog gcod ma byin len pa dang / /gzhan gyi bud med brdzun smra rnams/ /lnga pa chang gi btung ba nyid/ /thams cad sbrul bzhin dor —20—

bar bya/ zhes bslab gzhi lnga bzung / yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong spyin pa ni/ bdag gis sems can bsad mi bya/ /pha rol nor ni dbrog mi bya/ /bdag ni tshangs pa spyod pa spyad/ /brdzun gyi tshig kyang spang bar bgyi/ /myos byed chang gi btung ba ni/ /bdag gis gang du'ang btung mi bya/ /gar dang glu dang rgyan rnams dang/ /dga' ston bcas pa spang bar bya/ /khri stan mtho dang khri stan che/ /dus min kha zas spang bar bya/ /ji ltar gso sbyong yan lag brgyad/ /dgra bcom rjes su bdag gis slob/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas kyis gsungs ltar/ /rnam dag bdag gis bzung bar bgyi/ /de yis g.yon can bdud las rgyal/ /bla med sangs rgyas mchog thob bya/ /srid pas dub pa'i lus can rnams/ /kun gyi skyabs su 'gyur bar shog /srid pa de srid ji srid du/ /'khor gyi 'jig rten phan dga' ba'i/ /blo ldan skyes bu de gshegs skyes/ /legs pa rnams dang 'grogs par ye rdzog /ces lan gsum rjes bzlos byar gzhug bslab pa'i gnas lnga dang / yan lag brgyad pa 'di rab byung la ma byas kyang chog par sems so/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga mchog /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni/ /ye shes mnyam med yang dag brnyes/ /gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de/ /gang gi shākya seng ge sogs/ /mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde/ /mi zad chen po stobs chen bcom/ /'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /de —21—

nas sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes bzlos byar gzhug ste/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge ba rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /lan gsum/ slob ma gdong byang du phyogs pa'i gnas gsum du thig le bkod/ dpral par oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hāX rnams sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ slar yang gnas gsum du dro bzang gi thig le bkod la brtan par bya/ oṃ badzra pursha āXspreX sogs kyis mchod pa lnga phul/ hāX las byung ba'i so shing byin te/ oX badzra ha sa ha zhes dkyil 'khor gru bzhi par 'dor du bcu / so so'i dngos grub kyi ltas lung bstan/ khyor chu lan gsum du byin la/ oX khyoXbi shurnya dharmā sarba pa paX ni lca a gya ye rdzo dha ya sarba bi ka lhan a pa nā ya huX/ zhes brjod/dhīX dang ha las byung ba'i rtsa ku sha che chung sngas dang gdan gyi don du byin/ bsrung skud mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa snying po dang hūX bdun gyis byin gyis rlabs la dpung par bcing / yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya'o/ /de nas zab mo'i chos bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam la ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don/ /bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma yi/ /sngon chad sdig pa byas pa dag /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas pa smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di las/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams —22—

cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ /bdag nyid chen po kun kyi ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyod rnams theg chen du/ /sad ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni dong pas na/ /rang byung skal ba chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ni/ /bu kye da ni dkyil 'khor mchog /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang / /rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa/ /de kun nga la legs par smon/ zhes brjod/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o/ /nang bar rmi lam dris la/ legs na de ma thag tu dkyil 'khor gyi las rtsom/ gal te mi 'tshams pa rmi na bsrung ba dang sbyin bsreg gi las byas la slar yang dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i thig skud kha dog sna lnga pa dgu sgril dkyil 'khor gyi phyi'i tshad las sor brgyad kyis lhag pa/ rtsa sngags lan gsum gyis bsngags te/bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dang / sgrub grogs zhe sdang rdo rje mar gyur/thig skud lte ba'i thad kar drangs/ mig gnyis su ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba/ khro bo'i lta bas dkyil 'khor bkug ste/ thig skud la thim/ bdud rtsi lngas byug tseX( āXbha ga wān/badzra snyu traX a khyo khyu pra ya smo tsakra sru tra ṇa ya hūX/ zhes steng du gdabs pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha rnams bskul bar bsam/ a no n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmāX pa ra spa ra a nu pra bi ni/ sarba dharma a dun ta a nu ga ta sarba dharmaX zhes brjod cing spril nas g.yon —23—

pa'i rdo rje khu tshur bcings la/ dzaX yig gis slob ma la gtad/ oṃ sru tra sa mā yā ma ti kra ma hāX/ sems can kyi don du khyod kyi dus/ zhes brjod cing / ye shes kyi thig rtsa thig brgyad skya gdab par bya ste/ nub shar lho byang me dbang ldan/ /rlung srin rlung dbang me bden bral/ /srin po rlung ste slob dpon dang / /slob ma'i gnas su gnyis gnyis shes/ /tshangs thig gnyis dang logs thig bzhi/ /zur thig gnyis rnams gdab tshul yin/ de bzhin du las thig thig chen brgyad kyang gdab la/ dkyil 'khor khru gang nas khru lnga'i tshad du bya bar gsungs so/ /cha bcu drug rnam par rgyal ba nas brtsams te/ thig gi bya ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /de nas khro bo'i brnyes pa dang bcas pas sgo'i rtsa thig rnams dbye zhing hi hi zhes brjod/ phyir phyung nas/ oX āXhūX badzra muXswāhā/ thig skud kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ tshon rtsi rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rdul tshon sngon po mi g.yo ba nag po dang zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ /dkar po gtum po dkar po dang gti mug rdo rje ma/ /ser po gtum po ser po dang phra ma rdo rje ma/ /dmar po gtum po dmar po dang 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ ljang khu gtum po ljang khu dang phrag dog rdo rje ma rnams kyi ngo bor gyur/ rtsa sngags lan gsum gyis bsngags/ /thig gi skabs bzhin ye sheXs pa spyan drangs/ tseX( badzra tsi tra sa mā ya hūX gis bsngags shing / mtheb srin gyi mnye/ o badzra be gā kra ma ho/ zhes rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas dbus su song ste/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed/ /rang nyid gtum chen drag po yi/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs par bya/zhes brjod cing / dbang ldan nas re kha lnga sgo tshad gcig tsam slob dpon gyis bri bar bya ste/ nang nas nag ljang dmar ser dkar po'i rim pas so/ /phyi nas thig der tshon dgye bar bya ste/ tshon gyi las gzhan rnams zin pa na lha so so'i gdan la dbus su gtso bo'i phyag mtshan ral gri g.yas dang /—24—

yum gyi gri gug g.yon du 'bri/ /'dab ma rnams la'ang phyag g.yas kyi mtshan dgod par bya ste/rdzogs par zin pa na/ tseX( āXhuX gis tshon gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ /bum pa bcu yod na shar sgo'i g.yas su gtsor bum gnyis/ /gzhan rnams phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'god/bum pa gnyis kho na yin na shar sgo'i g.yas su rnam rgyal/ g.yon du las bum bkod la/ mtha' skor du mchod gtor dang rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan par bya'o/ /hūX zhes brjod pa dang gtso bo'i bsnyems pa dang bcas oX badzra spa ra ṇa khaX/ zhes brjod de rgyan rnams byin gyis rlabs/ bzhi pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas yo byin rlabs song nas/bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i nang du 'dug par bsams la/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ tshad med bzhi sgom pa yan chad mngon rtogs ltar maṇḍal mchod pa rdzogs par byas/ de nas rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gnas par bsgom/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying ga'i hāX yig las 'phros pa'i me lces/ zhes pa nas lan gsum gyi mthar/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyos su med par thim/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin rdzogs par bsgom/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūX gi 'od zer gyis gdod ma nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / sta gon gyi lha gtum po ye shes sems dpa' lha dgu'i sogs nas/ dzaXhūX baX hoX'i bar ye shes shes pa bstim pa'ang gong bzhi no/ /slar yang dbang gi nas/ don grub kyis dbu rgyan/ gyi bar dbang bskur rgyas btab kyang sgrub thabs bzhin du bya'o/ /de nas brtan par byas pa'i phyir las kyi rdo rje gzungs thag rdo rje lha so rbo'i gnas su bzung la/ slob dpon gyi g.yon pa'i khu tshur me tog dang bcas pas de sne nas bzung ste/ so so'i rang sngags bdun la sogs pa ci rigs par bzla'o/ /mthar dbus su bzung la yi ge brgya pa'ang ci rigs bzla/ de nas/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod —25—

pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ mchod pa byin gas spyi dang mthun par bya/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes rol pa las/ /kun bzang mchod yon rnam pa thams cad pa/ /mkha' mnyam kun tu mi zad 'byung ba 'dis/ /gtum chen khro bo'i 'khor lo mchog dgyes mdzod/ oX shrī tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sa pā ri pra wa ra sad ka ra ya argha pra titsā huX swāhā/ mchod yon zhes par zhab/sa bsil arghaX zhes par pa tuX/ de bzhin du/ zhal bsil dang / añtsa ma ni 'thor 'thung dang / pro kṣa ṇaX sbyar ro/ /kun tu bzang po'i 'byor pas yongs bzung nas/ /rnam mang me tog mchod sprin lhun stug pa/ /yid 'ong rig ma'i dga' ston gyur pa yang / /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/ oṃ shrī tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sa pā ri wā ra puṣṭhaX pra titsā swāhā/ tshig rkang gnyis pa la/dri zhim bdug spos sprin phung rab 'khrigs pa/ dhu pe:mun sel snang byed 'phreng ba rab 'bar ba/ ā lo ke: /gdung sel dri bzang chu rgyun rab bstar pa/ ga rnye: bcud ldan zhal zas ji snyed rab bkod pa/ ni wi te/snyan 'gyur sna tshogs rol mo rab sbyar ba/ shasta ces 'don pa spo/ oṃ badzra satwa su sogs sgeg sogs brgyad/ mchod lha bcu drug dang / rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang / 'dod yon lnga dang / bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / /gos zung la sogs pa 'bul/ /nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs dgos te/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX zhes pa nas oṃ āXhāX/ lan gsum gyis༄byin gyis rlabs/ skye ( kriṣṭha a tsa la huX phaṭa sogs so so'i mtshan sngags stus nang mchod phul/spros pa la dga' na dang por rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la 'bul ba dang / lha tshogs kyi gzhug tu chos skyong srung ma phyogs skyong dang rigs drug sogs la 'bul ba yang byas pas legs par 'gyur ro/ /de yang 'di ltar/rdo rje 'chang dbang na gā rdzu na dang / khwa pā ra dbang klu yi byang chub —26—

dang / shwakya srung ba chos kyi grags pa dang / /rin chen bzang po rin chen 'byung gnas dang / /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan rol ba'i rdo rje dang / /ye shes rgya mtsho nyi ma seng ge dang / /sangs rgyas dbyangs dang shākya seng ge yi/ /rgyal mtshan zhes dang nags kyi rin chen dang / /rong po rje dang blo gros chos skyong dang / khwakya mchog ldan sangs rgyas 'od zer dang / /rje btsun grol mchog chos sku lha dbang zhabs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /oX āXhāX a kwa ro lan mang du brjod/ mgon khyod bkres skyem mi mnga' yang / /'o thug bur khu sbrang rtsi'i chu//lhan skyes sbyar dang yongs gyur pa/ /rnam pa mang po'i btung bas mchod/ badzra bī pa thā/ bdud rtsi lnga'i bza' ba ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes lnga thob shog pañtsa a mṛ ta/ sgron ma lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi dam tshig gtso/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /rgyal ba'i sku mnga' yongs rdzogs thob par shog pañtsa pra dī pa/ sbrang rtsi bu ram 'bru yi chang / khreng las skyes dang bcos ma'i chang / khres rab rang bzhin myos byed lngas/ /gsang sngags lha la mchod par bgyi/ pañtsa ma da na/ bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang / /dmangs rigs mthar skyes las byung ba/ /bde chen bskyed byed rig ma lnga/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /pañtsa mu dra/ de nas bstod pa ni/ khyab 'jug phye mar 'thag par byed cing / sogs dang / 'od 'phro gtum pa'i spyan dang 'jigs rung za sogs dang /gtum po khros pa'i sogs kyi mthar/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /bgegs rnams bsdu zhing mthar mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan dpa' bo gcig pu'i —27—

sku/ /sku gsum gcig pa la phyag 'tshal/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis thabs dag gi/rang bzhin shes rab ral gri 'phyar/ /g.yon na shes rab dngos po yi/ /sdigs mdzub dang ni zhags pa 'dzin/ /sa 'og bdun po bskyong ba'i phyir/ /g.yon pa'i spyan gyis 'og tu gzigs/ /tshangs pa'i sgo nga bdun bskyod slad/ /g.yas pas steng gzigs la phyag 'tshal/ /de ni sa gzhi bsrung ba'i phyir/ /g.yon pa'i pus mo bzhag mdzad de/ /bdud rnams rab tu spong ba'i dbyibs/ /g.yas pa'i zhabs khyod la phyag 'tshal/ /mi bskyod mgon por de mtshon phyir/ /rin chen cod pan gos bkra ba'i/ /klubs shing zhe sdang rdo rje mar/ /snyoms zhugs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /longs spyod bskyed pa'i snying po yi/ /pho nya'i dgra 'joms mdung gi phyag /nyi ma bye ba las lhag 'od/ /dpal ldan gtum drag la phyag 'tshal/ /a yig gis ni stong nyid brjod/ /tsa yig gis kyang bde ba che/ /la yig gis ni de dag gcig /de phyir mi g.yo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /brgyad gnyis lon pas yongs gang ba/ /mtshan nyid bral ba'i skad cig dngos/ /chags bral gyis kyang mi g.yo nyid/ /de yi phyir yang khyod la 'dud/ /chags bral la ni gtum zhes bya/ /de ni bdud la drag po'o/ /bde ba'i rgyal po 'char ba ste/ /de phyir gtum drag khyod phyag 'tshal/ /brgyad po gang zhig 'char ba na/ /yul dbang lhan cig 'gro 'gyur pa/ /rdzogs pa'i kun du dga' ba'i thabs/ /de la mgo bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam pa kun kyi mchog ldan pa/ /phyag rgya chen po 'gyur med bdag /me long la ni pra phab bzhin/ /snang ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod la bstod kyang ma bstod de/ /—28—

mtshon par dka' yang dga' bskyed phyir/ /bdag gi bsod nams gang thob pa/ /de yis phal cher mi g.yor 'gyur/ zhes pas kyang bstod par bya'o/ /de nas rlung kha sbyor bzung ba sogs kun du spyod pa yid la dran par bya/ gru bzhi tshangs pa'i zhes pa nas brta ni swāhā/ zhes nga/'i bar dag dran dang bzlas pa bya/ lnga pa ni/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ oX snyu bhā wa nas/ mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oX āXhūX/ btags pas nang mchod phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ zhes pa nas/ kun 'grub shog ces pa'i bar brjod do/ /'jig rten pa'i gtor ma'ang skabs 'di nyid du 'bul bar bya'o/ /de nas gtso bo las rang 'dra ba gnyis pa chad de gtor ma'i las mdzad par bsam la/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol tu phyogs skyong dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gi cho gas phyi rol gtor ma btang la/ bgegs bskrad de nang du 'ong / na maXsarba ta thā ga ta su la li ta sogs kyis gtso bo la me tog dor/ oX badzra gi khyu ṭa ya sa mā ya pra be sha ya huX/ lan bzhis sgo dbye/ sa mā ya pra be sha ya sī/ me tog mgo la bzhag sems can rnams la dngos su thams cad kyi bka' drin stsole/ cig ces gsol ba btab/ de nas 'grub na spyin sreg gi mchod pa bya ste/ de'i cho ga ni 'od kyi snyem rab lta'o/ /drug pa ni/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du maṇḍal phul la/ bdag rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bor gyur/ oX tsakṣu banta wa rā ma na ya hūX/ gis mig dar/ āXkhaX wi ra hūX/ gis me tog snying gar rdo rje'i lte ba la huX nag po/ mgrin par padma la āXdamar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo la oX dkar po/ oX āXhāX/ kye dga' ba la dga' khyod su yin/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/༄/snying gar zla ba la rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ oX sarba yo ga tsitta utpa ta ya mi/ su ra te sa ma ya staX ho sirnyi badzra ya thā su khaX/ deng khyod de bzhin —29—

gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhi gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /ā khaX bī ra hūX/ 'dir spro na 'phreng ba las 'byung ba'i bskor ba dang / phyag 'tshal bdun po rnams bya'o//bsdus pa la mos na/ oX na ma ste hāX/ oX na mo me hāX/ oṃ na mo na ma hāX/ zhes bya/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ri gos su zhugs kyi/ jos khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di'o/ /gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la/ /'di smras na ni mgo bo 'gems/ /oX de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / /khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ste//rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par dus kyi bya ba byas nas dmyal bar lhung par 'gyur ta re/ de nas ye shes dbab pa ni/ rang skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang las ā yig las byung ba'i snang ba mtha' yas dmar po —30—
