padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur cigasnying gar laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa/ rdo rjes mtshan par nyi ma la hāX sngon po/ mgo bor paX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan par zla ba la ha dkar po/ mgrin par yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu g.yo ba'i ba dan gnyis kyis mtshan par zla ba la āX dmar po rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer rnams kyis sku dang gsung rdo rje'i lha tshogs thams cad sbyan drangs/ hūX ha āX yig rnams la thim/ rkang pa dag gi 'og nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor kyis sbar ba'i raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa yi ge ras mtshan pa 'od zer 'phro ba la gnas pa'i dzhaiXyig dmar pos 'degs bzhin par gyur pa'i dzhaiXyig gi 'od zer gyi tshogs rkang pa'i bu ga nas zhugs pa rnams dang / yi ge huX la sogs pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis lus mtha' dag kun nas gang bar gyur/ ā be ya stuX bha ya ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya hūX haX.āXdzhaiX rang gi 'dod pa'i don dang mthun pa'i dngos grub kyi ltas nam mkha'i kha dog kyang mthong bar mos/ slob ma dbang bskur skabs kha dog 'dri zhing lan 'debs/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams ji ltar de ltar shog /de yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /traX las byung ba'i me tog gi 'phreng ba/ oX ti ni badzra tri rdzog me bha wa shā shwa to me bha wa hri da ya me a dhi ti ni sarba sirnyi —31—

sme pra ya smo hūX ha ha ha ha hoX ā khaX bī ra huX/ pra tismo ku su mañdza linta tha ho/ zhes me tog dor/ oX pra ti grihā i maX sa twa ma hā bā la/ zhes me tog spyi bor bzhag oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par brtson/ /phye bas dbang po thams cad pa/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oX dzña na tsakṣu hāX āXswāhā/ kye rdo rje ltos shig rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs/ /dngos grub kun gyi phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyis/ /rdo rje padma mchog rol bas/ /gsang sngags rnams la sgrub pa gyis/ oX rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so/ /rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong / /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur/ sa ma ya ho ho hoX rig pa'i dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyir rol tu khrus kyi khang pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa sgo nub tu bstan pa/ dbus su sna tshogs padma'i gdan la bdag nyid gtso bo'i rnam pa dkyil 'khor la phyogs pas gnas par gyur/ oX āXtsaṇḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa sarba bisnro nu ta sā da ya huX phaṭa/dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros bdag gi lus la reg pas 'od kyi phung por 'gyur/ gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha —32—

mo'i padma ra thon te thams cad stong pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo nyid las skad cig gis hāX dang ral gri yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid gtum po chen po nag po shes job ma dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ spro na mngon rtogs bzhin zhal phyag gsal gdab bo/ /mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ /sangs rgyas thams cad khro bo gtum po'i rnam par spyan drangs te rang nyid la thim/ slar yang thug ka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshe/gas pa rig pa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ me tog la sogs pas mchod/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang / /yon tan 'gyung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de bzhin 'di la stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ /de bzhin ba/negs pa yab yum de rnams snyoms par zhugs pas/ /byang chub sems kyi rnam par gyur/ /gtso bo'i spyi bo nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung bas spyi bo nas dbang bskur te rang gi sgo gsum dri ma bral 'ing dag pa'i shel ltar gyur/ padma'i mtha' nas phyir phyung bas dbang stegs kyi gdan la 'khod/byang chub kyi sems kyi rdul phra rab tu gyur pa rnams kyang de bzhin gshegs pa rig pa'i lha mo sems dpa' sems ma khro bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur pa mkha' nang nas phyir phyung ste/ dbang bskur ba'i don du nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ gur gum dang tsan dan dang me tog la sogs pa'i char 'bebs par byed/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar 'dzin pa'i bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyis gang bas dbang bskur bzhin pa dang / lha mo rnams kyis/ tseX( bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun —33—

gyi snying la gnas/ /kun kyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyes byed bde ba chen po ste/ /de ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /oX phun tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ zhes sogs brjod/ shing gi yal gas bum chu blangs shing spyi bor gtor/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī huX/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bor nas dbang bskur/lus thams cad gang bde ba chen po myong zhing dri ma thams cad dag par gyur/chu'i dbang ngo / bdag nyid mi g.yo ba ser po'i 'khor los bsgyur pa'i ngo bo gyur/dbu rgyan stong pa'i ngang las rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po rin po che dang dril bu mdzin par gyur/ de zhu ba las rin po che'i dbus rgyan tu gyur/ oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ā bi sha ā bi sha a gya ༷ da ya huX phaṭa/ sngon bzhin chu dbang bskur ro/ /bdag nyid mi g.yo ba dmar po'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i ngo bor gyur/ dbang rdzas ral gri stong pa'i ngang las 'od dpag med dmar po padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i ral grir gyur/ oṃ ha na ha na mā ra ya mā ra ya sarba sha truX dzñā na khaṅge huX phaṭa/ sngon bzhi chu dbang bskur/ rang nyid mi g.yo ba ljang khu'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i ngo bor gyur/ dbang rdzas zhugs pa stong pa'i ngang las don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i zhags par gyur/ o gro sna gro sna ka ta ka ta katta katta sarba du giX pā she na banta banta ma hā sa tya te dharma ta swāhā/ yang gong bzhi chu dbang bskur/ rang nyid mi g.yo ba dkar po'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ he shrī bha ga wan kriṣṭha a tsa la sirnyi twaX huX phaṭa/gal te mi g.yo ba dkar po la me tog phog pa yin na/ sposa'i gnas su shwe ta sbyar ba la sogs pa —34—

shes par bya'o/ /bdag 'jug gi bya ba la gnas pa'i gang zag kyang bud med yin na dbang phyi ma bzhi po 'di dag las tha dad du bya ba'i tshul yang slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs su 'chad pa bzhin shes par bya'o/ /dbang 'di rnams bskur bas bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud mtha' dag nyan pa dang /bshad pa dang / sngags sgrub pa rnams la dbang bar 'gyur ro rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul la/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang/ /dam pa bdag la stsal nas ni/ /mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang / /sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid/ lan gsum/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ zhes pa nas/sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ ces pa'i bar gyis rigs lnga'i sdom bzung lan gsum/ gang gis bdag ni khyod drin las/ /rang dang gzhan don nus 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang / /thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol/ lan gsum/ dbang stegs kyi steng du bdag nyid hū dang rdo rje las byung ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rang snang gi yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ hu las byung ba'i rdo rje/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o/ /ā las skyes pa'i dril bu/ /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ khres —35—

rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bar bzhed/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis bdag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag mchog sems dpa' yi/ /dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan pa nyid/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod//gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /de na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ /ye shes phyag rgya'i byin rlabs nas/ /'dod pa kun la longs spyod pas/ /dngos grub thams cad sgrub par byos/ /rang nyid mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rig ma mā ma gī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bor mos la/ kha sbyor gyi rim pas rjes su chags pa dang bcas pa 'khyud pa tsam las byung ba'i bde ba rang rig pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don to/ /shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyis ni dbang du brjod/ de nas bum chu blangs te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun kyis phyag byas pa/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad sbyin par bgyi/oX sarba nas/ bde ba chen po myong ba'i bar gong bzhin/ bag chags dang bcas pa'i dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rang la gnyis su med par thim/ oX su pra tiṣṭha pa badzre swāhā/ purmye la sogs pas mchod/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / lha rnams ni ye shes lnga dang / tshad med pa bzhi'i —36—

bdag nyid do/ /snying po'i sngags lan gsum bzlas la/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyi/ /'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gi rgyud la mi g.yo gtum po khro bo'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig /de ltar na bum pa'i dbang thob pas sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku mngon du byas pa yin no/ /gsang dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ gzugs dang lang tshos brgyan pa'i shes rab ma phul bar mos/ khyod la 'di ni 'bul lags kyi/ /'dod don bde ba rab tu stsol/ /bdag ni 'dod pa'i bde don phyir/ /mgon po khyod kyi brtse bas bzung / zhes lan gsum/ gong bzhin mig dar bcing / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum snying po'i sngags bzla bzhin du/ rjes chags kyi snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems g.yon pa'i phyag gi mthe bong dang ming med kyi blangs te/ bdag gi lce la/ hūX phaṭa kyi rnam par bkod/ oX āXhūX/ bdud rtsi myang / ā ho ma hā su khaX/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/ de ring bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bskyed par bya yi/ gang gis 'das nga/ dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rab tu mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'gyur gyi/ 'on kyang khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du 'di smra bar mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / ral gri'i phyag rgya snying gar bas ste/ gal te smra na de yi tshe/ khren tu rno ba'i ral gri 'di/ khro bo gtum po'i phyag na gnas/ /gang gis dam tshig 'jig byed pa/ de la 'di —37—

yis mchog tu gcod/ /skye ba bye ba stong rnams su/ /mi rnams ral gri lag phyar bas/ /yan lag kun gcod mgo bo ni/ /gcod la gcig tu 'bad par byed/ /gal te dam tshig dral gyur na/ khyod kyang de ltar 'gyur ba yin/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ gong bzhin me tog phul/ gong bzhin gdong g.yogs bsal/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar byas pa blta ste/ de las byung ba'i bde ba ni gsang ba'i dbang ngo / /de ltar na gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du byas/ shes rab ye shes kyi don du ma rdzo phul/gsang dbang gi skabs ltar gsol ba btab/ dbang phyi ma 'di gnyis la mig dar 'ching ba mi mdzad do/ / slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos bdag nyid la rigs dang mthun pa'i phyag rgya gtad la/ bzang mo yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyi bsngags/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/rigs kyi bu khyod nyon cig de la dang po 'byud pa dang tsum pa la sogs pa phyi'i bya ba sna tshogs pa las thob pa'i bde ba ni dga' ba dang po'o/ /rdo rje dang padma yang dag par sbyor ba las mchog tu dga' ba'o/ /bsrub cing bskyod pa'i sbyor ba las byang chub kyi sems gtsug tor nas nor bu'i mgul bar son pa'i bar ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o/ /bde ba rgyun chad cing sngon bde bar snang ba dran pa ni dga' bral gyi dga' ba'o/ /de nas shes rab ma phyogs kyi gos can ma gcer bur gnas pa'i gsang ba'i chu skyes gsal bar byas te/ ci ste bu khyod 'di spro'am/ /nga las mi gtsang len pa ni/ /bshang gci rakta za —38—

ba dang / /bha ga'i mtha' nas 'jib byed dam/ zhes dris pa la/ khyod las dam tshig bza' bar ni/ /ci yi phyir na bdag mi spro/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /bdag gis mi mo kun gus bya/ /des kyang bdag nyid bde ba chen po la gus par rigs nas/ ā ho bdag gi padma ni bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa/ /bdag la dngos grub stsole mdzad ma/ /dal bus dal bus rab sbyor ba/ /padma ra bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ zhes smra zhing ltos pa med par lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ched du sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dang rig ma zhe sdang rdo rje mar gyur/ shes rab kyi mkha' zhes pa nas/ tseX( ā hūX zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byin gyis brlabs/snyoms par zhugs pa las lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ de nas 'dzag par sems pa na/ sems gcig pur ni rengs 'gyur nas/ /bde ba bskyed byed mi g.yo ba/ /mi tshor ba yi sems kyis bsgom/ /de ltar na shes rab ye shes dbang thob pas/ thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku mngon du byas/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du mkha phul/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba bto/ dngos po dang dngos med thams cad bral ba shes rab dang thabs yang dag par sbyor ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin dpal mi g.yo mgon po'i bdag nyid can dga' ba bzhi gcig pa'i sku/ srid pa dang zhi ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas pa'i thugs thar ba ni/'dod chags chen po las skye bar 'gyur te/ 'jig rten pa'i chags pa zad pa las zad par gyur pa mi g.yo ba'i don yongs su shes pas sangs rgyas kyi dngos grub rab tu 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod cing de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag /de —39—

ltar na dbang bzhi pa thob pas sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa bde ba chen po'i sku mngon du byas so/ /bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gyur/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ sloXsarba ta thā ga tā sirnyi sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa stunta ra ya mi badzra satwa hi hi hi hi hūX/ 'dir ni ngas khyod lung bstan bgyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu zhi ba'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las rab bton/ oX sarba ta thā ga ti sidha sa ma ya stuX bha rgyu wa swa/ 'jig rten kun tu thams cad nas/ /sems can kun la phan don phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ chos kyi gnas su rdo rje rin chen/ padma/ las kyi zhes pa rnams bcug shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin bdag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong bas/ /skyo med dogs dang bral ba yi/ /de ltar sems can don gyis shig /da ni khyod rnams dkyil 'khor gyi/ /slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams dag kyang dgongs par 'gyur/ /sems can kun la brtse don du/ /khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ /rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ /mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pa na/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /de ring khyod rnams bde bar gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med/ /mi thub tshugs pa yod min pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa'i —40—

sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu mthar grub bo/ /'di ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du kyis/ /'gro ba bde ba nyung la rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyod rnams phyin par 'gyur/ /deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su deng bdag 'gyu/ra/ /gtso bos ji ltar sogs dam tshig khas blang / bka' drin gtang rag gi don du maṇḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod/ bdun pa ni spyi dang mthun par dam tshig gsum gyi glu blangs/ /de nas cho ga'i bya ba rnams ni bdag sgom pa dang / gzhan la dmigs pa 'bogs pa'i khyad par ma gtogs bdag 'jug gi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ dang po yol bas bcad/ gsang gdams song ma thag yol ba'i nang du bcug /lha ngo bstan pa'i skabs su mngon rtogs dang bstun pa'i rgyas bsdud ci rigs pa spyod pa la/ dkyil 'khor chen po mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod bud med la dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ cod pan la sogs pa'i dbang rnams 'di lta ste/ rgyu ra'i thig le smin mtshams su byin la/ rgyal srid kyi btsun mo chen po'i gzugs su dmigs nas dar dpyangs bcings te/ 8( bha ga wa tī ā bi sha ā bi sha a gya hri da ya hu phaṭa/ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /ral gri'i gnas su lcags kyu gri gug byin la/ tse( karti ke sarba mā ra ṇi/ ma sa ka rta khro ༷ snye/ hūṃ lto / shaṃ / ༷ rte/ ༷ ༷ / / //rdo/༷/ rni hūṃ/ ༷ hūṃ// rte ༷snye —41—

gi mthar mig thur me long mda' gzhu zhi rjes gnang dang / bzhi pa'i rjes la rig ma'i brtul zhugs dang lung bstan gyi rjes su chos bshad dang/ 'jug tu dbugs 'byung ring po sogs rdo rje 'phreng bas kha skongs mdzad pa phyag len du snang ba shin tu ring legs pa'o/ /gsang dbang dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba la/ /dngos kyi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa ni rgyud nyid las gsal bar 'byung ba bzhin no/ /dbang bskur ba'i sngon dang tha mar sbyin sreg dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang / slar yang 'jig rten pa'i gtor mas mnyes par bya'o/ /phyi nas dkyil 'khor la sngar bzhin du mchod cing bstod pa dang / yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bzod par gsol ba/ bris sku la sogs pa g.yin dang gzhan la brtan bzhugs byas la/ rdul tsho ni gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ badzra muX zhes ye shes 'khor lo gshegs su gsol/ oṃ āXka ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX a tya nutpa sno twa ta/ oX āXhuX muX zhes 'don zhing chos thams cad skye ba med par mos pas dril bu 'brol zhing lag pa na gnas pa'i rdo rjes shar phyogs nas brtsams te thig lam nas gtso bo'i bar du dbye zhing / rdul tshon cung zad rang gi mgo bor blugs nas padma la sogs pa rnams dang / sgo dang zur rnams nas dbye bar bya'o/ /de nas skam pa'i phyag rgyas phur bu phyung la/ oṃ badzra gī 'e1 trī la ya/ sarba ki la na badzra dha ra a dzñā pa yā huX phaṭa hoX oṃ ru ru sbu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha sirnyi lo tsa ni sarba a rna spyo dha ni swāhā/ zhes pas phur khung du 'o mas gtor/ phur bu'i lha gshegs su gsol zhing khung bu bgang / de nas rdul tshon chu bor spyan 'dren pa spyi dang 'dra'o/ khyud sde'i rgya mtsho'i dbang bzhi'i yid bzhin nor/ /rdo rje'i tshig gi 'od zer ches gsal ba'ang / /mtha' dag skye bos nyer spyod ma nus—42—

pas/ /blos ldan don mthun gang dag 'dir zhugs kye/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bris pa las/ /bsod nams gang zhig 'dir thob pa/ /de las gtum po khro bo'i rgyal/ /mi g.yo mgon po nyid gyur cig /dpal gtum po khro bo chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje rol pa zhes bya ba 'di ni don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba dang / rgyud sde de nyid la mchog tu mos pa chen pos nye bar drangs te/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer brgyad pa la chos 'khor bsam stengs su sbyar ba las/ blo dman gyi don du phyis cung zad 'byer bde bar byas pa'o/ /dge bas bstan pa rin po che spyi dang /khyad par gtum po khro bo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ // zhus dag/ bkra shis//—

'dul byed ces bya ba bzhugs/tsho tshe spru sti/ dpag yas rgyal ba'i mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin par gus btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs gru chen legs bzung ste/ /byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i klong du 'jug par bya/ /de la dkyil 'khor chen po 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems sgom bzlas rnams spyi dang mthun par bya ba las/ 'askre1 ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi gnas gyur pa'i/ /'khor ba'i 'dam nas gtso bos drongs/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dang : sogs brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i skur gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i huX nag po de las bhuX yig cig spros pa mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor sngon po 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbyibs can du gyur/ yang paX gcig 'phros pa las/ de'i steng du padma 'dab ma bzhi pa zla ba'i gdan lnga dang bcas par gyur/ hāX las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bla ma dang yid dam gyi lha dang mkha' da sbyangs gang ba'i dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs te gdan la bzhugs par gyur/na mo gu ru khyuX dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can/ na mo badzra pā ṇi maṇḍa la de be khyuX shar du yi dam/ na mo budha ya/ lhor sangs rgyas/ na mo dharmā ya/nub tu dam chos/ na moXs dha ya/ byang du dge 'dun rnams so/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas—44—

thams cad dang / /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la/ /sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /lkoX sarba ta thā ga ta badzra pā ṇi maṇḍal de be khyuX arghaX pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pā tyaX añtsa ma naX/ me tog sogs la sngags kyi mgo 'dra ba la/ badzra punyu pu dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye huX/ de bzhi du/badzra dhu pe: ā lo ke: ga rnye: snu we te/ sha pta: lho sbyor/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /mchod pa bla na med pas mchod/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /'tshams med lnga dang nye ba lnga/ /mi dge bcu dang lci ba brgyad/ kha na ma tho la sogs pa/ /'phags pa'i tshogs la so sor bshags/ /'jig rten dge bcu ji snyed dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal dge 'dun bcas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas 'gro don mdzad/ /de dag la ni yi rang ngo / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing khams na/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ /ring po ma lon thams cad la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /'khor ba ji srid ma stongs par/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/ /dge bcu ji snyed spyod pa dang / /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi rnams dang /pha rol phyin pa bcu la sogs/ /byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag gi lus 'di ji srid du/ /len pa rdo rje slob dpon dang / /'khor lo chen po'i lha tshogs dang / /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa la/ /bdag yid dang bas dbul bar bgyi/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang / /'dod chags bral ba'i chos rnams dang / /tshogs kyi zhing gyur dge 'dun la/ /dad pa'i sems kyis skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog gi rang bzhin can/ /sems can kun la khyab par gnas/ /ma rtogs 'khor ra bar —45—

'khyams pa rnams/ /de dag don du sems bskyed do/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bcas pas/ /bslab dang slob par 'gyur ba yi/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims dang / /sdom pa'i tshul khrims ldan pa dang / /dge ba chos sdud tshul khrims rnams/ /yang dag blangs te gnas par bgyi/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas ni/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /mchod pa kun dang ldan par ni/ /dus kun du ni bde bar mnos/ /so so'am breng shas su lan gsum mo/ /rgyas pa la dga' na/ maṇḍal dang mchod pa khug ma/ bsangs sbyangs/ byin rlabs mchod pa'i tshigs bcad sogs kyang brjod do/ /sems can thams cad bde ba dang jo zhes pa nas/ gnas par gyur cig gi bar tshad med bzhi spyi mthun ltar 'don/ oṃ shu mya ta dzña na badzra swa bhā wa atpa ko ྅ haX/ lan gsum/ de dag ni sngon 'gro'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang sems huX yig mthing nag nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de las raX chad pa la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/huX chad pa las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag huX gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba dra ba gur bla re phyi rol ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor ra lor gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa huX huX phaṭa/ lan gsum/ gzhung las/ rlung dang chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du srung 'khor bsgom par bshad kyang da lta lag len la mi mdzad do//yang hūXlas e chad pa las chos kyi 'byung gnas phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs ka gyen du bstan pa/ rgya khyon dpag tu med par gyur/ hūṃ las yaX raX baX laX rnams chad chos 'byung gi nang du rim pas 'khod/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar —46—

po me lce gsum gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rje phyed pa bzhis mtshan pa'o/ /'dir bla ma smar chen po 'gyung bzhin lugs zlog tu bzhed do/ /'di nyid kyi gzhu pa las/lugs 'byung lugs zlog gnyis ka mi gsal mod/ gzhal yas khang gi gdan ma yin par rgyur gtong ba'i rigs la lugs 'byung lugs zlog gang byas kyang mi 'gal zhing / /bla ma'i man ngag nyid kyi phyir gnyis kar rung ngo / /nam mkha'i huX las bhuX zhig chad de/ 'byung ba bzhi la thim/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rten gyi dkyil 'khore gzhal med khang rjes 'brang dang bcas pa grub pa ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi'i sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po dang / dra phyed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab kyis bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi 'gram du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams 'khod pa/ sgo khang rnams kyi steng du/ zur bzhi nas ka ba rnams kyis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor padma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang / ri dwags kyi gzugs brnyan dang bcas pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng gtsang khang phyur bur gyur pa'i dbus kyi rtse mo rdo rje rin po che tog gis brgyan pa/ 'og gzhi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du khor yug nag po rim pa gnyis keng rus kyi 'phreng bas brgyan pa'i bar stongs kyi gzhi la dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs —47—

skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / shing dang / sprin dang / me dang / chu dang / mchod rten dang / klu dang / grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / ro dang / ro langs dang / sha za dang / srin po dang / bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs pas yongs su gang ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rgyan gyi rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i gzhal med khang chen po'i nang gi lha rnams shar dkar/ lto ser nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i steng du 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa/ mu khyud la gri gug dang / thod skam gyi 'phreng bas bskor pa/'khor lo'i lte bar sna tshogs padma'i steng du g.yas su tshangs pa dkar po dang /g.yon du brgya byin ser po kha bub tu gnas pa/ de gnyis kyi sogs phrag tu g.yas su zla ba dang g.yon du nyi ma'o/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams la shar du dri za pho mo/ lhor gshin rje pho mo/nub tu chu bdag pho mo/ byang du gnod sbyin pho mo rnams kha bub byin bcings su bsnol ba'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re'o/ /sgo bzhi'i sgo phugs kyi nang g.yas dang g.yon du zla ba'i gdan re re'ang grub par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ a ā i yī u mū ṛ grwa kla lī e i o au a a g.yas skor dang g.yon skor phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i steng du ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra wa la/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa snye/ g.yas skor dang g.yon skor phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /nam mkhar gnas pa'i rang sems hu yig sgra dang bcas pha8—

bzhin du nam mkha' nas babs te/ zla nyi'i bar du bzhugs/ de las thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ dpral ba la a yig gis mtshan pa/ de'i nang du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa thod par phyed tsam nub pa'i lte bar hu gis mtshan pa ni so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes so/ /de las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas tshur 'dus/ rdo rje thod pa sa bon dang bcas pa la thim pa ni/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /nyi zla sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sangs rgyas ga dma'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis rjes su gnang zhing byin gyis rlabs pa/ sku mdog mthing nag dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing / glog 'phreng ltar rno zhing tsha ba'i kha rlangs 'byin pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal mthing nag shin tu khros shing rngam pa/ a la la'i gad rgyangs 'khrug sgra ltar sgrog pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po yid tsam 'dzum zhing ba 'ad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po ya sos ma mchu mnan zhing ma dra5sa pa rnams zhe la mnan pa/zhal re re la me stag gi phung po ltar dmar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang / mi bzad pa'i mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ zla ba nya gang ba ltar rab tu rgyas pa'i bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor khro gnyer bsdus shing / sma ra ag tshom smin ma me lhar 'bar ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing rtse mor rdo rjes brgyan pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas kyi dang pos 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa 'phyar zhing gsor ba/ g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub kyis gdug pa can ma lus pa —49—

sdigs shing gsod pa/ phyag bar pa gnyis yum la 'khyud tshul gyi thal mo brdabs pas ri rab gzhig cing / bdud kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag rlag par mdzad pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis kyis klu rgyal gdug pa sbrul nag po'i gzugs can re re sked pa nas btsir te/ sta zur g.yas g.yon gyi thad ka nas 'dzin zhing mgo bo rtsa zhal du gsol nas mjug ma zhabs gnyis kyis 'og tu mnan pa/ sku sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas tshangs pa dang zla ba mnan zhing / g.yon brkyang bas brgya byin dang nyi ma brdzis pa/ stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris brla'i steng du 'phyang zhing / dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs can/nor rgyas dang dung skyong rgyal rigs ser pos dbu rgyan/ dga' bo dang gnyen dga' rje rigs dmar pos snyan cha/ padma dang chu lha bram ze'i rigs dkar pos dpung rgyan/ stobs rgyu dang rigs ldan dmangs rigs nag pos tshangs skud dang / ske rags byas pa ste gdug pa'i sbrul rnams kyis sku la brgyan pa'o/ /thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ mi ma rga'i do shal/ rin po che'i cod pan la sogs pa cha byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de ltar rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la sangs rgyas kyi gos sngon can mi bskyod pa sngon po/ g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas bzhengs pa ni ye shes sems dpa'o/ /de'i yang thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa nye ba la hū gis mtshan pa me 'bar ba ni/ ting nge 'dzin —50—

sems dpa'o/ /gtso bo bcom ldan 'das kyi pang du yum lha mo mdzes ldan ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig khro ma 'dzum gyi rnam pa can/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa dmar gyis gang ba 'dzin pas gtso bo'i mgul nas 'phyud pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing spyan gsum pa/rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing / g.yon yab kyi sku la 'khril ba/ bde ba chen po'i dga' bas brgyan pa'o/ /de nas 'khor gyi lha tshogs spro bar bya ste/ yab kyi gsang gnas huX las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa huX gis mtshan zhing rtse mor phaṭa kyis brgyan pa/ yum gyi mkha' aXlas byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa aXyig gis mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis bskul bas thugs ka'i huX las 'od 'phros/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drang zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes yongs su zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa byang chub kyi sems dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyi phung por gyur/ de nyid cha bcu drug pa gnyis su gyur/ cha brgyad thig le dkar dmar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rnam pa bzhir gyur/ cha bzhi yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje dang / bzhi yongs su gyur pa las thod par gyur/ thod khrag gi nang du rdo rje phyed nub tsam cha bzhi mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi la 'khod/ oṃ badzra spa ra ṇa huX phaṭa/ lan brgyad/ shar du khro bo chen po bdud las rgyal byed sku mdog dkar po phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje/ g.yon dang po 'khor lo'i lte ba —51—

nas yar bton pa'i mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa la/ yum 'od zer can ma dkar mo g.yas sbu gri 'phyar zhing / g.yo thod khrag 'dzin pas 'byud pa'o/ /lho phyogs su khro bo gzi brjid mtha' yas sku mdog ser po/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje 'phyar zhing / g.yon rin po ches mtshan pa'i dbyug pa bsnams pa/yum mdangs ldan ma ser mo g.yas rdo rje zangs gri dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khrud pa/ gshin rje pho mo zhabs kyi 'og tu gnon pa'o/ /nub tu khro bo rngam pa'i sgra sgrog sku mdog dmar po/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos rdo rje 'phyar zhing / g.yon dang pos padma dmar po dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ 'dir padma dmar pos mtshan pa'o/ /sprul zhags zhes phal cher 'chad kyang / sprul zhags la padmas mtshan pa mi bde bas dkyus ltar bya'o/ /yum sgra dbyangs can ma li khri'i mdog can g.yas dgra sta dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas 'byud pa/ chu lha pho mo zhabs kyis gnon pa/ byang du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang khu/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang po rdo rje rtse lnga 'phyar zhing / g.yon dang po sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con 'dzin pa/ yum rlung 'byin ma sna tshogs mdog can nam ljang khu phyag g.yas 'khor lo dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas 'byud pa/ de ltar khro bo bzhi po thams cad phyag 'og ma gnyis thugs kar sdigs mdzub bsnol ba'i phyag rgyas rang rang gi yum la 'byud pa/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris dang/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang / sbrul gyi rgyan dang / mi mgo skam rlon gyi do shal la sogs pa rgyan dang cha byas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po nyid dang mtshungs shing / zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /khro mo bzhi po rnams —52—

kyang gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan can thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal 'phyang ba/g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis rang rang gi thabs dang sbyor ba sogs cha byad thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /oX spa ra ṇa huX phaṭa/ lan brgyad brjod/ mkha' nang du gnas pa'i thig le cha lhag ma brgyad phyir spros te/ sgo bzhi'i zla ba'i gdan rnams su 'khod pa sgo skyong rnams su gyur pa ni/ shar gyi sgo khyud kyi nang gi g.yas su rdo rje lcags kyu dang / g.yon du lcags kyu ma ste gnyis kar yang sku mdog dkar ba/ phyag gnyis lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /lho'i sgo khyud kyi nang gi g.yas su rdo rje zhags pa dang / g.yon du zhags pa ma ste gnyis kar yang sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub gyi sgo khyud kyi nang gi g.yas su rdo rje lcags sgrog dang / g.yon du lcags sgrog ma ste gnyis kar yang sku mdog dmar ba phyag gnyis lcags sgrog 'dzin pa'o/ /byang gi sgo khyud kyi nang gi g.yas su rdo rje dril bu dang / g.yon du dril bu ma ste gnyis kar yang sku mdog ljang khu/ phyag gnyis dril bu 'dzin pa dang / sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /de thams cad kyang stag spags dang / sbrul rgyan can yab rnams g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang dang / yum rnams g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'o/ /sgo skyong 'di rnams kha sbyor gyi sku can ma yin/ yab yum so sor zhal sprod du bzhugs pa yin/ 'di dag la thig le las so so'i phyag mtshan du gyur nas bskyed pa'i lugs yod pa ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de ltar snyen ra bco brgyad po thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa khro gnyer bsdus pa —53—

skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing / gdul dka' ma lus pa 'dul bar mdzad pa/ khro bo dang khro mo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs shing sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las mdzad pa'o/ /de dag ni dam tshig gi bzhin go gyib /rdo /na/༵ /༵ ༵ 'i ri bdag spyu ༵ lgi ༵ rnyi ༵la ༵༵༵ // ༵ dang / phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin g.ye/gas pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa rnams ro mnyam du 'dres te/ dpal 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'bor du gyur pa badzra sa ma dza ma lus sems can: nas/bcom ldan 'khore bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang : zhes pa nas/ mchod pa bla na med pas mchod kyi bar/ gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar phyag mchod bya/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ dza : ba hoganyis su med par thim/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la o dkar po/ mgrin ༵rdo zer ༵༵/sang hūṃ / sa thams cad kyi ༵ dzhai~Xrdo ༵/sa kyi byi// ༵༵sa dhi / nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur bsdus te/ gnas gsum gyi yi spya dhi~X sna ༵༵ ༵/༵ ༵sbyi sa cad dbang dhi je rdo kā dzhai/ 'phros / gshed dod rig/sa~X ri / /shā ༵ ṭā ༵ sa ༵ //ca~X pya rgyas dhi ༵rdo ༵ ༵ ༵sa spre da~X rnams ༵ bad/ rdi rigs shes par bya ba'i phyir dbang bskur du gsol/ lko sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi —54—

khri phu chu maX/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje dang 'khor lo la sogs pa'i mtshan ma dang lhan gcig ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa phyag tu bsnams pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūX/ zhes gsungs shing / dbang bskur bas byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis sku lus gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ gtso 'khor thams cad la dbang rtags su rgyal ba mi bskyod pa re res dbu rgyan par gyur/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ gsal zhing dwangs la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung / spa brjod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams snang stong gnyis su med par thos/ yang tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin/ arghaXngu nas shabha'i bar gyi mchod pa phul/ hūX de nas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /rdo rje me dpung 'od dang ldan//de nyid mkha' dang 'byung ba las/ /dur khrod brgyad dang ldan pa'i gnas/ /huX thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yi/ kha sbyor nyi zla'i 'phro 'du las/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /'khor lo'i bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod/ thabs dang sogs tshigs rkang gong ma gnyis 'dra ba las/ dri za gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /bdud las rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshin rje gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje gzi brdzid phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chu lha gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rngam pa sgra sgrog phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gnod sbyin gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje las la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /huX 'byung ba lnga'i bdag —55—

nyid che/ /mdzes ldan 'od zer can ma dang / /mdangs ldan sgra dbyangs rlung 'byin te/ /skyed byed las kun sgrub la bstod/ /bka' nyan pho nya las mdzad pa/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /'gugs shing sdud dang sdoms dang 'dzin/ /mtha' 'dul las kun sgrub la bstod/ nang mchod dmigs nas/ oX badzra a khru ta ku ṭa li ha na ha na hūX phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shu khyu/ sarba dharma swa bhā wa shu khro3haX/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu yaX las rlung de'i steng du raX las me/ de'i steng du kaX las thod skam gyi skyed pu gsum/ de'i steng du āXlas thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las glang po che'i shabyang du ha las rta'i sha de rnams kyi steng na/ shar du be las dri chen/ lhor ra las rakta/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las klad pa rnams ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ de rnams kyi steng du oX mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las byung ba'i zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa/ hūX de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba kha dog dmar por gyur/yang huX las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ rdo rje huX ldan la thim/ de zla ba la thim/ de oX la thim/ oX yig dam rdzas la thim pas kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oX āXhuX lan mang du brjod/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du i dam a mṛ ta mahā swa da hūX/ phyag na rdo rje mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma/ /grub thob sa ba ri dang dza ba ri/ /de ba puṇḍa gar lo chos kyi —56—

bzang / /rin chen dngos grub smar ston chos rgyal dang / /sgang ston sher bla jo sras sher 'bum dang / khug sbug sngags 'chang 〈khru ston shes rab grub zer〉gru ston rdo rje seng / /bcom ldan rig ral zhang sgom zhig 〈rin rgyal〉po dang / sangs rgyas 〈'jam dbyangs〉dpal dang kun mkhyen dge 'dun bzang / rgyud 'dzin sangs rgyas brag dkar sems dpa' dang / bsod nams rgyal mtshan rje btsun rdo rings dbon/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /'khrid lung bshad rgyud bla ma rnams la mchod/ i dam: sogs sbyar/ yang chos kyi bzang : zhes pa'i rjes la/ gshen rigs ston pa rin chen dngos grub dang / /chos kyi rgyal mtshan shes rab rdo rje dang / /thub pa shes rab brtson 'grus seng ge dang / /chos rgyal shes rab grub ste smar ston drug /rin chen seng ge mkhas mchog rin chen grub//rgyal ba chos grub bka' bzhi rin rgyal ba/ /dkon mchog dpal bzang don grub rgyal mtshan dang / /bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal ldan chos bzang sogs/ dbang rgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ yang brtson 'grus seng ge'i rjes la/ chos kyi rgyal po zhes te smar ston lnga/ /gan chag dbang rgyal mjims chen rgyal mtshan dpal/ /kun mkhyen chen po sa bzang paṇa chen sogs/ /byin rlabs brgyud pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ brgyud pa 'di'i 'phros 'khrid dang tshig brgyud ni 'phags pa kun bzang/ brag dkar byang sems/ sems dpa' bsod nams rgyal man zhe/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnams/ rje btsun grol mchog rje lha dbang grags pa rnams so/ /tse( nī la sbar dha ra badzra pā ṇi ༵sa dhi pa~X dod nghru skabs 'dir 1 rlo// sngu sa ༵ //shi thu / / dho dzhai rdo na nā dhi ༵ rnyi —57—

pa ta ye i dam nī lwa ba ra dha ra sha rī ra/ badzra pā khri lhu da ta ya ya/ sa ma ti/ kra ma ti/ uta pa dwa na/ bha li sgri ti hu hu/ zhes pa 'di gtso bo'i rgyun sngags so/ /o pa ra kra mā ya phaṭa/ kri twan ta ya phaṭa/ kri tan ta ru pā ya phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇa ya phaṭa/ /bi dha ra ṇa ya phaṭa/ kro dha satwa nā ya phaṭa/ nī la ba sa nā ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la ya phaṭa/ de dag ni khro bo yab bzhi yum bzhi'o/ /o ha ra ha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ hū phaṭa/ sgo ba bzhi'i 'o//da tshinta/ dhinta dhi dzñā/ /ha sa ha sa/ nā sha ya na sha ya hu phaṭa/ sgo ma bzhi'i sngags te/ bsnyen pa'i skabs gtso bo la bzhi 'bum/ 'khor la bzhi khri/ zhes 'chad pa dang / yang dkyil 'khor 'bri ba sogs kyi don la/gtso bo la bzhi khri/ 'khor la bzhi stong gis kyang chog par 'dod pa'ang yod mod kyang / sngar dkyil 'khor gzhan gyi bsnyen pa ma song na bzhi 'bum nyid bzla ba legs/ yang bsnyen pa'i dus gtso bo'i rgyun bzlas kho na byed cing / bsnyen sgrub sgrel ba'i dus gtso 'khor sgrags te bzla'o zhes 'dod pa'ang yod mod kyi/ lag len du/ oṃ nī lā ba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi mahā kro dha satwa hu phaṭa/ces pa'i nye snying bzhi khri sogs ji ltar 'os pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ o nī lā ba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi hri da ya mahā kro dha satwa hu phaṭa/ ces pa la 'bru 'bum song na rab/ ma tha yang bzhi 'bum bzla'o/ /de nas gtso bo'i rgyun sngags kyang bzhi 'bum mam bzhi khri sogs bzlas kyang legs mod kyi/ de bas kyang rtsa sngags yongs rdzogs nyid bzla ba bzang ste/ bzlas pa'i gtso bo snying po dang rtsa sngags gang rigs shig la byed rgyu yin pas so/ /de la rtsa sngags ni/ ta du thā/ bho bho pa na nā ga a dhi pa ta ye/ i dam nī lā ba ra dha ra sha rī ra/ badzra pā ṇi hri da ya ya/ sa ma ti kra ma ti/ ma ku la/ uta pa ta na/ bha wi bya ti/ ta du thā/ budha ba dha/ bi bzhi bi bzhi/ ma ti kra ma thā/ ha ra ha ra nā —58—

ga nāX/ pra ha ra pra ha ra nā ga nāX/ tshinta tshinta nā ga hri da ya ni/ snyan dha dhi na dha nā ga man ṇi bi shirnyant+ra/ nā ga sha rī ra ṇi/ bi sgro ṭa ya nā ga nā ya ni/ ta du thā hūX phaṭa/nā ga bi ra cha ya hūX phaṭa/ nā ga ud sa da na ya huX phaṭa/ nī la ba sa na ya huX phaṭa/a pra ti ha ta ba la pa ri kra ma ya huX phaṭa/ kri tan tā ya huX phaṭa/ kri tan ta rū pa ya hūX phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇa ya huX phaṭa/ tru sa nā ya huX phaṭa/ ku lha ṇḍa uta sa ta na ya hūX phaṭa/pre ta pi shā tsa bi nā sha ka rā ya huX phaṭa/ yakṣa a pa sma ra bi nā sha ka ra ya hūX phaṭa/ha sa ha sa/ dha ra dha ra/ mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/ nā sha ya/ nā sha ya/ sarba bi sthān/ bi nā sha ka ra ya huX phaṭa/ sarba sha krus sang gha bi nā sha ka ra ya hūX phaṭa/ oṃ nī lāX ba ra dha ra/ badzra pā ṇi dha ra dzñā pa ya ti snya hā/de ltar ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar yang gong bzhi mchod bstod bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad dpal phyag na rdo rje rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de thams cad bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ srung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa yang lha bco brgyad la thim/ sgo ma bzhi dang khro mo bzhi gtso mo la thim/ sgo skyong bzhi dang khro mo bzhi 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi thugs kar thim/ bcom ldan 'das ma yang gtso bo'i thugs kar zhugs/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i sku snang stong bde ba'i rang bzhin can de yang 'od gsal ba'i dbyings su thim/ zhes cung zad mnyam par bzhagaslar yang rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ dpral par lkoX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag ces sogs—59—

dang / gzhan yang byang chub tu bsngo ba sogs ji ltar 'os pa byas te/ thun mtshams la 'jug go /thun mtshams su ga rtang ma gtong bar 'dod na/ gtor ma bcu gsum mam/ lnga'am/ gsum mam/bsdu na gcig bsham zhes gong ma rnams gsung pa ltar yin la/ klu la dkar gtor cig bsham na legs/ gzhan dmar gtor bya/ mchod pa'ang bshams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/hu zhu ba las 'byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri myong/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' klas par 'gyu/ra/ oṃ badzra argha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pā byi añtsa ma na/ o badzra puspe ā hū de bzhi du shabha'i bar du sbyar/ oṃ badzra bhaṇḍa ra ṇi ta: sogs/gtor ma byin rlabs gong du bshad pa'i nang mchod byin rlabs dang 'dra/ gtor mgron bskyed tshul la phyi rol maṇḍal mchod pa mchod pa dang 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas/ dbus su padma 'dab brgyad la lha bco brgyad/ de'i phyi rol dma' bar padma dmar po 'dab brgyad la klu brgyad/ de'i phyi rol sna tshogs 'dab ma bcu drug la/ gnod spyin brgyad dang bdud brgyad de dam can nyer bzhi de ltar bskyed par 'chad mod/ de ltar byas kyang legs mod kyi/ dkyus kyi nyams len la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs skad cig gis bsgoms nas/ klu dang gnod sbyin bdud sogs dur khrod du gnas par bsgoms te/ gtor ma phul ba'i chog go /de nas maṇḍal mchod pa'i gtor ma dang/ phyi rol gtor ma dang / rgyun 'phyer gtor chog ste gsum po dbye ba phyed dgos shing / dkyil 'khor chen po'i nang gtor rgyun 'byer dang 'dra'o/ /'dir de lta bu'i dbang byas nas/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mdun gyi nam mkhar chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i steng dbus su gzhal med khang gdan dang bcas pa/ mtha' skor dur khrod chen —60—

po brgyad/ phyi rol bsrungs ba'i 'khor los bskor ba dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ ta du thā/ bho sgo nas/ sgri ti hū hu/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje yab yum bzhugs par gyur/ o pa ra kra mjo nas/ ba la ya phaṭa/ shar du khro bo bdud las rgyal ba dang 'od zer can ma/ lhor gzi brjid mtha' yas dang mdangs ldan ma/ nub tu rngam pa sgra sgrog dang sgra dbyangs ma/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang / rlung 'byin ma rnams bzhugs par gyur/ o ha ra ha ra nas/nā sha ya hu phaṭa/ sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu yab yum rnams bzhugs par gyur/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la klu dang / gnod spyin bdud de drag po sde gsum rnams 'khod pa ni/ phu yig las byung ba'i klu brgyad dang / kṣa yig las byung ba'i gnod spyin brgyad dang / hū yig las byung pa'i bdud rgyal brgyad kyang 'khod par gyur/ steng gi nam mkha' la rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang / /sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpal 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor kyi lha tshogs la/ bla ma dkon mchog dam can srung ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dza dza : ba ho dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hū/ spros pa la mos na dbang bskur rgyas btab kyang byed de/ dam can rnams la gsang bdag phyag gnyis pa res dbu brgyan/ bsdu na mi dgos/ o ātwa ratna ku ru hu/ te dzo ba ling ta kha kha ji hi kha hi/ lan bdun/ oṃ ā bzhi dharma sa ṅgha hū/ ba ling ta kha kha 'a hi 'a hi/ zhes lan gsum/ argha: nas/ sha lta'i bar gyi mchod/sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ sogs sho lo ka snyag dang / mgon po thugs —61—

rje che ldan pa/ sogs gsum gyis bstod/ bla ma dam pa dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis bdag la byin gyis rlob cing thugs rjes bzung ste/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba bto/ gtor ma dang po'o/ /ta bya thā bho ste1 nas/bya ti hū hū i da ba li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ lan bdun/ tse( pa ra kra mngu nas/ nā sha ya hū hā phaṭa/ ba li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ lan gsum gyis dkyil 'khor ba rnams la 'bul/ argha: nas/shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ phyag na rdo rje drag po che/ /rdo rje khro bo drag wo 'joms/ /rdo rje mi thub 'jigs byed che//rdo rje gzi brjid sngags kyi gtso/ /rdo rje 'phrin las don kun mdzad/ /thabs 'dul 'khor lo che la 'dud/ ces dang / de nas 'byung ba lnga yis: nas/ las kun sgrub la bstod/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gtor ma gnyis pa'o/ /nor rgyas dung skyong ser po shar/ /dga' bo nye dga' dmar po lho/ /padma chu lha dkar po nub/ /stobs rgyu rigs ldan nag po byang / /thams cad gdengs ka bdun dang ldan/ /thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul gyi gnas/ /dga' rab dbang phyug thal ka 'khor lo 'dzin/ /me tog ma ni smug nag lcags kyu bsnams/ /thod 'phreng can ni nag po ral gri 'dzin/ /mdzes ldan ma ni sngon mo gri gug bsnams/ /bum pa'i rna ba sngon po dgra sta 'dzin/ /'od zer 'phrog ma dmar nag mi mgo bsnams/ /sen mo dgu pa nag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /mdangs 'phrog ma ni ljang nag rgyu zhags bsnams/ de ltar bdud rgyal yab yum thams cad ni/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhengs/ /bong bu'i rna ba thal ka ral gri 'dzin/ sha za mo ni sngon po 'khor lo —62—

thogs/ /rna ba 'phyang ba dud kha dbyug tho 'phyar/ /ral pa can ma dmar mo mda' gzhu 'dzin/ ral pa gyen bsgreng dmar nag mdung thung bsnams/ /gdong ser ser mo gri gug brdeg pa'i stangs/ /ral gri'i so can nag po dgra sta 'phyar/ /seng ge'i gdong ma dud kha rtse gsum 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin de brgyad phyag g.yon thod khrag bsnams/ /kun kyang 'khor tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor/o nī lā je nas/ kro dha satwa hū phaṭa/ oṃ nā ga sa pā ri wa ra bā lī ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ lan gsum/ oṃ nī lā: nas/ satwa hu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā pre ta sa pā ri wa ra ba ling ta kha kha ji hi 'a hi/ lan gsum/ skye( nī lā: nas/ sa twa hū phaṭa/ skye( ma hā yakṣa sa pā ri wa ra ba li ta kha kha ji hi ji hi/ lan gsum/ thun mong du/ a kā blo'i sngags lan bdun sogs kyi phul/ slar yang argha: nas/shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ brgya khrir zhabs bzhag 'jigs pa'i me/ /gad rgyangs ba6da mdzad zhal gsum pa/ /dang po'i zhal du gdug pa 'dzin/ /stobs chen rab tu gnon pa po/ /klu chen ma rung gdug pa can/ /nor rgyas dang ni dung skyong dang / /dga' bo dang ni 'jog po dang / /padma chen po padma dang / /stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs ldan dang / /rgya mtsho dag la gnas pa yi/ /klu dang sa bdag gnyan rnams ni/ /sprul pa las la grub pa yi/ /glen pa nga rgyal rdzu 'phrul can/ /sprul pa 'bum sde 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /bcom ldan mgon po zhal gsum pa/ /phyag drug rdo rje sdig pa g.yon/ /drag po'i thal mos skrag par byed/ /tha mas sbrul gdug ri rab mnan/ /mkha' la rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i bdud/ /dga' rab dbang phyug thod 'phreng can/ /bum rna sen dgu sha za'i bdud/ /gtsug na me tog —63—

mdzes ma dang / /'od zer 'phrog dang mdangs 'phrog ma/ /gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i 'khor/ /ma lus 'khor bcas thams cad kun/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /bcom ldan mgon po: nas/ ri rab mnan gyi bar gong bzhi/ 'khor du gnod sbyin chen po ni/ sha za rab 'jigs ral pa can/ /gdong ser seng ge gnod sbyin mo/ /bong bu'i rna ba rna ba 'phyang / /ral pa gyen bsgreng ral gri'i so/ /gnod sbyin 'khor te lnga brgyar bcas/ /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di long zhig ces dang / mchod spyin gtor ma: nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba: sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis dang /yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang : sogs/ khyod kyi sems can: nas/ badzra muXgadug pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus 'dul ba dang / /sems can 'khore ba ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i bdag po 'phags pa gos sngon can/ /'khordo ra dang bcas pa bdag gis 'khru/ba par rtse(ga /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sogs/ gzhan yang smon lam dang bkra shis ji ltar 'tsham par bya'o/ /'di'i sgos kyi gtor chog ni de tsam yin la/ chos skyong ye shes pa'i gtor bsngo gzhan byed na/ dkyil 'khor ba'i rjes drag po gsum gyi sngon la 'bul zhing / 'jig rten pa gzhan gyi gtor bsngo byed na/ drag po gsum gyi rjes su ma gtogs/ /sngon la byar mi btub/ lar yang 'dre phal pa nang gtor la 'jug pa ni legs rgyu med lags/ drag po gsum gyi rjes la/ 'khor lo bde mchog nas 'byung ba'i mkha' 'gro spyi gtor 'di mdzad pa gong ma rnams kyi phyag len du yang 'dug cing / shin tu gal che zhing legs pa'ang yin no/ /rnal 'byor gyi yan lag gzhan rnams ni/ gsang sngags bla med spyi dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ de dag gi rigs 'gre sbyar bas rung ba'i phyir 'dir ma smos so/ /bod yul 'dir gsang —64—

sngags gsar ma la yang phyag na rdo rje'i chos skor shin tu mang ste/ 'bro mar lugs kyi skor gos sngon can du grags pa dang / 'byung po 'dul byed kyi skor dang / gtum po khyung sham can gyi skor dang / u ye chos skor dang / 'khor lo chen po'i skor dang / mdo lugs su grags pa'i skor dang / rdo rje be con gyi skor dang / rdo rje bde khros kyi skor dang / rdo rje me lce'i skor rnams la che ba dgur grags/ de dag tu mi gtogs pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa sogs snga dar dang / stong nyid ting 'dzin gyis mdzad pa sogs phyi dar la 'gyur ba'i gzhung phra mo yang rnam grangs shin tu mang ba yod do/ /che ba dgu po rnams ci rigs pa la mkhas pa mang pos dpyad gzhir mdzad pa/ spyir rgya gzhung yin min the tshom can yang 'ga' re snang mod kyi/ chos skor 'di rnams bod yul du shin tu grags che zhing /thams cad la nus mthu mngon gyur du thob pa'i gsang sngags pa mang du byung ba kho na yin pas/ byin rlabs kyi gzi byin ches 'bar ba sha stag tu 'dug pas/ skur ba nam du yang mi btang cing / gus pa bskyed par bya'o/ /der ma zad che ba dgu po rnams la'ang 'ga' zhig la rgyud gzhung gnyis ka dang / kha cig la sgrub thabs la sogs pa'i gzhung 'ga' zung de rgya dpe las bsgyur ba rtsod med du yod pa kho na yin pas/ cha lag gi gzhung phran thor bu pa rnams la bod rtsom yod du chug kyang zhal gdams yin pa'i phyir 'gal ba med de/ chos skyong mgon po so so'i gdams ngag gi dpe bum bzhin no/ /yang byin rlabs med pa'i rgya gzhung las byin rlabs yod pa'i bod gzhung ngo mtshar chung ngu med pa'ang mkhyen par mdzod/ /khyad par du 'khor lo chen po'i chos skor 'di rnams mchog tu byin rlabs che zhing /rgyud gzhung rtsa ba rnams rtsod med yid ches can yin pas/ sngon gyi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis zur za tsam gsungs zer yang snying po med/ bcom ldan rig ral dang / kun mkhyen chen po jo nang pa dang /bu ston rin po che dang / chos rje bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / rje btsun tsong kha ba chen po —65—

dang / bo dong ba chen po sogs bod yul rang gi shing rta chen po phyogs re tsam yin pa gzhung lugs thams cad la chos kyi sbyan dang ldan pa rnams kyis chos 'di la rtsis su mdzad pas rtsod pa dang bral bar gyur to/ /'khor lo chen po'i sgrubs thabs sbyar ba las/ /byung ba'i dge ba dri med gang bsags des/ /nam mkha'i khongs na gnas pa'i sems can rnams/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par shog/ // dpal 'khor lo chen po'i sgrubs thabs srid gsum 'dul byed ces bya ba 'di yang / /bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag dang mthun par/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rnam 'byung gi lo'i dang po la sbyar ba'o/ / zhus dag/ maṅgal//—66—

gsum 'dul byed ces bya ba bzhugs/oṃ khyu sti/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil chog srid gsum 'dul byed ces bya ba/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa kun bcom zhing / /zhi ba'i mtha' la'ang mi ltung bar/ /go 'phang mchog la 'god der 'dud/ /gang zhig 'gro rnams smin zhing grol ba'i slad/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor cho ga gsungs/ /blun po spyi brtol can gyis yul min te/ /sngags rig mkhas rnams mgu ba 'di la 'jug /rgyal ba'i bka' sde snod gsum dang / shing rta chen po'i gzhung rnams nges par bsten dgos pa'i chos yin yang / da lta'i mtshan nyid pa rnams kyi byed tshul ni/ tshig la 'chel zhing gzhung dang lag len rgyab 'gal du 'gyur pas rang gi yun ring sbyangs pa'i chos la ma mgu bar bdud rtsi'i zas spangs te/ mi gtsang ba'i zas la khyi rnams rtsod pa lta bur gyur pa dang / yang sgom chen par khas mche ba dag lta skad mtho mtho po 'ga' zhig gi tshig la zhen nas/ dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i thabs khyad par can rnams ris su 'bor ba ni/ tshad pa'i nad ma smin pa la ga bur gyi sman btang ba bzhin nyams nyes su gyur pa dang / yang kha cig spros pa byed pa rnams la rnyed bkur 'byung ba mthong nas/ brgyud pa med cing lag len nor ba'i cho ga brdzus ma rnams kyis blun po mgo skor ba dang /sgra dang rtog ge sogs la shes 'dod langs pas sgom chen pa'i rang tshugs zhig pa dag ni/ dper na/rgyal srid kyi bya ba bor nas chang 'tshong ma'i khyim rtag tu bsten pa dang mtshungs so/ /de lta bas na mkhas 'dod dang grub par rdzu ba'i mtha' gnyis su ma lhung bar/ yang dag pa'i lam las 'bras bu —67—

mchod grub par 'dod na/ dus kyi tha ma 'di lta bur rdo rje theg pa la nges par brten dgos shing /de'i rtsa ba yang khungs dang / brgyud par ldan zhing / lag len ma nor ba'i dbang gi cho gas smin pa ci dgos so/ /zhes pa 'di thams cad du go bar bya'o/ /skabs 'dir dpal 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la/ dang por slob ma rjes bzung ngam lha dang bla ma la gsol ba gdab cing srung ba'i cho ga ni/ gzhung nyid la rgyas shing gsal bar yod pa ltar yin te/ de yang slob dpon gyi maṇḍal bcas/ slob ma'i gsol ba 'debs pa dang dri ba dri lan bya/ maṇḍal der tshom bu bkod/ lha spyan drangs nas rgyun bshags yan lag bcu pa phyed du 'jug /bsrung ba'i don du/ oX a tshu ta huX/ zhes pa bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags thung gi bzlas lung tsam sbyin pa yin te/ 'on kyang de dag phyis lag len mi mdzad par snang bas go yul tsam du byas pas chog go /gnyis pa bsnyen pa byed tshul yang spyi dang mtshungs shing / bum chog la brten nas bsnyen pa kha gso byed pa'i srol yang byung ngo/ /gsum pa sa chog ni/ brtag bslang sbyang bzung bsrung ba ste lnga'o/ /dang po brtag pa ni spyi dang 'dra/ gnyis pa sa bslang ba ni/ gtor ma me tog spos dang ting lor bcas pa zhig a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang du zlaX las byung ba'i gtor snod kyi nang du/oṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma yo byad thams ced dang ldan par gyur/ oX āXhuX ha ho hri/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa sarba sa pā ri wa ri khyiX oX a kā ro sogs lan gsum nas bdun la sogs pa'i bar dang / na maXsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oX sa lha ra 'a ra huX/ lan bdun/ oX badzra arghaX swāhā/ tseX( badzra pursha āXhuX nas/ shasta āXhuX/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor —68—

don du khyod kyis rtsol/ lan gsum dang dril sil bya/ de rjes rol rṣa dang bcas te gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /de ni sgos kyi bdag po las bslang ba yin no/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus su maṇḍal tshom bu mchod gtor dang bcas pa bshams/ bsangs sbyangs/ ṭakki ni hu dza/ o ha/lan gsum/ ha gi sgra dang hu gi 'od kyis bskul nas/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa byung / tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni/ sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ kyai rig pa 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bgyi ba bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes gsungs par gyur/mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun gyi nang du hū bdun las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me togabadug spos/ mar me/ dri myong/ zhal zas dang / gzhan yang mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis gang bar gyur/ o badzra argha ā hū/ nas/ shasta ā hu/ gi bar/ o pri thi bī de bi bhya.argha pra tismo swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pu du/ o badzra pu zhe ā hū/ nas/ sha rto ā hu/ gi bar dang / gaṇḍi sogs/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ o ā hu ha ho hri/ gsum/ o pri thi bī de bī khyu na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sbyo bi shwa mu khe khyu sarba thā kha utpa te spa ra ṇa i ma ga ga na kha gro ste da ba li ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni —69—

dpang du gyur/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi stobs bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/lan gsum/ kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar mdzod ciga.o pri thi bī de bī khyu argha pra titsā swāhā/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim par gyur/ de ni sa spyi'i bdag mo sa lha las bslang ba'o/ /gsum pa sa sbyang ba ni/oṃ bhu kha/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyur/ hu la hu/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ o ni lā ba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi kro dha satwa hū phaṭa/ ces bzlas te yungs chu thal ba rnams gtor/ sa phyogs nam mkha' ltar spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes so/ /spyin sreg gi sa sbyang ba byed na skabs 'dir bya/ bzhi pa bzung ba ni/ sa phyogs 'di bdag dpal phyag na rdo rje'i nyer spyod kyi gzhi yin no/ /sa phyogs 'di rdo rje'i gdan/ nga ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'o/ /sa phyogs 'di 'og min gyi zhing khams/ nga nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje lha bco brgyad kyi bdag nyid do/ /zhes blos gzung la/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir 'dug mchod pa bsham/ spros pa la mos na 'og nas 'gyung ba ltar sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ bsdu na mchod pa byin rlabs tsam byas te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas gzung / /bzlas pa rdzogs kyi bar bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor kyi mngon rtogs rgyas pa yongs rdzogs bsgoms/de nas phyogs kyi slob ma rnams kyis sngar gyi mchod pa kha gsos shing byin rlabs bya/ slob dpon gyis bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor la phul bar mos te/ /chu gsum nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa sngags tsam gyis phul/ khro mo bzhi'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /—70—

dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /sems can kun kyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ oṃ badzra u sta dkyis 'khor nam mkha' la btegs gtso bo'i thugs ka nas rang nyid phyag gnyis par sprul/ a haX badzra pā ṇi/ mig g.yas su ma las nyi ma/ g.yon ṭa las zla ba/ mig 'bras huX du gyur/hūX skyoX mang du brjod/ hūX lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje'i stobs/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor bas/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ /lus gsum las skyes dges par bya/ /gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'/ /'dir ni 'jig 'gyur gzhan du min/ /mi dang mi min 'byung po'i tshogs/ /gdon gyi rigs su gtogs pa rnams/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ ba drag tu brjod/ huX huX zhes byang shar gyi mtshams nas g.yas su bskor bar bya'o/ /stangs stabs la sogs pa shes shing spro na skabs 'dir byed/ gzhung las/ bde mchog nag po dkyil chog dang mthun par bshad/ bsdu na med kyang chog go/oṃ badzra gī la ya sarba bi gha nan brgyu huX phaṭa/ ces mang du bzlas pas phur bu byin gyis brlabs/ byang shar nas brtsams te phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'debs te/ sumbha re re'i mthar/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/—71—

sarba du gin phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya/ sarba pā paX phaṭa/ huX hūX hūṃ/ badzra gī la badzra dha ro a dzña pa ya ti/ sarba du kā ya wa ka tsitta badzra gī la ya huX huX phaṭa/ ces pa tshar re re brjod/ a rgha la sogs pas mchod/ spos 'dug yungs dkar gtor/ brtan bzhugs bya/mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar dkyil 'khor la gtor ma rgyas par 'bul lo/ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad bzhi pa sta gon ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma ni/ oX badzra a mṛ ta ku ṭa li ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ oX swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shurnyo3haX/ oX āXhūX ha ho hri/lan gsum/ dzi/ oX kha kha 'a hi khwa hi/ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa/ bhu ta pre ta pi sha tsa/u.unta/ a pa smu ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya/ i daX ba li groṇḍa skye/ sa ma ya rakta stu/ma ma sarba sirnyi sme pra ya:smyo/ ya the baX/ ya the gliX bhañdza tha/ pi wa tha/ dzigha tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka rta ya/ sad su kha/ bi shudha sa ha yi ka /bha nywaskye huX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ eX( badzra arghaX swāhā/ tseX( badzra pā duX swāhā/ tseX( badzra pukhre/ āXhūX/ /dhu pa ā lo ke ga rnye ni wi te/ shabha āXhūX/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / klu yi gnod na srin i: ཿnga po'i: yi dwags: sha za'i: smyo byed: brjed byed: mkha' 'gro'i: ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus pa ni tham cad dag /'dir bzhags bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis mchis pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag —72—

'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun kyis bka' drin bdag la rtsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yis/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la rtsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mjodi/ /'jig rten bde zhing 'e1 legs dang / /'bru/ rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phangs thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma la sogs pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bgegs rnams bzlog cing 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du —73—

song shig ra brjod/ gnas yo byin gas ni/ tshe badzra a mṛ ta: oṃ su bhā wa: stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang huX yig las 'byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ bhuX las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āXhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las gyur pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong kyi bar du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badzra arghaX swāhā/ oṃ badzra pā byaX swā hā/ oṃ badzra pa spre āXhuX/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo keg rnye ni wi te/ shasta āXhūX/ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya ho/ oṃ badzra spa ra ṇa khaX/ oṃ badzra lha rjer ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saX pra ra ṇi ta/sarba bzhi spyo tra/ pra tsa li te/ pra dzñā pa ra mi ta/ nā da paṃ bha we/ badzra dharma hri da ya/sa sto ṣa ni hūṃ huX hūṃ ho ho ho ā khaX swāhā/ zhes gnas yo byin gyis brlabs/ /bar 'dir tshogasapa yod cing spro na zhu 'bul bya/ de rjes skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ zhes pa'i bar ma phro rtogs rdzogs par bsgom te/ de dag ni sta gon gyi sngon du bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /'di nyid kyi gzhung las kyang / sa'i lha mo'i cho ga lan cig las ma gsungs shing / bla ma gong ma rnams sa lha sa —74—

chog gi skabs su song bas 'dir mi dgos gsung pa ltar ro/ /skabs 'dir sta gon dngos ni gsum ste/ bum pa dang lha dang slob ma sta gon no/ /dang po ni/ lha grangs dang mthun par byed na yab yum mnyam sbyor gyi dbang du byas nas dgu las bum dang bcu'o/ /drug tu byed na gtso bo la gcigaphyogs bzhi'i lha la re re dang las bum mo/ /gsum byed na/ gtso bum dang / lha thams cad pa ste rnam rgyal dang / las bum mo/ /bsdu na bum pa gnyis kyis chog ste rnam rgyal dang las bum mo/ /de ltar na bum pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ gzungs ring tshar gsum gyis bgegs dang byur bsal zhing byin gyis brlab/ /su bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX paX las sna tshogs padma'i steng du/ a a las zla ba'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi steng du bhuX bhuX las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing / mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas gos kyi mgul bcings dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du/rang gi thugs ka'i hūX las suX zhig spros te ri rab tu gyur/ hūX spros te 'khod pa las de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje gyur/ de'i lte bar paX las padma'i sdong po padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i nyer bar/bhuX las gzhal yas khang lha'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ ta bya thā bho bho nas bya ti huX skyoX/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyagata rdo rje sangs rgyas ga dma'i klung nas dga' bas brgyan pa'o/ /oṃ pa ra kra ma nas/ ba la ya phaṭa/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi la/ shar du khro bo chen po nas/bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ /oṃ ha ra ha ra nas nā sha ya huX phaṭa/shar gyi sgo khyud kyi nas 'phrin las mdzad pa'o/ /las bum gyi nang du huX las —75—

bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang khu/ phyag gnyis hu mdzad kyi phyag rgyas khro bo'i rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin zhing / pad nyi la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs par khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad dpal phyag na rdo rje lha bcu brgyad bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa'i rnam par badzra sa mā dza a spo tas bsangs/ a ji nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ dza hu ba ho/ lha thams cad kyi spyir bor zla ba nas hū mthing nag go /yang thugs ka'i hu las 'od zer 'phros/ /mi bskyod pa re res dbu rgyan par gyur/ yang argha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ snying po'i mthar/ oṃ ā hu/ phyag na rdo rje drag po che/ sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ bum nang gi lha'i sku la thim pas 'od zer dmar pos khyab/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ gtso bo la bskyed sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla dgos/ 'khor gyi sngags thung rnams nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzla zer te ci bde yin/ las bum la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta ku ḍa li ha na ha na hū phaṭa/ ces nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa bzla/ gal che shos med mi rung thun mong du gzungs ring nyer gcig dang / /snying po nye snying gnyis kyang ji ltar 'os pa bzla'o/ /bsdu na bzlas pa gzhan spangs te rtsa sngags kho nas kyang chog go/mthar a bhi ṣe ka ta bzlas shing gong bzhin mchod bstod yig brgya bzod gsol rnams byas/ oṃ ā hū zhes bzla zhing dung gi chu blug lha rnams 'od du zhu zhing bum chu la thim par gyur/ smon lam dang bkra shis cung zad brjod/ /gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ sa gzhi'am maṇḍal la lha'i bzhugs gnas kyi grangs bzhin du dril bzang gi thig le 'god de/ dbus su gru bzhi/ gzhan bcu gnyis su zlum por —76—

bkod/ mchod gtor rgya cher mug ma/ thob thang la dri bzang gi thig le'i steng du me tog tshom bur 'god cing / /sngags re brjod rgyu yin yang / lag len mi bde na shoms kyi dus su/ thig le dang tshom bu bkod pas chog go/sa chog gi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg na/ de nyid spyan drangs te dmigs pas phab pa nyid kyis chog /sa chog gi skabs dkyil 'khor rang la bsdus pa'am/ rdul tshon la yang sa chog mi byed pa'am/ gal te ras bris yin na/ dam tshig pa bskyed dgos te/ gang ltar yang sa gzhi bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ ta bya thā/ bho bho nas smri ti hū hu/ lan gsum/ dpal phyag na rdo rje dang yum mdzes ldan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pa ra kra ma ya phaṭa/ bi da ra ṇa ya phaṭa/ khro bo bdud las rgyal ba dang / lha mo 'od zer can ma la phyag 'tshal lo//kri twanta ya phaṭa/ kro dha satwa na ya phaṭa/ khro bo gzi brjid 'bar ba dang / lha mo mdangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kri tanta rū pa ya phaṭa/ nī la wa sa na ya phaṭa/khro bo rngam pa sgra sgrog dang / lha mo sgra dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ro ṣa ṇa ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la ya phaṭa/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang / lha mo rlung 'byin ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ha ra ha ra/ ha sa ha sa/ rdo rje lcags kyu dang /lcags kyu ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ rdo rje zhags pa dang / zhags pa ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshinta tshinta mā ra ya mā ra ya/ rdo rje lcags sgrog dang / lcags sgrog ma la phyag 'tshal lo / /dhinta dhinta nā sha ya nā sha ya/ rdo rje dril bu dang / dril bu ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags de rnams so sor lan gsum gsum brjod/ nam mkha' nas 'bebs pa yin na/sngags de rnams re re'i mthar a be sha ya a/ zhes btags pa tshar gcig brjod/ ye shes spyan —77—

'dren mi dgos/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa yin na/ phyis ye shes spyan 'dren dgos so/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du sna tshogs rdo rje'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i rin po che sna tshogasanas gdan re re yang grub par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po nas dga' bas brgyan pa'o/ /rtsibs bzhi la shar du khro bo/ nas bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/ khar sgo'i sgo 'byud nas 'phrin las mdzad pa'o/ /de nas ye shes spyan 'dren dang / dbang bskur rgyas btab byed na/ rang gi thugs ka'i hu las 'od zer 'phros/zhes pa gnyis kyi gong ma nas/ dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes pa'o/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bsangs sbyangs dang 'dod yon lnga'i bar rnams dngos gzhi'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ de rjes/oṃ a mṛ ta sogs nang mchod dang / shes rab thabs kyi sbyor ba yi sogs bstod pas bstod/ dngos gzhi'i skabs kyi bdag 'jug gi 'jug tu 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar/ nang gtor phul nas/ snyan gsan dbab par bya ste/ ma lus phyogs na bzhug/sa pa yi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma dgongs gsol/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bya yi/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri/ /deng 'dir thams cad kun gshegs shig /dngos grub 'dir ni stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ argha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ snying po cung zad bzla/ oṃ badzra u / ba hū phaṭa/ ces nam mkha' la bteg go /dkyil 'khor nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su zhugs shing / ā li kā le'i 'phreng bas rgyas 'debs zhes bla ma gong ma rnams gsungs so/ /de nas yig brgya bzlas/ smon lam dang bkra shis ji ltar 'os pa bya/ rjes chog gzhan mi dgos/ gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni/ 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur la/ lha gnas kyi nyin mo byed na/ gtor 'bul gyi gong 'og —78—

gnyis dang / dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs zin pa ste/ gnas skabs gsum po gang du byas kyang 'dra'o/ /de dag ni smar chen po'i dkyil chog dang / rgya gzhud gi yig sna sa bcad mdzad pa nas brtsams/ lugs 'di'i bod kyi bla ma rnams dkyil cho ga gzhan phal cher gung mthun pa'i phyag len brgyud pa'i rim pa yin zhing / dkyil chog spyi 'gro rnams dang go rim mthun pa'i phyir dang / lag len bde bar ngos 'dzin pa'i chos 'di 'dra'i rigs rnams man ngag gtso bor byed pa'i phyir dang /lag len gyi rgyun yin pa'i phyir/ lag len la ni rim pa de ltar bya'o/ /'on kyang gzhung gi dngos bstan la ni go rim gzhan du snang ste/ dkyil chog spyi la grags pa'i sa chog dang sta gon 'dres pa lta bur yod kyang / /rgya gzhus dngos bstan rang lugs la ni ma 'dres shing go rim ma 'chol ba ste/ de yang dkyil chog 'dir sa brtag pa mi gsungs/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid gzhung gzhan du bshad zin pa dang 'dra bar dgongs/ de na skabs 'dir bdag bskyed rgyas pa sngon du song nas gzhi bdag las sa bslang / sbyang ba la las dang sngags dang sbyin sreg dang /mtshan ma med pas sbyang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs/ dang po la lto 'phye ba rtag ces sho lo ka gcig gis rgyas zugad yod/ gzhan rnams la rgyas bshad ma mdzad de don gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ /sa bzung ba la blo dang lha yis sa bzung ngo / /zhes 'byung / dang po dkyus su bshad pa bzhin yin/ lha yi sa bzung ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la thod pa'i snod bzhag /lha tshogs kyi sngags brjod bzhin du/ der me tog dor bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams skad cig gis byon nas/ sa gzhi bdag gir mdzad par bsam mchod bstod cig byas la mi dmigs par bsams/ dkyus kyi sa gzhi ni rdo rje gdan zhes sogs la'ang 'di'i don tshang ba tsam yin/ gzhung dngos las/ bzung ba gnyis la'ang rgyas bshad ma byung ngo / /de nas skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la bum pa rnams bshams te/ lha'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i maṇḍal bris pa'i steng du 'god pa sogs yod/ bum —79—

sgrub ngo bo dkyus dang 'dra/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i steng du bum pa'i lha tshogs 'god pa nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lhas sa bzung ba'ang yin/ bum sgrub 'di kho nas chog la dgongs nas/ /ga gon gyi skabs su ma bshad do/ /sa srung ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg bdag nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis bgegs la bka' bsgo ba dang / stang stabs thun mong gi srung 'khor tsam gsung te/ dra ba ra bar gyur pa'o//zhesapa yan chad sa chog yin/ de nas sa'i lha mo'i cho ga gsungs pa ni sa lha sta gon yin la/ 'dis ngon 'grub par dgongs nas sa chog gi skabs su sa lha'i cho ga med/ bod kyi bla ma rnams 'di la go zlog ste 'chad/ de nas slob dpon gyis mchod pa dang bcas te/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ zhes sogs phyogs bcu sangs rgyas rnams la snyan mnan/ slob dpon gtso bor gsal ba la/ phyogs bzhi'i gsol 'debs byed/ de rjes lha sta gon dngos ni/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor phab/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren sogs byed pa'o/ /de'i 'phros la gsal kha ma byung yang/ thig tshon gyi sngon du dkyil 'khor nam mkhar 'degs pa bshad pa skabs 'dir blangs kyang rung / gzhung gi dngos bstan ni/ lha rnams bzhugs bzhin pa la sngar bsgrub pa'i bum pa rnams spyan drangs te bzlas pa dang mchod bstod byas/ las bum gyis gnas dang yo byad thams cad la bsangs gtor tsam bya'o/ /de nas yol bas bcad de/ de nub mchod pa mtshan thub yod par byed/ snyan gsan dbab pa ma gsungs mod/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las 'byung bas byas kyang legs/ gang ltar yang nang par snga bar mchod bstod byas nas dkyil 'khor nam mkhar 'degs/ de nas thig tshon gyi las rnams bya'o/ /bum pa sta gon gyi skabs 'dir bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i bum pa la/ zhes pa'i tshig 'byung bas/ bum sgrub la brten nas bsnyen pa kha gso byed par/ zur gyis bstan par mngon yang / sa bzung ba dang / zung ba'i bar du bsnyen pa yod don med —80—
