pas/ gzhung gi dkyus su bshad pa de ni lha yis sa bsrung ba yin gyi bsnyen pa min no/ /'o na gzhud du/ de nas bum pa'i snying po ni/ /'bum tsho gcig tu bsnyen pa 'bul/ /dus dang grangs dang mtshan ma yi/ /thun mtshams sbyor ba re re la/ /gtso ba'i bsnyen pa brgya ru 'bul/ /'khor la lnga bcu rim gyis 'bul/ zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ bum bsnyen bstan pa yin snyam na/ bsnyen pa brgya ru 'bul zhesapa/ bzlas pa dang bsnyen pa'i dbye ba ma phyed pas skye bo blun po'i kha rgyugs shor 'dug cing / gzhi'i bsnyen pa yin na bum pa la brten pa mi 'thad/ slob ma'i bsnyen pa kha gsor grags pa de yin na dus dang zhes pa mi 'thad/ /'dir 'bum dang brgya dang lnga bcu zhes 'byung ba/ gong du 'phreng ba'i sngags ni rtsa gcig bzlas/ zhes pa dang 'gal zhing / bum pa'i snying po ngos gzung du med pa sogasatshig don gnyis ka mi legs pa kho nar snang bas/ rang bzo mkhan gyis lhad bcug pa'i tshig yin par mngon no/ /'og tu bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i bum pa la zhes pa yang / bsnyen pa dang dbang gi bum sgrub gnyis po cho ga 'dra ba'i don yin pas/ bum pa ltar zhes pa'i don du 'chad dgos so/ /gzhan du na/ byin gyis brlab la sogs pa nas/ zhes gsungs pas/ bum bsnyen grub pa la slar byin gyisabarlob mi dgos pa'i phyir dang / bum bsnyen gyi bum pas phyis dbang bskur na ha cang thal zhing /bum bsnyen byed pa'i lag len gzhan kun dang yang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu na bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i bum pa la byin gyi brlab la sogs pa nas/ mchod pa yan chad rdzogs par bya/zhes pa 'di yang / de nas bum pa'i snying po ni/ sogs kyi gzhug 'thud pa'i phyir rang bzor bcug pa min na rung ste/ zhes brtag par yang bya'o/ /yang kha cig 'di snyam du gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi go rim 'di kho na bzhin byed ba ni mi rung ste/ phyogs bzhi gsol btab ni/ sa chog gi skabs bgegs la bka' bsgo ba'i sngon du dgos kyi/ sta gon gyi skabs su mi drang ngo snyam na dkyil chog gzhan dang —81—

bstun na de skad ces smra ba bden du rung yang / 'di dang dkyil chog g.yin la skabs 'di dag tu mi 'dra ba cher yod pas lugs tha dad nyid kyi phyir/ de de 'god par mi nus so/ /phyogs bzhi gsol gdab 'di gang nas bshad pa'i rtsa bar rang gi khungs ni/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i le'u bzhi pa yin la/ der ni gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su/ dkyil 'khor 'bri ba dang sgrub cing mchod pa tsam zhig gsungs kyi/ sa chog gi sgos chos yin par gsungs pa med pas/ rtsa ba'i khungs rgyud dang ni mi 'gal te/ 'dir yang dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i sngon du byed pas so/ /de la dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ zhes pa ni/ dkyil 'khor sprul zhing bshad du gsol/ zhes pa yin na/ 'dir lta sta dgon nas brtsams te/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor sprul pa yin par dgongs pas de dang sbrel ba yin gyi don med du bkrugs pa ni ma yin no/ /des na dkyil chog rgya gzhung gi dngos bstan kho na la go rim bsgyur ba med par lag len byas na yang 'di nyid kyi rang lugs yin pa'i phyir legs so snyam pa ni bdag gi rnam par rtog pa'o/ /grub thob dza ba ri pa rang gi dgongs pa'ang khong rang gi gzhung gi dngos bstan nyid yin dgos te/ rgyud rnams su ni cho ga'i rim pa 'thor thabs dang 'khrugs can du 'byung ba yin gyi/dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos chog sgrigs su bsgrigs pa 'di dag ni 'thor ba bsdus 'khrugs pa bsal zin pa yin pas/ 'di dag la'ang 'khrugs sdebs dgos na ha cang thal bar 'gyur te/ bod du byas pa'i dkyil chog rnams la'ang 'khrugs sdebs dgos par mi 'gyur ram/ yang gzhung 'di nyid kho na'i dbang dzu byas pa la yang sa chog dang / sta gon 'khrugs can du yod na slob ma dbang bskur la yang yod dgos pa las/ slob ma sta gon gyi rim pa dang / dngos gzhi dbang bskur la dngos bstan gyi go rim bzhin byed du rung ba'i phyir/ sa chog dang sta gon la yang rung ba nyid de rgyu mtshan rnam pa kun tu mtshungs so/ /des na gzhung gi dngos bstan mi rung ngo zhes smra bar mi bya la/—82—

gzhung gi dngos bstan kyang bya rung / sgyur byed lo paṇa gnyis kyi man ngag 'di yang rbang / 'on kyang da lta byin rlabs 'byung ba'i rgyun yod bzhin pa yin pas lo paṇa gyi man ngag lugs la lag len byed zer na legs pa yin no/ /dza ba ri pa rang gi man ngag ni khong rang gi gzhung ltar byed pa nyid las gzhan 'os med kyang phyis lo paṇa rnams kyis kyang gnang ba thob par shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa dkyil 'khor zhug gi cho ga ni/ nang par snga bar thig tshon rnams 'dus byas/ tshon lnga po la rigs lnga'i sa bon bris/ dbus su sngon po shar du dkar po sogs 'god/ tshon gyi steng du so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i thig skud kyang 'jog ste/ byin rlabs phyogs gcig tu byed pa'i lugs su 'dugaspyir gzhung rnams las so sor byin rlabs byed par gsungs shing / 'di nyid kyi gzhung las kyang gsal mod/ phyogs gcig tu byed pa'i lag len ka mang bar byung 'dug bla chos su thal ba'i nyes skyon cung zad yong srid na'ang rnam pa gcig tu na 'gal ba cher med do/ /mchod pa lnga dang nang mchod bsham/ dkyil 'khor rṣa po'i mngon rtogs gtor chog dang bcas pa song na legs/ min na'ang rang skad cig gis gtso bor bskyed nas bzlas pa cung zad bya/thig rdzo a mṛ tas bsangs/ sma bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thig tshon sngon po hu las mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon dkar po oṃ las rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon ser po tra las rin chen 'byung ldan gser mdog rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon dmar po hri las 'od dpag med byi dra'i mdangs can padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thig tshon ljang khu kha las don yod grub pa margad 'od can ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rang snang gi yum gyis 'khyud pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hu/—83—

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi shiñtsa hūX/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wa ra arghaX pra tī tstsha snyu hā/ de bzhin du/ badzra pursha āXhāX/ nas shasta'i bar nang mchod sngar byin rlabasam byas na 'dir byed/ huX oṃ traX hri ji khaX/ oṃ ā༄༷༷huX/ zhes lan gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ huX oṃ traX hriX khaX/ zhes lan nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa sogs ci ltar 'os pa bzlas/ rgyal ba rigs lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon rnams su gyur/ thig skud rnams phyogs cig gag tu bzhag la brkyang / oṃ badzra su tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma huX/ lan mang du brjod/ rdul tshon mtheb srin gyis mnye zhing /oṃ badzra tsi tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma huX/ mang du brjod/ slob ma rdo rje lha mo mdzes ldan mar gyur/ oṃ a rgyo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharma pa ra spa ra a nu pra pri gi sarba dharmaX admanta a nu pra pri ni sarba dharmaXhuX/ zhes thig skud bsgril lo/ /'di nyid kyi gzhung na sngags 'di'i gsal kha med pas sngags 'di byed phyin spyi dang mthun par byed pa legs so/ /de nas hū ཾ hū ཾ zhes thig sna slob ma la gto / nam mkha' gang ba'i bde gshegs rnams/ /khyed kyis 'gro don mdzad dus lags/ /thig skud sgra yis bskul nas ni/ /thams cad 'dir ni gshe/gas su gsol/ oṃ āXhūX swāhā/ zhes thig chen brgyad po steng dang 'og tu gdab/ nub shar lho byang me dbang dang / /rma srin rma dbang me srin po/ /me rma srin lwa/nga zhes bya'o/ /de'i rjes su las thig rnams btab/ snying po bzla bzhin du/ slob dpon gyis dang por dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nas 'bri ste/ de nas g.yin rnams kyis bgyi ste spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di dag ni gzhung la kha —84—

'gengs byas pa man ngag gi lugs yin no/ /gzhung gi dngos bstan ni/ thig skud la ye shes kyi thig skud stim pa tsam dang / thig sna 'dren pa dang / skyed ā hū swāhā sa thig 'debs pa dang / rdul tshon stong pa'i ngang las yig 'bru lnga/ ye shes kyi rdul tshon spyan drangs te bstims pas rdul tshon du gyur/ de nas tshon 'gyed pa tsam ma gtogs ma gsungs/ rdul tshon rigs lnga'i sa bon las bskyed par gsungs pas/ thig skud kyang rigs lnga'i sa bon las bskyed pa tsam go bar nus/ kha 'gengs ma byas par gzhung gi dngos bstan 'di kho nas kyang chog par sems so/ /bris zin nas thig tshon gyi lhag ma la mchod bstod gshegs gsol bya ste spyi dang 'dra/ de nas rgyan sna tshogs dgram ste/ sa stegs kyi grwa bzhi la ral gri dang / mda' dang / me long rnams bzhi bzhi 'god par bshad/ gong bzhin sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ sgrub thabs ltar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom ste/bcom ldan 'das ma yang gtso bo'i thugs kar bsdu/ zhal phyag lhag ma rnams kyang rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āsnying gar hū/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te dang po bum pa 'god/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na rang rang gi gnas su 'god par bshad kyang / /lag len mi bde bas so sor 'jog pa'i stang ka tsam byas la/ gtso bo'i bum pa shar sgo'i g.yas la nye ba dang / gzhan rnams rang rang gi phyogs dang 'brel bar phyi rol du 'god/ bum pa gnyis kyi phyogs la rnam rgyal bum pa shar sgo'i g.yas su 'god cing las bum ni rnam pa kun tu byang shar du'o/ /yang go skabs dog pas 'god stabs mi bde ba dang / ras bris kyi phyogs la ni stegs bu gzhan la bzhag pas rung ba'i phyir/bum pa 'god pa'i cho ga 'di nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin no/ /de rjes mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs nas/ bgegs sbyang ba gsum dang / sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang / las bum gyis khrus gsol —85—

byed pa rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/ gzhung du tshogs gsog gnyis byed par gsungs pa ni/ dngos gzhi'i thog mar bdag bskyed rgyas pa mi byed pa la dgongs/ de yang nus pa dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyi dbang du byas nas/ dkyil chog rgya gzhung phal cher la yang bdag bskyed rgyas pa med mod kyang / /byin rlabs 'jug pa'i khyad che ba'i phyir dang / dkyil 'khor phal cher gyi da lta'i lag len la bdag bskyed rgyas pa yod pa ltar 'dir yang ste/ des na tshogs bsags gnyis dang / de nasabadag nyid ༷hū du bsam/ zhes pa skabs 'dir bsgom mi dgos so/ /mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ oṃ shu n+ya ta sogs/ rang gi thugs ka nas raX chad pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ huX bsnol ma chad pa las zhes pa nas/ gdan re re'ang grub par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ huX yig zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su hūX de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las/ lha mtshan gtso bo yab yum gyi rnam par gyur/ sgo 'byed pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzra dha ra uta gha ṭa sam ya huX/ lan bzhi sgo bzhi rang bye bar gyur/ rang nyid gzhal yas khang chen po'i shar sgo nas zhugs te/ dbus kyi mtshan ma'i lha dang gnyis su med par gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas huX las zhes pa nas/ mdangs can gyi phung por gyur/ de nyid cha bco brgyad du gyur/ dbus kyi cha gnyis thig le dkar dmar nyi zla kha spyor gyi rnam par gyur/ zla ba rdo rje dang / nyi ma thod khrag tu gyur/ thod khrag gi nang du rdo rje phyed nub tsam/ de las bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje yum lha mo mdzes ldan ma'i 'byud pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ badzra spa ra ṇa phaṭa/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/—86—

slar 'dus shing gcig tu 'dres pa rang nyid la thim pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sangs rgyas ga dma'i klung zhes pa das/dga' bas brgyan pa'o/ /'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mdzad pa mi dgos/ bdag skyed ltar spro ba yin pas/byang chub kyi sems cha brgyad/ thig le dkar dmar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rnam pa bzhin gyur/ zhes pa nas/ g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'o'i bar dang / de ltar 'khor bco brgyad po thams cad kyang ni yi ge 'bru gsum la thim/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sta gon gyi lha rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad badzra sa mā dza ma lus sems can sogs gong bzhin/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ gong bzhin mchod nas/ dza : ba ho sgrub mchod zhag sbrel gyi nyi ma phyi ma rnams la mi dgos/ yang thugs ka'i hu las 'od zer 'phros/ nas/ mi bskyod pa re res dbu brgyan par gyur/zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin las/ bdag la rigs shes par/ zhes pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la rigs shes pa/ zhes 'don pa spo/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can du yongs su bye ste/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i shar sgo'i phyogs su gnas pas mchod pa'i las mdzad par 'gyur/ amri tas bsangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hu zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon nas sha lta ā hū/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta ye bhya bi shā sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum/hu rab mchog bdud rtsi a rgyu'i rgyun/ /dwangs shing gsal la ro mchog ldan/ /rab tu dgyes shing tshim byed 'di/ /dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul/—87—

bo dang gnyis su med par 'dres/ zhes brjod do/ /nang ma rdzo ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta kun li nas gzung / nang mchod byin rlabs dang / oṃ nī la sogs la i da sogs sbyar bas gtso bo la 'bul ba'i bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin/ oṃ pa ra kra ma ya phaṭa/ sogs sngags re re'i mthar 'bru gsum btanas te 'bul/ ha ra ha ra hū phaṭa/ tshinta tshinta hū phaṭa/ skye( ā hū/ zhesasogs spyor ba yin/ de bzhin du spyi 'gro'i tshig rnams kyang sbyar te/ mgron sna tshogs pa rnams la 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ zhes pa nas/ byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ ā zhes pa'i bar sgeg sogs brgyad kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa atpa ko3ha/ gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher spel la/ snang stong sgyu ma lta bur shes pas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ nas/ 'on kyang skyobs pa'i sras su skye/ zhes brjod de bla na med pa'i mchod pa'o/ /hu thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yi/ zhes pa nas/ las kun sgrub la bstod/ ces pas bstod do/ /spros pa la dga' na bstod pa rgyas pa 'dis kyang bstod par bya ste/hu rang bzhin mkha' ltar khyab pa chos kyi dbyings/ /stug po bkod pa'i gnas mchog dam pa na/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gtso bo mi bskyod mgon/ /byang chub lnga ldan sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku/ /dpal ldan lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog tu/ /thugs rje 'gro rnams 'dren mdzad gsang ba'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /ris med ye shes chos kyi dbyings su zhugs/ /rnam shes 'khor bcas dag pa'i chos kyi sku/ /zhe sdang rnam dag zhe sdang chen po'i sku/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gyur med sku ni nam mkha'i kha dog 'dra/ /sku gsum rnam par dag pa'i zhal ras gsum/ /rnam par dag pa'i spyan gsum me —90—

'od 'phro/ /phyag drug kṣa rol phyin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /che ba'i yon tan rgyas pa'i dbu skra 'bar/ /rdo rje rtse lnga ye shes lnga dang ldan/ /sdigs mdzub ma rtogs 'gro la thar lam ston/ /sa steng gnod spyin 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zung 'jug thal mos bdag lta'i ri bo 'joms/ /'gro ba'i zhe sdang 'joms phyir sbrul gdug gsol/ /nam mkha' rgyu ba'i bdud dpung 'joms mdzad cing / /sa 'og klu tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku sbom gsus khyim rgyas pa chos nyid klong / /zhabs g.yas bskums pas 'khor ba rtag mtha' spangs/ /g.yon pa bskyangs bas myang 'das chad mtha' bsal/ /tshangs dang brgya byin mnan la phyag 'tshal lo/ kha na ma tho spangs pa'i chos gos sngo/ /stag lpags lhan skyes byang sems gshin rje 'dul/ /sprul gyis brgyan pas nyon mongs dug gsum dag /'dod dgu'i 'phrin las stsol la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i yum mchog rdo rje mā ma gī /mdzes ldan lha mo mnyam nyid byang chub sems/ /rnam dag nam mkha'i khams kyi ngo bo nyid/ khres rab pha rol phyin la phyag 'tshal lo /gzugs can snang ba chos kyi dbyings su thim/ /sku yi mdzad pa snang stong snyu ma'i ngang / /'gro ba'i gti mug dra ba 'joms mdzad pa/ khro chen bdud las rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /myong ba'i tshogs kun mnyam nyid thugs rje'i ngang / /rgyal ba'i yon to rin chen 'od zer 'bar/ /nga rgyal ser sna'i dra ba 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje khro bo gzi brjid la phyag 'tshal/ /'dzin byed dag pa so sor rtog pa'i dngos/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi gsang ba can/ /brtse ba'i 'od kyis 'dod chags rgya mtsho skem/ /khro rgyal rngam pa sgra sgrog la phyag 'tshal/ /bya ba sgrub —91—

mdzad las rnams kun la khyab/ de bzhen gshegs pa kun kyi 'phrin las mgon/ /phrag dog nags tshal ye shes 'bar bas bsregs/ /legs mdzad bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par dag pa sa yi khams/ /byams pa tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /gdug can kun la phur bus 'debs/ /'od zer can ma la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par dag pa chu yi khams/ /snying rje tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /gdug pa can rnams rengs shing gnon/ /mdangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par thar pa me yi khams/ /dga' ba tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /'gro ba ma lus dbang du mdzad/ /sgra dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal/ /rnam par dag pa rlud gi khams/ btang snyoms tshad med ngo bo nyid/ /'phrin las ma lus sgrub mdzad ma//rdo rje rlung 'byin la phyag 'tshal/ khres rab dang bcas dad pa'i stobs/ /ma rig chu bo skem mdzad cing / /'gugs byed rdo rje lcags kyu dang / /lcags kyu ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ khres rab dang bcas brtson 'grus stobs/ /srid pa'i sbyor ba 'joms mdzad cing / /'ching byed rdo rje zhugs pa dang / /zhugs pa mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ khres rab dang bcas dran pa'i stobs/ /'dod pa'i zag pa 'joms mdzad cing / /sdom byed rdo rje lcags sgrog dang/ /lcags sgrog ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ khres rab dang bcas ting 'dzin stobs/ /lta ba ngan pa'i nyer len 'joms/ /'babs byed rdo rje dril bu dang / /dril bu ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun gzhi gnas gyur dag pa'i klong / /rnam dag ye shes 'jig rten khams/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa yi/ /gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las dang nyon mongs sna tshogs kyi/ /sdug bsngal 'khrul ba'i sems can rnams/ /rdo —92—

rje'i gnas la 'god pa'i rtags/ /dur khrod brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'gyur don dam ye shes mchog /kun tu khyab par 'bar ba yi/ /bla med srung ba'i 'khor lo la/ /bdag yid dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /thabs shes nyi zla kha sbyor 'phro 'du las/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba'i ngang tshul gyi/ /dkyil 'khod ra rten dang brten par bcas pa la/ /gnyis med tshul gyis gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba'i bdag cag rnams/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus 'joms nus pa'i / /thugs kyi rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag po yi/ /go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par shog /ces so/ /bar 'dir nus na spyin sreg gi ma rdzo pas kyang mchod par bya mod/ ma grub kyang 'gal ba med/ de rjes mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa ji ltar 'os pa byas te/ bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyis/bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos sgrub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ bden stobs brjod de/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du byung / /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor ra ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog lan gsum brjod do/ /sdoms ni/ khrus byas maṇḍal gsol gdab sdom pa bzung / /lhar bskyed gdong g.yo/gsabasangs byed sems bskyed bya/ gsang gdam dam chu spyin te phyi 'jug yin/ nang 'khrid skor ba gsol btab ye shes dbab/ brtan byed gsang gdams bka' mnyan me tog dor/ /me tog 'ching dang nam mkha'i kha dog brtag /gdong dbye lha ngo ston pa nang 'jug yin/ zhes sdoms blo la —93—

nges par bya'o/ /dang po khrus ni/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / a bhi ṣe ka ta sogs brjod/ slob ma dbang skur la ni/ khrus byas te me tog bkye bsdu sems bskyed gsal 'debs rnams yin/ gnyis pa ni 'jug pa'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul/ gsum pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ bzhi pa ni/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / zhes pa nas/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ kyi bar rigs lnga'i sdom bzung spyi dang mthun/ lnga pa lhar bskyed pa ni/ rang skad gcig gis bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ zhes brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ rang nyid ces pa khyed rang rnams su 'don pa spo ste/ 'di thams cad la rigs 'gre'o/ /'jug pa'i skabs su lus kyi spyod pa dang mthun pa'i sku'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs su 'pho bas/ g.yon brkyang sogs kyi nges can 'dir mi bzhed cing / phyag mtshan yang skabs 'dir mi mdzad pa'i lugs so/ /drug pa mig dar bcing ba ni/ ā kha lī ra hū/ bdun pa bsangs ba ni/rdo rje gsor zhing / oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hu phaṭa/ lan gsum/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs las bum gyi chus gtor ro/ /bgyod pa sems bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ brtse ba snying rje chen po dang stong nyid ye shes rdo rje dbyer med pa'i byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gyur/ oṃ badzra yo ka tsitta u pa da ya mi/rdo rje snying gar bldan su ra te sa ma ya stu/ ho sirnyi badzra ya thā su kha/dgu pa dkyil 'khor gsang gdams ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /ma mthong snod dang mi ldan pa/ /su la'ang ston par ma byed cig ces rdo rje spyi bor bzhag 'grub dam chu sbyin pa ni/ nang mchod bsang ste/—94—

'di ni rdo rje dam tshig chu/ /srungs shig ma srungs sreg par byed/ /srungs na dngos grub ster byed pa/ /bdud rtsi 'di ni myang bar gyis/ oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ de dag ni byis 'jug yin pas slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi'am yol ba'i phyi rol du bya'o/ / bcu gcig pa nang 'jug gi thog ma yol ba'i nang du 'khrud pa ni/ dkyil 'khore gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i las kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje la 'jus te srung 'khor gyi nang du zhugs par gyur/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hu phaṭa swāhā/ gagaganyis pa skor ba dang phyag 'tshal ni/ hū hu hu/ zhes dkyil 'khor la bskor ba byas par mos/skyed na ma te hu/ na ma me hu / na mo( na ma hū swāhā/ zhes shar sgo nas phyag 'tshal bar mos/ bcu gsum pa ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal phyag na rdo rje bdag la dbab par mdzod cig lan gsum/ bcu bzhi pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ 'khore ba thamasacad ni sdug bsngal/ 'dus byas thams cad ni mi rtag /snang zhing srid pas chos thams cad ni sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po thams cad bla ma dang 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis phyag na rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i skur gsal ba'i rkang pa'i 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can gyi rgyud gyen du bstan pa la rkang pa gnyis bzhag pa/spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po sku la phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/nyams bde ba chen po dang ldan par bzhugs/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus —95—

su bcom ldan 'das ma'i ngo bo a yig las/ 'bar ba'i gtum mo tsaṇḍali'i me lce tshon gang tsam du 'phags/ rkang 'og gi gzhu g.yo ba'i zhugs kyis rang nyid gyen du 'degs bzhin pa dang / gtum mo'i gdung ba'i 'od kyis lus kyi nang thams cad gang / spyi bo'i bla ma'i thugs ka nas a yig dmar po char babs pa bzhin byon/ snying ga nas zhugs lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab/ dkyil 'khor kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad dpal phyag na rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs/ ba spru'i bu ga nas zhugs shing thim par gyur/ ta du thā/ bho bho nas/ rtsi ti hū/ badzra a be sha a a/ zhes brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /bco lnga pa brtan par bya ba ni/ dkyil 'khor kyi gtso bo'am/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying gar sangs rgyas gos sngon can du gyur/ snying ga'am spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag /oṃ nī lwa ba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi tsitta maṇḍal badzra sa ma ya/ ti grin/bcu drug pa lha sngags gsang bar gdams pa ni/ mthu stobs phyag na rdo rje ni/ /khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /rtag tu yi dam lha yin gyi/ /tshul 'di smra bar ma byed cig /gal te tshu 9 / 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshe/gas/ bcu bdun pa bka' ma to par gdams pa ni/ nga ni phyag na rdo rje ste/ /nga yis bsgo ba nyan par gyis/ /nga la brnyes par ma byed cig /gal te khyod kyi bsnyan na ni/ /dam tshig 'di yis sreg par byed/ /tsha ba chen po'i gnas su lhung / bco brgyad me rta go 'bul ba ni/ mthu stobs mnga' bdag dkyil 'khor du/ /rig pa'i me tog 'di phul bas/ /sngon tshe ye shes bsnyes pa'i lha/ /gang yin de la 'bab par shog /oṃ pra —96—

tismo badzra ho/ bcu dgu pa me tog 'ching ba ni/ oṃ pra ti gro hā su mi maX sa tā mahā ba la/ nyi shu pa nam mkha'i kha dog brtag pa ni/ rang gi las dang rjes su mthun pa'i kha dog mthong bar gyur/ ces brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ skabs 'dir dri lan byed pa lag len mi bde ba'i me tog 'dor ba'i sngon du byed pa spyi dang 'dra ba'i lag len yod pa ltar 'gal ba med do/ /yig rnying 'ga' re dang / sngon gyi lag len zhig la skabs 'dir gsang ming 'dogs pa'i srol zhig byung ba/ snying ma ba'i lag len 'chugs pa ni min nam/ gang ltar mkhas pa rnams phyag len mi mdzad pas reg zhig lag len mi byed la/ rnying ma la de ltar byed pa la yang dgos pa cig yod do/ /nyer gcig pa gdong dbye ba ni/ rang bzhin rnam dag bdag nyid kyi/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug ma yi gnas/ /dri med rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni lta bar gyis/ oṃ dzñā na tsakṣu huX aX nyer gnyis pa lha ngo bstan pa ni/bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs mngon rtogs ltar zhib mor bstan na legs so/ /de nas dngos gzhi las/ slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ sdoms ni/gsol gdab dbang lha spyan 'dren dang / /chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang / /dril bu ming dang sngags dbang dang / /brtul zhugs rgyan dang dbugs dbyung dang / /lung bstan rnams su shes par bya/ dang po ni/ bsam gyis mi khyab chos kyi snod/ /dbang bskur dam pa mdzad du gsol/lan gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na/ 'khor gyi bum chu rnams rnam rgyal bum par bsdu/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' sems ma/ ye shes khro —97—

bo khro mo thams cad badzra sa mā dza/ rma badzra argha swāhā/ oṃ badzra purnyu ā hū/ nasashasta'i bar/ phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ sogs sho lo karnya ga gis bstod/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ 'gro ba skyob pa'i rmad du dbang / yon to 'byung nas ji ltar stsal/ de bzhin 'di la gnang bar zhu/ lan gsum/ gsum pa ni/ a mṛ tasabasangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ pa las padma dang ra las nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ gnyis ka'ang hu las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang /g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / cung zad khro bo'i ltas can/ dar dang rin po tsho rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ yum mā ma gī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hū/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra sa mā dza dza / ba ho~X/ skabs 'dir rgyas pa la mos na/ dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur rgyas gdab dang mchod bstod bya/ bsdun mi dgos/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba: sogs bkra shis tshig brjod/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing / sku gsum dam tshig las byung ba/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /mi bskyod pas ni dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ā dar sha dzñā na a bhi 'khri ñtsa ya mi/ bum chu btung / de ltar dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba mi —98—

bskyod par gyur pas dbus brgyan/ oṃ badzra punyu āXhūX/ sogs nyer spyod lngas ma rdzo/gong du dbang rdzas dang slob ma la lhan cig tu mchod pa phul nas/ 'dir slob ma'i mchod pa mi byed pa'i lugs kyang yod do/ /lag len dkyus ltar bya'o/ /de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhes sdang dag rnam shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas so/ /sdoms ni/ bsangs sbyang sngon du 'gro ba yi/ /lhar bskyed byin rlabs ye shes dgug /dbang rdzas zhu zhing shis pa brjod/ /dbang bskur mchod dang rtogs pa bskyed/ /chu dbang bskur ba'i sdoms yin te/ khres brjod ma gtogs cod pan sogs/ /phyi ma bzhi la'ang 'dra ba yin/ /brtan byed chu dbang lhag por bskur/ zhes go bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni bsangs sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzasadabu rgyan mi dmigs te/ gnyis ka'ang aX las rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i: yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa sangs rgyas thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam pa spyan drangs: dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ dbu rgyan ཿngas dar dbyangs bskon bzhi du/sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che/ /dbu rgyan rin chen bla na med/ /rin chen kun gyi mchog 'gro ba/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzra sa ma tā dzñā na ratna swa bhā wa huX/ a bhi khri 3 mi/ bum chus spyi bor gtor la/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi kheñtsa hūX/ de ltar dbang bskur bas: zhes dang / spyi bor 'khyil ba rin chen 'byung —99—

ldan du gyur pas dbu brgyan: cod pan gyi dbang : ser sna: tshor ba'i phung rṣamanyam pa nyid kyi: rin chen 'byung ldan gyi: zhes 'don pa spo/ gzhan thams cad chu dbang dang 'dra/ de kho nas phyi ma gsum la rigs 'gre ste/ lnga pa ni/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje: dzi las 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po g.yas padma dang : yum gos dkar mo dmar mo1 sangs rgyas thams cad 'od dpag med kyi: dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang /mi phyed rdo rje gsang ba las/ chos rnams kun gyi sgor gyur pa'i/ rdo rje chos kyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzra pra ti be da dzñā na a bhi khri po ni mi/ oṃ badzre bha wa a bhi khri ྅ sta huXngu spyi bor 'khyil ba 'od dpag med du gyur pas 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang je 'dod chags 'du shes kyi phung po so sor rtog pa'i ye shesaje'od dpag med kyi: zhes 'don pa spo/ drug pa ni/ dbang rdzas dril bu: khaX las don yong grub pa sku mdog ljang khu/ g.yas ral gri: /yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khunguthams cad don yod grub pa'i: dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa: dril bur gyur/shes rab thabs dang ldan pa yi/ /'gro don mnyam med byed pa dang / /mchod pa'i las rnams rdzogs byed pa'i/ /dril bu lus kyi dbang skur ro/ /oṃ kṛ tyā nu ṭha dzñā na a bhi rdzi myu hūX/ oṃ badzre: don yod grub par gyur pas don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i phrag dog 'du byed kyi phung po bya ba sgrub pa'i: don yod grub pa'i zhes 'don pa spo/ bdun pa ni/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu mi dmigs te/ bhuX las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas 'khor le1 yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar sna6 sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par —100—

snang mdzad kyi: dbang rdzas kyi rnam par snang mdzad: rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /cis kyang mi shigs mi g.yo ba/ /rdo rje'i ming du rab tu bsgrags/ oṃ tri tsakra dharma dhwa tu dzñā na badzra a bhi khiñtsa mi/ kyai dpal/ phyag na rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /oṃ badzre bha wa rnam par snang mdzad du gyur pas rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas: gti mug: gzugs kyi phung po chos dbyings ye shes rnam par sna mdzad gyi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas so/ /zhes 'don pa spo/ brgyad pa ni/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar/ arghaXngu nas shasta'i bar gyis sngags mchod phul/thig le'i rang bzhin mi shigs pa/ kha sbyor nyi zla'i 'phro 'du las/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag 'joms mdzad pa/ /'khor lo'i bdag po khyod la bstod/ oX ni lwa sba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇa hri da ya/ mahwa kro rda sa twa huX phaṭa/ lan gsum/ bcom ldan bdag gi bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ 'di la slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs ni/ slob dpon gyis bzlas pa cung zad byas nas/ lag len gsung gi rjes gnang bzhin byed do/ /dgu pa ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las nyi ma'i gdan la huX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing /g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa zhabs g.yon brkyang gi bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/dpral bar: nas sangs rgyas thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs/—101—

oṃ badzra sa mā dza dza / ba hoX hu las byung ba'i rdo rje lag pa g.yas su gtad/'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /mthu stobs mnga' bdag phyag na bsnams/khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ oṃ badzra satwa stu a bhi khiñtsa mi/ lan gsum gsor/ deng phyin chad tha mal gyi spyod pa brtul la/ phyag na rdo rje'i tshul zhugs la tshul bar gyis shig spros pa byed na 'dir yang chu dbang bskur nas mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan dang mchod pa sogs byed do/ /'ag pa ni/ bsangs sbyangasasogs brtul tsos dang 'dra ba las/ yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog mthing nag /nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub/ bar pa gnyis thal mo rdeb pa/ tha ma gnyis sbrul nag gi sked pa nas 'dzin zhing / mgo bo zhal du gsol zhing mjug ma zhabs 'og tu gnon pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis padma myongs pa brgya byin zla ba nyi ma rnams kyi gdan la bzhugs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /dpral bar tho nas ba ho'i bar brtul zhugs kyi skabs bzhin/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /na bza' chos gos sngon po 'di/ /de ring khyod la spyin par bya/ khams gsum kun las rgyal bar shog /rgyan dang cha lugs 'bar ba 'di/ /dpa' bo'i bu yis blang bar gyis/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul bzhugs brtan/ /phyi dang nang na yang dag gnas/ oṃ nī lwa sba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi he he/ stangs stabs bya zhing rdo rje gsor la/ hu hu zhes lan mang du brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs tshigs bcad snga ma la stag lpags dang gos sngon tshigs bcad phyi ma'i skabs sbrul rgyan dang khro zhal dang phyag mawo rdor dril sogs gtod/—102—

gzhan med na rdo rje tsam lag tu gtad pas kyang chog khro zhal zer ba 'di khro 'bag gi ming yin/ tsa ka li byed pa nor ro/ /oṃ badzre: mi bskyod par gyur pas dbu rgyan/ pu tshu sogs/lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na/ sogs kyis bstod/ deng nas khyod rdo rje 'chang chen po'i brtul zhugs la gnas par gyis shig bcu gcig pa ni/ nga ni shākya seng ge ste/ /rgyan cha phyag na rdo rjer byas/ /'di kun nga yis sprul pa ste/ /ma 'jigs 'jigs par ma byed cig /khyod ni 'khor ba'i 'jigs las thar/ /mi bskyod sangs rgyas zhing khams su/ /rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar 'gyur/ /de ltar bdag gis lung bstan to/ /oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hu/ a bhi sa ṣañtsa mi/ kyai dpal/dpal phyag na rdo rje zhes/ bya ba'i de bzhin gshe/gas pa'o/ /bha wa swa/ dkyil 'khor 'di la dbugs dbyung zer/ spyi khyab tu lung bstan zer ba de yin/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs kyi lag len nam lung bstan spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ bu khyod 'bor lo'i dbang bskur bas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid yin/ /phyag na rdo rje mthu stobs can/ /de bzhin gshegs par lung bstan no/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te/ /grong khyer mchog du zhugs pa yin/ oṃ ni la ba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi sidha sa ma ya stu/ a bhi ti thu stu sku/ dpal phyag na rdo rje zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag gis ni slob ma'i dbang mchog bstan zin to/ /sdoms ni/rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur la//phyir mi ldog dang rjes gnang gnyis/ /gsol btab dbang stegs lha skyed dang / /byin rlabs ye shes dbang bskur dang / /nang gi lha dbang chos 'khor bskor/ /mchod bstod bstan bzhugs bya ba rnams/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur yin/ /mchod dang sems can don —103—

byed pa'i/ /rjes gnang rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ ces pa blo la nges par bya'o/ /dang po gsol gdab ni/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ mtshan ma med par 'gro ba'i don/ /gang dag gis ni byed nus pa/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che/ /dpa' bo chen pos bdag la stsal// /lan gsum/gnyis pa dbang stegs ni/ dkyil 'khor ra gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan dang bcas pa/ de'i steng thad du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang bla bre/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ mtha' skor du mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pa dang bcas par gyur/ gsum pa lhar bskyed pa ni/ gdan de'i steng du rang nyid gnas te/ oṃ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hū las rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/g.yas rdo rje: yum rdo rje snye ma dkar mo gri gug dang : bzhi pa byin rlabs dang lnga pa ye shes ni/ dpral bar: sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra sa mā dza dza : ba ho/ drug pa dbang bskur ni/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bar gyur/ ji ltar bltams pa: nas/ shri ye hū/ de ltar dbang bskur bas: rdo rje 'chang chen por gyur pas dbu brgyan/ de dag ni chu dbang la 'don pa spo rgyu yin/ bdun pa nang gi lha dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/hu las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa/ de'i lte bar dpal 'khor lo chen po lha bco brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ ni lwa: nas hu hū phaṭa/ lan dgu'am bco brgyad bzlas/ rang gi snying —104—

gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hū las byung ba'i rdo rje de'i lte bar gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /ta du thā/ bho bho: nas bya ti hū/ dkyil ge dur gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje yum lha mo mdzes ldan mas 'khyud pa/ thugs ka nas byung rang gi snying ga'i nang gi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su bzhugs par gyur/ o pa ra kra ma ya phaṭa: nas na sha ya hū phaṭa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams thugs ka nas spros/ rang gi snying ga'i nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi so so'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ gtso 'khor rnams kyi zhal phyag sogs mngon rtogs bzhin brjod na legs/ spros pa la dga' na 'dir yang gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams byed de legs pa'ang yin la/ bsdu na lha bkod pa tsam gyis chog go /brgyad pa chos 'khor bskor du bzhug pa ni/ tse( badzra he tu ma/ o badzra bha ga ra/ o badzra lha rnye a deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun du gang bar gyis/ zhes brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ 'khor lo dung dril bu po ti rnams gtod/ bdag nyid khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur pa la mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mchod par gyur/ dgu pa mchod bstod ni/ argha: nas sha lta'i bar mchod pa dgu tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar phul/ stobs po che la drag shul che/ /rig sngags rgyal po dge ba po/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bcu pa brtan bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ o su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ de —105—

dag gi phyir mi ldog gi dbang ngo / /rjes gnang gnyis kyi mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ mi bya ba ni gang yang med/ /dpa' bo chen po nga yi bkas/ /'dod pa lnga la spyod par gyis/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang ni/deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis/ /lus dang srog la mi blta bar/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /'gro ba'i don ni mnyam med kyis/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung chos can/ /sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no/ khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ ces pa'o/ /de nas de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chog sum cu rtsa bdun no/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ 'jig rten pa dang theg pa dman pa rnams kyis rtogs par dka' ba'o/ /dur khrod brgyad ni rnam shes brgyad dag pa'o/ /phung po lnga dag pa'i ye shes lnga ni khro bo lnga'o/ /'byung ba lnga dag pa'i tshad med lnga ni yum lnga'o/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang 'phrin las dag pa'i sgo skyong rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das ni chos nyid mi 'gyur bas sku mdog dang rtsa zhal mthing ka'o/ /g.yas zhal dkar ba ni skyon dang bral ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba ni sems can rjes su 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum ni dus gsum mkhyen pa/ zhabs gnyis kyi bskyang bskum ni rtag pa dang chad pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pa/ phyag drug ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug ste/ sa gsum gyi gdon 'joms pa/ gzung 'dzin spangs ba'i stag lpags/ mi dge ba spangs pa'i gos sngon/ sna tshogs pa'i yon to ni sku'i rgyan no/ /wo brjod/ de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag /lam bskyed rim sgom pa dang —106—

'phrin las sgrub pa la dbang / sa dang po man chad kyi nus pa 'jog sku rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas/ gsang dbang du maṇḍal phul/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /gsang ba'i spyod pa thabs ldan pa'i/ khres rab chen po'i snod 'gyur phyir/ /dbang bskur chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'am/gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsal du gsol/ zhes 'don pa spos kyang rung / lan gsum/gsang spyod thabs dang ldan pa yi/ /ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med/ /bdud rtsi chen po'i ro myang phyir/ dbang bskur 'di la khyod spro'am/ tshig gong ma gsum 'dra ba las/dbang bskur 'di la bdag spro lags/ ā kha lī ra hū/ mig dar bcings/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer ma mchis pa/ yab yum rjes su chags pa snyoms par zhugs pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/yab yum gyi sku la rjes su bzhugs par gyur/ yum gyi padma'i sna rtser padma 'dab lnga'i lhe ba la rdo rje mā ma ki/ 'dab ma bzhi la spyan ma dang / rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma rnams bzhugs/ yab kyi rdo rje'i bu gar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar mi bskyod pa/ rtsibs bzhi la rnam snang rin 'byung / 'od dpag med/ don yod sgrub pa rnams 'khor bar gyur/ phyi dang nang gi lha mo rnams kyi mkha' ni a las byung ba'i padma a sa mtshan pa dang /dpa' bo rnams kyi gsang ba hu las rdo rje hū gis mtshan par gyur/ phyi dbyibs kyi lha yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ gzhir gnas kyi thig le dkar dmar dang / sngar sbyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor bcas thams cad gsang ba'i —107—

rigs lnga yab yum la thim/ rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas thabs dang shes rab ro mnyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bde ba'i ngo bor zhu/ de nyid thabs shes kyi mkha' gsang las phyir byung ste/ bdag gi lce la bzhag /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /dam tshig 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ khams lnga yi ni ros gang ba'i/ /bde ba chen po myang bar gyis/ zhes go du brjod/ ā ho su kha skal chen po/ /dngos sgrub dam pa rtsal du gsol/ gsang rdzas myangs bar gyur/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de bzhin bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ oṃ ā hu/ gdong g.yogs bkrol/ de ltar na byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /sa bdun pa man chad kyi nus pa bzhag /lam rtsa dang rlung gi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang / gsung rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas so/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ gsol gdab dang dri ba dri lan mig dar bcing ba gsang dbang dang 'dra ba las/ shes rab ye shes dbang bskur stsol/ zhes 'don pa spos kyang sto / mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya ye shes bsgrub pa'i don du gtad par gyur/ lha mo 'di ni khyad par che/ /mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo/ /rnam pa kun tu phyag rgya long / /bu yi bla med mchod par gyis/ /des kyang byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /bu yis ci dgar bza' nus sam/ /phyag rgya lnga las byung ba yi/ /rig ma dad pas mchod nus sam/ /bshang gci khu ba rakta sogs/ /'di nyid du ni bsten nus sam/ /nga yi gsang ba'i padma ni/ /bde ba myur du skyes pa ste/ khyod kyis rtag tu mchod nus sam/ zhes bris pa la/ ji skad —108—

bshad pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ spyo lan bto/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang / rig ma lha mo mdzes ldan ma'i skur/ dpral bar o/ mgrin par āthugs kar hū/ yab kyi gsang gnas hu las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hu gis mtshan zhing / rtse mor phaṭa kyis brgyan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las byung ba'i padma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa a yig gis mtshan pa/ yab yum snyom par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes spyi bo'i ha yi ga bzhu ste/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhir lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog gi dga' ba bzhi mngon du byas par gyur/ o ā hū/ mig dar bkrol/ rdo rje spyi bor bas nga dang rdo rje slob dpon dang / /mched dang lcam dral la sogs dang / khams gsum sems can thams cad la/ /ma mos brnyas par ma byed cig /gzhan yang dam tshig bshad pa rnams/ /rtag tu khyod kyis srung bar gyis/ /deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmi lam bzhin du sems can gyi/ /don ni bdag nyid kun gyis kyai/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag /pho nya'i lam sgom pa la dbang / dag pa sa gsum gyi nus pa bzhag thugs rdo rje mngon du 'gyur pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇḍal phul/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang / /de ring ring chen bzhi pa yang / /bka' drin gyis ni bdag la skyobs/ lan gsum/ ye shes 'di ni cher phra zhing / /rdo rje rnying po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rdul bral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ sems —109—

nyid bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gdod ma nas don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du rang shar ba/ zab mo dang gsal ba gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni bzhi pa'i don gyi de kho na nyid do/ /'di'i gzhung na dbang bzhi pa zhal shes su mdzad/ bod snga ma rnams kyi yi ge na/ bzhi pa la mig dar bcings 'grol re yang byed par byas mod/ rang lugs la mi dgos so/ /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /lam phyag rgya chen po bsam mi khyab sgom pa la dbang / sa bcu gcig pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i nus pa bzhag /ye shes rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas so/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' rtsal pa/ de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi lan gsum/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te: sogs bya/ dge ba bsngo'o/ /de nas nang gtor rnams nang mchod ltar byin gyis rlabs/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la klu dang : zhes pa nas/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar nang gtor rgyas par 'bul lo/ /de dag gis ni dngos gzhi'i cho ga las/ bdag 'jug gi rim pa rnams bstan zin to/ /slob ma dbang bskur ba'i bya ba la ni/ rnam pa gnyis te/ nub dang po slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba dang / nub phyi ma dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i bya ba dngos so/ dang po ni/ lha sta gon gyi nyin par de nyid yin na tshom bu sogs la rjes ma bsdus na/ yol bas sgrib par 'dod kyang mtha' gcig tu nges pa mi dgos pas ci bder bya/ dkyil 'khor bris zin nas dngos gzhi'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i bya ba dang 'brel ba'i skabs yin na/ yol ba 'thug pos bsgribs te phyogs tsam yang mi mthong bar byed pa gal che/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/ slob dpon gyis/ slob —110—

ma rnams sems bskyed gsal 'debs su bcug /chos bshad bya/ slob mas sta gon gyi don du maṇḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ nas/ mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ gyi bar spyi dang mthun pa gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ zhes pa nas/ bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig ces pa'i bar spro ba bskyed pa spyi dang 'dra ba las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / sogs tshig rkang drug mi byed par/ dus gsum 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /rdo rje gsang sngags 'di bsgom pas/ zhes brjod pa'i lugs de mdzad/ dpa' bos byang chub shing drud du/ zhes pa man chad spyi 'gro ltar ro/ de nas sdom pa bzung ba'i don du ma rdzo phul la/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar dgu rnam par dag pa bya ste/ de yang/ phyogs bcu/'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la/ /sgo gsum dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ zhes pa nas/ de dag don du sems bskyed do/ /zhes pas mthun mong gi sdom pa bzung / sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / zhes pa nas/mya ngan 'das la 'god/ kyi bar ro/ de nas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ amri tas sangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing /g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ pad nyi la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing rgyan dang cha byas yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ dri bzang bdud rtsi dang bsres pa'i thig le gnas gsum du reg oX āXhuX/ dpral bar oṃ las 'khordo ra lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āXlas padma dmar po aXs mtshan pa/ thugs kar —111—

hu las rdo rje sngon po hū gis mtshan pa/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim par mos shig de nas mchod pa lnga po rim bzhin phul/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /mchod pa kun dang ldan pa yi/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig ces so/ /de nas snying po bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i so shing ster te/ cho ga spyi dang 'dra/ de nas spro ba bskyed pa yang / 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ zhes sogs spyi dang 'dra bar brjod pa las/ go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / 'gro don mnyam med byed par nus/ zhes pa 'jug /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ de la bu yis brtson par gyis/ zhes pa ni khyad par ro/ /de nas dpung skud 'ching ste/ a mṛ ta'i sngags kyis so de nas ku sha spyin pa yang spyi dang 'dra/gzhung 'dir ma bshad kyang / khyor chu sbyin pa yang dgos pa mngon te/ byed na so shing gi rjes la'o/de nas rmi lam brtag cing ngan na srung ba ni/ bu kyai nang par dkyil 'khor mchog /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang/ /rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa/ /de kun nga la legs par smos/ zhes brjod cing don spund pa yang spyi dang 'dra'o/ slob ma sta gon mdo tsam bstan zin to/ /dngos gzhi slob ma dbang bskur ni/ bdag 'jug grol ba na/ slar yang gong bzhin bden stobs brjod nas/ bdag 'jug ji ltar byas pa bzhin slob ma la bskur ba yin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rags rim rnams gong bdag 'jug gi skabs su brjod zin la/ gzhan ni lag len byed pa'i rim pa la bltas pas shes par 'gyur gyi yi ges ci zhig bya/ deng sang 'di na chen rlom 'ga' zhig gzhan la 'gran pa'i phyir dang / chos rgyun rnam dag la gnod pa skyel ba'i phyir/ dpe —112—

sgrogs kyi dbang bskur 'dra byed de/ sangs rgyas dang thams cad mkhyen par khas len bzhin du/dbang bskur lugs lag len 'ol ci tsam yang mi shes par yu ba med pa'i gzhug sdum shes ldan khrel ba'i rgyu mang po snang ba/ de dag ni dang por bla ma la ma thob/ bar du lag len ma mthong /mthar dpe cha bltas pas go la re byas kyang khong ma khrol ba'i skyon yin/ gzhan la 'dran pa'i phyir du cho ga 'dra byed 'dod nas/ brgyus pa dang khungs gang yang mi 'tshol bar gnas gzhi gog po re nas blun po dam mnyam sdom shor re bos te/ gsang sngags kyi phyag len yar 'bul gyin yod do/ /zer ba mthong ste/ gar 'chams 'dra dang mgur dbyangs yin zer nas bod skad rgyag /mi nag mgo skor 'dra byed/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rmangs nas zhig /gsang sngags kyi srog rtsa bcad/ rgyal khams phur bar byed pa yin pa/ de ltar ma go bar shes ldan yin du re ba'i dge bshes dang / sde dpon dag de'i rjes la rgyug pa dag snang ba ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pas thab tu gzhug par bya rgyu yin no//des na gsang sngags kyi chos de rgyud gzhung tshad ldan las bshad pa zhig dgos/ brgyud pa ma chad pa zhig dgos/ lag len ma 'tshol ba zhig dgos/ bla ma'i 'og tu slob ma 'dzul ba zhig dgos/shes rab dang rig pa yod rlom gyi bla chos byas pas mi 'ong / shes rab kyi nyi ma shar ba zhig gis kyang nan tan zhib tig byas pa zhig dgos pa yin/ po ti bltas pa gcig pus kyang mi 'ong / nyams myong yin rdzu dang / khog nas brdol ba yin lo ba'i zol sbyor dang / zhal mthong yin zer ba dang / bla ma ma bsten par skye ba dran pa yin/ pha mes kyi chos yin zer ba sogs kyis grul mi btub dus deng sang bla ma'i zhal gyi man ngag gis legs par brgyan pa/ sel med cing byin rlabs dang ldan pa zhig dgos so/ /rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa gsar ba bshams/ snying pa kha gso/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i mchod pa'i skabs bzhi byin gyis bsas/ 'gro ba'i mgon po thugs rje can/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la/ gzung 'dzin dri mas ma gos par/ /—113—

mnyes phyir sku gsung thugs la 'bul/ oṃ nī lā ba ra dha ra badzra pā ṇi argha/ pā du añtsa ma na/ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hu/ zhes chu gsum tshig gcig gis 'bul/ /gzhan me tog dam pa 'di dag ni/ zhes sogs rol mo'i bar du gong bzhi/thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yi/ zhes pa nas/ las kun sgrub la bstod/ spyi dang mthun par dngos sgrub zhu/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya mang du bzla/ ma 'byor ba dang :sogs/ lhag pa dang ni : sogs/ gtso bo nus pa: sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor yin na brtan bzhugs spyi dang mthun/ rdul tshon gyi cho ga zhag sbrel byed pa'i snga ma rnams la'ang gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes brjod/rdul tshon gshegs gsol byed na sngon du tho phyin rten gsum yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs byas/de rjes rdul tshon gshegs gsol dang / rdul tshon chu bor sbyan 'dren dang bum pa bsdu ba dang / thig chas bsdu ba gnas gsum byin rlabs dang srung ba dang / bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs bya ste spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'khor lo chen po dbang gi che bar grags/ /rgyud sde'i mthar thug rnal 'byor bla med lugs/ /gsang sngags phyi 'gyur tshad ldan dbang bzhi'i srol/ /mkhas mang bye bas bsten 'di ngo mtshar rmad/ /dbang chog bris pa'i dge ba gang / /ston ka'i zla ltar dkar ba des/ /'gro ba drug na spyod pa rnams/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pa gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil chog srid gsum 'dul byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ dza ba ri pa'i dkyil chog gi gzhung yod/ sma ra chen po'i gsal byed dang / kun mkhyen sa ṅgha ba dang / lo tsā ba rin rnam ma dang / 'dul 'dzin grags rgyal ma sogs dkyil chog snga phyi mang po'ang mthong mod kyi/ thams cad kha skongs than thun ma gtogs don la 'gal ba mi 'jug cing / dkyil chog bod ma rnams na mi gsal ba gzhung na yod pa'ang ci rigs snang / 'dir ni gzhung dang mthun par snying po'i gnad bsdus te/ rgyal khams pa tā —114—

ra nā thas bkod pa'o// // dza ya dza ya dza yantu/ yang smras pa/ 'di la dkyil chog mang na yang / /man ngag lugs dang gzhung gi lugs/ /ma 'dres 'byed pa nyung ba'i phyir/ /'dir ni gsal bar bkod pa yin/ /bar skabs byung ba'i man ngag la/ /gzhung gi don du rlom pa rnams/ /gzhung ni 'khrugs can yin no zhes/ /gzhung don log par 'dzin pa mthong / /lo paṇa dngos kyi man ngag kyang / /smad par mi bya bzang mod kyi/ /kyai rdor 'brog lugs 'phags skor dang / /'phreng ba'i kha bskongs 'dir mi dgos/ /'di ni thun mong man ngag ste/ /ku sa li ba'i lugs yin pas/ /mang po bltas pa'i legs bsdus kyis/ /chos 'di'i lugs su mi 'gyur ro/ /mkhas pa'i lugs la mkhas pa dang / /ku sa li la rnal 'byor pa'i/ /lugs bzhin legs par shes na ni/ /skyon med yon tan kun ldan 'gyur/ zhes pa'ang tā ra na thas ched du brjod pa'o/ / zhus dag/ maṅgal//—115—

'joms rol ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ khyu sti/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud 'joms rol ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /cho ga 'di'i dbang du byas nas don gsum ste/ dmigs par bya ba'i yul/bsgrub par bya ba'i thabs/ nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni gzhi 'bras kyi de kho na nyid nas gang la mngon spyod bya ba'i yul gyi bar ro/ /gnyis pa la drug ste/ phun tshogs lnga dang ldan pas gzhi bca' zhing / /sgrub pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i las rim bstan/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa dngos la 'jug /slob ma dkyil 'khor gzhugs shing dbang bskur bshad/ /gsum tshan gnyis kyis kha skongs las 'jug bsdu/ /bshags bsdoms las kyis phra mo'i nyes pa sbyang / zhes pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sgrub po gnas dang rdzas dang yo byad dus/ zhes bya ba slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid sogs te gzhan du gsal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma la dmigs te/ oX badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li huX tshinta tshinta hūX phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oX su bha wa shu yi spuXsarba dharmaXswa bhā wa rga smosa3haX/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhāX las byung ba'i gtor snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āXhūX las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ bhuX ratna pañtsa a mṛ ta hūX oX āXhūX/ phyogs skyong ba bcu gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa —116—

thams cad badzra sa mā dzaX oX int+ra ye/ asna ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ṛ te/ bā ru ṇa/ bā ya be/ ku be ra/ i shā na/ pra rmi pri thi ldi de lī swāhā/ na maXsarba ta thā ga ta khyo bi shwa mu khe khyuXsarba thā khaX uta ga te sa spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX gro sno daX ba lo ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ tseX( gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug/ mar gnas pa la sogs pa/ sarba bhā te rtso sa pā ri wa re khyuX/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā nāX a du nus sno twad oX āXhuX ༄phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum arghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar spyi dang 'dra/ sa'i phyogs 'dir rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs te sgrub pa la 'jug par 'tshal gyi/ phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa dkar phyogs skyong ba dam tshig can rnams kyis bar chad srung ba dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i gtong grogs mdzod cig /bar ma rnams kyis kyang ru ma nga / phrag ma dog /phan pa'i sems kyis 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i 'phrin las ci 'grub tu mdzad du gsol/ ma rung log 'dren gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa thams cad gtor ma'i lhag ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /ces rol mo'i sgra dang bos te phyir dor/ gnas dang rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gong bzhin a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang huX yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che ba/ dbus su zlaX las dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su snags pa'i nang du oX las byung ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su/ oX āXhuX rnams las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pas —117—

yongs su gang bar gyur/ oX badzra arghaX swāhā/ oṃ badzra pu duX swāhā/ oṃ badzra pursha āXhūX nas sha lta āXhuX/ tsho rna rū pa kā ma gu ṇa āXhuX/ rū pa'i tshab tu sha lta ganta ra sa sparnye dharma dhwa tu/ zhes pa rnams bcug rol mo'i sgra bya/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs 'don no/ /de ltar sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas rdzas byin rlabs ni nyi ma phal cher la 'jug go /de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems sgom bzlas rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/ oX shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra su ༷bhā ༷wa aXkhru ko3haX/ eX yaX raX baX laX raX ke snruX bhūX bi shwa bi shudhe dzñāX nā tsaXkra maṇḍal hu bhā/ pa padma maṇḍal hu/ a tsand+ra maṇḍal hu/ ma surya maṇḍal hu/ sha ru dra ru dri ti re baX/ huX huX spa ra ṇa phaṭa/ saX ha ra ṇa huX/ oṃ badzra gī li gī la ya sarba spre baX hūX phaṭa/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po he ru ka zhes pa nas/ ting 'dzin sems dpa' a yig ge'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar brjod/ oX badzra kro dha huX ka ra huX ga rdza ga rdza hūX phaṭa/ steng du khro bo hūX mdzad sngo/ zhes pa nas/ mi ro'i gdan la rol gar mdzad/ ces pa'i bar du 'og nas 'byung ba ltar brjod/ arghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug tshul ston zhing /nas/ gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/ de 'dra'i lha tshogs nas/dbang dang dngos grub stso'/ gyi bar brjod/ snying po brgya rtsa sogs dang / khro bo bcu'i sngags ji ltar rigs pa bzlas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying gar thim/ dzaXhūX baX ho/ 'di ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bsdus pa ste/ nyi ma dang po kho na la 'jug go/cho ga de rnams ni bshad 'bum so so'i rtsis mgos bsdus pa min yang gsang sngags spyi 'gros dang / bla ma brgyud pa'i lag len las byung ba yin no/ /da ni sgrub pa'i sngon 'gro las rim dngos la/ sa chog mtshams gcod phyi skangs dang / /las gsum phur bu byin rlabs dang / /phur bshar —118—

'debs dang mchod pa 'gram/ /bum pa 'god dang ma ta sgrol/ dang po ni/ de nas gser skyems dang gtor ma bsham/ sngon 'gro gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta a wa 'e1 ki te tse( sambha ra sambha ra hu/ zhes lan bdun tsam gyis bsngos/ spros pa byed na gser skyems rgyas pa gyer/hū dgongs shig sa bdag lha klu sde dang dpung / /byin rlabs bsngo ba'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /'phrin las gnyan po sgrub phyir sa slong gi /rin chen gter gyis sa 'di stsal du gsol/ lan gsum gyi mthar phud gtor gtor ma phyir bto /rol chen byas la/ sa slong zhing bka' bsgo'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i gnas su dri bzang gi thig le'am tshom bu bkod gtor ma dang mchod pa byin rlabs sngar bzhin bya ste gnas khang srung 'khor dang gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa mi dgos so/ /ha ha ha rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas/ /kun gyi yum chen sangs rgyas spyan/ /nor 'dzin sa yi lha mo ni/ /'khor dang bcas pa gshe/gas su gsol/ /o pri thi lī de ldi ā ga smo a ga smo dza hū ba ho/ oṃ ba su dha ri argha nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ khyod ni sa 'jin gtso mo ste/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu 'jig rten skyong / gser mdog phyag na bum pa bsnams/ /'jig rten yum gyur phyag 'tshal bstod/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nas/ rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor 'bri/ ga tsā ga tsā rdza za nā de dag ni sa blang ba'o/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta hu/lan bdun brjod/ ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyang ba'o/ /las dang bya bas sbyang ba ni/ stegs bu byed pa sogs 'dir ma bshad do/ /de nas stang stabs kyis bzung ba ni/ spros pa la dga' na/ mcham yig las 'byung ba ltar/ dpal chen po'i 'gying mcham la sogs pa phur bu'i rtsa mchams su grags pa rnams skabs 'dir byed pa yin zhing / spros pa gtso bor mi byed na mcham med kyang mchog go /—119—

slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo bcu spros/ oṃ badzra gī li sogs/ o di bha sogs/ o badzra kro dha hu ka ra nas/ sbo ṭa spro ṭa hu phaṭa/ bgegs sbyang ba spyi dang mthun par/ zhi bas sbyang ba dang / zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba dang / drag pos sbyang ba rnams byed pa las/ khro bo'i bstod pa'i 'jug tu/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i nas/gdon mi za/ zhes pa'i bar bgegs la bka' bsgo tshig lhug pa'i skabs/ bden pa chen pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dpal rdo rje phur bu 'phrin las kyi sgrub pa chen po rtsom pa yin gyi/ srid pa gsum gyi bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par/zhes 'don pa spo/rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bdug rdzas kyis bdug yungs kar brabs te/ 'byung bzhi'i rdzas kyis sbyang ba yang bya'o/ /de dag ni sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang ba'o/ /sa bzung pa la nges par bya dgos pa ni/ mchod gtor bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la 'dug nas/ /'og tu 'chad 'gyur ltar ya gyi mes bsregs zhes rdzas byin rlabs nas gzung bzlas pa'i 'jug gi bstod pa/ dpal gyi bka' sdod sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar du bya/ sa ha ra ṇa hū/ dza hu ba ho zhes dkyil 'khor rang gi thugs kar bsdu'o/ yang na stang stabs kyis bzung ba skabs 'dir byas kyang chog go /gnyis pa mtshams bcad pa ni sa srung ba ste/de la dang por rgyal chen bzhi bya ra ba'i tshul du bzhag pa ni/ mtho brtsigs de la rgyal chen gyi sngags bris/ so sor mchod gtor zug ma/ thog mar shar gyi de la mchod pa dang gtor ma byin rlabs sa'i lha mo'i skabs bzhi bya/ lko zla ta ra gi ya swāhā/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung sku mdog dkar po go'u rgyud mangs 'dzin pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ri rab kyi ba rim nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor bcas badzra sa mā —120—

dzaX eX( khyo ta ra ni ya/ na maXsarba sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags btags pas gtor ma 'bul/ arghaX nas sha lta'i bar gyi mchod/ dri za dag gi bdag po rgyal/ tar gyi phyogs rnams skyong byed pa/ /rgyal po chen po gnas srung po/ /btsun mo sras dang blon por bcas/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'dis bzhes la/nas/ kun 'grub shog shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung / /'jig rten skyong ba grags dang ldan/ /sde bo che la stobs po che/ kha dog ldan zhing rdzu 'phrul che/ /bdag cag re ba bskang ba'i phyir/ /ma dag pa rnams mtshams chod cig khar phyogs bgegs kyi mtshams chod cig /zhi ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /bdag cag sgrub pa ma thon gyi bar du/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor bcas kyis gdon bgegs bar chad nang du mi btang zhing / dngos grub phyi la yal du mi gzhug par sgrub pa'i gtong grogs dam pa mdzod cig ces bya/ g.yin gsum la'ang de kho nas rigs 'gre ste/ oX bee ru lha ka ye swāhā/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po/ sku mdog sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa zhes tshul des so so'i mawo dang sngags rnams spos/ grul bum dag gi: lho phyogs: rgyal po chen po lus 'phags po lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po: lho'i bgegs rnams: mngon spyod 'phrin las: zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /de bzhin du/ nub ma la/ oX bi ru pā kṣa ya swāhā/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang sku mdog dmar po sbrul zhags dang mchod rten 'dzin pa/ klu rnams dag gi:nub kyi: spyan mi bzang : nub phyogs na ni spyan mi bzang: nub kyi bgegs rnams: dbang gi 'phrin las zhes 'don pa spo/ byang gi la/ oṃ bee shra wa ṇa ya snya hā/—121—

rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ sku mdog ser po be con dang ne'u 'dzin pa:gnod sbyin dag gi byang gi: ngal gsos po byang phyogs na ni rnam thos bu:byang gi bgegs rnams: rgyal ba'i 'phrin las: zhes 'don pa spo/ de nas khro bo bcu jag pa'i tshul du btang ba ni/ sgrub khang gi phyi rol gom pa nyer gcig tsam gyi mtshams su 'brub khung byed par bshad kyang / tshad nges bzung mi dgos te/ sgrub khang gi phyi mtshams ji ltar 'os par dong chung ngu ca zad re brus la/ phur chung bcu khro bo bcur mos/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu rnams bkug ste/ 'khrub khung gi nang du bcug par gyur/ steng gi 'brub khung du phur bu gcig btab ste tho bas brdungs/ snying po'i mthar/ oṃ badzra kro dha hūX ka ra huX/ ga rdza ga rdza hūX phaṭa/ e ma bdag nyid rang byung ba/ khro bo chen po huX ka ra/ sprul pa'i pho nya'i tshogs spros nas/ /steng na gnas pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /lcags kyus bzung la phur bus thob/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgya ru khos/ /lus kyang dum bu stong du gtubs/snying la gī li ki la ya/ zhes brjod/ des phyogs bcu gar la rigs 'gre ste/ huX kar zhes pa'i dod du/ rnam par rgyal dgrag sngon can: skyon rje gshed/ mi g.yo mgon/rta mchog dpal: 'dod pa'i rgyal/ bdud rtsi 'khyil: khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal ni/ stobs po che zhes sogs 'don pa spo zhing / steng gi dod du phyogs so so dang / khro bo bcu po rang rang so so'i sngags kyi 'don pa spo'o/ /de dag ni phyi mtshams bcad pa yin par 'chad do/ /de nas dam sri mnan pa ni/ ling ga'i snying gar/ ya ma dam sri staX bha ni dzaXdzaX zhes pa 'bri bar bshad/ grog la bris pa'i ling ga'am/ sngags kyi rna/ga ril snying gar bcug pas bag zan nam khaṃ pa la byas pa'i ling gas kyang —122—

rung / 'brub khung du ling ga bcas la/ sde brgyad la gser skyems btang / e ya ra badzra dzwa la ra/ 'brub khung yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ dri las dam sri pho mo lcags sgrog dang zhags pas bcings pa'i lus can du gyur/ bden brdar dang dgug gzhug bya/ /phur chung gcig bdud rtsi 'khyil bar bskyed/ snying po dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags mang du bzlas/ hū/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas chen 'dir/ /dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /bka' las 'da' byed dam sri rnams/ /mnan zhing gzir ba'i dus la bab/ lan gsum/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li skyo/ tshinta tshinta hu phaṭa/ dang snying po spel ba mang du bzlas/ phur chung de ling ga'i snying gar btab/ bar mtshams rnams su yungs kar ram/ bal tshone nam/ drag sngags bzlas pa'i bye mas bkang / rdo rje rgyal gra bris pa'i g.yas pas mnan/ de yang sas g.yogs shing mnan la/ hū mnan no mnan no ri rab 'og /spyings so spyings so rgya mtshor spyings/ /gtad do gtad do gshin rje'i lag /thar med 'ching ba thob par shog/byang chub sems mchog ma skyes par/ /nam yang gtong bar ma byed cig /gtad do ma btang sho ra re/ /sangs rgyas stong gi bka' yin no/ /o la hū la da sri sta bha ya na/ spros pa la dga' na las bzhi'i bro brdungs kyang bya/'a hu/ bzhi pa mang du bzla/ de nas sgo byang 'dogs pa ni/ ra'i sog pa gnyis kyi gcig la gzhin rje gshed dang / gcig la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sku bris la/ gshin rje gshed sgo'i ya them gyi phyi dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil ba nang du 'dogs par byed de/ gcig la bsdu na gshen rje gshed gal che bas/ de nyid sgo'i ya them gyi nang du 'dogs so/ /gang ltar yang bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hū yig las gshin rje gshed nag po/ dbyug pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa —123—

dang / bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang khu rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /ye shes pa badzra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ oX āXkro khyi ka ya manta ka hūX phaṭa/ oX a mṛ ta kuṇḍali hūX phaṭa/ yang na 'di nyid rang gi khro btsu'i sngags kyi nang tshan gyis kyang rung ste/ /sngags gnyis po brgya rtsa tsam bzlas/ arghaX nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ hūX gsang chen lhun grub pho brang na/ /bcom ldan chos rjes bka' stsal ltar/ /bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa po/ /bka' gsang gzhung chen 'di sgrub bo/ /'di la gnod cing bar gcod kun/ /sa 'di phan chad ma btang cig /phyi 'khor skyong ba'i mu ran la/ /rdo rje yal gaX thub par mdzod/ oX badzra sa ma rā dza sa ma ya stuX/ huX ljang nag 'bar ba chen po'i klong dkyil nas/ /'khyil ba'i dam tshig bdud rtsi 'bar ba khyed/ /rnal 'byor dam can sgrub pa'i 'bras bu rnams/ /mngon sum tshad ma'i yid bzhan sgrub par mdzod/ lkoX badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li sa ma ya stuX/ me tog dor/ de dag ni bar mtshams bcad pa'o/ /nang mtshams gcod pa ni/'og dngos gzhi gzhung las 'byung ba ltar/stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid dpal chen po/ zhes pa nas/ bhañdza ra ṇa huX phaṭa/ kyi bar brjod de/ don srung 'khor sgom pa ste/ de yan chad ni sa'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ /sa bzung ba nyid kyi lha sta gon grub pa'i phyir/ rnying ma tshad ldan phal la de ni logs su mi mdzad do/ /gsum pa phyi bshags dang phyi bskang ni/ sma tsā gdab pa/ mdo sde bklag pa/ 'jig rten pa'i lha tshogs rnams la gtor ma gtong ba sogs yin te rang ngam dge 'dun gyis ji ltar 'os tsam bya'o/ /bzhi pa dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa'i las gsum bstan pa las dang po go mā ye gtong pa ni/'byung lnga dang sbyar ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsis chag chag 'debs bzhin pas/ hūX bka' —124—

gsang rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdud rtsi dri chen ye shes lnga ldan pas/ /bde gshegs kun gyi gsang mchod sgrub pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'kho ra chen por chag chag 'debs/ /oṃ ma hā ma la pu ta maṇḍa la hūṃ/ bka' gsang sogs/ tshig gzhan gong bzhin las/ rkang pa gnyis pa las/ dam rdzas dag pa'i bdud rtsi gur gum chus/ zhes dang / sngags la ma la pu ta'i gnas su mahā kud ku maṇḍa la zhes dang / 'khor ba'i rgyun gcod byang chub sems kyi dang / zhes dang / mahā rakta maṇḍa la zhes 'don pa spo gnyis pa thig gdab pa ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hu las thig skud nag po mi bskyod pa/ o las thig skud dkar po rnam snang / snya las thig skud ser po rin 'byung / ā las thig skud dmar po snang mtha'/ hā las thig skud ljang khu don grub kyi ngo bor gyur/ rgyal ba rigs lnga gtso bo'i sku la zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba thig skud la thim/ hū badzra gī li gī la ya hū phaṭa/ o badzra2 snyu badzra5 ā badzra: hā badzra gī li sogs 'don pa spos nas mang du bzlas/ slob ma 'khor lo rgyas 'debs su gsal bas/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ sogs dang / slob dpon gtso bor gsal bas / snying rjes bsgral ba'i sogs glur blangs te/ hū stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /nga ni dkyil 'khor thig 'debs kyi/ /gdug can tshogs rnams gang 'khod pa/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ o badzra kro dhi ni hu phaṭa/ ces thig sna gto/ hu nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi e yi ngang / /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por thigabatab pas/ /rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /pho brang ye shes lhun gyis grub par gyur/ banta dzñā na tsakra e khri/ zhes thig gdab bo/ /gsum pa tshon gyi —125—

bya ba la gnyis kyi tshon byin gyis brlab pa ni/ thig skud byin rlabs 'don pa spos pas rdul tshon gyis brlabs/ gī la ya lan mang du brjod/ de rjes tshon 'byed pa'i tshe/ dkar po oṃ gyi rang bzhin las/ /zla ba shel gyi 'od zer 'phros/ /chos dbyings ye shes byin gyis brlabs/ /phur bu dngos grub thob par shog /gī la ya bzlas de bawo du 'don pa spos te/ mthing ka hūX gi ind+ra ni la'i: me long ye shes: ser po snya yig: rin chen gser gyi: mnyam nyid dmar po āXyi: rin chen byu ru'i za sor rtog ye shes: ljang khu hā yi: rin chen g.yu yi nan tan ye shes: go so/ /bar 'dir dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bya'o/ lnga pa phur bu byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sngar bzhin slob mas rdo rje gzhon nu'i sogs dang / slob dpon gyi snying rjes bsgral ba'i sogs brjod phur bu rnams re re bzhi/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ raX yaX khaX/ oṃ spyo bhā wa rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /zhes yun ring du bsgom/ huX las byung ba'i phur bu rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur par mos la 'og nas 'byung ba'i lha bskyed sngags rnams tshar gcig brjod/ spro zhing nus na mngon rtogs kyi skabs las 'byung ba ltar/ zhal phyag rnams gsal btang kyang legs/ ngag nas mi brjod kyang yid kyis dmigs pas gsal thebs pa ni nges par dgos so/ /yang sngags de dag lan gcig brjod pas/ lha thams cad lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam par gyur/ huX skye med rnam dag nas/ sras mchog gī la ya/ skye med chos kyi dbyings las bzhengs nas kyang / /srid pa rdo rje phur bu sgrub par mdzod/oṃ badzra gī li ki la ya badzra sa mā dzaX dzaXdzwaX/ baX hoXtiṣṭha badzra ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra gī li gī la ya mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta ba ling ta rakta hoX huX di sta tsakra sogs kyisabastod pa las dbu la sogs kyi dod du/ ral gri'i sgra la sbu dri'i so zhes 'don pa spo/ phur —126—

pa'i lha thams cad kyi dbu la hū o snya ā hā rnams las byung ba'i rgyal ba rigs lnga/ de rnams kyi 'od zer gyi sku lus gang bar gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs te thim/ /phur bu'i spyi bor o dkar po/ sked par hi dmar po/ rtse mor phaṭa ser po/ de rnams kyi 'od zer 'phro 'du las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 'dus par gyur pa ni/dbal gyi logs gsum la hū re/ /zur gsum la phaṭa re/ rtse mor a thung nag po'o/ /de rnams las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su 'gyur pa las/ dgra bgegs kyi sdig sgrib bsreg pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa me'i dbal du gyur/ 'og phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su 'byung ba ltar/ ma surya nas/ e be sha ya a/ o bo dhi tsitta a bhi ṇa po myu a/ zhes pa dang / o badzra gī li gī la ya dzwa la dzwa la sogs sngags gsum gyis dbang bskur ba'i bar rnams bya/ tse( badzra gī li gī la ya be ta li sogs/ yungs kar gu gul rakta rnams kyis gzi byin bskyed/ hu khro rgyal 'jigs byed badzra gī la ya/ zur gsum sku gsung thugs su gzi brjid skyed/ zur bzhi ye shes bzhi rtsa zlum po byams dang snying rjer zla gam chags med dbyings suja'abyung lnga yum gyi dbyings su: bcu drug rol pa'i pho nyar: ma skyes lhun gyis grub par: gang la bya ba'i dgra bgegs rlag pa'i phyir/ su la bsnun kyang thams cad sgrol bar mdzod/ snying po'i mthar/ badzra kro dha sarba buddhā ta thā ga ta ha sa ya na hū/ a be sha ya a/ zhes ming du bzlas so/ /de ltar na chos skur byin gyis brlab//longs skur byin gyis brlab/ sprul skur byin gyis brlab/ ye shes lngar/ sku gsung thugs su thugs rtse gcig par/ 'gro don sras mchog tu dbang bskur ste bdun no/ /yang skad cig las bzhengs su —127—

gsol ba/ spyan 'dren pa/ gnyis med du stim pa/ bstod pa 'bul ba/ gzi byin bskyed pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ dbang bskur ba ste/ bdun du byed pa'i lugs kyang yod pa gang ltar byas kyang mi 'gal lo/ /drug pa ni/ phur bu dkyil 'khor la 'god pa yin te/ snga rabs pa rnams phur bshar 'debs pa zhes zer ro/ /dbus nas rang byung grub pa'i lha/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /chos dbyings rdo rje'i ngang nyid las/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /yum chen 'khore lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /yab yum gnyis su med pa yang / /ru dra bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ o badzra gī li gī la ya di lta tsakra badzra sa ma ya tikhyi skye/ steng nas rang 'byu/nga grub pa'i lha//sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /chos dbyings rdo rje'i ngang nyid las/ /hu mdzad rdo rje sgra 'byin bcas/ /phra men phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo /dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ /tshangs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ badzra kro dha hu ka ra hu ga rdza ga rdza hū phaṭa/ badzra sa ma ya ti grin/ de bzhin du 'don pa bsgyur te/ shar nas: sangs rgyas sogs rkang pa gnyis kun la sbyar/ rnam rgyal rdo rje sgeg snyems cha phra men stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbang dang / zhes sogs kun la sbyar/ brgya byin dgyes shing sogs nas sngags brjod pa sogs kun la sbyar/ me nas: dbyug sngon rdo rje sder mor: phra men g.yag dang bya rog mgo /me lha: lho nas gshin rje dur khrod lha mor: sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /gshin rje: lho nub: mi g.yo rdo rje gtun khung : gzigs dang kha ta'i/ srin pojenub nas: rta mgrin rdo rje gtum mor: byi la pu shud/ chu lha: rlung nas: gzhan —128—

gyis mi thub mda' snyems bcas/ spyang khu khra yi: rlung lha byang nas: 'khyil pa rdo rje rlung 'byin: seng ge pha wang / gnod sbyin: byang shar khams gsum rnam rgyal gsod mar dred dang sbre mong : dbang ldan: 'og nas: stobs rṣa rdo rje skul byed dom dang byi ba'i: sa bdag pa shar nas5 rang byung grub pa'i lha/'gugs byed chen mo pu shud mgo khar sgo nyi steng mi gro'i steng/ dgyes shing sogs sbyar ba dang rang sngags brjod/ de bzhin du go brjes te/ sto nas 'ching byed chen mo bya rog mgo lho sgor dgyes sogs/ nub nas: sdom byed chen mo srin bya'i mgo nub sgor dgyes shi pa byang nas: mnyes byed chen po khra yi mgo /byang sgor: dgyes shing : sogs sbyar/ dam can gyi phur pa 'god na/ lko badzra gī la gī la ya ma tha ma tha badzra hū phaṭa/ ma tha sogs 'don pa spos te/ dzwa la dzwa la badzra/ su ru su ru badzra/ mu 2rgya badzra/ ma ma wa sha ku 'ug ma te nya ka ra/ /ma ma karma shigha ka ra/ ka te ka ye/ a dzi te/ dza ye bi dza ye/ a ba ra dzi te/ rnams la sngar bzhin sbyar/ o badzra gī li gī la ya ma ma shī ghra ka ra ya hū phaṭa/ lan bzhi/ de bzhin du/ ma ra phya na dang / pra ma rta na ya/ yang lan bzhi bzhi sbyar/ spyir de tsam gyis chog la/ spros pa la dga' na/ nam gyi go1da kyi dam can ma/ sogs la/ dus la bab/ ces pa rnams bzhugs su gsol/ zhes 'don pa bsgrub bas chog go / bdun pa rgyan bkram pa ni/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan mchod rdzas sogs bsham/ shes rab ral gri yum gyi rang bzhin las/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya'i cho 'phru/la ci yang rtags/ /thabs shes rang bzhin mchod pa'i lha mo rnams/ /rgyan dang mchod rdzas gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ sarba pū dza megha sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/zhes brjod do/ /brgyad pa bum pa 'god pa'am bum pa sta gon ni/ slob ma dbang bskur dang / rab —129—

gnas dang bdag 'jug phal pa dang / sgrub pa dngos grub gyi dbang len pa rnams la bum sgrub nges par dgos la/ sgrub mchod tsam la ni bum pa nges par dgos pa min yang 'grub na ni legs so/ /de la bum sgrub dngos ni/ bdag mdun bum gsum dbyer med du sgrub pa yin la/ 'dir bum pa bsham pa ste/ bum pa rnams la yungs kar gtor zhing gu gul gyi gdug pas bgegs bskrad/ dri bzang gi chu la bdud rtsi a mṛ tas btab pas bkang / shing 'o ma can gyi yal gas kha rgyan bya/gzhan spyi dang mthun par bshams te/ gzungs thag nas bzung la/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po brgya rtsa re dang / khro bcu'i sngags nyer gcig re bzla/ thams cad kyi thun mong du/ ki lā ya stong phrag sogs mang du bzlas nas dkyil 'khor la dgod par bya'o/ /de yang bum pa bcu gcig yod na/ dbus ma rnam rgyal bum pa la gtso bo yab yum dang / /g.yin bcu po la khro bcu bzla ba yin pas/ gtso bum mañdzi sogs kyi steng du bkod nas/ dbus su 'jog pa sogs lha so so'i rang gnas su 'god dgos rgyu yin yang 'god tshul stabs mi bde na/gtso bum shar sgo'i thad kyi g.yon dang / gzhan rnams rdo rwa'i nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad la 'god do/ /bum pa gcig las med na shar sgo'am nub sgo gang 'thad du bkod kyang chog /'dir bsang dgos pa rnams bdud rtsi'am nyung kar gtor bas byed pa'i phyir/ /las bum dang bsang chu mi dgos la/ ci ste byed na byang gi bum pa nyid las bum yin pas/ bsang chur byed na'ang las thams cad pa'i bum chu de nyid dung phor du blangs pas so/ /rnying ma'i yig rnying 'ga' re na yang bum pa sta gon spyi dang mthun pa'i lugs kyang 'dug pas/ de ltar 'gal ba med mod kyi rang lugs de tsam gyis chog go /dgu pa ma snya sgrol ba ni/ slob dpon hū kā ras mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi dkyil chog na/ dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor bskyed zin pa'i rjes su/ /ma khyi sgrol ba drag po'i rol gar mang po dang bcas te/ sbyor sgrol gyi mchod pa'i tshul du mdzad pa nyid rtsa ba'i khungs yin pas —130—
