spyir de dang mthun na legs kyang / gong ma mang po zhig skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i don du/ ma traX sgrol ba bsdus pa re mdzad pa yang rnying ma rang lugs gyi rgyud gzhung don la gnas pa'i phyir/ sgrub par bya ba kho na'o/ /de yang ma taX gi ling ga bcas nas bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las yi ge dri las byung ba'i rnam pa ma taX ga ru dra'i gzugs can/ /ngo bo sgrub pa po dngos grub sgrub pa la gegs byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren byad ma kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo gdug can de nyid dbang med du 'gyel zhing sa la lhung bar gyur/ bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs ka nas khro bo mi g.yo ba snyen ra dang bcas pa spros par gyur/ huX dur khrod gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /thabs dang shes rab rol pa las/ /za byed 'bar ba'i rngam stabs kyis/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /'joms byed chen po ārya a tsa la/ /mnyes byed rdo rje srin po sen rnon ma/ rdo rje phra men gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /sdang dgra gnod byed sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ sa ma ya stuX/ lan gsum/ ling ga bskyed cing pho nya spro ba'o/ /bden brdar brjod cing / dngos grub la bar du gcod cing bstan pa la gnod par byed pa'i sdang dgra gnod byed 'gegs dang log 'dren byad ma la sogs pa ma taX gi rigs su gnas shing bdud kyis byin brlabs pa gnod byed ru dra thams cad/ ces 'don pa spos te dgug gzhug bya/ thar pa'i lam 'byed dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /skal ldan tshogs rnams 'ongs pa ltar/ /ru dra 'dir shog rigs kyi bu/ /bde bar 'ongs so legs par shog /snying i mthar mi g.yo ba'i sngags sbyar/ ma taX ka ru tra ā ka sha tri yaX dza bā ma ra ya dza dza/ zhes lan gsum gyi sa bos te ma traX 'bod cing dgug pa'o/ /sngags gnyis kyi mthar/ ma taX ka ru tra —131—

a be sha ya a a/ lan gnyis shu rtsa gcig gis gzugs brnyan la dbab pa'o/ /dzaXhūX baX hoX mang du bzlas shing / gzugs brnyan 'brub khung du bcug /mgo lho nub dang rkang pa byang shar du bstan/ pho mo gnyis yod na bsnol mar bzhag zhabs kyi 'og du mnan par bsam/ /mthar byed chen po'i 'gying stabs kyis/ /sgrol bdag zhabs ni g.yas pa yi/ /ru dra pho mo'i steng nas gnon/ sa ma ya dzwa la tsitta huX phaṭa/ ma taX mnan pa'o/ /phur chung gcig gam gnyis ling ga la btab ste/ khog pa dral zhing sgo dbye ste/ /lhun sdo/ba dbyings kyi sgo dbye'o/ /ye shes 'bar ba'i phur pa yis/ /yul las 'das pa'i sgo phye shig snying po dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyi mthar/ ma taX ga ru dra ud gha ḍa ya/sa ma ya pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ma taX khog pa dral ba'o/ /raX yaX khaX zhes mang du bzlas ru dra'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs sbyangs par bsam/ sgrib pa sbyang ba'o/ /tseX( ma tha ma tha sarba pre ta ga te he du na hūX phaṭa/ oX pa tsa pa tsa sarba tirya ga te he du na hūX phaṭa/ oX da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he du na huX phaṭa/ sngags gsum po de mang du bzlas pa ni ngan song gi sgo bkag pa'o/ /de yi khams dang skye mched rnams/ /sems kyi ngo bor rab bsdus te//byang chub sems kyi dbyings nyid du/ khams gsum 'khor ba kun bsdu'o/ /tri huX bodhi tsitta saX ha ra ṇa hūX/ zhes byang chub sems su bsdus/ de ni huX la bsdu ba'o/ /zla dkyil hūX gi sbyor bas 'phangs/ phaṭa kyis shes rab lhums su bskyod/ /bde gshegs rigs kyi sras su skyes/ /'gro ba'i don du dbang yang bskur/ /āXhūX yaX phaṭa/badzra satwa huX/ a bhi khiñtsa a/ zhes gnas spar ba'o/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pas 'jig /sdig pa'i las kyis sdug bsngal bskyed/ /nga yi bstan pa 'dir —132—

zhugs shig /'on tang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dral/ zhes chos bstan pa'o/ /chos nyid skye 'gag med pa yang / /bde bar gshegs dang 'gro ba zhes/ /bdag med pas na mnyam nyid sku/ /thugs rje chen pos cis mi 'dzin/ zhes lta ba bstan pa'o/ /ma taX chen po'i khog pa la/ /he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad gyur/ /dkyil 'khor chen por bzhugs pa'o/ /bhāX bi shwa be ris khyu/ e waX ma ya/ maṇḍa la raX/ zhes bzla zhing / ling ga gtubs te mgo bo brden bral/ lag gnyis lco dang nub/ sked pa g.yas g.yon me dang rlung / rkang pa shar dang byang / pho rtags dbang ldan du bor te/ gzhal yas khang du bstan pa'o/ /de ltar na/ pho nya spros dang dgug gzhug dang / gzugs la dbab cing zhabs kyi mnan/ khog pa dral dang sgrib pa sbyangs/ /ngan song sgo bkag huX la bsdu/ /gnas spar chos bshad lta ba bstan/ /gzhal yas khang bsgyur bcu gnyis so/ /zhes pa ni ma taX sgrol ba'i sdoms so/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa dngos la 'jug pa ni/ 'dir dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni bdag mdun bum gsum dbyer med yin par go dgos so/ /de yang sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / gnas yo'am/ mchod pa byin rlabs kyang 'dir byas na legs/ /sman rag byin rlabs kyi rjes su byas kyang rung ngo / /de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la sdoms ni/tshad med mtshams bcad brdar sgo dbye/ /brda'i phyag 'tshal rtags kyis 'debs/ dam 'cha' bshags pa byin 'bebs dang / /yo byad byin rlabs bsnyen phur bskyed/ ces pa ltar sbyor ba'i chos bcu las/ dang po tshad med sgom pa ni/sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog gnyis pa —133—

mtshams gcod pa ni/ oṃ swa bha wa shurnyaXsarba dharmāXspyo bhā wa sko ) ( ྅haX/ oṃ badzra gī li ki la ya sarba birtswan baX huX phaṭa/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur/ thugs kar hūX nag po 'od zer 'bar ba/ de las khro bo bcu spros phyogs bcur 'khod/ oṃ badzra kro dha hūX ka ra huX/ oX badzra kro dha bi dza ya hūX/ oX badzra kro dhwa ni la daṇḍa hūX/ oṃ badzra kro dha ya mun ta ka huX/ oṃ badzra kro dha ārya a tsa la huX/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya 'a ba huX/ oṃ badzra krodha a pa ra dzi ta hūX/ /oX badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍali hūX/ oṃ badzra kro dha tri lo kya bi dza ya hūX/ oX badzra kro dha mahā ba la hūX/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /lha'am 'on te bdud kyang rung / /nga la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos/ /khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka'/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun gyi bka'/ /chos nyid bden pa'i bka' 'di yis//srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ /na rag dmyal khams yan chad kyi/ /srid gsum gnas pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs/ /sgrub la bar gcod 'tshe ba dang / /dkyil 'khor lta bar mi dbang zhing / /phyag rgya sgom dang bzlas pa dang / /gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba/ /de dag thams cad da lta nyid/ /myur ba kho nar gzhan du dengs/ /gal te bka' las 'da' byed na/ /ya ka me dbal rab khros te/ /lus sems rdul du brlag nas kyang / /mi bzad dmyal ba chen por lhung / /mtshon cha rdo rje 'bar ba yis/ /'jigs par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /'du ba'i lha ni ma gtogs pa/ /gsang ba'i dam can so so nas/ /kun kyang thugs dam skongs zin gyi/ /so so'i gnas su 'gro —134—

bar gyis/ /yungs kar gtor zhing drag rol dang bcas/ khro bo btsu'i sngags drag tu bzlas te bgegs bskrad/ nga yi dkyil 'khor bstan bya'i phyir/ khro rgyal byin rlabs las 'byung ba'i/ /marsā cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin srung / /hū steng yang rdo rje'i bla re gur/ 'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi la/ /phyogs mtshams rdo rje 'bar bas gtams/ rdo rje'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig/steng yang 'bor lo'i bla re gur/sogs rdo rje'i dod du 'khor lo cug pa dang / rin po che dang / padma dang / rgya gram dang / ral gri dang / be con zhes pa rnams bcug ste 'don pa spo/ lko badzra te dza tiṣṭha tsakra rakṣa hu phaṭa/ lan gsum/ o badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hū phaṭa/ lan gsum ste mtshams bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa brda sgo dbye ba ni/ dkyil 'khor shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi nas/ ye shes bzhi yi sgo mo rab phye ste/ /byams dang snying rje dga' dang btang snyoms kyi/ /'phags pa'i zhal bzang bdag la bstan du gsol/ o badzra tsakra maṇḍa la pra be sha ya phaṭa/ /bzhi pa brda phyag 'tshal ba ni/ 'jigs byed gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khore du/ /rdo rje yab yum mched dang lcam dral tshogs/ /mchog gi sgo gsum dang ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /brda dang gar gyis mchod nas phyag bgyi'o/ /a ti bhu ho pra ti bhu ho/ /lnga pa rtags bto pa ni/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /mkha' 'gro gying dang ma mo'i tshogs lhan cig /rnal 'byor dag pa gsum la 'god pa'i phyir/ /rakta zhag dang thal chen mtshan mas btang/ ma hā rakta ni hū/ ma hā smig ta hū/ ma hā ki ni ri ti bhasma hū/ /drug pa dam 'cha' ba ni/ las byang so so na tshig rigs mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang don gcig pas 'gal ba med —135—

la/ 'dir ni rgyun bshags nyid dam bca' yin te/ yan lag bdun pa'i nang du de thams cad 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ /des na 'di ltar bya ste/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma 'phags pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad badzra sa mā dzaX rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i 'gegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang / /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dgongs pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ zhes rgyun chags lan gsum gyis dam bcas/ /bdun pa bshags pa ni/ dam tshig nyer brgyad kyi bshags pa sogs dang / zhi khro'i bshags pa ye shes sku mchog sogs rgyas pa rnams spro zhing nus na bya la bsdu na/huX sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa dang / /rtsa ba yan lag nyes byas phra mo dang / /dam tshig che chung tshor dang ma tshor dang / /zla dang zhor gyis dam tshig nyams pa dang / khas blangs che la nyams blangs chung ba dang / /bka' ltar ma bgyis gzhung ltar ma bsrangs dang / /ting 'dzin ltod gyur 'dzab bzlas nyung pa dang / /yi dam lha yi sgom pa g.yel ba sogs/ /nyams grib nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba ci mchis pa/ /kun —136—

rdzob rgyu mtshan tsam gyi dbang gis ni/ /rang nongs 'gyod pa'i tshul gyis mthol lo bshags/ /byams pa'i thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang / /gnyis med dbyings las mi 'gyur bdag bkod nas/ /mi dmigs btang snyoms ngang du bzhugs nas kyang / /gnyis med don gyi tshangs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bshags pa lan gsum bya/ dzaXdzaXspe baX hoX zhes brjod/ /brgyad pa byin dbab pa ni/hūX nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs byin rlabs can/ /tshur gshegs dkyil 'khor 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /sgrub mchod rnal 'byor bdag la dbang cig bskur/ hūX a la la ho/ hūX huX huX dzaXhūX baX hoX sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya stuX/ hūX/ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab/ khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /byin gyis rlobs pa'i dus la bab/ /dbang chen bskur ba'i dus la bab/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /mthu chen mthun stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /byin chen byin rlobs bcom ldan 'das/ /dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ /dgu pa yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs/ raX gyi mes bsregs/ yaX gyi rlud gis gtor/ khaX gi chus bkrus/ swa bhā was sbyangs/bhāX las banta 'bar ba'i snod chen po rnams su/ oX las 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam kyis mi khyab pa/ mkha' dbyings thams cad gang bar gyur/ phud dang gtor ma'i gnas su/ yaX las rlung / raX las me/ kaX las mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ bhūX las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ bdud rtsi'i snod la nyi zla —137—

rdo rje'i kha gcod can/ /nang bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ hūX oX snya āXhā rnams kyis mtshan pa dang / gtor ma'i snod du sha lnga la muX laX māX pāX tāX gis mtshan par gyur/rlung g.yos/ me spar/ rdzas rnams zhu/ oṃ badzra lha ka /oṃ dzi na dzi ka /snyu ratna lha ka.āX.a ro li ka /hā pra dzñā dhika /muX badzra dhwa tu/ laX mo hā rā ti/ māX dī ṣa rā ti/ pāX rā ga rā ti/ tāX badzra rā ti/ sman la rgyal ba rigs lnga dang / /gtor ma la yum lnga rnams 'khod/ sa ma ya hoX oṃ āXhuX sarba pañtsa sogs lan gsum/ 'khor 'das kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug /de thams cad dam rdzas sman dang gtor ma la 'dres pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āXhuX sarba pañtsa a tsho ta hūX khyi tha/ zhes pa nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa brgyad/ oṃ āXhuX ma hā ba li ta te li ta te dzo ba li ta ba li ba te gu phya sidha sa ma ya huX hri tha/ ra yig las rakta'i snod dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ra yig gis mtshan pa'i gdan la/ raX las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa'i phung po mtha' yas par gyur/ oX āXhuX ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal huX hi tha/ rgya cher 'phel ba la khams gsum gyi rakta thams cad bkug ste de la thim par gyur/ gtor ma dang rakta byin rlabs kyi sngags kyang bdun nam nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa sogs ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ mchod pa byin stsas spyi 'gro de gong du ma song na skabs 'dir bya mod/ gong du byed pa nyid lag len gtso che'o/ /bcu pa bsnyen phur bskyed pa ni/bsangs sbyangs/ e las byung ba gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du/ pad nyi dang dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gdan la huX spros/ huX spa ra ṇa phaṭa/ saX ha ra ṇa hūX/ badzra gī li gī la ya/ phur pa rdo rje gzhon nu yum dang bcas pa/ oṃ badzra ki li gī la ya hūX phaṭa/ lan bdun/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i phur bur —138—

gyur/ de'i rtse mor dpal rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum/ rgya mdud gong ma la khro bo bcu/ chang bzung la za byed gsod byed nyi shu /rgya mdud 'og ma la sgo srungs bzhi sogs 'khordo ra bar gyur/ gī la ya 'bru bcu drug pa lan bdun bzlas te/ bsnyen pa'i phur bu byin gyis rlob pa'o/ /'dir bsnyen phur dang sras mchog tha dad du byed pa'i dbang du byas nas/dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i skabs/ bsnyen phur dang bdag nyid dbyer med du dmigs pa yin la/ de ltar na bsnyen phur dngos grub kyi rdzas yin gyi bsgral las la mi 'jug cing / bsgral las sras mchog gis mdzad la/ 'di rdo rje'i phur bu dang / sras mchog ni ri rab phur bur bya mod kyi/ spyir mtha' gcig tu nges pa ni ma yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ lha sgoms mchod pa dang /sngags kyi bzlas pa gnyis so/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rgyu ting nge 'dzin gsum/ 'bras bu dkyil 'khor gsum/ mdzad 'phrin mchod pa gsum zhes bya'o/ /dang po ni/ huX rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod/ /mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thigs pa shar/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba na/ /snying gi go ru bsgom par bya/ oX ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atpa ko3haX/ de bzhi nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin no/ /rang bzhin ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams byang chub la 'god par bya'o/ /kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i rang sems huX yig mthing nag nam mkha'i khams su gnas par gyur/ oX dharmā dha du swa bhā ba atpa ko3haX/ de ni rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu dkyil 'khor gsum bskyed pa la/ rten gzhal yas khang 'khor bcas bskyed pa dang / brten pa dkyil 'khor rnam gsum dngos bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ nam mkha'i hūX las spros pa'i raX yaX khaX gis snod bcud thams cad sbyangs/ e yaX raX baX laX taX ko bhūX rnams spros pa las —139—

rten gyi dkyil 'khor grub pa ni/ e yig nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus su yaX las rlud / raX las me/ baX las chu/ laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du raX las rakta'i rgya mtsho/ de'i dbus su ke las keng rus brtsegs pa'i ri rab/ /khriX bi shwa bi shudhe banta dzñā na tsakra maṇḍa la huX bhāX/ ri rab kyi steng du bhūX las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ rab tu 'jigs shing kyi g.ya' ba/ gnam lcags ur mo'i gzhi la gnas pa/ thod pa skam rlon gyis brtsigs pa la rakta'i zhal chu 'bab cing / 'dod snam dang pha gur bcas pa rkang lag gi shar bu dang / sgal tshigs kyi mda' yab can/ rus pa'i dra phyed dang / rgyu sno gyi lda ldi dang / /skra'i rnga yab dang / thod tshal gyi zla ba dang / /mi ro'i rgyal mtshan dang / zhing lpags kyi 'phan gdugs dang bla re la sogs pas brgyan pa/ rta babs dang sgo'i phyi rol ro langs dang keng rus kyi ka ba can/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du rus sbal chu srin lha chen klu chen gza' skar 'byung po'i tshogs rnams bsgral ba las grub pa'i ka gdung gral phyam la sogs pas brgyan pa/ bar bar thams cad rin po che'i rang bzhin zla ba dang nyi ma ltar 'od zer 'phro ba/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor mi mgo dang rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa'o/ /'di khro dkyil gyi lugs yin/ zhi dkyil ltar na spyi dang 'dra mod de gtso mi che'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi dbus su gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ de'i steng du paX padma maṇḍa la huX gis sna tshogs padma'i gdan/ a tsand+ra maṇḍa la huX gis zla ba'i gdan/ /ma surya maṇḍa la hūX gis nyi ma'i gdan/ shaX ru dra ru dri ti ra baX gyis ru dra —140—

pho mo g.yas g.yon du mgo bstan te 'gyel ba'i gdan rnams su gyur/ gnyis pa la bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sgom pa/ phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor spro ba/ phur bu rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i rang sems huX yig de gzhal med khang gi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du babs pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ khyad par du gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/tshur 'dus hūX la thim/ huX spa ra ṇa phaṭa/ si ha ra ṇa hūX/ oṃ badzra gī li gī la ya sarba bisnrun baX hūX phaṭa/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po he ru ka khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur pa ni/ /dus mtha'i sprin ltar sku mdog nag /dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad/ /rab khros shin tu 'jigs pa'i sku/ /sku che rags shing sbom la thung / /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags kyang 'gril/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gi dang po ni/ /rdo rje rtse dgu 'phyar zhing gsor/ /gnyis pas rdor rje rtse lnga bsnams/ /g.yon gyi dang po sdigs mdzub can/ /me dpung bsnams pas gdug can sreg /gnyis pa mdung rtse gsum pa yis/ /rtse mor mtshan pa'i kha ṭaX ga /tha ma mdun gyi phyag gnyis kyis/ /ri rab phur bu bsgril ba'i tshul/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas/ /ru dra pho mo mnan zhing brdzis/ /stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can/ /glang lpags zhing chen stod g.yogs gsol/ /thod pa tshar gsum 'phreng bas brgyan/ /gdug pa'i sprul gyis brgyan pa ste/ /rgyal rigs dkar po thod du bcings/ /rje rigs —141—

ser pos mgul pa brgyan/ /dmangs rigs dmar po snyan char byas/ /bram ze ljang khu gdu bu ste/ /ske rags dang ni se mo do/ /klu chen gdol pa nag po'o/ /thal chen mchog gi tshom bu dang / /rakta dmar gyi thig le dang / /zhag chen zo ris rnams kyis mtshan/ /sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar/ /dbu skra khams ser gyen du 'khyil/ /rdo rje'i gshog pa g.yas g.yon gdengs/ /sku lus rdo rjes go char gtams/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /skra dang ba sbu'i khung bu sogs/ /thams cad rdo rje gzhon nus gtams/ /thugs kar so bzhi'i tshad tsam gyi/ /gzhal med khang pa sgo gcig pa/ /sgo srung rta mgrin rim par bcas/ /de nang nyi ma la gnas pa'i/ /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar hū/ /mtha' skor sngags 'phreng 'khod par gyur/ /o di lta tsakra ha na ha na hū phaṭa/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi/ /g.yas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /g.yon pa thod khrag yab la stob/ khro mo'i cha byad yongs rdzogs pa/ /dpal chen sku la gnyis med 'byud/ /thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' dang / /ting 'dzin sems dpa' a yig go /hū snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te/ /phung po rdo rjer gtams byas nas/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hu las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ hū rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /srid pa rdo rjer grub 'dzod cig /yang hū las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs o badzra sa mā dza hu srid pa rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /ye shes khro bo grub par mdzad/—142—

dzaXhūX baX hoX rang gi dpral bar oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ de rnams las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs gnas gsum du thim/ hūX sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /dang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi zad pa/ /sku yi dbyig tu bdag skyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra su bha wa atpa ko3haX/ eX1 waka: haX/ eX6tsitta haX/ yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha thams cad spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ huX thabs kyi spyod pa'i 'gro don du/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad pa'i/ /dbang dang byin rlabs bdag stsol cig /rigs lnga rnams kyis dbang bskur bar gyur/ oX badzra shrī he ru ka badzra kro khyo shwa hūX/ oṃ buddhā shrī he ru ka buddhā khyo shwa rī oṃ/ oX ratna shrī he ru ka ratna kro khyu shwa rī drwaX/ oX padma shrī he ru ka padma kro khyu shwa ri hi/ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhi shwa ri a/ gnyis pa phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor spro ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad kyi ngo bo phyogs skyong bcu chung mar bcas pa bkug ste 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams kyi steng du pad nyi la bzhag gtso bo'i thugs ka nas hūX bcu spros te de rnams kyi steng du 'khod/ de rnams khro bcu 'khor dang bcas par gyur ba ni/ oṃ badzra kro dha hūX ka ra huX ga rdza ga rdza huX phaṭa/ steng du khro bo huX mdzad sngo/ /zhal gsum mthing dkar dmar ba ste//rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang / /bar pa 'phreng ba mda' gzhu 'dzin/ /tha ma phur bu bsgril zhing 'debs/ /tshangs pa pho mo mnan zhing brdzis/ /lha mo rdo rje sgra 'byin 'byud/ /sprul pa phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha bi dza ya huX ha na ha na —143—

hūṃ phaṭa/ /shar du khro bo rnam rgyal dkar/ /zhal sasum dkar dmar nag pa ste/ /rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang / /bar ma rdo rje 'khor lo 'dzin/ /mtha' gnyis phur bu bsgril zhing 'debs/ /brgya byin pho mo mnan zhing brdzis/ /lha mo rdo rje sgeg snyems 'byud/ /sprul ba stag dang bya rgod mgo /oX badzra kro dha nī la daṇḍahuX/ da ha da ha hūX phaṭa/ shar lhor khro bo dbyug sngon nag /zhal gsum nag dkar dmar ba ste/ rtsa phyag: bar pa dbyug tho me dbal bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis: me lha pho:lha mo rdo rje sder mos 'khyud/ /sprul pa g.yag dang bya rog mgo /lkoX badzra kro dha ya munta ka huX pa tsa pa tsa hūX phaṭa/ lho phyogs gshin rje gshed po nag /zhal gsum mthing dkar dmar ba ste/ rtsa phyag: bar pa dbyug tho dgra sta 'dzin/ mtha' gnyis: gshin rje pho mo lha mo rdo rje dur khrod 'byud/ sprul ba sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /oX badzra kro dha ā rya a tsa la hūX banta banta hūX phaṭa/ lho nub khro bo mi g.yo smugazhal gsum smug dkar ljang ba: rtsa phyag: bar pa ral gri/ zhags pa: mtha' gnyis5 srin po pho mo lha mo rdo rje ga tsho/ khung je sprul pa gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /oX badzra kro dha ha ya kṛ ba huX hu lu hu lu huX phaṭa/ nub tu khro bo rta mgrin dmar/ dmar dkar mthing nag: rtsa phyag: bar pa padma sprul zhags mtha' gnyis: chu bdag pho mo: rdo rje gtum mo: sprul pa byin pu shud mgo /oX badzra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūX/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha huX phaṭa/ nub byang gzhan gyis mi thub dmar/ zhal gsum dmar dkar ljang khu: rtsa phyag bar pa lcags kyu rnga yab: mtha' gnyis: rlung lha pho mo: rdo rje mda' snyems: sprul pa spyang ki bya khra'i mgo /oX badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūX/ tshinta tshinta hūX phaṭa/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang /—144—

zhal gsum ljang dkar dmar po rtsa phyag: bar pa rgya gram dbyug tho: gnod sbyin pho mo: rdo rje rlung 'byin sprul pa seng ge pha wang mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha tre lo kya bi dza ya skyo/ dhinta dhinta hu phaṭa/ byang shar khams gsum rnam rgyal ljang / /zhal gsum ljang nag ser po rtsa phyag: bar pa rdo rje dri shu /mtha' gnyis: dbang ldan pho mo: rdo rjer gsod byed: sprul pa dred dang sre mong mgo /oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā ba la hū/ sgro ṭa hpho ṭa hū phaṭa/ 'og phyogs stobs chen du ba'i mdog /zhal gsum dung dkar dmar ba rtsa phyag bar pa tho ba gas shing : mtha' gnyis:sa bdag pho mo rdo rje skul byed: sprul pa dom dang bya ba'i mgo /khro bo yab yum nyi shu yang / /rgyan dang cha byad rnam 'gyur rnams/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo yab yum mtshungs/ /yum rnams yab dang sku mdog mtshungs/ /g.yas phyogs pho nya mche ba can/ /za byed thams cad skyes pa'i tshul/ /g.yon phyogs phyag brnyan sder mo can/ /gsod byed thams cad bud med lus/ /sprul pa khra thabs nyi shu rnams/ /thams cad rang rang khro bo yi/ /sku mdog rtsa ba mtshungs pa las/ /rnam sprul ma nges cir yang ston/ khro mo bcu dang pho nya kun/ /phyag na phur bu thod khrag 'dzin/ /oṃ badzra gī li gī la ya bi da ya ba ba hu phaṭa/ shar phyogs sgo ma gnod sbyin mo/ /dkar mo pu shud mgo bo can/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyu 'bar ba thogs/ o badzra gī li ki la ya na ma sa manta hri hri hū phaṭa/ lto phyogs sgo ma 'jigs byed ma/ /ser mo ke ka'i mgo bo can/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje zhags pa thogs/ o badzra gī li gī la ya su ru su ru pra su ru hū phaṭa/ nub phyogs sgo ma bdud rtsi ma/ /dmar mo srin bya'i mgo bo can/ /phyag g.yas lug brgyud lcags —145—

sgrogs thogs/ oṃ badzra ki sna li gī la ya mā ra ya mā ra ya hu phaṭa/ /byang phyogs sgo ma gsod byed ma/ /ljang nag khra yi mgo bo can/ /phyag g.yas 'bebs bya dril bu 'dzin/ /de ltar sgo ma bzhi po rnams/ /phyag g.yon rdo rje phur bu 'debs/ /mi ro'i gdan la rol gar mdzad/ /'khor rnams kun kyang gshog rgyangs can//phyi rol dam can khor yul ga /ma tha ma tha badzra/ shar stod du/ sho na mu kha mthing nag lcags spyang mgo dgu pa la zho zhe pa/ g.yas thod dbyug 'dzin pa/ dzwa la dzwa la badzra/lho stod du shrī ka mu kha ser nag gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad la zhon pa/g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ su ru su ru badzra nub stod du sri la mu kha dmar nag zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum la zhon pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ mu ru mu ru badzra/ byang stod du shwa na mu kha ljang nag g.yu'i khyi mo ral pa can la zhon pa/g.yas zhing chung zhal du gsol zhing / de bzhi char yang g.yon rang rigs kyi phur bu thogs pa'o/ /hū ma ma wā khyi ka ri hu/ shar smad du/ re ma tī mthing nag dre'u rkang gsum la zhon pa/ dri shul dang me long 'dzin pa/ /ma ta nya ka ra/ lho smad du re ma dza ser mo sha ba yu mo la 'chibs shing / g.yas gser gyi zor ba dang / g.yon g.yu'i snod thogs pa/ i nan da dhi/ nub smad du re ma hri dmar nag chu glang la zhon pa/ lcags kyu dang banta 'dzin pa/ ma ma shigha karma ka ra ye/ /byang smad du re ma dzu ljang nag rnga mong la zhon pa/ khra shing dang mtshon gyi grub gu thogs pa'o/ /yang thams cad kyang phyag g.yon na mchog phur ro/ /ka tang ka ye/shar du rdo rje ya spyin mthing nag lcags kyu dang bya phur 'dzin pa/ g.yu 'brug la —146—

'chibs pa/ lhor rdo rje de sbyin ser mo zhags pa dang byi dur gyi phur pa 'dzin pa/chu srin pir la zhon pa/ a dzi te/ nub tu rdo rje bse sbyin dmar mo lcags sgrog dang mchog phur 'dzin pa/ glog dmar la 'chibs pa a pa ra dzi ti/ byang du rdo rje phag byi ljang khu dril bu ser lding gi phur pa 'dzin pa/ chu rta sngon po la 'chibs pa'o /ma ma shī ghra karma ka ra ye/ shwa na ma bzhi'i ming po ni/ pra ma rā dza srin po'i gying dkar po dung phur bsgril ba/ ya ma rā dza gnyen rje'i gying sngon po lcags phur bsgril ba/ da sha ji ba bdud kyi gying dmar po zangs phur bsgril ba/ yag sha skṛ ba gnod sbyin gyi gying ser po gser phur bsgril ba/ mā ra se na bdag nyid chen mo'i ming po rnams ni/ shar bdud dkar po mche ba 'dzin pa/ lho bdud sngon po be con: nub bdud dmar nag gzhags pa byang bdud ljang nag ral gri: pra manta na ya skyo/ sa bdag chen mo rnams kyi ming po ni/ /srin po'i gyad chen dkar po/ gzhin rje'i gyad chen nag po/ bdud kyi gyad chen mig ring dmar po/ gnod sbyin gyad chen mon pa sngon po ste/ de bzhi char yang g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs pa dang / g.yon rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i phur bu 'dzin pa/ ming po thams cad kyang sku che la yan lag rags pa/ mi gdug cing 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can/ za za 'cha' 'cha' rngam rngam 'dra ba'o/ /de ltar dpal chen po dkyil 'khor bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs dang bcas pa ye shes chen po'i rol pa las rang shar ba/ bkrag mdangs gzi byin dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ zhes pa nas/—147—

karma kro khyu shwa rī a/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin las/ dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig ces 'don pa stso/ /gsum pa phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ sras mchog rnams bsangs sbyangs/e spa ra ṇa phaṭa/ phur gdan gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ o badzra gī li sogs snying po 'bru bcu drug pa dang sgo ma bzhi'i sngags brjod/ e ma asne maṇḍal sarba shā chun re hū/ dza : ba ho o badzra ki li ki la ya be ta li maṇḍa la rakṣa rakṣa hū phaṭa/ sras mchog gi phur bu la yungs kar gtor zhing thum bu gdags/tse( badzra ki li gī la ya ma gu ta la ta la ta la pra ta la sa ma ya tiṣṭha hū phaṭa/ gu gul gyis bdugs/ o badzra ki li gī la ya ma hā rakta dzwa la na hū phaṭa/ rakta byug pa'am byug tshul tsam bya/ a be sha ya a zhes phur pa lag tu blangs/ lko ha na ha na di bha tsakra hu phaṭa/ thal mo ka pu tas bzung / badzra satwa rā dza ya hū/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas bzung /o badzra gī li gī la ya sa ma ya ti glu bhyo/ zhes phur gdan gyi steng du gtsug pa/ sras mchog lnga yod cing spros pa la dga' na/ sngags de dag so so lan lnga lnga brjod/ gang ltar yang / skye med rnam dag chos sku'i dbyings nyid las/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum ma lus sku/ /sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sras mchog ki la ya/ /srid pa rdo rje phur bur sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings las bzhengs/ badzra añdza li dza mnyam pa'i tha' mo bya/phur bu rnams gtso bo yab yum gyi sku la zhugs/ sbyor mtshams nas rigs lnga he ru kar gyur/ hu dbus kyi mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /rdo rje 'dus pa'i sras mchog gī la ya/ /zhe sdang bdud 'dul khro rgyal dbyings nas —148—

bzhengs/ /srid pa rdo rje phur bur sgrub pa'i phyir/ /mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ de la 'don pa bsgyur te/ dbus kyi zhes pa/ shar phyogs lho phyogs nub phyogs byang phyogs rnams dang / mthing nag ces par/ sprug nag ser nag dmar nag ljang nag ces dang / zhe sdang zhes par/ gti mug nga rgyal 'dod chags phrag dog ces 'don pa spo'o/ /de ltar sprul sku rigs lngar bzhengs par gsol ba btab pas/ he ru ka rigs lnga rnams lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can du gyur/ oX hi sna badzra gī li gī la ya sarba cha baX huX phaṭa/ de bzhin du/oX di sna tsakra hi lta ratna/ di rdo padma/ di lta karma zhes 'don pa spos la brjod/ phur bu'i spyi bor oX/ sked par khyoX rtse mor phaṭa/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ wo pa nas/ karma kro dha shwa rī a zhes pa'i bar gong bzhi/ ma surya maṇḍa la/ a tsanta maṇḍal:lag mthil gnyis su zla ba dang / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor g.yas kyi sor mo lnga la huX oX smyo āXha las rgyal ba rigs lnga/ g.yon gyi sor mo lnga la muX laX maX paX taX yum lnga'i ngo bo/ sa ma ya stuX/ badzra añdza lī huX/ sor mo rnams bsnol/ badzra banta rdor bsdams bya/ badzra añdza li dzaX zhes phur bu blangs/ a be sha ya a zhes cung zad bsgril tshul bya/ rigs lnga yab yum phur bu la thim/ /rgya mdud gong ma dang cung zhogs byed yan chad la/ phyogs bzhi dang steng gi khro bo/ man chad la mtshams bzhi dang 'og gi khro bo bzhugs par mos/ huX hi rdo tsakra phur pa'i lha/ mthing nag gcer bu ral pa can/ /sku stod khro bo chen po la/ dbu gsum phyag kyang drug pa ste/ /dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs/ /lte ba man chad sku yi cha/ /utpal sngon po'i 'dab ma 'dra/ /'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /lcags kyi phur bu —149—

zur gsum pa/ /drag por gyur pa'i phur pa ste/ /btab na lha yang rlag 'gyur na/ /gnod byed bgegs la smos ci dgos/ gī la ya 'bru bcu drug pa lan gsum sogs ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ 'grub na/ ma surya maṇḍal man chad/ sras mchog re re bzhin du tshar re grub na legs so/ /skye( badzra gī li gī la ya dzwa la dzwa la pra dzwa la sgru ṭa spru ṭa sarba nā sha nā ya hu phaṭa/ ces sras mchog gi gtso bo dpral bar reg oṃ badzra gī li gī la ya bya kri pa la hri sho dha ya hu phaṭa/ mgrin par reg o badzra ki li gī la ya tshinta tshinta hu phaṭa/ snying gar reg ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi dbang blang ba'o/ /gsum pa 'phrin las mchod pa rnam pa gsum ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hū las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can srungs ma dang bcas pa'i rnam par mchod pa'i don du badzra sa mā dza hū srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang / /dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir/ /ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol/ khro bo chen po gshegs nas kyang / rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang / /badzra ki la ya yi dngos grub stsole/ sa ma ya ho sa ma ya sta/dza : ba ho pra be sha ya phaṭa/ srid gsum gdug pa 'dul ba dang / /nga rgyal chen po bstan pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la/ /rtse gcig yid kyi phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti bhu ho/ pra ti dza ho/ oṃ badzra gī li gī la ya sa pā ri wa ra pā da bhandha na ka ro mi/ dza : ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ de nas mar pa 'bul ba la/mchod pa'i gtso bo rnam gsum dang / zhar byung gi mchod pa'i rnam grangs gzhan no/ /dang po ni/ sman rag gtor gsum 'bul ba ste/ lko sangs rgyas kun dang —150—

mnyam sbyor ba/ /rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud drug sems can kun grol phyir/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen la/ /thugs dam dbyings nyid skul ba'i phyir/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /bzhengs te kun tu dges mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ badzra gī li gī la ya/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raX sku hi/ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /dpal gyi yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ oX āXskyoX/ ye shes khro bo chen po bcu rnams dang / khres rab dbyings kyi khro mo bcu rnams la/ /rnam dag sogs gong bzhi/ sprul pa khra thabs nyi shu sgo ma bzhi/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad sras mchog rnam lnga la/ rnam dag: bka' yi pho nya yang sprul sum sprul dang / /srung mar dam bcas zhal bzhes thams cad la/ rnam dag: kun bzang rigs lnga dpal chen khrag 'thung sogs/ /rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma thams cad dang / /pra bha hasti padma 'byung gnas sogs/ /rigs 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma thams cad dang / /mkhar chen mtsho rgyal rdo rje bdud 'joms sogs/ /gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma thams cad dang / /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad dang / /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la/ rnam dag: bar 'dir spros pa la dga' na/ sman bshags dang sku gsung thugs kyi —151—

dngos grub blang pa sogs kyang byed do/ /hu ma hā rakta bsgral ba'i khrag /mū la rakta rtsa ba'i khrag /padma rakta sbyor ba'i khrag /chu dang ma 'dres dwangs ma'i khrag /bsgral ba'i sha tshogs ri ltar sbung / /'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil/ /zhe sdang mchog phran gcal du bkram/ /tsi ta'i tshogs ni rdza ltar klags/ /dmar chen rgya mtsho chen po la/ /sna tshogs zhing gi me to she shar/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas zhal du 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs la bzhengs su gsol/ /zhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ o badzra gī li gī la ya ma hā ma sa 'a hi/ ma hā rakta 'a hi/ ma hā a snyi ji hi/ ma hā tsitta sku hi/ ma hā go ro tsa na 'a hi/ ma hā ba su ta 'a hi/ rakta gtor ma la lan gsum du sbran te/ dang po gtso bo yab yum/ gnyis pa 'jig rten 'das pa'i 'khor tshogs/ gsum pa dam can srung ma rnams la 'bul/ rakta tshar gsum gyi mchod pa zhes grags pa'i phyir/gyer yang lan gsum byas na legs so/ /de nas gtor ma gsar pa yod na sngar bzhin byin rlabs kyang bya/ med na/ o ma hā ba li ta sogs byin rlabs lan gsum gyis kha gsos/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi rab tu brgyan/ /dam tshig bzhin du nus pas 'bul lags kyi/ /thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes nas kyang / /gī la ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ dza hū ba ho shrī he ru ka i da: putpa/ dhu pa/ dī ba/ ganta/ ba li ta pra tismo ho grotna 'a hi/ badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha ji hi sku hi/ gyer dang bcas pa lan gsum/ de ni gtor ma dngos yin la/ de rjes mchod pa rnam pa gsum char gyi 'jug sdoms ni/snying po 'bru bcu drug pa'i mthar/ ma hā ba li ta 'a ra ji hi ma hā rakta ji ra sku hi/ ma hā —152—

pañtsa a mṛ ta ji ra twa hi/ zhes btags pa lan bdun la sogs pas phul/ bsdu na de tsam gyis kyang chog de nas spro na rtsa brgyud bla ma'i mtshan nas smod pa dang / /dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad dang / sras mchog rnams dang / dam can rnams kyis bskyed sngags kyi mthar yang de zhin btags te 'bul/ khyad par du ha sa ya ra la sogs pa las sngags drug gi mthar tse( badzra yakṣa krodha ma hā ba li ta sogs btags pas lan mang du 'bul/ lha rnams dgyes nas ha hā zhes gsungs/ hū hū zhes bdag la byin gyis rlabs/ phaṭa phaṭa ces dgra bgegs bsgral te chos nyid du spar bar gyur/ 'di ni sman raka gtor gsum zhes pa'i go rim ltar byas pa yin la/ yang phud sman rakta gsum zhes pa ltar gtor ma thog mar byas kyang rnying mar lugs mang po la yod pas mi legs pa ma yin no/ /gnyis pa zhor byung mchod pa'i rnam grangs la/ 'dod yon sna tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ rdo rje sgeg mo'i dga' bas mchod bya zhing / /rdo rje 'phreng mos rab tu brgyan byas te/ /rdo rje glu mas gsang ba'i glu blangs nas/ /rdo rje gar mas mdzod pa'i gar bsgyur ma/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams gang nas/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can srung ma la/ /rnam dag mos pa'i blo yis bdag 'bul lo/ /bzhes shig gī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /rdo rje bdug pas ma lus tshim byas nas/ /rdo rje me tog ma yis mdzes par bkram/ /rdo rje sgron me ma yi dgyes pa bskyed/ /dri mchog ma yi dri zhim byug bya ba/ phyogs bcu'i sogs gong bzhi/ o badzra lwa gya hū/ o badzra mā le tru/ o badzra girti hi oṃ badzra nirti a/ o badzra dhu pe hū/ oṃ badzra purdze drwa/ o badzra ā lo ke hi o badzra ga rnye a/ 'di ni sman mchod kyi wos don yin no/ /mchog tu gtsang ba'i mchod yon 'di/ /rdo rje khro bo'i tshogs la —153—

'bul/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas kyang / /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badzra gī li gī la ya arghaX pra tismo swāhā/ /mchog tu gtsang ba'i zhabs bsil 'di/ :pā tyaX/ :rin chen mdzes pa'i me tog 'di/ :pungaX zhing kun khyab pa'i bdug spos 'di/ :ga paXngu sgron me rin chen snang gsal 'di/ :dī paXngu dri zhim ngad ldang byug pa 'di/ :gantaX: ro mchog brgya ldan zhal zas 'di/ : ne be tyaX: rnam mang rol mo sil snyan 'di shabha pra ca grwahwa'i bar du sbyar te/ 'di ni gtor ma'i yan lag go/de nas sbyor ba'i mchod pa ni/ huX 'khril pa'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /padma la ni rdo rje zhugs/ /bdag nyid mchod pas mnyes par shog /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas 'di thams cad la/ /hūX dang phaṭa kyis ldan par mdzod/ /mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po dag /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni/ /dkyil 'khor la yang dkyil 'khor thim/ /a la la te bzhes su gsol/ oṃ badzra gī li gī la ya/ dzaXhūX baX ho boXsbo tsitta ma hā su khaX/ a nu rā ga ya mi de nas bsgral mchod ni/ dngos su ling ga bcas na dgug bzhug bya/ med na yid kyi byas par mos te/ dzaXdam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ /sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ /phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab/ khwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ /bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ /sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab/ /bsgral bar bya ba'i dus la bab/ khyod kyi 'phrin las dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tsho pa/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni/ /gnod cing gdug —154—

pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ /khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /yud tsam gyis ni 'dir bkug nas/ /mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang / /lus ngag rdul du brlags nas kyang / /sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ oX laX hūX laX staX bha naX mo haX gha ta ya/ bha ga wan hruXljo bi kri ta shrī badzra hūX ka ra hūX hūX phaṭa phaṭa/ badzra gī li ki la ya dzaXhuX baX hoX sarba bisnrin badzra gī li gī la ya huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ badzra hūX ka ra skyoX a/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /zung zhig sdoms shig rnam par chings/ /gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis/ /rings par khug la smra ru chug /phob cig rnam par gzir par gyis/ /nga yis dbang du gyur nas ni/ /bsgo ba'i las rnams nyan par gyis/ /huX pa ra bi duX tshinta tshinta hūX phaṭa/ dhinta dhinta huX phaṭa/ gro hā gro hā huX phaṭa/ ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ banta banta huX phaṭa/ tāX ḍa ya tāX ḍa ya hūX phaṭa/ ha sa ya ra ha sa ya ra hri daṇḍahuX phaṭa/ shwe ghraX a na ya hūX phaṭa/ dza la pā ya dza la pā ya hūX phaṭa/ a be sha ya a be sha ya hūX phaṭa/ bi dha ya bi dha ya hūX phaṭa/ o badzra yakṣa kro dha 'a hi/ bi da ya bi da ya badzra yakṣa kro dha ji he/ dzaX bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab//sngon chad ji ltar dam bcas pa'i/ /mngon spyod 'phrin las myur du mdzod/ ha na ha na badzra/ da ha da ha badzra/ pa tsa pa tsa badzra/ ma tha ma tha badzra/ dzā la dzā la badzra/su ru su ru badzra/ mu ru mu ru badzra/ ka taX ka ṭa ye dza ye bi dza ye/ a dzi te a pa ra dzi te/ ma ra phya na/ pra marda ne huX phaṭa/ rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni/ /sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /stobs chen khro bo chen po yis/ /klad pa tshal pa —155—

brgya ru khos/ /nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren rnams/ /nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed/ ma ma wa shaX ku ru tang nya ka ra i nan da khyu ma ma karma shī ghaX ka ra ye/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa yi/ /lha'ang 'on te bdud kyang rung / /nga la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos/ /sarba ā na ya huX phaṭa/ /tā ṭa ya tā ṭa ya hūX phaṭa/ brdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gshun/ /bka' las 'da' byed sdig can rnams/ /rdo rje me dbal snying bsregs nas/ /lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlogs/ khro mo 'bar ba'i gtso khung du/ /rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas nas/ /lha yang rung ste bsgral bar bya'o/ kha tāX kha tāX kha tāX hūX huX huX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha ji hi 'a hi/ ha ha hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas zhal du stabs pa ni/ huX he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan 'dren no/ /dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di sa /zhing chen gsar rnying ti ra'i tshogs/ /dmar gyi arghaX rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ma'i tshogs rnams kyang / /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ dzaXhūṃ baX hoX shrī he ru ka ma hā sa ma ya/ kha kha 'a hi ji hi/ de ltar sbyor sgrol kyi mchod pa de gnyis ni/ rakta'i mchod pa dang 'brel ba'o/ /de rjes bstod pas mchod pa ni/ skyoXbaskal me 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /sku mdog dbus zhal mthing ka ni/ /chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i rtags/ /g.yas kyi zhal mdog dkar ba ni/ /bag chags skyon gyis ma gos rtags/ /g.yon gyi zhal mdog dmar ba ni/ /'gro ba'i don la chags pa'i rtags/ /dbu skra gyen du 'bar ba ni/ /srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags/ /spyan dgu sdang mig —156—

gzigs pa ni/ /thig dgu mtha' ru phyin pa'i rtags/ /rnam thar zhal gsum mche ba gtsigs/ /dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i rtags/ /pha rol phyin pa'i phyag drug ste/ /rtse dgu sa dgu 'joms pa'i rtags/ /rtse lnga 'bar ba ye shes lnga/ /me dpung nyon mongs bag chags bsreg /kha ṭāX rtse gsum srid gsum gcod/ /ri rab phur pa 'gril ba ni/ /dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med rtags//tshar gsum 'phreng bas brgyan pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas rdzogs pa'i rtags/ /nga rgyal phrag dog lta ngan rnams/ /dbyings su dag pa'i na bza' gsum/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /rtags mtshan gsum gyis sku la brgyan/ /klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan pa ni/ /rnam thar brgyad po rdzogs pa'i rtags/ /zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum bzhugs pa ni/ /bdud bzhi zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags/ /yab yum gnyis su med par sbyor ba ni/ /dbyings dang ye shes don dam gcig pa'i rtags/ /khro bo yab yum nyi shus bskor ba ni/ /pha rol phyin dang shes bcu rdzogs pa'i rtags/ /khra thabs sgo ma sras mchog tshogs kyis bskor/ /sna tshogs sprul pas gdug pa 'dul ba'i rtags/ /ma bdun sring mos bskor sogs dmag dpung 'gyed/ /bse lcags dung gsum 'khor gyi bskor ba ni/ /grub pa'i rtags 'byin zhing bcu sgrol ba'i rtags/ /de ltar che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i/ /dpal bo chen po 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ ces phyogs gzhan las dag dran bshad pa'i dod du skabs 'dir rtags bsdod bya/ de rjes don bstod byed par spro na'ang / 'og tu ཿnga ba'i bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyi pa sogs bya/ cung zad rgyas pa la mos na yig rnying rnams kyang shes par bya'o/ /de rjes la bzlas pa la —157—

'jug dgos te/ /gnyis pa la bzlas pa'i sngon 'gro bzlas pa dngos rjes bstod pa ste gsum las/dang po la rig 'dzin bskul ba dang / /'dzab kha dbye ba gnyis las/ thog ma ni/ hu ma g.yel ma 'phangs rig 'dzin tshogs/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /srid pa'i phur bu bdag sgrub kyi/ /byin gyis rlob cing gshegs su gsol/ /u rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams/ /padma ge sar sdong po la/ /ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags/ /'khordo ra du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor/ /khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyi/ /byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol/ /rigs ni za hor rgyal po'i rigs/ /slob dpon pra bha ha ti rtsal/srid pa'i phur bu bdag: byin gyis: dur khrod ming ni bsil pa tshal/ /slob dpon dha na sang kri ta/ slob dpon dha na sang kri ta / /slob dpon blo ldan mchog sred rtsal/ /rgya mtsho'i/ gling du bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ /sa bdag klu gnyan btul/ ba bzhin/ /dam srid 'dul zhing gshe/gas su gsol/ /gza' dang rgyu skar btul/ ba bzhin/ /dgra bgegs 'dul zhing gshe/gas su gsol/ /srid pa'i phur bu:byin gyis jo rgya gar yul du grub thob pa/ /slob dpon padma'i 'byung gnas kyis//lho phyogs tsan dan nags tshal na/ /ji ltar rtags phyung bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /srid pa'i byin gyis: bi ma la yi mi tra yis/ga dru lha yi chu bo la/ /ji ltar rtags phyung bsnyel lam ci/ /phur bu sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /srid pa'i: byin sa rgyas bal po'i yul du grub thob pa/ /rig 'dzin shi la mañdzu yis/ /manta la yi mkhar sgong la/ /ji ltar rtags sogs gong bzhi/ bod kyi yul du grub thob pa/ /sna na rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis/ /yar 5—158—

klung sgrags kyi phu chu la/ ji ltar rtags: shud pu dpal gyi seng ge yis/ has po ri yi spang po la/ ji ltar rtags: 'chims rṣa shākya pra bha yis/ /'on cang rdo yi brag dmar la/ ji ltar rtags: mkhar rje za yi mtsho rgyal gyis/ /dgung gi pho rog nag po la/ ji ltar rtags: mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug gis/ /rtsis kyi spyang khu sngon po la/ ji ltar rtags: phur bu: srid pa'i byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gdung 'tshob pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /rig 'dzin sprul pa'i tshogs thams cad/ /bdag la byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes gyer ro/ /sngon 'gro gnyis pa 'dzab kha dbye ba ni/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug tshul ston zhing / /rgod dang gshe dang 'jigs su rung ba dang / /snying rje ma dang zhi ba la sogs pa/ /sku yi dngos po gar dgur bsgyur ba ni/ /rgyan dang cha lugs ldan pas sgeg sgeg 'dra/ /bdud bzhi gdan du bting bas dpa' dpa' 'dra/ /sku che yan lag rags pas 'jigs 'jigs 'dra/ /g.yas zhal dkar la 'dzum pa sgeg sgeg 'dra/ /g.yon zhal dmar la gdangs pas gshe gshe 'dra/ /dbus zhal mthing la rngam pa khro khro 'dra/ /rgyud drug rjes su 'dzin pas brtse brtse 'dra/ /dgyes bde chags pas rol pa dam dam 'dra/ /chos sku mtshan ma med pas zhi zhi 'dra/ /rdo rje rtse dgus sa dgu'i rtog pa 'joms/ /rtse lnga gdengs pas dug lnga dbyings su sgrol/ /me dpung 'bar bas 'khor ba'i nyon mongs sreg /kha ṭāX rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod/ /ri rab phur bus dgra bgegs gzir bar byed/ /de 'dra'i khro bo 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs mchod pa 'di bzhis la/ /thugs rjes —159—

brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /bcom ldan dpal chen thugs kyi dgyes bde mo/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i yum/ /tshur gshe/gas sogs gong bzhin/hū mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo /rnam rgyal sgeg snyems stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo /gshin rje dur khrod shwa ba 'ug pa'i mgo /mi g.yo gshun khung gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /rta mgrin gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo /gzhan gyis mi thub mda' snyems spyang khra'i mgo /'khyil pa rlung 'byin seng ge pha wang mgo /khams gsum gsod byed dred dang sre mong mgo /stobs chen bskul byed dom dang byi ba'i mgo /gnod spyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/ /de 'dra'i lha tshogs 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /tshur byon sogs/ zhe sdang khros pa'i me ni mthing nag 'bar/ /gti mug khros pa'i me ni smug nag 'bar/ /'dod chags khros pa'i me ni dmar nag 'bar/ /phrag dog 'khros pa'i me ni ljang nag 'bar/ /gru gsum 'od lnga 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog gī la ya/ /rigs lnga rdo rje gzhon nu sku bzhengs shig /bdud dang log 'dren ma lus 'dus pa'i phyir/de 'dra'i lha tshogs 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /tshur byon sogs/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' srung dam can tshogs/ /bdag nyid chen mo bzhi dang shwa na bzhi//bsre ba'i lha mo bzhi rnams ming por bcas/ /pho bdud nyi shu gcig sogs sde brgyad tshogs/ /rang rang las la brtson pa'i pho nya rnams/ /tshur byon sogs gong bzhin no/ /—160—

gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ bcom ldan yab yum thabs shes gnyis su med/ /rnam sprul khro bo yab yum pho nya'i tshogs/ yum ring dus nas bsnyen zhing bsgrubs pa'i lha/ / drag po rang byung dbang dang dngos grub lha tshul/ zhes lan gsum sogs gsol ba btab nas bzlas pa bya ste/ sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs su gī la ya 'bru bcu drug pa nyid ci nus su bzla zhing / khro bcu las sngags dang bcas pa dang / sgo ma'i sngags rnams cung zad re bzla yi/ grangs nges gzung can mi dgos so/ /gsum pa rjes bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ /yid kyis sgrub sprul pa'i mchod pa dang bcas te/hū bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs dbyings phyug shes rab bcas/ /gtso bo yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyogs bcu dregs pa bsnon pa'i gdan stengs su/ /mthu chen bdud 'dul khro rgyal 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /hu dang phaṭa kyis srid gsum 'khor ba 'jig /'jigs byed khro rgyal tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen dbyings nas 'bar ba'i sku bzhengs ma/ /thabs mchog sku la so sor dgyes pas 'khyud/ /shes rab tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad ma/ /ye shes khro mo bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod/ khams gsum dbang bsdud thugs rje sprul pa'i sku/ /gtum khros za gsod rnam 'phrul pho nya'i tshogs/ /phyag rgya rnam bzhis 'dul mdzad sgo skyong ma/ /rdo rje phra men tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpal gyi sras mchog rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las mdzad/ /yakṣa me dbal sprul pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /smon lam dbang gi dregs pa'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /dpal gyi bka' sdod sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams kyis dngos gzhi'i cho ga bstan zin no/ /rnying ma'i —161—

lugs kyi sgrub mchod la bdag 'jug gi lag len mdzad pa nyung bas sgrub mchod tsam la bdag 'jug ma grub kyang mi 'gal mod/ spyir 'grub na legs pas gal te byed na skabs 'dir bzang ste/bdag 'jug ni dngos gzhi'i cho ga yin pas so/ /'on kyang phur chog gsar pa rnams kyi lag len la ni/ 'di nas lhag ma'i rjes yan chad du bdag 'jug gi dus ma nges par byed pa'ang snang ngo / /de la bdag 'jug ni dbang gi yi ge las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gsum las/ dang po tshogs kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs rdzas rnams bshams/ bdud rtsi gtor la/ bsangs sbyangs/ ra gyi mes bsregs zhes pa nas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur gyi bar gtor ma byin wos dang 'dra/ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang/ zhes pa nas/ dngos grub stsol/ dam tshig chen po gshegs su gsol/ /sprul pa chen po gshegs su gsol/ phyag brnyan chen po: shwa na mu kha: bdag nyid wo mo sa bdag wo mo bran dang pho nya: 'bor bos thams cad khro bo 'khor bcas gshegs nas kyang / rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang / /gī la ya yi dngos grub stsole/ badzra sa mā dza dza rgyu ba ho tshogs phud cha gsum du bya/ /dang po snod du bcug la stegs mtho bar bzhag bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ zhes pa nas/ yakṣa kro dha kha kha ji hi ji rti'i bar gong gtor ma'i skabs bzhin/ gar byas 'grub bo rnal 'byor pa/ /gar gyi dbang phyug gtso bo che/ /zla ba la sogs snying po can/ ma sa la sogs ro mchog gsol/ me tog la sogs tsan dan 'phreng / /bzang rgu 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /mdzes rgu 'bul lo gzigs su gsol//bda' rgu 'bul lo rol du gsol/ /snyan rgu 'bul lo gsan du gsol/ /mi mo rnams kyi reg bya sogs/ gong bzhin/ tshogs bar pa la dmigs te/ tshe rabs bskal pa —162—

thog ma med pa nas/ /da lta lus 'di blangs pa tshun chod du/ /lus kyi sdig byas sdig pa dngos su bgyis/ /ngag gi 'khyal tshig smra ba ngan du chug /sems kyi blo nor log par bsam pa sogs/ /'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa/ /bkra ba'i lha tshogs khyed la bzod par gsol/ /ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang / /de'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams/ /mi yi skyon mthong tsa na chad pas gcod/ /nongs par gyur kyang bka' chad ma gcod cig /mthu rtsal ci yod dgra dang bgegs la sprugs/ /bstan pa 'jig sogs nyes skyon ma gzigs sam/ /sgrub po'i nyes pa phran tshogs dbyings su thim/ /nyams par gyur pa longs spyod tshogs kyis bskang / /dam bskong dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol/ tshogs tha ma ni/ gzugs brnyan du byas la/ spros pa la dga' na/ khro bo bcu nas phur srungs kyi bar gyis bskul rnams bya/ bsdu na dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ sogs la tshang pas bskul logs pa med kyang chog /bden pa brdar ba spyi dang 'dra ba las/ 'jam dpal sku/ padma gsung / yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phur pa 'phrin las/ ma mo rbod gtong / 'jig rten mchod bstod/ smod pa drag sngags/ 'dus pa mdo/rgyu 'phrul rgyan/ 'chi med tshe/ lhun grub rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra /rnal 'byor dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/sems can yongs la 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad dang / khyad par du 'di zhes bya ba skad cig thad cig yud tsam la bsgral ba'i las kyi gnas 'dir mchis par gyur cig /che ge mo 'di'i rgyab brten dang —163—

dpung gnyen byed pa'i pho lha dang yul lha dang srog lha dang / dgra lha dang zhang lha la sogs pa nyon cig /gnod byed dgra bgegs 'di dag gi /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smad/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig rnal 'byor pa'i sku la bdos/ dben gnas dang cho se gzhi dbral/ las bzang rgu ni spangs/ las ngan rgu ni byas pa yin pas/ 'di la srung ba ma byed/ mgon skyabs ma byed/yal bar thong cig /gal te 'di'i rgyab rten dang dpung gnyen byed na/ khyed cag rnams dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'i chad pas bcad nas/ mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal bar skyes te/ thar med kyi sdug bsngal myong bar the tshom med do/ /yul phyogs 'di dag na gnas pa'i yul bdag gnas bdag klu gnyan sa bdag la sogs pa 'jig rten dregs pa can thams cad kyang nyon cig /bdag cag khyed rnams la gnod pa mi byed do/ /drag sngags kyi me dbal mi gtong / /phur pa'i rtse mi gtod/ yungs kar gyi rbab mi sgril/ drag rdzas kyi thun zor mi brdeg /drag po'i pho nya mi 'gyed do/ /bdag cag ni dgra bgegs gdug pa can bsgral ba'i zhing bcu 'di rnams 'gugs pa yin pas/ khyed rnams ko long ma sdom/ ma 'jigs/ ma skrag /ma bsdangs bar dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' rtags 'dzin par nga yi rgyab dang dpung gyis shig /gdug pa can 'di da lta nyid du khug la bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig ces snyan gsan dbab pa lan gsum bya/ de nas rgyas pa la mos na/ khro bo bcu nas phur srungs bar gyi bskul rnams bya ste pho nya gtong ba yin/ bsdu na/ sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab/ sogs la tshang bas 'dir ma brjod kyang chog /de nas bden brdar sogs gong du mug da pa dang spyi 'gros dang mthun pa'i tshig gis liṅga dgug 'dren bya/—164—

dza dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab/ ces pa nas/ zhal du stab pa'i bar gong bsgral mchod kyi skabs bzhin no/ /'di tsam ni bsdus pa'i lugs yin la/ rgyas pa ni/ gong ma rnams kyis mdzad zin pa las shes par bya la/ 'bring po 'tsham pa zhig g.yin du yang 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /'di skabs ling ro rnams gtor ma la btab/ cha shas cung zad tsam tshogs rdzas dang yang bsre/ cung zad cig lhag gtor gtsang ma dang yang bsre'o/ /de rjes brda dang brda'i lan dang 'bul len sogs spyi dang 'dra bar byas nas/ rnal 'byor pa rnams tshogs la rol lo/ /rjes chog gnyis pa lhag ma'i gtor ma ni/ lhag ma rnams snod cig tu bsdus nas rme gtor gyi tshul du bsham/ de'i 'gram du lhag ma gtsang gtor yang ba6ga /bdud rtsis bran/ tso rna mahā ba li ta/ sogs lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ hū bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /yum chen 'khor lo'i rgyas 'debs kyi/ /sprul pa'i pho nya dpag yas dang / /grub pa gsang ba 'bar ma'i tshogs/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /tshur gshegs gtor ma 'di la bzhes la/ khro rje lcam dral srung ba dang / /rkyen las byung ba'i dgra bo rnams/ /yud tsam gyis ni med par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khore bcas kyi/ /mi mthun bar chad zhi ba dang / /re smon thams cad 'gru/ba par mdzod/ de nas lhag gtor gnyis dang / 'jig rten pa'i spyi gtor gtor gral nas blangs pa nas blangs pa rnams rdo rje 'gros kyis phyi snur du bzhag /raktas bran/ 'di skad ces/'jig rten las 'das pho nya myo /yang dag sku gcig byung ba ni/ /dpal gyi pho nya lcags kyu 'dzin/ /'di 'dra gcig pur ma nges te/ /stong khams khyab par sprul byed ma/ /shar gyi phyogs nas gshegs su gsol/ /'jig rten las 'das pho nya myo /yang dag sku gcig byung ba ni/ /dung gi spyang mo mgo dgu ma/ /—165—

ral pa lcang lo re re la/ /pho nya kyu thogs sprin ltar gtings/ khar lho mtshams nas gshe/gas su gsol/ de gnyis kun la 'gre ste/ dpal gyi pho nya zhags pa thogs/'di 'dra stong khams: lho yi: lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma/ ral pa: pho nya zhags thogs: lho nub mtshams: dpal gyi lcags sgrog: 'di 'dra: stong khams: nub kyi: zangs kyi spyang mo ral pa: pho nya sgrog thogs: nub byang :dpal gyi: dril bu: 'di 'dra: stong khams byang gi phyogs: g.yu yi spyang mo:ral pa pho nya dril thogs: byang shar: lcags kyi byi ba chen po la/ /mi mo lcags kyi tshul can zhon/ /lha srin sde brgyad phung byed ma/ /'og gi phyogs nas:lcags kyi bya khra brgyad khri la/ /mi mo lcags kyi: lha srin sde brgyad skyong byed ma/steng gi phyogs nas: sngon kyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ kha khrag dmar gyi mchod pas mchod/ /chem chem dgongs shig sa ma ya/ /'dir gshe/gas bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /gzhan yang dpal gyi bka' nyan pa/ /khyab byed chen po khyung gi mgo /'jigs byed chen po spyang ki'i mgo /gsod byed chen po dred kyi mgo /'byin byed byi la pu shud mgo /smyo byed ltos 'phye rmigs bu'i mgo /rkun byed chen po byi ba'i mgo /za byed chen po stag gi mgo /sgron byed seng ge pha wang mgo /phra men chen po khyed rnams kyang / bye ba brgya stong 'khor dang bcas/ sngon gyi thugs dam: : : ngu 'bar ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/ /'bar ba chen mo lus 'bar rnams/ /dpal chen sku la 'phro zhing 'du/ /'bar ma nyi ma'i zhags pa 'debs/ /'bar ma me khyer glog 'phreng 'dzin/ /'bar ma gshin rje skar mda' 'phen/ /'bar ma ser mo mdun thung 'phen/ /'bar ma klu mo lce 'bebs —166—

ma/ /'bar ma rlung bdag ral gri'i skra/ /'bar ma gnod sbyin khyung thogs ma//'bar ma gtum mo ba lang rna/ /'bar ma chen po khyed rnams kyang / sngon gyi:: : : oX badzra ḍā ki ni pra tismo i maX dzi hūX/ oṃ bzhi ṭā ki ni pra titsā i maX ba liX oṃX oṃ ratna ṭā ki ni pra tisnro i maX ba dzi drwaX/ oX padma ḍā ki ni pra titsā i maX ba li sdiX.oṃ karma ḍā ki ni pra tismo i maX ba li a/ oX sarba ḍā ki ni pra tismo i maX ba liX ho/lan gsum gyis stab/ de nas lhag ma rme gtor gtsang gtor gnyis bsres/ tshogs phud bar pa la blugs/ kha khrus btab la/ /spyi gtor ni de la bsres kyang chog ma bsres kyang chog /yang cung zad phyir snur la/ /sman dang rakta cung zad bran/ 'bru gsum lan mang du brjod/ hūX sngon tshe dpal chen he ru ka'i/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /grub pa dbang phyug ma tshogs ma/ /klas dang byi mo bran mo'i tshogs/ /rgyal mo blon mo ded dpon ma/ /g.yog mo dang ni yang g.yog ma/ /bran dang yang bran 'khor dang bcas/ sngon gyi: je je 2 sngon tshe dpal spyan sngar khar gyi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /dkar mo dung gi thor tshugs can/ /lho yi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /sngon mo gzig gi sham thabs can/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /dmar mo zangs kyi lan phran can/ /byang gi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /gser gyi 'od zer mda' 'phen ma/ steng gi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /rnam sprul ma nges cir yang ston/ /'og gi phyogs kyi ma mo ni/ /ru dra sgrol ba'i mthu mo che/ dpal gyi lha mo shugs 'gro ma/ khyod ni nam mkha'i rgyal mo ste/ sngon gyi: : jo gling bzhi mgyogs ma lha yi sring / khar gyi mgyogs ma gshegs su gsol/ /mkha' la khyung lding gshin rje'i lcam/ /lho yi mgyogs ma:dkar sham g.yas thod klu yi sring / /nub kyi mgyogs: nag mo sder chen gnod —167—

sbyin srid/ /byang gi mgyogs ma: sring mo chen mo khyed bzhi yang / sngon tshe: spyan sngar: tshangs ma la sogs nyi shu brgyad/ gar ma la sogs nyi shu brgyad/ /ma sring la sogs nyi shu brgyad/ /'bar ma la sogs nyi shu brgyad/ /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /pho nya sum brgya drug cu rnams/ /sngon gyi sogs gong bzhi/ bar 'di srung ma rnams la las brtse ba ste/ bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dpal sa btsan/ /bar snang khams kyi mthun mo che/ /chos kyi dbyings na bzhugs tsa na/ /rdo rje gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ /rgya mtsho'i gting na bzhugs tsa na/ /rdo rje me za brag gyon ma/ /bha ga'i klong na bzhugs tsa na/ /yum chen bha ga hri ti ma/ /bar snang khams na rgyu bas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /ston bzhin sha ba zhon pa paṇḍa sha ba ri/ /nam gyi gung phyed rgyu bas nam gru mthu mo che/ /ri rab rtse la bzhugs nas gling bzhi skyong mdzad ma/ gling bzhi kun byams drag mo rgyal/ /mi gcig ma la ming dgu ma/ /mkhan brgya ma la mtshan stong ma/ /gang la bya ba nor ra re/ /skyod cig rgya mtsho'i gting nas bskyod/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel yal gam can/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab/ /zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum la/ /zangs kyi mi mo chen mo zhon/ /mig ni nyi ma'i zer las 'tsher/ /sbu ni ral gri'i so bas rno/ /sder mo lcags kyu 'bar ba 'dra/ /'jug ma lcags kyu bsdogs pa bzhin/ /bang ni glog gi bskyod du med/ /skad ni stong khams khyab par sgrog /g.yas pa rdo rje ri rab brnyel/ /g.yon pa zangs kyi zhags pa thogs/ /gang la bya ba nor ra re/ /skyod gcig ri rab rtse nas bskyod/ /ma g.yel bcol ba'i sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab /—168—

bse yi lha mo( ched bzhi las/ /gcig ni bal yul mthil na bzhugs/ /mar khu'i mtsho la gnas bcas shing / khyod kyi bka' nyan 'bum sde ni/ /nang yang mar khu'i mtsho la 'du// /nub kyang mar khu'i mtsho la 'du/ /rgya mtsho'i gting na 'du 'du ba/ /mthing nag ral pa sha ra ra/ /dbang gi bse khrab si li li/ /bse yi ral pa si li li/ /ral pa re la phur pa re/ khyod ni bdud kyi bu mo ste/ /'chibs su bdud rta nag po 'chibs/ /na bza' ber chen mthing nag gsol/ /brda ni mi 'phrod lho bal mon/ /skad ni mi go ldab ma ldib/ /dri ni mi zhim chi li li/ /gzugs ni mi sdug lag brgya ma/ /g.yon pa lnga bcu lcags kyu 'dzin/ /g.yas pa lnga bcu phur bu bsgril/ /lcags kyus bzung la phur bus thob/ badzra ku lanta ra'i dus la bab/ /de yis rigs 'gre ste/ sa bdag: bse yi: gcig ni tsha ba'i rong na bzhugs/ zhag gi mtsho la khyod kyi bka' nyan: nang yang zhag girgyonub kyang zhag gi: rgya mtsho'i gting : mthing nag: dbang gi bse yi: ral pa re: khyod ni gza' yi: 'chibs su gza' rta zhur po: nab bza' ber chen ser khra: brda ni: skad ni: dri ni: gzugs ni g.yon pa g.yas pa: lcags kyusangubadzra shu lanta ra'i/ de bzhin du sbyar nas/ gcig ni mang yul bse na: rakta'i ma6 khyod kyi nang yang : nub kyang : rgya mtsho'i: mthing nag: dbang gingubase yi ral pa: khyod ni btsan gyi: 'chibs su btsan rta dmar po: nab bza' ber chen dmar khra: brda ni: skad ni dri ni: gzugs ni: g.yon pa:g.yas pa: lcags kyus/ badzra tsa rmyusna / ra'i dus la bab/ /gcig ni gnya' nam bri na bzhugs/ /'o ma'i khyod kyi: nang yang ngu nub kyang 'o ma'i/ rgya mtsho—169—

mthing nag: dbang gi: bse ral pa khyod ni klu yi: 'chibs su klu rta sngon po nab bza' ber chen sngon po brda ni: skad ni: dri ni: gzugs ni:g.yon pa: g.yas pa: lcags kyus: badzra kang ka dha ra'i dus la bab/ hu/ pho nya bran dang mngags pa'i tshogs/ khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bdud nag chen po ral chen dang / /bdud rje zla ba ka la drag /bdud rje ro langs khrag mig dang / /dur khrod nag po snying dkar te/ /dung gi skyes bu mched bzhi dang / /tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ khreng gyi dmar po ma ru rtse/ skyes bu phya sangs dkar po dang / /nag po srog bdud chen po ste/ /lcags kyi skyes bu bzhi po dang / /skyes bu gying chen ma ru rtse/ /skyes bu gshin rje ma ru rtse/ /skyes bu bdud nag ma ru rtse/ /skyes bu gnod sbyin ma ru rtse/ /bse yi skyes bu mched bzhi dang /khyab pa lce rings skya gcig pu/ /nag po 'dzum med so brdar 'khrigs/ /nag po skrag med gshin rje'i gtso/ /gsod byed 'bar ma 'jog po klu/ /srog gcod shan pa mched bzhi dang / /sa bdag blon po rtsang kun dang / /bdud kyi blon po spyang ki'i mgo /gdeng pa snying dkar klu yi blon/ /'brog gnas gnod sbyin blon po dang / /'byung po ser po sna yon po/ /de ltar pho bdud nyer gcig rnams/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /yid la brnags pa'i las mdzod cig /bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi ni/ /nag mo khrag gi ral pa can/ /srod la dgra bo'i snying 'byin ma/ /nag mo zhag gi ral pa can/ /nam phyed dgra bo'i srog gcod ma/ /nag mo dung gi ral pa can/ /nyi shar dgra bo'i bla dgugs ma/ /nag mo zangs kyi ral pa can/ /tho rangs dgra bo'i sha la rol/ /de ltar nag mo —170—

mched bzhi po/ /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /sarba a na ya hū ཾ phaṭa/ ta tha ya hū phaṭa/ ces rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te lhag gtor phyi rol du dor ro/ /gsum pa nyer bsdu'i bya ba la/ bstan ma bskul ba/ dngos grub blang ba/ bzod gsol/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba/ bdag nyid srung ba/ smon lam gdab pa rnams yod pa las/ dang po ni/ ho bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ sngon gyi dam bca' las mi 'da' bar/ dpal chen po'i pham phabs la gnos te/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi gdong grogs la 'dir gshegs shigadza hū ba ho e a ra li hri hri dza/ hu bka' yi tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ /tshur gshe/gas tshur gshegs skyong ma rnams/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs te/ /'dir gshegs dam dgongs gtor ma bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /bdag nyid chen po rdo rje kun grags ma/ /dpal ldan lha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / /gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun du bzang / /'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/ /bdud kyi bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi dang / /gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu bun ma/ /mkha' rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ /gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje rlung mo dang / /smangs ri rab 'jom rdo rje grags mo rgyal/ /gnod sbyin bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi dang / /kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong / /btsan la la ro rdo rje sman gcig ma/ /sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo sil/ /g.yu'i dril snyan rdo rje zur le ma/ /sman btsun bu mo chen mo khyed bzhi ste/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas rnams kyang / /sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig rjes dgongs —171—

nas/ /lhab lhub rin chen mang po'i rgyan dang bcas/ /pho nya bran g.yog mang po'i 'khor dang bcas/ /sil snyan rol mo mang po'i sgra dang bcas/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ /che ge chen mo khyed rnams kyang //rdo rje thod 'phreng spyan snga sa /zhing chen tshogs kyi mchod bkram nas/ /rnam lnga bdud rtsi'i longs spyod kyis/ /dbang bskur ming btags dam mnos te/ /thar pa thob par ming yang grags/ /lag tu rdo rje byin nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gral du bzhag /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /rnal 'byor sgrub po'i grogs mdzod cig /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long la/ /bcol ba'i las rnams grub bar mdzod/ ces bstan ma bskyang ngo / /de nas gtor ma zor du 'phang pa'i srol yang yod mod/ dkyus la mi dgos pas ji ltar bde bar gshegs las bzhi'i bro brdung ba ni/ gtor snod kha sbub la/ huX dang po gti mug nyid las byung / /bar du gti mug nyid la 'khor/ /tha mar gti mug nyid kyis 'dul/ /gti mug rdo rje'i 'phrin las mdzad/ /dngul lam dkar po'i shing dag la/ /mgo bo rgya mdud rtse mo zlum/ /logs la bzhi ba'i lha bsgoms te/ khong stong byang chub sems lung bstan/ /rtse mo zlum po lta ba yis/ /thams cad ma lus zhi bar 'gyur/ /zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med/ /zhi ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin du 'don pa spos la/ gti mug ces par/ nga rgyal zhes dang / gser ram ser po'i shing zo mgo bo rgya mdud zur bzhi rtse/ /logs la rgyas pa'i: khong stong : rtse mo zur bzhi zhi ba zhes pa rnams su rgyas pa/ yang de bzhin du gti mug ces par/ 'dod chags/ zangs sam dmar po'i: rtse zla gam/ logs la dbang girgyo—172—

khong stong rgyo rtse mo zla gam: zhi ba'i gnas su dbang gi dang / dbang du dbang sdud lha de bzhi du /gti mug ces par/ zhes sdang /lcags sam nag po'i :rtse zur gsum/ logs la drag po'i: khong stong : rtse mo zur gsum: ma lus rlag par 'gyur/ 'joms par ma gyur 'joms mdzad lha: re re'i mthar gī la ya sbyar ro/ /dngos grub blang ba ni/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /'khor lo rgyas 'debs dgongs su gsol/ /dang po bsnyen pa'i dbu btsugs nas/ /bsnyen pa'i dus kyang mtha' ru phyin/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i sgo ru zhugs/ /do nub yan chad zhag grangs thems/ /bzlas brjod grangs kyang thems lags kyi/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /mgon po thugs rje byon pa na/ khyed kyi thugs dam stsal bas na/ /'gro ba mang po grol slad du/ /gī la ya yi dngos grub stsole// /gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi/ /sgrub mchog bdag gi rnam rtog sbyangs pa'i phyir/ /gsang ba byang chub sems kyi dngos grub stsole/ /bde gshegs kun 'dus thugs dam rgyud bskul nas/ /'gro ba ma lus byang chub don byas te/ /dpal chen he ru ka yi go 'phang mchog /da lta nyid du thob pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /hū mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang rmigs pa'i mgo /zhes pa nas/ gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/ /dpal gyis bka' gnyan ye shes lha kun gyi/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'gro ba drug la thugs rtser dgongs su gsol/ /rdzu 'phrul dbang ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /sems la dbang ba'i ye shes: tshe la skye ba chos la yo byad las la smon lam: mos pa: bsdu —173—

dngos bzhi yi: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog gī la ya/ khams gsum bsgral ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/khro rgyal sku yi: gsung gi thugs kyi: yon to 'phrin las dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ khwa na la sogs bka' yi pho nya'i tshogs/ /sgrub pa rtags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ma tshogs nam gru re ma ti yi tshogs/ /pho nya bka' sdod dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rdo rje ya spyin la sogs dam can tshogs/ /rdzu 'phrul drag po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ye shes lha dang mkha' 'gro srungs ma'i tshogs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /dkyus kyi cho ga'i yan lag la nges par dgos pa min yang skabs 'di'am/gong 'dzab bzlas kyi mthar/ tshe chog logs su yod pa ltar rang gzhan gyi don du spro na bya ste/ de'i tshe tshe chog gi mthar mchod bstod kyang bya'o/ /gang ltar yang de rjes yig brgya mang du bzlas pa'i mthar/ lta ba spangs pas chos nyid don ma rtogs/ /sgom pa yun thung yi dam lha ma gsal/ /bsnyen sgrub yun thung dngos grub mthu ma brnyes/ /'bad rtsol chung bas slob dpon thugs ma dgyes//brtse gdung chung pas mched lcam thugs dang 'gal/ /le lo snyoms las mchod pa ma tshang bas/ /ye shes lha spangs dngos grub g.yel ba'i rgyu/ /de sogs nongs par gyur pa ci bgyis pa/ /bkra ba'i lha tshogs spyan sngar mthol lo bshags/ /nyes skyon thams cad dbyings su dag gyur cig /ma 'byor pa dang /sogs spyi dang 'dra bar bzod gsol byas/ o khyod kyis sems can sogs/ 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ nyi ma tha ma la yin na dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying —174—

gar bsdus nas 'od gsal du mnyam par bzhag /ā ka phra hu(/ sngags kyis las rjes bsdu ba spyi dang 'dra/ dge 'dis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i gī la ya'i//go 'phang byang chub myur thob nas/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal bar shog /ces sogs smon lam gdab cing / hu skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi sku sprul pa/ /bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /mi 'gyur rtag pa'i don gyi bkra shis shog /'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum gyi bkra shis shog /sprul pa'i khro rgyal bcu yi bkra shis shog khres rab khro mo bcu yi bkra shis shog /yang sprul phyag brnyan tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /ye shes sgo skyong bzhi yi bkra shis shog /'phrin las sras mchog rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dam can bka' sdod tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /dge legs 'bras bur smin pa'i bkra shis shog /gzha yang shis brjod kyi khyad par ji ltar 'os pa brjod do//de ltar dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud 'joms rol pa ces bya ba 'di ni/'khon lugs kyi las byang rnying pa sa chen gyis mdzad par yang byed pa 'di la gtso bor brten/ de yang snubs lugs kyi las byang dang phal cher mthun par 'dug cing / gzhan kha skongs dgos pa yang gdams ngag drug pa dang / /skyi lugs sogs sngags rnying bka' ma rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs shing / gsar ma'i rgyas 'gebs sogs spangs te rang lugs gtsang zhing dag par brjod pa ni/rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha'i sug las so// // zhus dag/ bkra shis//—175spo

slob ma dbang bskur bar byed par 'dod na/ nang par dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa byed rgyu'i deng gi nyin par te/ dgongs kha'i dus su slob ma rnams/ dkyil 'khor khang par 'tshog na dkyil 'khor la yol ba 'thug po btang ste bsgribs/ dkyil 'khor ma bshams pa'i sngon du yin na yang /rdul tshon bum pa sogs mi mthong ba'i phyir sgrib pa legs/ dkyil chog rdo rje las rim ltar na spyi dang mthun yang / phur pa'i chos skor gyi rtsa ba'i gzhung rnams kyi bzhed dgongs min pas/ sta gon rnam bzhi'i rim pa sogs gsar ma dang sbyar ba dgos pa'i nges pa med pas/ slob ma sta gon ji ltar skabs su pab pa la bya/ de yang slob ma rnams gu gul gyis bdug khrus byas/ gral la 'khord/me tog bkye bsdu bya/ bla mas chos bshad byas nas maṇḍal 'bul du bcug /skye rga na dang 'chi ba yi/ /chu srin la sogs 'jigs byed las/ /'don par mdzad pa khyod 'ba' zhig /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /zhes pa nas/ mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum rjes zlos kyi gsol ba bto/ bu tshur gsang ba'i cho ga ni/ khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ khyod ni gsang ba'i snod yin te/ /dam tshig dam pa bstan par bya/ /byang chub sems kyang bskyed par bya/ /'khor ba dag las bskyab par bya/ /dkyil 'khor chen por bzhug par bya/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur ro/ /da ni dad pa bskyed par bgyi/ zhes pa tsam mam spro na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / zhes pa'ang brjod de spro bha bskyed/ bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa dang / /bgyid du stsal dang —176—

yi rang ba/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /ma lus de dag bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni yid rang ngo / /sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i thabs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sems can ma lus srid par lhung / /'gro ba rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /bdag gi de ring nyid du ni/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khong ra bcas pa /ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /zhes pa nas/ mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyis ni bslab pa dang / nas/ so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bsgrubs nas ni/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba rnams/ /byang chub gnas su sgrol bar shog rgyun dzin gas dang sdom bzung 'di/ rtsa ba lugs kyi dbang bskur la byed la mna' snam pa'i lugs dang kyi lugs sogs la mi byed do/ /dngos su maṇḍal tshom bu lnga pa zhig bshams/ khyed rang rnams kyi mos pa la/maṇḍal 'di nyid gzhal med khang du mos/ /tshom bu lnga po gdod nas grub pa'i rgyal ba rigs lngar gyur/ ngu zhe sogs mchod pa lnga phul/ o bi shu khye sarba hi na hū phaṭa/ces slob ma bsangs/ yungs kar gtor la nga bzlas pas bgegs bskrad/ maṇḍa 'a/ gyi dbus kyi rdo rje sems dpa' las rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis pa chad nas khyed rang rnams la thim/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur/ gnas gsum du —177—

bdud rtsi'i thig le byas la/ skye( tsakra snya hā glu(/ ā padma spru hā khyi hu badzra snyu hā hu/ zhes brjod la/ sku gsung thugs su sbyor ba yi/ /lus ngag yid gsum srung ba dang / /rnam thar gsum la 'god pa'i phyir/ /byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas mdzod cigadapung skud bcing pa'ang spyi dang 'dra ste/ hu zhes drag tu bzla ba dang / snying po 'bru bcu drug pas bsrung ba bya/ rdo rje srung ba'i don du ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis btab//lus kyi nyes pa bsal ba dang / /srung dang sta gon gnas par mdzod/ ces brjod/so shing / o badzra dan da sa sba ra tikṣa ṇa snya hā/ zhes pas byin gyis rlabs shing slob mar gtad/ /ngag gi nyes pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /dur khrod so shing dam pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor steng du rab tu dor/ /dbang gi lha rnams bstan du gsol/zhes brjod nas 'dor du gzhug/khyor chu sbyin pa spyi dang 'dra/ /zab mo'i chos bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ yod med dag las rnam par 'das/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med/ /rab tu rtog med gnas med pa/ /spros pa thams cad spangs pa yin/ zhes brjod cing de'i don bsam du gzhug/'di ni yid dag par byed pa ste/ spro na de'i rjes su/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag ces sogs spro ba bskyed pa'ang 'grub na legs/ de rjes yi ge 'bru gsum gyis bsngags pa'i rtswa'i sngas dang gdan gtad/ bu kye sang nas dkyil 'khore mchog /ces sogs nyal bar gdams shing rmi lam brtag pa spyi dang mthun te slob ma sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /nang par dngos gzhi'i skabs su/ bdag 'jug dang slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ lhag gtor gyis byed kyang legs pa'i skabs zhig yod mod/ 'on kyang bzlas pa'i gzhug gi bstod pa song ba'i mtshams der/ dang por bdag 'jug len par spro na 'di ltar bya ste/ de la sdoms ni/gsol btab dri lan lha la zhu/ /nang 'jag phyag 'tshal rgyun bshags bya/ /sdom —178—

bzung mig dar me tog gtad/ /dam bzhag ye shes dbab pa dang / /ltas brtag me tog 'bul ba dang / /mig dar bsal la me tog bcings/ /bltar bskul lha ngo de nyid bstan/ /gsol btab bgegs bskrad chu dbang dang //dbu rgyan rdo dril ming phyag mtshan/ /slob dpon dbang la gsol gdab dang / /slob ma lhar bskyed rdo dril gtad/ /chu dbang bskur la brtan bzhugs bya/ /rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan chos dus gtod/ /bka' yi gnang ba rjes gnang yin/ /gsang ba'i dbang la gsol gdab dang / /dbang bskur dngos dang lung bstan no/ /sher dbang gsol btab thog mar gdams/ /dri ba dri lan gdabs pa dang / /rig ma gtad de dbugs dbyung bya/ /bzhi pa la yang gsol btab dang //bdud rtsi sbyin nas brjod bral bsgom/ /de rjes dam tshig brtan par bya/ de ltar sdoms blo yul du nges par byas nas/ /dang po gsol btab ni/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam//slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi/ /rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer du/ /slob dpon gyi ni bdag gzhug gsol/ gnyis pa dri ba ni/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /'dod don gang yin khyod kyis smros/ gsum pa lan ni/ skal bzang bdag ni bde chen la'o/ /bdag ni gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rab tu 'jug par 'tshal lags so/ /bzhi pa lha la zhu ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyid/ lnga pa nang du 'jug pa ni/ o badzra gī li sogs dang ā kha bī ra sogs/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi dus skabs 'dir yol ba bsal/ drug pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ dus —179—

gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /bde gshe/gas rgyal ba 'khorwa ra bcas la/ /lus ngag yid gsum phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun 4nags kyi sngon du/ sdom pa sgrags pa byed par spro na/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/zhes pa nas/ ci nus bgyi/ zhes pa'i bar spyi dang mthun pa byed par bshad kyang / bsdu na nges par dgos pa'ang min pas/ bdag gi sdig pa zhes pa nas/ gnas su sgrol bar lha(gagi bar slob ma sta gon gyi bar bzhin/ bdun pa rgyun bshags dang / brgyad pa sdom bzung lan gsum bya/ dgu pa mig dar ni/ ā kha bī ra hū gis bcings/ bcu pa me tog kyang ā kha bī ra hu gis bzung / /bcu gcig pa dam la bldan pa ni/ rigs kyi bu khyod tshur nyon cig/de ring bde gshegs thams cad kyi/ /nang du khyod ni bzhugs pa yin/ /slob dpon lung bstan ngas kyang ni/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /ye shes khyod la bskyed par bya/ /rnal 'byor bu mchog khyod kyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dngos grub dam pa thob 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan rnams lta ci smos/ /dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba'i/ drung du smra bar ma byed cigaces dang / bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /de ring khyod kyi snying la zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ zhes dang / 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chus 'dis 'grub/ o badzra pañtsa a mṛ ta ha na ha na ḍa hū phaṭa/ ces dang / deng nas brtsams te thams cad du/ /rdo rje gzhon nu nga yin gyi/ /nga yis smras pa bu yis gyis/ /nga la brnyas par ma byed cig khyod kyis gal te brnyas na ni/ khyod ni sdug bsngal dang bcas te/ /tshe yi 'du byed btang —180—
