nas ni/ /sems can dmyal ba chen por lhung / bcu gnyis pa ye shes dbab pa ni/slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol/ /sems can kun la phan bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i 'khor bcas rnams/ /de ring bdag la dbab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ rang gi snying gar hu yig sngags kyi 'phreng ba dang bcas pa me 'od rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer ma mchis pa'i thugs ka nas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma lcags kyu thogs pa dpag tu med pa sprul zhing spros/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs/snying ga'i sa bon sngags bcas la thim/ sdig sgrib dag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ lus nang thams cad 'od kyis gang bar gyur/ 'bru go drug pa'i sngags kyi mthar/ o badzra a be sha ya a a a/ zhes lan brgya rtsa sogs brjod/ tiṣṭha badzra bcu gsum pa ltas brtag pa ni/ /las dang mthun pa'i nam mkha'i kha dog mthong / slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ nam mkha'i kha dog skabs 'dir 'bri/ bcu bzhi pa me tog bul ba ni/ o dri zhim me tog dam pa 'di/ /dkyil 'khor dam par dbul bar bgyi/o prati smo badzra ho/ bco lnga pa mig dar bsal ba ni/ sngon gyi mig mkhan rgyal po yis//'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ khyod kyi mi shes rab rib bsal/ o pra ba ra sha ya phaṭa/ bcu drug pa me tog bcings pas dbang bskur ba ni/ stobs dang ldan pa'i sems can khyod/ /me tog 'phreng bas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ā hū a bhi khiñtsa ma/ me tog spyi bor bcings/ bcu bdun pa blta —181—

bar bskul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khres rab rnam gsum rab tu skyed/ /khyod ni thugs kyi rigs su skye/ /bde bar gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /rigs drug sems can thams cad la/ /bu bzhin snying rje kun nas bskyed/ /gsang ba'i chos la dad par gyis/ bco brgyad pa lha ngo ni/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ rten gyi dkyil 'kho ra grub pa ni/ nam mkha'i khams su zhes pa nas/ gdan rnams su gyur/ zhes pa'i bar dang / bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po he ru ka nas/ gnyis med 'byud ces pa'i bar dang / khro bo bcu 'khor dang bcas par gyur pa nas/ dpag tu med pa dang bcas par grub par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar sa bon dang sngags rnams bor ba'i sgo nas lha ngo bo bstan/ skabs 'dir rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur zhes brjod/ bcu dgu pa de kho na nyid kyi bstan pa ni/dkyil 'khor gru bzhir gyur pa ni/ /tshad med bzhi rnams dag pa'i rtags/ /sgo bzhi dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ /gsal bar dag pa'i rtags yin no/ /rta babs yang dag sbong ba bzhi/ /rnam par dag pa'i rtags yin no/ /dra ba dra phyed 'phyang ba ni/ /nyon mongs nye nyon rnam dag pa'o/ /ka ba brgyad kyis dbus brgyan pa//'phags lam brgyad po rnam dag rtags/ /rin chen pha gu la sogs rgyan/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'o/ /rdo rje'i rwa bas bskor ba ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dag pa'i rtags/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad rnam dag pa'o/ khro bo chen po bcu rnams ni/ /mi dge bcu rnams dag pa ste/ /de rnams kun gyi yon tan gyi/ /chos rnams rnam dag yum rnams so/ /stobs bcu rnam —182—

dag khro bo dang / /dbang bcu rnam dag yum rnams te/ /stong nyid rnam dag phyag brnyan la/ /tshangs gnas dag pa'i sgo srung so/ /de ltar na dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa ni/dad pa'i sa tshogs kyis lam mo/ /nyi shu pa dbang dngos gzhi'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ma rdza phul la/ slob dpon dam pa dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i dbang bskur ba/ /sems can kun la phan gdags phyir/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang lha tshul cig lan gsum/ nyer gcig la bgegs bskrad pa ni/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs/ gu gul bdug /yungs kar gyis brabs/ /bden pa ngar dang bcas te bgegs skrod pa'i tshig brjod dgos la/ bdag 'jug gi skabs gī li bzlas shing rdo rje gsor ro/ nyer gnyis pa chu dbang ni/oX swa bhā wa bi shudha sarba dharmaXswa bhā wa bi shurnyo3 haX/ bdag dang dbang rdzas stong pa'i ngang las/ pad nyi la gnas pa'i huX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa las/ badzra he ru ka yab yum sku mdog mthing nag /rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi myos thams cad rdzogs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dzaX dzaXshuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba las ye shes bum pa'i chur gyur/ che ba'i yon tan kun rdzogs shing / /byang chub sems chus rab gang ba/ /rnam par dag pa'i bum pa 'dis/ de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /oX badzra asti titsā hūX/ arghaX pursha nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ nyer gsum pa cod pan gyi dbang ni/ gzhan rnams de dang 'dra ba las/padma dang nyi ma'i steng du snya las rin po che snyas mtshan pa las/ ratna he ru ka yab yum sku mdog ser po/ rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i cod pan du 'gyur gyi bar gong bzhi/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi —183—

rgyan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa dang / /dar dpyangs dag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ badzra mu ku ṭa ratna a bhi ṣañtsa tra/ gong bzhin mchod/ nyer bzhi pa rdo rje'i dbang ni/ snga ma gnyis la 'don pa bsgyur te/ a las padma as mtshan pa/ padma he ru ka yab yum sku mdog dmar po/ padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa: rdo rjer gyur/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ye shes byang chub sems yin te/ /gnyis med don gyi ngo bo 'dis/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ o badzra bodhi tsitta a bhi khiñtsa hu/ mchod/ nyer lnga pa dril bu'i dbang ni/ hā las rgya gram hwas mtshan pa las/ karma he ru ka yab yum sku mdog ljang khu/ /ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa: dril bur gyur/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /byang chub sgom phyir rang bzhin no/ khres rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gro ba/ /de ring khyod la 'dis dbang bskur/ o badzra a ti pa ti a bhi khiñtsa hū/ nyer drug pa ming gi dbang ni/o las 'khor lo o gyis mtshan pa/ bzhi he ru ka yab yum sku mdog dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa: rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ 'di ste sangs rgyas dngos yin te/ /rab tu bsngags pa gsang ba'i ming / /rdo rje che ge mo zhes pas//de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /o badzra satwa badzra na ma a bhi 'dzin hū/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi skabs gsang ming 'dogs te/ spyi dang mthun pa nyid legs shing / rnying ma ba rang lugs kyi rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal sogs rigs lnga dang mi 'gyur lhun grub/ mi ldog yang dag /dri med grub pa rnams la rtsal gyi mtha' can du byed pa sogs kyang 'dug cing / me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i mtshan rtags kyang legs pa yin no/ /mchod/ de ltar na dbang lnga bskur bas/ nyon mongs lnga ye shes —184—

lngar gyur/ phung po lnga rgyal ba lnga'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa yin no/ /nyer bdun pa phyag mawo gyi dbang ni/ bdag nyid badzra he ru ka rdo rje gzhon nu'i ngo bor gyur/ a las byung ba'i banta hu las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse dgu pa'o/ /shes rab padma'i snod kyi mchog /thabs mchog rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ /thabs dang shes rab phyag mtshan 'di//de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /o sarba ta thā ga ta pradzñā u pa ya/ sa ma a bhi khri3 mi hā/ spro na cod pan dang 'di'i bar la/ brten byed kyi chu dbang re yang bskur bar 'dug go / nyer brgyad pa slob dpon gyi dbang las don tshan thog ma gsol btab ni/ maṇḍal phul nas/ slob dpon dam pa dgongs su gsol/ /sems can kun la phan btags phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid/ /de ring bdag la lung bstan stso'i// lan gsum/ don tshan gnyis pa lhar bskyed pa ni/ dbang stegs kyi steng du rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ steng du gdugs dkar po/ mtha' skor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po dang bcas pa'o/ /don tshan gsum pa rdor dril gtad pa ni/ hū las byung ba'i rdo rje dang / a las byung ba'i dril bu/ thabs mchog ye shes rdo rje dang / khres rab chos kyi dril bu gzung / /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs/ dam tshig gsum po rab tu brtan/ don tshan bzhi pa chu dbang bskur ba ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po sa /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /o badzra ki li gī la ya sarba ne ba hu phaṭa/ badzra a bhi khri nyu rkahū/ don tshan lnga pa brtan bzhugs ni/ pukhre/ la sogs pas mchod/ me tog gtor zhing —185—

rol rṣa dang bcas pas/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ de rnams slob dpon gyi dbang ngo / /nyer dgu pa rjes gnang la/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi rjes gnang ni/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ de bzhi du rdo rje rin wo/ padma/ ral gri rnams la gong bzhin sbyar dung gtad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ tshig snga ma gsum 'dra ba las/ khyod kyi chos kyi dung bus shig /bka'i gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ slob ma dam pa khyod kyis kyang / /ji ltar 'dul ba'i 'phrin las kyang / /slob dpon las rnams ci rigs par/ /de ring phan chad sgrub par gyis/ de ltar na bum pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ mos pa'i spyod pa'i sa sbyor ba'i lam mo/ /sum cu pa gsang dbang la maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/slob dpon dam pa bde gshegs gtso/ /rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang gsum dam pa'i dbang mchog 'di/ /de ring bdag las gnang bar gsol/ gsang dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu dpa' bo gcig pa'i skur gyur/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bcom ldan 'das yab yum thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i tshogs bde ba chen po'i nyams bskyed/ thugs ka'i hū gi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i bde bar gshe/gas pa rnams zhal du zhugs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bha wa atpa ko3ha/ /thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag byang chub sems kyi rdo rje 'di/ /sems kyi rnam rtog mun bcom nas/ /gsang ba'i gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /de ring khyod la dbab par bya/ bdud rtsi myangs/ de ring sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bdag ni —186—

bsod nams skal pa che/ /dpal ldan yon tan kun gyi rgyan/ /rdo rje gzhon nu bdag nyid do/ (/lung bstan pa ni byed tshul spyi dang 'dra ba las/ tshig 'di skad ces/ ji ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod bton/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bha ba su/zhes pa'o/ /de ltar na gsang pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ don dam pa'i sems dang po bskyed pa mthong ba'i lam mo/ /so gcig pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la maṇḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ji ltar mkhyen pa'i thugs chud pa/ /de ltar rjes su bdag la ni/ khres rab ye shes dbang bskur stsole/ thog mar gdams pa ni/sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang / khres rab ma la brten pas 'grub/ /ye shes skye ba'i gzhi yin phyir/ khyod kyis 'dod chags ma sdangs shig dri ba dri lan ni/ bu khyod tshur shog rdo rje can/ /gzhi mnyam gla rtsi spyod nus sam/ /rakta ga bur bza' ba dang / /bud med dad pas bsten nus sam/ /padma ra 'o byed mi rtog gam/ /smros shig snod ldan ngang tshul can/ lan ni/shes rab dad pas bdag bsten to/ /bdud rtsi lnga la gus par bgyid/ /bde ba sgrub par gdab pa ni/ smad byung nga yi padma ni/ /bde ba thams cad 'di las rnyed/ /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kun/ /rtag tu 'di dang mi 'bral te/ /padma 'di ni chos dbyings yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'di las 'byung / /sems can thams cad 'di ru grol/ /nang gi rtsa yi 'khor lo la/ /padma zhes byar rab tu gsungs/ /padma —187—

nang gi nam mkha' zhes/ /'byung ba lnga po rang bzhin gnas/ /lte ba dang ni ge sar bcas/ /padma brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /ze'u 'bru dbus nas 'byung ba yin/ /de nyid bdud rtsi dam pa ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po'o/ /zhes gdams pa thob/ shes rab dam pa 'di yis ni/ khyod kyi ye shes skyed byed pas/ dad pas rab tu bsten par gyis/ zhes slob dpon gyis bdag la shes rab yang dag par gtad/ tha mal gyi rtog pa spangs nas lha dang sngags dang chos kyi thabs mkhas su bsgyur nas/ rjes chags snyoms 'jug bde ba chen po la brten nas/ zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa mngon du byas/ dbugs dbyung ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ngo bo nyid du khyod gyur to/ khams gsum bdag por khyod gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' khyod gyur to/ /bdud dang mu stegs thams cad las/ /rgyal bar gyur ba khyod yin no/ /grong khyer las kyang grong khyer te/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer du/ /blo ldan snod can khyod bzhugs pas/ /sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rgyu 'di yin/de ltar na shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sa dgu'i bdag nyid sgom pa'i lam mo so gnyis pa dbang bzhi pa las/ gsol btab ni/ khyod zhabs padma'i bka' drin gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi byang chub sems/ /don chen zab mos nyon mongs 'joms /de ring bdag la gnang bar lu lan gsum/ rgyu'i mthar phyin pa bdud rtsi sbyin pa ni/ rang nyid he ru ka yab yum rjes su chags pa'i snyoms par zhugs pa'i/ byang chub kyi sems dbang gi gnas su phyin pa'i ye shes dper mtshon par byas/ oṃ mahā bo dhi tsitta a bhi khiñtsa hu/ byang chub kyi sems mkha'i dkyil 'khor las ro 'dzin gyi blang ste rmyangs pa'i nyams myong la mnyam par bzhag 'bras bu mthar phyin brjod bral sgom pa ni/ 'di ltar —188—

mtha' yas snang ba kun/ /skad cig gcig la dmigs med de/ /brjod pa'i tha snyad kun dang bral/ /rang byung ye shes zhes byar brjod/ /de ltar na bzhi pa'i dbang bskur ba ni/ mthar phyin mi slob pa'i lam mo/ /so gsum pa dam tshig sgrags pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon mched lcam la/ /sgo gsum sgo nas gnod pa byed/ /sku yi dam tshig nyams par 'gyur/ /de las ldog te phan par bya/ /sngags dang snying po bar chad cing / /gsang ba bsrung par ma nus pa/ /gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa yin/ /phyag rgya bzhi gsal de las bzlog /gsang bcu la sogs gnyer gtad pa/ /snod min pa la gsang ma thub/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa ste/ /de las bzlog te gsang ba bsrung / /sbyor sgrol ma spyin len dang rdzun du smra/ /tshig rlangs la sogs dam tshig lnga rnams ni/ /'gro ba'i don du gzhung bzhin spyad par bgyi/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal dang / /phrag dog la sogs nyon mongs lnga rnams ni/ /ye shes ngo bo nyid kyi spang mi bya/ /dri chen dri chu dmar chen zil pa dang / /mdangs chen la sogs dam rdzas lnga rnams ni/ /gnyis med tshul gyis dang du blang bar bya/ /phung po lnga dang 'byung ba chen po lnga/ kha dog lnga dang yul lnga dbang po lnga/ /rnam shes lnga dang yul lnga ye shes lnga/ /yab lnga yum lnga sbyor zhing shes par bya/ /rdo rje rigs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /rin chen rigs dang bde bzhin padma'i rigs/ /las kyi rigs te rgyal ba rigs lnga po/ /le lo spangs te ting 'dzin grub par bya/ skabs 'dir dam tshig nyi shu rtsa brgyad po de tsam zhig bstan no/ /rjes kyi bya ba ni/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs maṇḍal 'bul ba dang / deng nas brtsams te sogs dang / dge ba bsngo ba rnams bya'o/ /slob ma la dbang bskur pa'i dngos —189—

dregs pa kun 'dul zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu ru ha ya kṛ bā ya/ /nyin byed 'bum gyi snang ba las lhag cing / /dus mtha'i 'bar byed kyis kyang mi dpogs pa'i/ /rab dmar 'jigs byed chen po'i skur ston pa'i/ /rta mgrin khro bo'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nyid mchod pa'i cho ga yan lag bcas/ /ma tshang med pa gsal bar brjod 'dod kyi/ /yi dam srung ma gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rje btsun bla ma mgon bcas 'dir byin rlobs/ /'phrin las kun gyi 'dod 'jo zhing / /dregs ldan ma lus 'dul ba dang / khams gsum dbang phyug cher 'gyur zhing / /bdud rnams nyams par byed pa'o/ /'dir dben pa'i gnas su 'di nyid kyi bris sku bkram/ bla bre la sogs pa'i mdzes par byas/ bris sku'i mdun du stegs bu la rten gtor rtsa ba zlum po/ rtse mo gru gsum smug rtsis kha bsgyur ba/ rtse mor rta mgos mtshon pa dang / stegs bu gzhan la gtor ma/mchod pa sman rag phud sogs legs par bshams la/ gnyis pa cho ga la sdom ni/ skyabs sems sngon 'gro gtor ma dang // mtshams gcod rgyal chen gtor ma dang / /tshogs gsog tshad med thugs bskul dang / /bdag bskyed bzlas pa rdzas byin rlabs/ /snod bskyed spyan 'dren phyag 'tshal dang / /bzhugs gsol mchod sman rakta dang / /bskang gso bstod pa bshags pa dang / /gtor ma tshogs 'khor rjes chog go /ngag 'don ni/༈ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la skyabs —191—

su mchi/ /zhi ba chos dbyings bsam mi khyab/ /dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi// 4theg gsum 'phags pa phyir mi ldog /dge bdun la yang skyabs su mchi/ lan gsum/ deng nas bla med byang chub thos kyi bar/ /bla med byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing / /byang chub spyod pa thams cad rab spyod la/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas mchog thob shog /lan gsum/ snying pos bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las raX yaX khaX/ raX gyi mes bsregs yaX gyis gtor/ khaX gyis bkrus shing dag par gyur/ oX las rin chen 'bar ba'i snod/ /zab cing rgya che hūX yig las/ /gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āXhūX ha ho khyoX lan bdun/ oX sarba bhu te spyo na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sbyo sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren rnams/ /nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /gtor ma rgya chen 'di longs la/ /ma 'tshe bar ni gzhan du dengs/ de nas bden brdar ci rigs pa brjod la/ drag sngags dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad par bya'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas rdo rje 'khor lo be con ral gri rgya gram la sogs pa mtshon cha me dpung 'bar ba'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ g.yas skor du lan gsum du bskor bas/ gnod byed thams cad thal bar brlag par byas nas rim pa bzhin du/ rdo rje 'khor lo be con ral gri rgya gram rnams kyis sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla bre me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas par 'gyur/ steng yang rdo rje'i bla bre la/ /'og kyang rdo rje sa gzhi ste/ /phyogs mtshams rdo rje 'bar bas gtams/ /rdo rje'i mtshams las ma 'da' shig oX badzra rakṣa tsakra hūX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ steng yang 'khor lo'i: 'og kyang 'khor lo'i: phyogs mtshams 'khor —192—

lo'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig lko tsakra rakṣa hu hā phaṭa swāhā/ steng yang be con:'og kyang be con phyogs mtshams be con: be con mtshams las: o ḍa ṇḍa:steng yang ral gri'i 'og kyang ral gri'i phyogs mtshams ral gri ral gri'i mtshams las lko khad gangu steng yang rgya gram: 'og kyang rgya gram: phyogs mtshams rgya gram: rgya gram mtshams las o nan badzra: hu dpal chen mi zad dkyil 'khor nas/ /'bar ba'i khro bo med dpung 'bar/ /gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams/ /bgegs dang log 'dren rdul du rlogs/ /dbang chen me dpung dmar nag 'bar/ /bskal pa dus mtha'i me lta bu/ /dbang drag mtsho ni cha brag ltar gtams/ /gang la bab kyang gcod cing sgrol/ /dbang chen khro mo mi zad rngam/ srid pa'i ye shes khro bo 'khrigs/ /dbang chen mtshams las gang 'da' ba/ /rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya'o/ /o ra kro dha rakṣa badzra dzwa la rakṣa rakṣa dzwa la ra hu/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma badzra yaktas bsangs/ rdo rje ma'i sngags rgyas bsregs/ rdo rje bsdams ba'i phyag rgya/ a kā ro'i/ sngags dang bcas pa'i byin gyis brlabs/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa tse( badzra sa mā dza tse( rnyi ta raṇḍa ya/ bhe ru lha kā ya/ bhe ru pakṣa ya/ bee shra ba na ya/sa pā ri wā ra argha pā ju/ o rnyi ṭa ra ni sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sbyo sogs gsum gyis phul/ oṃ rnyi ṭa sogs sngon du 'gro bas/ pu po nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs pi wang 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /yul 'khor bsrung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ /—193—

grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ded dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod spyin tshogs la dbang bsgrur ba'i/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ khar phyogs na ni yul 'khor bsrung / /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /nub phyog na ni spyan mi bzang / /byang phyogs na ni rnam thos sras/ /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan pa/ /sde bo che la stobs po che/ kha dog ldan zhing gzi brjid che/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di long las/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzad de/ /bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma dang dpal padma dbang chen gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa ma dza o ha ya gro ba sa pa ri wā ra argha: nas shabha'i bar gyi mchod/ ye shes ha ya kṛ ba rta mchog dpal/ /chags med sku ni nub ka'i dmar mtha' ltar/ /'bar ba'i sku la ral pa gyen du brdzes/ /ma rig tshangs pa kha bub gnon pa'i lha/ /padma rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /dza ྅ ba ho rnying ma ba spyi la bdag mdun dbyer med du byed pa mang na'ang / 'di la nges pas so sor mdzad pa la bar 'dir bdag skyed mngon rtogs ji lta ba bzhin bsgoms la/ bzlas pa ci 'grub bya'o/ /hu a la la ho —194—

bha ga wān sa ma ya ho/ 'phags mchog thugs rjes dub la bab/ khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal 'byung ba'i dus la bab/ dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus la bab/ /dam tshig bskang ba'i dus la bab/ /mthu chen mthu stobs rtsol cig bcom ldan 'das/ /dbang chen dbang bskur: byin chen byin wos phob cig dngos grub mchog rnams rtsol cig: bdag gi las 'di'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ oX badzra aX ku sha dzā dzā/mchod rdzas kyi dri ma rnams raX gyi mes bsregs/ āXyis spel/ hūX yig rnams las byung ba'i mchod yon ma dkar mo/ me tog ma ser mo bdug spos ma dkar mo/ /mar me ma dmar skya/ dri rbang ma ljang khu rol mo ma kha dog sna tshogs pa rnams dang / gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rdo rje ma rnams dkar sngo ser dmar ljang ba mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa thogs pa rnams kyis sa dang bar snang thams cad gang bar gyur/ oX a ha ra a ha ra hūX/ lan gsum/ oX badzra arghaX āXhuX nas shasta'i bar rol mo'i sgra bya/ oX a ru pa badzra ṇi huX/ sha lta ga rnye ra sa spa ra she badzre ṇi huX nang mchod gtor ma rakta rnams/ stong pa'i ngang las raX yaX khaX gis dri ma sbyangs/ yaX las rlung / raX las me kaX las mi mgo'i sgyid pu gsum/ a las thod pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams bzhu zhing bskol/ slangs pa hūX oX swāhā ā rnams su gyur pa las byung ba'i he ru ka rigs lnga yum dang bcas par gyur/ sa ma ya stuX/ rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ oX āXhūX/ 'khor 'das kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bkug /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/ oX āXhuX sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūX hri ṭha/ oX āXhūX/ te dzwa ba ling ta ba la ba te gu phya sirnyi —195—

sa ma ya hūX hru ṭha/ a las thod pa'i nang du raX las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oX āXhūX mahā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūX hri ṭha/ mdun bskyed kyi rten rnams snying pos bsangs/ swabha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung sngo/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ raX las me'i dkyil 'khor/ khaX las rakta'i rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'khrugs/ suX las maX sa'i sa gzhi rgya che ba/ kaX las keng rus brtsegs pa'i ri rab steng / gaX las drag po 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /dmar nag gru gsum thod rus 'a / bar las grub/ /phyi rol dur khrod rin chen gzhal yas khang / /dbus su pad zla nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan/ /ye shes las grub dkyil 'khor 'khor lor gyur/ de hriXyig las mngon rtogs bdag bskyed ltar bskyed la/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min nas padma dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs lkoX badzra sa mā dza/ huX chos kyi dbyings las 'khor bcas skur bzhengs shig /dbang chen khros pa'i rgyal po skur bzhengs shig /ma chags padma 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas/ /rta mchog rol ba'i khro bo gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes rnam dag sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor nas/ khro rgyan yab yum mkha' 'gro'i chogs bcas bshegs/ /sna tshogs 'phrin las bya ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /bran dang pho nya'i tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol/ mahā sa ma ya dzaX sa ma ya stuX/ hiX rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku padma'i gsung / /chos rje 'od dpag med dang rdo rje chos/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang hiXlas rngam mchen sku/ /rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sprul pa yang sprul khro bo khro mo dang / /rig lnga yab yum sems dpa' sems mar bcas//—196—

pho nya bran dang phra men sngags pa'i tshogs/ /'khore dang bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu ho/ pra ti dza ho/ hu dam tshig dbang gis dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ /ye shes dbang chen 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /pho brang gsang pa'i dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /mi g.yo dges shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ dza : ba ho sa ma ya stu/ me tog bdug spos snang gsal sgra/ zhal zas dri chab gtsang ma 'di/ /padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor la/ /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /o padme shwa ra ha ya kṛ ba sa pā ri wā ra argha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ya skyo/ de bzhin du sha lta'i bar du bya'o/ /gzugs kyi lha mo sku mdog dkar/ /phyag na mdzes sdug longs spyod bsnams/ /dbang chen lha yi spyan la 'bul/ /gzugs kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /a la la ste bzhes su gsol/ /sgra yi lha mo sku mdog sngo/ /phyag na mdzes sdug sgra brnyan: dbang chen lha yi snyan la: sgra yis mchod pa dam pa: a la la ste: dri yi lha mo sku mdog ser/ phyag na dri'i dung chos: dbang chen lha yi shangs la: dri mchog mchod pa: a la la ste: ro yi lha mo sku mdog dmar/ /phyag na zhal zas ro mchog dbang chen lha yi ljags la: ro yi mchod pa: a la la ste:reg bya'i lha mo sku mdog ljang / /phyag na na bza' sna tshogs: dbang chen lha yi sku la: reg bya'i mchod pa dam a la la ste bzhes su gsol/ o rū pa sha lta ga rnye ra sa spar she de bi pū dza ā hu/ hū rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rig lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud drug sgrib pa kun sgrol phyir/ /dug lnga sel ba'i —197—

bdud rtsi 'di/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen la/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /bla med 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsole/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza kha ra khya hi/ /snga rabs 'das pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang / /da ltar bzhugs pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang / /rgyal ba dgongs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /rig 'dzin brda las brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /a mi de ba lo ke shā ra dang / /rta mgrin padma 'byung gnas dbon ston sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod par 'bul/ /thugs rjes dgongs la dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /'chi med bdud rtsi ra sa ya na yi/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /padma dbang chen 'khor bcas la/ /bdag nyid dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas kun tu dges par mdzode/ 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha ra ji hi/ slar yang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis mtshan gyi mthar 'di zhes bya ba'i bla ma'i zhal du 'bul lo/ /tse( ā hu/ bteg la mtheb srin gyi spyi bo'i thad nas nang mchod 'bul/ snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la snying gi thad nas nang mchod 'bul/ /chos skyong sngags la 'bru gsum btags la lte ba'i thad nas nang mchod 'bul/hū ye shes khro bo dbang chen gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub mchog/rnal 'byor lus ngag yid la thim/ /gnyis med gyur nas brtan par bya/ kā ya sirnyi lko/ lha ka sdodhi ā tsitta sirnyi hū/ zhes dngos grub blangs/ rnam dag rang byung lhun grub sman mchog 'di/ /rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor bcas la/ /—198—

gus pas mchod pa 'bul lo kha raX 'a hi/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oX mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raX sku hi/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /padma la ni rdo rje zhugs/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa'i mchod pas bgyi/ /padma su kha bo dhi tsitta swāhā/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dgra bgegs ma lus pa bkug tshar bcad de gtor ma dang rakta la thim/ sprul pa'i khro tshogs 'bar ba yis/ /zhing bcu ma lus thams cad dang / /'bor ba nyon mongs rgya dral nas/ /dug lnga dbyings su bsgral bar bya/ /sarba sha truX mā ra ya phaṭa/ /zhing gyur thams cad dbyings su sgrol/ sha khrag srog dbugs mchod pa 'di/ /rta mgrin rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor la/ /'bul gyis yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /khyad par 'dod yon mchod pa'i mchog kha khrag keng rus rgya mtsho yis/ /gtor ma'i mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /rta mgrin 'khor bcas mnyes gyur cig /mahā maX sa ji hi/ /mahā rakta 'a hi/ /mahā tsitta khwa hi/ /kaX ni ri te hūX/ rakta gtor ma'i khar bsgrengs/ slar yang mchod pa dang gtor ma gsos snying pos bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/huX yig las byung ba'i mchod rdzas dang thun rdzas nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bas/ khro rgyal rta mgrin 'khor bcas kyi spyan lam du 'byung bar 'gyur cig na maXsarba ta thā ga ta smyoX nas/ ga ga na khaX swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ hūX mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang / /mar me dri chab zhal zas dang / / sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /rta mgrin 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /yid sprul mchod pa dpag med dang / /mngon bshams sngags dang —199—

phyag rgya dang / /ting 'dzin mchog gis byin rlabs nas/ /'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig /sangs rgyas dam tshig lcags kyu lnga/ /rig ma'i dam tshig bdud rtsi lnga/ /nang gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang //ye shes bskyed phyir bzhes su gsol/ /thabs shes dbyer med rig ma'i tshogs/ /phyogs kun khyab par rnam sprul te/ /gsang sngags lha la mchod par 'bul/ /dgyes pa chen po thugs rang byung mngon shes bsgrub pa'i phyir/ dbang lnga'i pu spyo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar sdud pa'i phyir/ /tshil chen dhu pes: ma rig mun pa sel ba'i phyir/ /zhu chen dī pes: shugs 'gro'i tshogs rnams sdud pa'i phyir/ /mkhris chen ga rnyesajogasang sngags lha rnams mthu bskyed phyir/ /ma sa gtor ma'i: dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba yi/ /g.yang gzhi bla re 'phan gdugs dang / /rgyu rlon lda ldi bar snang brgyan/ /dam nyams skra yi rnga yab g.yob/ /dur khrod chas brgyad sku la gsol/ /mahā rakta'i argha bsgrengs/ /keng rus phub pa'i gzhal yas khang /khrag zhag rgya mtsho'i klong dkyil du/ /mi bzad dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor/ /rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun sogs/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i thugs bris sku la sogs phyi yi rten/ /bskyed rim rnal 'byor nang gi rten/ /thig le nyag cig gsang ba'i rten/ /rta mgrin rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang / /'khor bcas dgyes shing tshims mdzad la/ /nyams chags bskang zhing dngos grub stsol/ /phyi nang bar chad kun sel zhing / /'dod don thams cad 'grub par mdzod/ /hū gzhan yang dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ khang bzang rnam pa sna tshogs dang //'bras bu gsum ro bcu dang sman /dkar gsum la sogs bdud rtsi'i zas/ /200—

sbrang rtsi'i la sogs ro zhim mchog /lha rdzas na bza' rnam mang po/ /rin chen cod paṇa do shal sogs/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang chas bkod bcas/ /'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur cig/bskang ngo bskal ba'i thugs dam bskang / /bsgrub bya dbang du sdus pa'i phyir/ /lcags kyu zhags pas thugs dam bskang / /dgra bgegs rdul bzhin brlag pa'i phyir/ /gri khug ral gri rtse gsum dang / /tho ba dgra sta mdung thung sogs/ /sna tshogs mtshan chas gnod byed dug gis myos pa'i phyir/ /sbrul chen brgyad kyis: thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje cang te'u thod pa dang / /sgra snyan dril bu'i: chos kyi dbyings las bskul ba'i phyir/ /rig sngags gsungs gi bzlas brjod dang / /sil snyan rnga zlum rnga bo che/ /pi wang gling bu la sogs pa/ /rol mo glu dbyangs bstod par bcas/ /'bul gyis kun tu dges par mdzod/ /drag po'i las la bskul ba'i phyir/don snying sna lnga'i 'phrin las thams cad bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sna tshogs srog chags spyan sngar 'bul/ /nor bu'i gzhal med khang pa dang / /dar gyi bla bre 'phan gdugs dang / /rin chen gdan khri pad nyi zla/ /sgeg mo la sogs lha mo brgyad/ /dpal be la sogs bkra shis brgyad/ /me long la sogs rdzas mchog brgyad/ /ral gri la sogs dngos grub brgyad/ /mdor na longs spyod thams cad dang / /gling bzhi ri rab 'jig rten gsum/ /nam mkha' gang bar rnam sprul te/ /padma dbang gi thugs dam bskangs/ /rta mgrin rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang / khro chen yab yum: pho nya bran gyi: sprul pa yang sprul las byed dregs pa'i: dge legs spel phyir bzhes su gsol/ /mgyogs 'gro'i dam tshig yin —201—

pa'i phyir/ /bdud rtsi'i sman gyis: khro bo pho nyar 'gyed pa'i phyir/ /dmar wo gtor mas: sprul pa las la bskul ba'i phyir/ kha chang phud kyis: dam tshig gnyan po gso ba'i phyir/ /tshogs kyi 'khor: mahā rakta'i mchod yon 'di/ /dbang phyug nyer brgyad srog chags nor sna sna tshogs 'di/ skyes bu gying gi go mtshon sna tshogs bdar ba 'di/ /srog bdag dmar po'i: bdud bshos gos nag la sogs pas/ /bdud rgyal nag po'i: gsang rten rnam pa sna tshogs pas//rdo rje ma mo'i thugs dam bskang / /'khor bcas thugs dam skong gyur nas/ /bar chad sel zhing 'dod don sgrubs/hū ha ya kṛ ba'i dus la bab/ khro rgyal yab yum dus la bab/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan/ /rta mchog rol ba'i bka' rtags 'chang / /dkyil 'khor lha ni ye shes sku/ /bsrung ma las mkhan mthu rtsal che/ /do nub khyed la mchod pa 'bul/ /dam tshig 'phrin las sgrub tu gsol/ /bdag cag rgyu sbyor la sogs pa'i/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang / /bsrung zhing bzlog par mdzad du gsol/ /tshe ring longs spyod 'phel ba dang / /dbang thang 'phrin las kun rgyas shing / /mi nor zas sogs 'phel bar mdzod/ /rgyal po rgyal phran blon po dang //yul mi gtso bo dbang du bsdus/ /sde brgyad dregs can bran du 'khol/ /bsgrub bya dbang byas 'gugs par mdzode/ /sdang ba'i dgra bgegs ma lus pa/ /skad cig tsam gyis thal bar rlogs/ /ma dang smra ba'i dug can rnams/ /rnam shes ye shes mkha' sbyor che/ /ye shes chen po mi shigs pas/ /lus ngan de dag bor du chug /ye shes dag la sa mā dza/ /drag po'i pho nya da spros shig /mkha' dbyings —202—

mi zad khro bos khyab/ /dug gi na bun sprin ltar gtings/ /mtsho ni cha 'khrul 'khor char ltar phob/ /rdo rje tho bas mgo bo chom/ /rdo rje dbyug pas rkang lag chog /rdo rje mda' gzhus snying la phug /rdo rje ral gris lus kun gtubs/ /sprul pa'i pho nya thams cad kyis/ /dam nyams dgra bo che ge mo'i/ /gnam gyi 'ju thag skya bo chod/ /sa yi rten phur nag po phyung / /las kyi rlu pa gi rgyab nas phul/ /'jigs pa'i mun pas mdun nas bsus/ khong pa'i nang nas snying thon cig /dbang po lnga dang don snying lnga/ /da lta thon la lus sems khrol/ /sde brgyad dmag dpung sprin ltar gtibs//phyogs kun srin po khros pa dang / /ma mo gshin rje khros pas khyab/ /wa dang bya rog bya rgod dang / /bya gcan gdug pas gang ba rnams/ kha cig sha za khrag 'thung zhing / /la la dras pa lha ba 'jib/ /rgyu ma nang khrol 'ded pa dang / /lhu tshigs rus pa 'thor bar mdzod/ /rnam shes mar me ltar bsad nas/ /mtsho ni char sa mun sros byed pas/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlogs/ /rnam shes dbyings su spor du gsol/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khe7ra bcas kyi/ /nad kha khram kha dgra la bsgrur/ /chags che nyam nga dgra la bsgrur/ /gnod byed bar chad mi mthun pa/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la rtso/ /thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la sbyo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang / /sems can bde skyid 'phel bar mjodi/ /bar 'dir bstod pa che chung gsar rnying rnams ci rigs pas bstod cing dbyangs su gyer bar bya'o/ /hu padma dbang chen dkyil 'khor dam pa nas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha tshogs bcas/ /mnyam nyid bzang ngan rtog dang bral na yang / /—203—

yud tsam bdag gi tshig la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni mi shes rmongs shing le lo che/ /sgom sgrub mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba dang / /dam rdzas ma tshang mchod gtor g.yel ba dang / /rgyu chung phud nyams mchod rdzas 'bags pa dang //cho ga 'khrul dang gsang ba g.yel ba sogs/ /dam tshig 'gal 'khrul thams cad so sor bshags/ /thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad bzod par gsol/ /chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid du dag gyur pas/ /bdag cag bla med bde chen thob par shog /de nas gtor chog ltar gtor ma phul la/ bar 'di myur mdzad mgon po la sogs pa'i chos skyong gang byed kyi gtor ma yang bya'o/ /de nas tshogs kyi mchod pa bya ste/ snga 'gyur rang snang la grags pa'i cho ga rim pa gsum la sogs pa ni 'dir nges par dgos pa ma yin pas/ mdo tsam gzhan dang mthun pa'i 'di ltar spel bar bya ste/ tshogs rdzas rnams sman phud byin rlabs kyi skabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/hū e yig bde chen klong yangs su/ /wa yig rdo rje rtag 'char ba/ /gsung mchog rdo rje 'od dpag med/ /mtha' yas sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas/ khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir/ /byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol/ /gnas khang 'di la byin phob la/ /tshogs rdzas 'di la bcud cig chug/'dir 'dul rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol//'gro la thugs rjes chen po yis/ /rang snang ri bo ta la nas/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /lha klu gnod spyin tshogs kyis bskor/ khyed kyi rjes sungubyin gyi rlabs: gnas khang je tshogs rdzas 'di la 'dir 'dus rnal 'byorangumachog dang thun mong : lho nub rnga yab srin po'i gling / /padma 'od kyi gzhal yas —204—

su/ /slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la/ /'khor du rma kha' 'gro mang pos bskor/khyed kyi: byin gyis brlabs: gnas khang : tshogs rdzas5 'dir 'dus:mchog dang bye gangs can sa yi thig le mchog /skye sgang snying rje'i pho brang nas/ /dbon ston dharmā seng ha ni/ /skal ldan dag pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ khyod kyi:byin gyis: gnas khang : tshogs rdzas: 'dir 'dus bye mchog dang zo phyogs bcu dag pa'i zhing khams nas/ /byin rlabs thugs rjes ldan pa yi/ /drin can brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams/ /rig 'dzin du ma'i 'khor dang bcas/ khyod 'a kyatsha byin gyis brlabs: gnas khang : tshogs rdzas: 'dir 'dus5 mchog dang : rang snang dag pa'i gzhal yas khang / /gar bzhugs da(ga min gnas mchorwa ga nas/ /kun bzang rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs dang bcas/ khyod kyi:byin gyis: gnas khang : tshogs rdzas: 'dir 'dus: mchog dang : sde brgyad bran du 'khol ba'i zhing / /dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa yang / /yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor/ khyed kyi: byin gyis:gnas khang : tshogs rdzas: 'dir 'dus mchog dang : he ru ka yis byin brlabs pa/ /sum bcu rtsa gnyis gnas mchog nas/ /bgrang yas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /sprul pa nyid sprul tshogs dang bcas/ khyed kyis: byin gyis brlabs: gnas khang : tshogs rdzas 'dir 'dus mchog: gdug can dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i zhing / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po ni/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas/ /khyed kyi rjes su bdag slob kyi/ /byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol/ /bla ma yid dam —205—

mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rigs kyi cod pan sdem se sdem/ /dar gyi cod pan pu ru sa /rgyan cha mang po khra la la/ /rol mo mang po di ri ri/ /glu len gar byed khyug se khyug /'khor tshogs 'bum sde sha ra ra/ /sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne ne/ /gtad med rig pa gsal la la/ /brjod med dbyings su thal la la/ /bde ba chen por khril li li/ /byin gyis rlobs phyir gshegs su gsol/ /gnas khang 'di la byi phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dngos grub stsol/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ /'khor gsum gnyis su med par 'dres/ tshogs kyi spyi phud phul la/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa ā li kā li'i ngo bo rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di/byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du ga na tsakra pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza kha kha ji hi ji hi/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du kha kha khya hi sku hi/ 'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong bsrung ma rnams kyi zhal du kha kha ji hi 'a hi/ dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched grogs rdo rje sbun grogs rnams kyi zhal du kha kha 'a hi ji hi/ de nas snying po'i mthar gtor sngags btags la/ yi dam la lan gsum phul/ chos skyong gi gtor sngags la kha kha btags la phul/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor yang 'bul/ las kyis rdo rjes/ gzigs shig mdzes pa dam pa'i chos/ /'di la the tshom bya mi drang / /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa gsum/ /rang bzhin gcig tu lhan cig rol/ wo so sor drangs so/ /so sos kyang / rin thang med chos legs par 'ongs/ /'dod chags kyi ni dri ma spangs/ /blang dang blang min las grol ba/ /'di nyid phul ba ngo mtshar che/—206—

zhes blangs/ thams cad kyis phud spyi 'bungs su bsdus nas/ o dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing / /rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa bzhes/ /sgrib pa'i dri ma kun sel zhing / /rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bde ba chen por mnyes gyur cig /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg byas khyad par mchis pa rnams/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'bul/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /gzugs dang sgra dang : reg bya'i khyad par: yi dam lha tshogs mchog dang thun mong ngu gzugs dang sgra dang : reg bya'i khyad parajebastan bsrung rgya mtsho'i tshogs dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ reg bya'i gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul/ /phyi nang bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg bya'i khyad par mchis pa rnams/ dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la 'bul /bsam pa 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mjodi/ a kā ro/ lan gsum gyis phul/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas tshims par za'o/ /hu sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs pa/ /'od zer sna lnga'i dra bas mdzes/ /seng ge 'phrog byed tshangs dbang gtso/ /thugs brtser mdzod cig te na hū/ de na hu de na te te hū/ zhes klu blangs/ lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis de bzhin gshe/gas pa lnga bsregs te/ /spyan la sogs pa yang bsregs te/ /bsregs pa'i ro bong can ha 'dzag /ces bde ba bsgom/ de3sa tshogs lhag bsdus la/bsangs sbyangs/ o ā hu ha ho hi ma mo nag mo dud pa'i sol ba mo lhag sdud kyi rdo —207— —

rje pho nya mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad lhag ma'i dam tshig gi gnas su badzra sa mā dza oṃ ma ga ri ye sa pā ri wā ra argha: nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ hū ma ga ri ye sa pā ri wā ra khyu a kā ro: sogs lan bdun gyis phul/ ma mo nag mo dud pa'i sol ba mo/ lhag sdud kyi rdo rje pho nya mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams/lhag ma'i gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la bdag cag rnams kyi 'phrin las thogs pa med par bsgrub shig /phyi rol sgo drug na gnas pa'i 'byung po 'cho le ba'i tshogs dam tshig gi cho ga la blta bar mi dbang pa rnams la sbyin no/ /rdo rje theg pa la gsang ba mchog gi sgor spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ ba ling ta kha kha ji hi 'a hi/ u tsi gi bhakṣa si swāhā/ snying po bzlas shing lhag gtor phyir rol du dor/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs dang/ yi dam gyi bstod pa mdor bsdus tsam gyis bstod nas/ slob dpon dang dpal khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol ba'i lha tshogs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mongs kyis dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po byung / rang gi dpral bar thim/ mgrin pa nas dmar po dang/ thugs ka nas sngon po dang / gnas gsum char nas dkar dmar mthing gsum byung / rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ dbang bzhi thob par bsam zhing / snga 'gyur kyi cho ga gzha dang 'brel ba slob dpon padma'i bka' bsrung dam can/ spyi sgos rnams kyi gtor ma dang / khyad par bstan skyong bya bar 'dod na skabs 'dir bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pa mang du bzlas/ de nas/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bris sku la brtan bzhugs spyi dang —208—

mthun par bya/ khyod kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyis gtor mgron rnams spyi dang mthun par gshegs/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /ces sogs kyis smon las btab bkra shis bka' rgya mas thog drangs te/ shis brjod ci 'grub bya'o/ / grub pa kun gyis nyer bsten pa/ /dbang chen gsang ba'i sgrub thabs kyi/ /'phrin las cho ga 'dir gsal byas/ /dge 'dis 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog /dpal khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol ba gsang sgrub kyi las byang dregs pa kun 'dul zhes bya ba 'di ni chos 'di nyid la mchog tu gus pa dang ldan pa/ /'phrin las rnam rgyal zhes bya bas/ /lugs 'di la yi ge 'thor thabs su gnas pa las/ /chog sgrigs gsal ba ches dkon par 'dug pa'i/ /las byang gsal ba zhig sgrig par 'os so zhes yang yang bskul ba la brten nas/ shangs pa bka' rgyud kyi chos rigs su skyes pa rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer brgyad pa la chos 'khor sdengs su bkod pa'o// // zhu dag/ maṅgal//—209—

sbyar ba bzhugs/na mo gu sa thams cad rig pa'i rgyud 'debs bla ma la phyag 'tshal sro/yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /rigs kun 'khor losabasgyur ba rdo rje sems/ /gsang bdag rnam 'phrul ind+ra bhu ti'i zhabag /gsowab 'debs so snying nas skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byore ma dpal ka ma la pa dang//bde ba'i rdo rje nor bu gling pa'i zhabs/ /de nyid bcu mkhyen shudha ka ra'i mtshan//gus pa'i phyag 'tshal bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /sgra bsgyur kun kyi mchog gyurarin chen bzang / /legs pa'i shes rab blo gsal kun gyi phul/ /cho ge'i mthar son sum ston ye shes 'bar/ /yang yang gsol ba 'debs so thugasarjes bzung / /gnyan ston tshul 'bar rtog dpyod pha mthar son/ /yo ga rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag dben rtsa grags/ /'dus pa'i bdag po thod pa 'od zeral/ /mchog tu mos pa'i phyag 'tshal byin gyis rlobs/ /chen po'i gtsun rgyan rong pa chos mgon dang / /bod yul chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i mtshan/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa rdorje shes rab ste/ /ngo mtshar bla ma gsum la snying nasadad/ /byin rlabs gzi ldan bla ma 'phags rgyal dang / /de yi thugs sras rin chen dpal bzang dang / /skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ /dad pa rnam gsum stobs su gyur pas 'dud/ /gdams ngag rgya mtsho kun mkhyen —210—

gangs khrod pa/ /'jam dbyangs bdun par grags pa theg chen rje/ /gang desarjes bzung brag thog bsod nams bzang / /de dag rnams la'ang phyag 'tshalobyin gyis rlobs/ /'jig med dpa' bo kun dga' rnam rgyal zhabs/ /smra ba'i dbang po byang chub dbang rgyal dang / /zab don nyams zhes shākya kun dgo)zhabs/ /brgyud ldan de dag rnams la'ang gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang ye shes dbang po dang / /brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /'gro kun dga' mdzad snying po'i zhabs la yang / /gsol ba 'debs so phyag 'tshawaskyabs su mchi/ (〈dza〉 slob dpon dam pa kun dga' chos bsam pa/ /dngos rgyud bla ma snying po byang chub zhabs/ /snying po 'phrin las kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /gsol ba 'debs so snying nas skyabs su mchi) /bde gshe/gas rnams kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang / /phyag rgya sngags dang ting 'dzin cho ga'i mthus//ngan song rgyud kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /sdug bsngal mod la zhi bar byin gyisarlobs/ /'gro gnas drug tu 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /dkyil snyen ṭa chen po rtag tu mngon sum mthong / /de ma thag tu gzungs dang ting 'dzin dang / /yon tan mtha' yas thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /ye shes dbang bskur bye ba phrag brgya thob/ /don dam dkyil 'khor lha dang skal mnyam gyur/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa rnams rab rdzogs nas/ /thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i gnasathob rbe(ga /'di ni yo ga stod lugs smad lugs gnyis 'dus kyi dbang du byas/ bdag skyed rgyas pa dang 'brel che ba'i brgyud pa yin la/ spyir stod lugs smad lugs zhes pa'i tha snyad rdor da cings snyid kyi cho ga'i dbye ba yin mod kyang / de'i mdangs zhig sbyong rgyud kyi cho ga la yang cung zad shar—211—

ba'o/ /rnal 'byor ma ka ma la pa ni/ ka ma la pa ti'o/ /ind+ra bhū ti dang de'i bar du lcam la smra myadagadon zhugs pa 'jug pa'ang yod de dgos nges ma yin no/ /dben rtsa grags zhes pa'ang thod padaben rtsa grags te thod pa 'od zer de'i dpon po'o/ /lugs de gnyis la mi the ba sa lugs kyi rgyud rim ni/ phyag rdor/ rab gsal zlog rab 'byor skyangs/ kun snying/ shes rab skyangs/ zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ zhes rgyag ra pa'i rgyud pa 'ded cing / de rjes nor bu gling pa/ shudha/ lo chen phrag stengs pa/ mal lko sa skya gongam bzhi/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ ti shrī kun blo/ chos rje bla ma/ gangs khrod paman chad gong dang 'dra/ sa lugs nang sel/ ngor lugs ltar na/ bla ma dam pa'i ri khrod pa blo brtan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen/ ngor chen/ dpal ldan rdo rje/ kun dga' mchog grub/ rje grol mchog /rje brtsun rdo rings pa kun dga'i mtshan can/ de'i drung du bdag gis bka' thob/ yang wor chen/ kha char ba/ pan chen shākya mchog ldan/ /mtha' gong pa thugs rje dpal/ rje grol mchog khres ded kyang chog go /yang bo dong ba'i lugs ltar na/ ring rgyud bla ma dam pa/ byang rtse grags rgyag rje chos rgyawab nyid ces rgyud pa 'ded la/ nye rgyud rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis gnang ba sbyin nas/ /4sko chen 'jigs med grags pa/ sngags ram pa 'jam grags/ slob dpon bkra shis grags pa/ /slobadapon sangs rgyas dpal/ sngags 'chang tshul khrim/sa rnam rgyal/ de la bdag gis nos pa lags/ /mkhas mchog bu ston nas rgyud pa ni/ stod lus sa༈ smad lugs so so dang / gcig tu 'dres pa dgade dag gis nang sel rtsa bsnur 'dzims sogs so sor rgyud nga dang / jo bo lugs rigs gnyis/zang dkar lugs/ sa lugs/ kha che lugs/ chag lugs sogs rgyud pa mi 'dra ba shin tu mang po so sor gsan nas gcig tu 'dus pa yin/ de rnams so so'i rgyud yig shin tu mang po dag yi ges—212—

'jigs te 'dir ma bris/ shes par 'dod na gsan yig tu ltos/ de phyin chad ni thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ thugs sras lo tsā ba/ 'jam dbyangs grags rgyal/ 'khrul zhig tshul rgyal/ mkhyen rab chos rje/ chos rig pa/ dbon po rin chen rgyal po/ rje byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan chos bzang / rnams brgyud nas ngos kyis 'bums so/ /jo bo rje'i rang pe rto sbyongargyud lugs kun rig dkar po'i brgyud pa ni/bcom ldan shākya seng ge 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /gsang gsum bdag po phyagan rdo rje dang / /mkhas mchog dzñā na shrī mi tra dang / /byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag a ti sha /gus pas skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /gas sngagasagrub pa go mi sgom chen dang / /sngags rgyud rig pa skyi nor dzñā na'i zhabs/ /brtson pa mthar phyin gnyal pa nyi she ba/ /mos gus mthar phyin snur ston singaha'i zhabs/ /gus pas skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /sprul ston 'barathog srung ma bran du 'khol/ /mthu stobs che ldan yang dag rdo rje rtsangs/ de srasa'abyung gnas seṅge mkhas pa'i phul/ /'phrin las mchog gyur mdo sde sesgo la/ /gus pas skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /bskal bzang sems dpa' lungabastan chos sku 'od/ /gsang sngags bdag po blo ldan seng ge lce/ /rmad byungalcoston bsod nams dpal bzang dang / de sras mkhas mchog dbang phyug badzra la/gus pas skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhas btsun grags ldan mkhan chen rin rgyal ba/ /dkon mchog bzang po 'jam dbyangs dngos byon tshul//mkhan chen chos dbang nges don bstan pa 'dzin/ /kun dga' dpal lte 'byar tshergu'i gtsug na mdzes/ /gus pas skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs/ /nyams—213—

rtogs mthar phyin bkra shis rnam rgyal dang / /gnas lugs gzigs pa lungarig rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /phyogs 'dzin rdzun dang g.yo zol ma yin pa'i/rdorje slob dpon yin nges sgrol ba'i mgon/ gus pas skyabs su mchi'o byin gyisarlobs/ /'dir dpe mang po na jo bo'i slob ma go bi sgom rsā zer te/ la la ru go mi zer ba dag /snur seng he'i ming nyi ma seng ge'o/ /yang dag sogs ni/ rtsangs yang dag rdo rje'o/ /mdo sde seng ge yang lce ston yin/ mkhan chen rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' dpal 'byor ba ni/ chos lungatshogs pa'i mkhan rnge'u(/ /yang kun rigs lugs kyi nang sel grags che ba/ gzhan phan snying ngo re grags pa dang / brag nag pa lugs ni yi ge de de'i stengs nas dgos su ma thob kyang snga ma la 'dus so/ /ces bya'o/ / de ltar na ngan song sbyong ba gzi brdzid kyi rgyal po'i rtsa ba'i dkyil lnga bor thamasacad rig pa'i dbang rgyud man ngag brgyud yig gsol 'debs su sbyar ba 'di yang / slob bu dam pa yol mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis bskul nas/ kun dga' snying pos smras pa'o// //gcig zhus/// ma ṅga la//—214—

zhes bya ba bas kyigs/cha swā sti/ dpal thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'khor ba kun grol zhesabyab/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rnams kun la rang rig ye shes mchog /ris bral 'od brgyas rnam par snang mdzad pa/ bla med bla ma dkyil 'bor lha tshogs la/ /gus pas gas ni nas dkyil 'khor cho ga mug da/ /tshul 'di shin tu dar bas na/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga yi ge mtha' yasasnang / /'on kyang mang pos nan tan du/ /bskul phyir 'bri ba'ang mi 'gal tsam/ de la re chigadakyil 'khor ras bris la brten nas myur du sgrub pa'i dngos gzhi/ cho ga nyin gcig ma bshad par bya'o/ /thog mar yo byad rnams tshogs par byas nas/ cho ga la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsu5las/ dang po 'a thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang / khyad par gyi sngon 'gro gnyis so/ /dang grol rga las/dang po gnas kyi bdag po la gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ oX badzra yakṣa hūX/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi lasargya bcings pas so /huX badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa huX phaṭa/rdorje me'i phyagargyas so/ /oṃ a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX arya nu tru sno twata/ rdo rje bsdams pa 'debs tshul lo/ /sngags de dag kyang lan gsum gsum mo/ /gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdagaganyus/ mar gnas pa la sogs pa srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po thams cad ā karṣa ya dzaX oṃ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wa re khyuXn ma ༷༷sarba ta thā ga ta lco bi shwa mukhekhyuXsarba thā khaX utpa| te spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX gro hā daX ba li ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum —215—

la sogs pas bsngos/ phyag rgya ni rdor thal kha phye ba'o/ / oṃ badzra arghaX pra tismo swāhā/ oṃ badzra pulpe āXhuX/ dhu pe ā lo ke ga rnye ne we te badzra shasta āXhuX/dril bcu la dang bcas/ sal rgyu ba'i 'byung po dang / /gang yang sa la brten pa rnams/ /sa phyogs dgoganas 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'byung ba/ ji ltar nus paranyer sbyor na/ /sems can kun la dge don du/ khyod kyis bar chad ma byed par//dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ ces rol mo dang cas gtor ma phyi rol tu dor/gnyis pa gnas dang mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ yaktas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhuX las byung ba'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang grub bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ oX las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya tsheb rnams kyi nang du oX zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oX badzra arghaX swāhā/ de bzhi du/ pu byaX oX badzrastso āXhuX/ de bzhi du shaga'i bar rol wo dang cas te/ na mo bha ga wa te badzra sa ra pra ma dha na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te sa mya klaX brnya/ya/ ta bya thā/ lkoX badzra badzra mahābadzre mahā te dza badzre/ mahā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ mahā bo dhi manta u pa saX kra ma ṇi/ /sarba karma a ba ra ṇa/ bi sho dha ni swāhā/ lan gsum mo/ /gsum pa rgyud dag par byed pa ni/bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad —216—

dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyis bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ /chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsabazhi'i 'byung gnas/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//dam pa'i chos rnams la phyag skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnamasal skyabs su mchi'o/ /lan mang du brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi lan gsum/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /byang chub snying por mches kyi bar//rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas byas nas/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /lan gsum mo/ /bzhi pa nang khrus ni/rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings lka tseXkhas bha wa shudha sarba dharmā swa bhāX wa shurnyo3haX/ snang grags gzung 'dzin gyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub cing / chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa 'gyurab med pa'o/ /gnyis pa khyad par kyi sngon 'gro la gsum las/ dang po lce lag byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khoragyi steng du rang sems huX las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi —217—

don byas/ tshur 'dus hūX la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid phyag na rdorje sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing / g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ semasadapa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i lkog mar hruXlas padma dmar po 'dab brgyad lce'i thad ka'i pad 'dab du huX las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa nyal stabs su gnas pa/ rdo rje de lce la thim pas lce rdo rje rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badzra dzi hwa lan gsum/ lag mthil gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/de'i steng du huX huX las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa re re'o/ /de zhu ba las rdorje lagapa sor mo rnams kyang rdo rje rtse gcig pa rnams su gyur/gnyis pa srung 'khor la/ / lhar bskyed dbang bskur go cha bgo /spyan 'dren mchod brked bka' bsgo dang / bsnun sogs phyogs bcing bsrung dang brtan/ zhes pa ltar don 'a rtsalas/dngapo ni/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng huX/ de'i 'od zer gyi le1 'du las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje zhi ba nyid yongs su gyur te/ rdo rje khro bo me ltar 'bar ba sku mdog mthing nag sprul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyagagayas 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa thugs kar gsor zhing / g.yon de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ shin tu 'jigs khrod 'bar ba 'khrugs pa/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing ma rungs pa rnams sdigs par mdzad pa'o//gnyis pa ni/ khro bo ti rinti ri'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ gro hā badzra sa mā ya hūX baX/ phyag rgya de nyi spyi bo la sogs pa rigs bdag gi gnas lngar reg ste/ tseX( badzra dzwa la a na lwarka skyoX a dhi/|yeñtsa maX/ lan lngas 'phreng bas dbang bskur/ gsum pa ni/rdo rje khu tshur kha sbyor gnas dgur reg cing /—218—

mdud pa bcing tshul dang bcas/ eX( ṭuX/lan dgu /g.yas pa'i mthe chung dang / g.yon pa'i mdzum mo nas bkrol te/ thal mo'i rting pa brdabs la/ badzra tu smri ho/ zhes pa rnams kyis go bgo go /bzhi pa ni/ de nas dril sil dang bcas te/ hūX ye shes bskal ba me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsreg /zhe sdang gzhin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpagasacan/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khrobo bzhugs su 'tshal/ /leg 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ oX badzra kro dhwa rwadza sa pā ri wa rabadzras ma dzaX dzaXhūX baX hoX lnga pa ni/ oṃ badzra kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wa re bhyaX badzra bu 〉 āXhuX/ ne wi te'i bar du sbyar/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten sprod pa'i tshal yang mi spong zhing / /thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skuraston pa'i/ khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngangalas ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ gsung ngaro'abrug stong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing / /sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /sprul gdugargyan gyi brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal ba'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyilan/ /dpa' bo'i stang stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung bsregs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtso/ chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'a yi 'dre re —219—

khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog /khro rgyalabagegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig pa'i huX sgra des sgrogacing/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsole ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ drug pa ni/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sagazhi la gnas pa'i/ /lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig/nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po 'bri/ khyed cag 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /gal te nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na/ /ye shes can gyi rdorje 'bar ba yis/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing / /gegs rnams brlag paro'agyur ba gdon mi za/ dril sil rol chen dang cas te/ hūX bzhi pa bzlas go /twan pa ni/bgegs la bsnun pa'i phyag rgya dang / tseX( badzra dzwa la a na lwarka spyoX/ me'i phyag rgyad da hūXbadzra a na la sogs bcings pa'i phyag rgya dang / badzra ne ti banta sarba bisnrun/de gsum ni sngar yod kyi bgegs bsal ba'o /brgyad pa ni/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas nas/ oX badzra ḍi bho me bha wa rakṣa sarba na swāhā/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ lkoX hu lu hu lu hūX phaṭa/ ste dza rdo rje'i gur du gyur/oX badzra yakṣa khyuX de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i bla brer gyur/ lkoX truX banta sgaX shar tu rdo rdzo rwa ba grub/ oX hūX badzra pā sha hāXde'i nang du rwa ba gnyis pa'o/ /oX badzra pa taXgri pa taX gi ni ra ṭa/ nub tu rdo rje rwa ba grub/ hruXbadzra kā li ru ṭam ṭa/ byang du rdorje'i rwa ba grub/ oX badzra shi kha re ru ṭa ma ṭa/ lhor rdo rje'i rwa ba grub/ hūX badzra karma phyogs mtshams thams cad du rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ huX hūX hūX hūX huX skyoX huX skyoXde'i nang du yang rdo rje'i rwa bar gyur/ oX badzra banta baX/ phyi rol du yang rdo rje'i rang —220—

bzhin dum bu gcig par gyur/ bgegs la bsnun hranas bzung / hūX rkyang ma gtogs pe'i sngags de rnams lan gsum bya/ dgu pa ni/ khro bo me ltar 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas ga oX badzrasatwa kro dha a na la rka mahā badzra kro dha tra ba tra ba bi tra ba/ bi tra ba/ sarba a pa ya/nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ha ra ha ra/ pru ṇaX hūX phaṭa/ lan dgu /o badzra karma kaX /oX badzrarakṣa hāX/ lkoX badzra yakṣa huX/ oX badzra sa rnyi baX/ de rnams kyang lan gsum gsum ske srungabayin no/ bcu pa ni/ rdo rje snying gar bzung zhing dril bu rgyun 'brol dang 4sa/ oX badzra sa twa sam ya ma nu pā lā ya/ badzra satwa tī no pa tiṣṭha/ gi rnyo me bha wa/ su to stso me bha wa/ a nu ra lto me bha wa/ su po stso me bha wa/ /sarba sirnyi sme pra ya tsā sarba karma su tsa me/tsu steX shri yaX ku ru hūX ha ha ha ha hoXbha ga wan/ badzra satwa mā me muñtsa badzi bha wa ma ha sa mā ya swatwa a/ zhes lan gsum gyi brtan par mos so/ /ti rinti ri'i phyag rgya man chad nasade yan chad la badzra satwa kre( dha sogs sngags lan dgu brjod rgyu de ma gtogs/ gzhan thams cad logs nas drangs pa'o/ /gsum pa tshogs bsags pa ni/ /lkoX badzra tsakra khruX rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgya g.yas su bskor/ dkyil 'khor lo grub/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pe'itshogs thams cad mngon sum du bzhugs par gyur/ lkoX sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya lhaka tsitta pra ṇa me na/ badzra banta naX/ ka ro mi/ zhes phyag byas/ lkoX badzra arnyaX swahā oXbadzra pursha hūṃ nas/ shabha 'a bar gyis mchod/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa sngo ge༈ ka gsum gyis bstod/ rgyun bshags ni/ dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang / /rjes su yi rang yang na bgyid stsal gang / /de dag thams cad byang chub mchog gi ni/ /spyan sngar da lta ma lus so sor bshags/ /bde gshegs sras kyi —221—

tshogs gnyis zab pa dang / /rgya chen 'gro ba ma lus pa yi don/ /sgrub par byed dang de las gzhan pa la'ang / /rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang wo/ /thugasarjes khyab pa'i thugs dang ldan gyur cig /blo gros sdig bral gti mug tshogasardekun bcom/ /ma lus rigs kyi padma'i nang zhugs pa/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams la skyabs su mchi/ /blo mchog rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba ste/ /dman pas 'jigs pa nyid kyi rgyal byed tshal/ /srid pa'i 'byor ba zil gyis gnon pa'i mchog /gsung mchog chos la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /'dod chagasalasogs sbrul gyi dug bcom zhing / /blo gros rnam rgyal thugs rje che ldan pa/ /brtul zhugs bzang po'i tshogs la skyabs mcha zhing / /srid dang bral ba rnamasal bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rgyu yi rjes su bdag po'i yul bdag nyid/ /'bras bu'i stobs kyis dgra las rgyal gyur pa/ /snying rje'i rtsa ba zug cing yang dag rtogs//mnyam med byang chub sems ni bzung bar bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni yongs su smin pa'am/ /yang na yongs su bskyab par bya phyir ram/ /rang gi sems ni dgapar bya ba'i phyir/ 'di dag thams cad rtsa sogs bzhin du btang / /de bzhin tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus dang / /bsam gtan shes rab bla na med pa ni/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan par bya ba'i phyir/ /skad cig re re zhing yangabasgom par bgyi/ /bde bar gshe/gas pa sngags la mkhas pa yis/ /cho se rgyal rtag tu lhun gyis grub pa ni/ /'gro ba 'di yis thob par bya ba'i phyir/ khyad 'phags gnas la bdag gis gnas par bgyi/ lan gsum/ de nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdagal—222—

dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ zhes pa nas/sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ kyi bar spyi dang 'dra/ de rjes/ dkyil zhabora'akhor lo rang gi snying gar thim/ zhes bya/ de yan chad kyi sngon 'gro'i rim 3mas bsta zin to/ /da ni dngos gzhi'i rim pa la bdag bskyed/ bum bskyed/ /mdun skyed/ mchod gtor/bdag 'jug ste lnga las/ dang po la lha'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa dang / rjes kyi bya bgo /dang po la dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog /las rgyal mchog ste gsum yod pa las/ dang po ni/stong nyid rten bskyed gtso bor sgom/ /gzug brnyan sbyor dang sdig pa bral/ /ye shes phab nas dbangadu bya/ /gnas gsum byin brlabs dbang bskur dang / /mchod bstod 'phrin las bcu gcig go de nas dang po ni/ oX shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atpa ko3haX/ stong pa nyid du gyur/gnyis pa ni/ oṃ bha stong pa'i ngang las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tshu'i dkyila'akhor/ de'i steng du gser kyi sa gzhi/ de'i steng du rgya mtsho chen po/ dbus su ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa shar shel lto bi rje rya nub padma ra ga byang gser las grub pa'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ljang dmar ser sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskorab/ de'i steng du dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa'i gzhi dang / shar bu dang mda' yab kyis skor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mosna rnyas pas ma ce de rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khorwa da pa/ them skas dang bcas pa'i sgo khang bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang —223—

rim bzhi glang seng brtsegs pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i steng du padma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / de'i steng du gdugs dang g.yas g.yon tu ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ 'byams gyi phyi rol du rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi srung ba'i ge rgor lo me 'od 'bar ba dang bcas pa'o/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i gzhal/yas khang de'i nang ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang / de'i steng du rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ phyi'i 'khyams ri rab kyi phyogs dang mtshungs pa'i mdog dang / nang gi lha snam shar sngo lho ser nub dmar byang ljang pa gzhal yas khang gi dbus kyi gzhi dkar ba/de'i dbus su seng ge shar du glang po lto rta mchog nub tu rma bya byang du mkha' lding gis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri re re/ de'i phyi rol tu 'khor lo sngon po rtsibasabacu drug pa dang bcas pa'o/ /bzhugs khri lnga'i steng dang / /mtshams bzhi po rnams dang / /'khore lo'i rtsibs rnams dang / /gru chad bzhi dang/ sgo bzhi dang / grubazhi rnams su padma dang zla ba'i gdan re re'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dbus kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lko las 'khore lo o gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mo chod/ /sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi pa phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/—224—

dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rab tu zhi ba chen po'i nyams dang ldan zhing / zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis brtan par bzhugs pa/dbu skra'i thor tshugs rin po che'i cod pan can/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yongs su rdzogs pa 'khor los bsgyur ba chen po'i cha byad can 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar zhing 'phro ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ gzugs brnyan sbyor ba ste/ lag gnyis thal mo gan rkyal byas/ 'a yon pa gnyis su o las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de'i steng du g.yas par hū/g.yon par ā gnyis ka'i mtha' skor du/ a ā i yī u mū ṛ grwa mṛ snyi e i o au a a rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba 'od 'phro ba'o/ /mthe bong gnyis la o/ mdzub mo gnyis la hu/ gung mo gnyis la tra/ srin las/gnyis la hri mthochung gnyis la a/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ g.yas kyi sor mo lnga la rnamasnang mi skyod pa rin chen 'byung ldan 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa rnamasaso/ /g.yon gyi sor mo lnga la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ rdorje thugs ma/rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ rdo rje thams cad ma rnams 'khod paragyur/ mnyam pa'i thal mo dang / o a no n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmā lha dang lha mophan tshun reg par 'gyur/ rdo rje thal mo dang / pa ra spa ra a nu pra bi ni sarba dharsārjes su zhugs par gyur/ rdo rje bsdam pa dang / a tutta a nu pra bi ni sarba dharmā badzra banta/ lha rnams rogacig tu 'dres par gyur/ lnga pa ni/rdor bsdams pelkabadzra banta tra ṭa lan gsum/ sdig pa thams cad bral bar gyur/ drug pa ni/rdor —225—

bsdams mthe bong nang du bas dang po'i rdo rje char bzhan babs te nga gar /badzra ā be sha zhes pa lan gcig dang /a zhes pa nyer gcig phyag rgya de nyid dgrol la seragol gtogs/ti ni badzra ḍi rnyo me bha wa/sha shwa to me bha wa/hri da ya me/a dhiṣṭha rlo se/|rje/ dang rna sbyo)rdesarba 'a me pra ya smo huX brtan par gyur/bdun pa ni/'a rje khu tshur dam rgya dang /badzra mu nya/sgribargyad pa ni byinaXtogs/oX 'a mu zhi baX/to gsum thams cad rdekren rtse ge po gyur/brgyad pan/'a ༷gyas za ce/ rta hū ཾ phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtuXloXsnga ge chaX snro ta bhra ta sarba a ba ra ṇa na shā rdo//ṭa/ tru ṭa tra ṭa sarba a ba ra ṇa na hu phaṭa/tshirnya tshinta sarba a / sgro tha ṇa dzñāX 'a/dgu ༵ /rigs dhi kyi | phyag rgya spyi ༵ logs dzo /nas lngar ༵as te/bhi sa sna o kho myu huX/sa mu a lta sna myu lkoXrna/ raṇḍa a bha ṣañtsa traX/ padma a ṣañtsa hraX karma a bha ṣañtsa a/bcu pa/ni/bar 'dir ston/tshigs rdo/da dang da pa'i mchod pa bya la/'a ༷ sngags 'a gyi mchod de/oX mi nyam nyid miXswāhā/༷ badzra /5sge a huX nas shabha 'a bar 'a mchod rjong chog go/bstod pa mnyam ma g.yo mas bstoX/sda/rdo dral ba nas mchod bstod kya baX 'aX dang po sbyor ba la snyen mu par dgosapas yan lag 'a/gzugs gyo bzhi sbyora'i sbyo 'a/spyar na dang po sbyor ba 'a ༷na la nasatunges par dgos pa ma yan pas phyag rgya ba rgyas gtab kya sngon du byas kyang chog mod kya/sdag/pa dral ba sogs kyi sngon du byed pa spyi khyab kyi lag len la 'dug pa ltar 'gal ba yang mi snang bas re shig skabs zu/ri bya'o/sa/ sa sabhā gcag pa na/de nas 'ad skad ces ngag tu song gi rgyung bsam ste/tshangs pa chen po 'ang gdan rnyi gzhugs te/de nas ngan song rgyud yongs swa sa ba zhesabya ba 'a tang nge 'an la snyoms par hu 2 /sa nas ngan song gsum gya rgyud las

rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i byang du ba sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa mang po'i 'phreng ba nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spru nas phyung nas/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag kun tu snang bar byas so/ /kun tu snang bar byas pas sems can thams cad kyi sems nyone mongs pa'i 'chings pa las rnam par grol te/ bde ba so sor thob nas/ yang dga' ba'i tshal thams cad kun tu snang bar byas te/ mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyisamachod nas lan brgya stong du bskor ba byas te/ mgo bos lan brgya stong du phyaga'atshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'kho de 'di skad ces gsol to/ /e ma ho sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /e masangasargyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /ces brjod cing rnam pa du mas mchod nas rang bzhin gyi gnasasu gshe/gas par gyur to zhes so/ /tshig 'di ni rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang bar ma chad par gleng slang ba'i skabs yin pas/ 'de skabs kyi tshangs pa chen po ni ston pa bcom ldan 'das nyid yin na/ rdor sems dang phyag rdor sogs la spyor ba cung zad mi rigs pas kun rig gi dkyil 'khor la ni/ shākya thub nyid sku'i rnamapa 'gyur ba'i rnam snang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin pas rnam snang la sbyong ba dang / gtsug dgulta bu la ni sku'i rnam pa ma 'gyur ba'i shākya seng ge la'ang sbyar bas legs so/ /yang dkyil 'khora'adi la shākya rigs kyi dbang po ni/ sku rnam pa ma 'gyur ba'i shākya thub nyid yin kyang / gtso bo lasagazhan du sku'i rnam pa logs su bstan pa nyid kyis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo ma yin pa'i phyir gleng —227—

gzhi dang gleng slang gi 'phren las kyi gtso bo mdzad pa'i dogs pa mi 'byung ngo //de nas tshangs pachen po zhes pa bcom ldan 'das thub pa nyid rnam par snang mdzad 'khor los bsgyur ba'i cha byad du bzhengs pa nyid yin par the tshom med pas/rigs kyi cal col mang po'i rjes su 'brang bar mi bya'o//spyir rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang mthun par 'di lta bu'i dmigs pa bsgom pa ni shin tu legs lkatshig 'di nyid kho na brjod dgos par ni ma nges te/tshig 'di rgyud las 'byung yang lo rgyus kyi skabs tsam yin gyi/cho ga'i don du gsungs pa'i sngags tshig ma yin pa'i phyir ro//'on kyang tshig tubarjod phyin rgyud tshig brjod na shin tu bzang zhing /phyogs 'di'i snga phyi thams cad kyang /dmigs pa 'di bsgom phyin tshig 'di yang brjod pa'i lag len du mthun par snang ngo //de ltar na de dag gisani dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin bstan zin to//gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog ni//sa bon spro dang 'khor tshogs bskyed//ye shes/spyan 'dren mdzad pa dang /tso/༷ ༷dab sngon 'gro rgyas sa 'a//she bsku/ wo te don tshwa bdun/dang po ni/ga ba 'a thugs kar zla ba 'a dkyal 'kha/ra gya steng du/hūXtruX hriX.a/oX truX hriX.a/skyoXdza ho dhu/traX rya bhi ta/hriXdhiXkruXbhā/kaXraXkṣaXgaXskyoXbhāX hri nga 4sto ge la slotshe.a/huXbyeXhra a/dzaXhuXṭāXha sheXd ye deXsnror/de rnams ga rtsa ba rnam par snangangs thugs ka nas phyar spras te so sa gdan la 'bo / da par gyur/gnyisapani/yag 'bru de rnams las 'ong ze 'phros/khams gsum thams cad snangabar byas/'ag tsho dge tshe she~Xyems cad ma chad/semasacan sa snyi /da kya 'i mdzad/ dus te spra sa ru ri su yongs su khu/ra pa snas/ tshong 'a rjo pha~Xr snrong ba 'a rgyal po la sogasardepa' sangs rgyas bzha/mtshams ba/rdo 2༷ma bzha/rtsabs bcu drug la byang shar

mtshams kyi tshur rol nas brtsams te/ g.yas bskor gyi sems dpa' bcu drugaste/ phyogs bzhi so sor rtsibs bzhi bzhi la sems dpa' bzhi bzhi/ gru chad bzhi la sgeg mo sogs bzhi/ lha snam kyi grwa bzhi la me rta ge ma la sogs pa bzhi/sgo bzhin sgo ba bzhi rnams grub pa ni/ hū las dbus kyi shar du thams cad rigapa sbyong ba'i rgyal po dkar po mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ tru las lhorathams cad rig pa rgyal ba mchoge sngon po g.yas mchog spyin dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ hi zilas nub tu thams cad rig pa shākya thub pa ser po cho se 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ sha las byang du thams cad rig pa zin chen me tog ljang khu/ g.yas skyabs spyin dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mjad pa/ sangs rgyas bzhi po de rnams kyang rang rang gi khri la sa bzhugs shang/ rgetso bo dang mtshungs pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i gzugs can no/ /shar lhor o las sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo spyan 'bras kyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu tru las mā ma gī sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nub byang du pā las gos dkar mo dmar mo padma dmar po 'dzin pa/ byang shar du tālas sgrol ma ljang khu utpal sngon po 'dzin pa/ de rnams phyag g.yas pas rangarang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcu drugalabyang shar mtshams nas brtsams te g.yas bskor gyis sems dpa' bcu drug tu gyur pa las/ shar phyogs su bzhi ni hū las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po phyagagayas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin zhing / g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dza las rdo rje rgyal po ser po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ ho las rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' —229—

gzhu 'dzin pa/ dhu las rdorje legs pa ljang khu rdorje se gol gyis legs so ster pa/ lho'i phyogs su bzhi ni/ truX las rdo rje rin chen ser po g.yas zin po tshedapral bar 'jog cing / g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ rya las rdorje gohribarjid dmar ser nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ sbo las rdo rje rgyal mtshan sngon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i tog can gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ ha las rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po rbe'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ nub phyogs su bzhi ni/ hruXlas rdo rje chos dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ g.yon padma'i sdong po rtsa ba dkur brten zhing / /g.yas pas de'i me tog thugs ka'i thad du kha 'byed pa/ dhīXlas rdo rje rnon po sngon po g.yas ral gri dang g.yon po ti 'dzin pa/ kruX las rdo rje rgyu serapo g.yas pa'i gung mo la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bskor ba/ bha las rdo rje smra ba dmar po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ljags 'dzin pa/ /byang phyogs su bzhi ni/ kaX lasardo rje las sna tshogs mdog g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin zheng /g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ raX las rdo rje srung ba ser po phyag gnyis rdorje'i go khrab 'dzin pa/ kṣaX las rdo rje gnod spyin nag po phyag gnyis kyi rdo rje mtsheb re re 'dzin pa/ saX las rdo rje khu tshur ser po phyag gnyis dam tshig gi khu tshuragyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa'o/ /de dag gi phyi rol zur mtshams bzhi la shar ltor huX las rdo rje sgeg mo dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje re re bzung nas snyems pa'i tshul 'dzad pa/ lhonub tu traX las rdo rje 'phreng ba ma ser mo phyag gnyis rin po che'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ nub byang du hriXlas rdo rje glu ma dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can pi waX —230—

'dzin pa/ /byang shar tu a las rdo rje gar ma ljang khu phyag gnyis rdo rje rtsegasurapa gnyis 'dzin pas gar byed pa'o/ /de'i yang phyi rol mtshams bzhi la shar lhor huX las gdug spos ma dkar mo spos snod 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu truX lasametog ma ser mo me tog gi kong bu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du hriXlas mar mesladamar skya mar me'i kong bu 'dzin pa/ byang shar du a las dri chab ma ljang khu dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa'o/ /de dag gi phyi rol du sgo ma bzhi po dag ni/ shar du dzaXlas rdo rje lcagasakyu ma dkar mo phyag gnyis lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ ltor hūX las rdo rje zhags pa tshaser mo phyag gnyis zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu baX las rdo rje lcags sgrogamadamar mo phyag gnyis lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang du hoXlas rdorje dril bu ma ljangakhu phyag g.yas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum bzhi dang / lho dang nub kyis semasadapa' lhag ma gsum gsum dang / dril bu ma rnams g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ sems dpa' thams cad ral pa'i thod tshugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lha mo rnams ni dbu skra byed bcings pa/ sked skabs phra zhing nu 'bur rgyas pa/ thams cad kyang sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / dar gyi na bza' dang zin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis bgyon pa'o/ /'di dag las kha cig sgo skyong bzhi khro bo khro mor 'dod de 'dir de ltar mi byed lka rdo rje gnod spyin khro bo sbom thung stag lpags sprul rgyan can du 'dod pa dang / zhi ma khro dar dang rin po tshes brgyan par 'dod pa la sogs yod kyang / 'dir ni sems dpa' bcu drug bzhi khro'i nyams dngachalugs la khyad par med par byas na legs so/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol gyi —231—

khyams la byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ /rgyal ba'i nyan thos thams cad dang / /de bzhin rang rgyal gtsobo rnams/ khro bo mngags pa pho nya sogs/ /dkyil 'khor phyi yi phyi rol du/ /'dzam bu'i gling du tshangs pa dang / /byang phyogs su ni dbang phyug ske shar dang nub kyi gling du ni/ /brgya byin khyab 'jug 'khor dang bcas/ /lha min dri za naslamakha' lding / /gnod spyin srin po lto phye che/ /'gyung po yi dwags sha za dang / /kludang grul bum ri rnams dang / /rgyal po bzhi rnams gnas par gyur/ /gza' dngaskar ma rgyu skar dang / khros pa ma rungs 'tshe ba ni/ /bgegs dang bi nā ya kadang / /sems can kun la phan byed pa'i/ /drang srong skal pa chen po rnams/ /phra men ma dang bud med dang / /sring mo de bzhin rnal 'byore ma/ /'byung ba bzhi yi lha chen po/ khyim dang ri la gnas pa dang / /shing dang kun ra nags la sogs/ /dur khrod grong khyer gnas pa'o/ /de lhar na dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' 'khor du gnas pa thams cad kyang skad cig gis grub par gyur/ de dag ni dam tshig pa bskyed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/de nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs par gyur/ o badzra sa mā dza dang rdo rje bsdu pa'i phyag rgya lngo gsum/ phyogasabacu'i zhing khams kun nas sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs pa gzhal yas khang gi nang du byon par gyur/ bo zhe pa ni/ lko sarba ta thā ga ta pā da banta na ka ro mi/ zhes dam tshig pa la phyag mdzad par bsam/ e waho kun tu bzang po yi/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mchog /de bzhin —232—
