gshegs pa'i 'khor lo yi/ /dbus na de bzhin gshegs pa mdzes/ khor du brjod nas/ 'khor thams cad phyogs phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugasakar 'dus lnga po yang dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi thugs kar zhugs te gnas pa las ji ltar thim pa bzhin du rgyal ba lnga smros/ gzhan rnams lnga po rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros te/ dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi lha tsho gosarnams la ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du so sor gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ lkoX badzra aX gu sha dza/ oX badzra pā sha huX/ oX badzra spos baX/ oX badzra a be sha a/ e ma ho sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rgya chen gdod nas skye ba med/ /rduskaphran rnams ni ji snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni gcig tu gyur/ go'/da du stsod do/ /lnga pa ni/ las rgya dang / oX badzra yakṣa hūX gsum/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ dmargyadang / oX badzra sa rnyi baX gsum/ sgo bcad/ las rgya dang / lkoX badzra rakta haX gsum go dza skon/oX kruX/ dgu oX badzra tu yi ho/ zhes pas srung ba byas/ rdor thal kha phye/ oX badzra sa twa guXgis mchod yon phul/ de rnams rgyas btab kyi sngon 'gro yin no/ /drug pa rgyas btab dngos la bzhi las/ dang por dam tshig gi phyag rgyas btab pa ni/ dri spyi ma ṭa/ sa ma ya staX/ sarba bid tri lja dzaXhūX baX hoX sa ma ya stuX/ sa ma ya stuX/ a haX/ sarba bid sarba bid sarba bid/ces pa'i mthar/ oX sarba bid sarba a ba ra ṇa bi she/ dha ya ha na hūX phaṭa/ zhagasusagatso bo rnam snang gi'o/ /de bzhi du/ sa ma ya stuX/ sarba bid tra khyi dzaXhūX baX hoX sam ya stuX/ sa ma ya stuX/ a haX/ sarba bid sarba bid sarba bid ces pa'i mthar oX saXrnga bid hūX/ lan gsum/ spyong rgyal gyi'o/ /sangs rgyas gzhan gsum la'ang des rigs 'gre ste/ o sarba bid phaṭa/ oX sarba bid a/ lkoX sarba bid traṭa/ ces mtha'i sngags sgyur ba kho na'o/ /de —233—

ya o ༵ / rdo ma tsa rtso/ / shī //ma/rjo/ ta sku lo tsas rgyas khri/ dhī bye/ /༵ bhe pyi ༵rdo rtsa byung sgyu blo ne / shad re~Xsdo~X/'di man chad des rigs 'gre ste/ budha rde lo tsa ni zhes pa'i dod du/ badzra mā ma gī mtho'i sngags la/ o badzra mā ma gī tra/ de bzhi du badzra paṇḍa rwa dang / o badzra paṇḍa ra dehisirnyi lo kotta ra ba swāhā/ badzra tā re dang / o tā re tu stu re tu hu hu blug gas swā twayum bzhi'o/ /sems dpa' bcu drug po rnams la badzra satwa kho na las gzhan so so'i mtshan mi dri shu badzra /rdoX / ho go bye ༷ kau ༷ rdo sku ha / rnams / byeX /hūm̐ ༷ sngi/ o badzra ā satwa badzra sgris twa/ rdo /hūm̐ nghru shī / rdo sbru/ nai~X/ ༷rdo rdo ༵/ dro 1 o kau rdo badzra re/ nghru / hūm̐ /ar su ༵ ༵ satwa/ /brdo phros rdo/ dzā ༷lji dī rdo ༵/ dhi pa lji ༵ ༵ ༵ ༵ lti/ra dhi / sna dro shwa bzin du / badzra —sa su dang / oṃ badzra lā su hu/ badzra mā lo dang / o badzra mya lo sga badzra gyi ti badzra /dhu ༷ ༵/ sdo hā ༵ dang rdzu/ ༵ gā rdzu stso / rdzu/rmi kau ༵ko/ dang/dhu~X badzra ā/ ༵ ke sdi badzra garnye dang / oṃ badzra ga rje a/ badzra a gu sha dang / o badzra so gu sha dzabadzra pā sha dang / o badzra pā sha hu/ /badzra spoṭa dang / o ba lo/ṭa ba/ badzra ā be—234—

sha dang / lkoX badzra ā be sha hoX sgo ba bzhi po rnams kyi'o/ /skal bzang 'a yis man chad lani bdag bskyed kyi skabs 'dir rgyas btab mi dgos te mos sgom kho na las/ gzhan bskyed chogagis bskyed pa med pa'i phyir ro/ / de ltar dam tshig gi phyag rgyas bsgrubs pa'i lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūX las dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa re res mtshan par gyur/ gnyis pa chos kyi phyag rgya ni/ lha thams cad kyi lkog marahiXlas padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lce'i padma'i 'dab mar sdiXlas zla ba'i steng du huX las rdo rje rtse lnga pa rdo rje'i lte ba la lha rang rang gi gsang sngags chos kyi yi ges mtshan par gyur/ lkoX sarba bid sarba a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na huXphaṭa/ tseX( sarba bid huX zhes pa nas/ tseX( badzra ā be sha he rdo re bar lan ze'am/ tshar gsum gsum skabs dang 'tshams par brjod 'di la lag pa'i phyag rgya phyag chen dang 'dra bar 'ching ba'i srol yang 'dug mod kyi/ chos rgya la lag pa'i phyag rgya mi 'ching ba nyid gdod ma'i lugs 0 0so/ /gsum pa las kyi phyag rgya ni/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar a las sna tsho gosardorje re res mtshan par gyur/ 'di nyid kyi rgyud na gsal ba rnams de dang de yin la/ mi gsal ba rnams phyag mtshan med pa'i phyag chen gyi tshul du 'ching ba yin no/ /gong dam rgya'i skabs su bshad pa ltar rigs lnga las/ sa ma ya staX dang / gzhan rnams la su ra ta stuX/ mgor sbyar nas/ tseX( sarba a pa ya bi tre sto dha ni huX phaṭa/ sarba bid ces pa lngas rigs lnga dang/ tseX( sarba ā pa ya bi cwa( dha ni huX phaṭa/ bzhi lo tsi ni zhes pa nas/ oX sarba ā pa ya bi sho dha ni skyoXphaṭa/ badzra ā be sha zhes pa'i bar ro/ /bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po ni/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'o/ /lkoX sarba bid sarba a ba raṇa bi sho dha ya ha na huX phaṭa nas/ oṃ badzra ā be sha ho'i bar sa ma ya stuX dang / su ra —235—

ta stu gyi mgo 'dren tshul gong bzhin te/ ji ltar bsgom pa dang mthun pa'i phyag chen bcingango / /gal te phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs mi lcogs na/ sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs pa tsa5byed payin mod kyi/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dang mthun par bkral ba'i lugs byed phyin nges par bya ste/ 'i de med na de nyid bsdus pa sogs nas khyad chos gzhan ni de bas med pas yo ga'i cho ga yin rgyu ci yang med do/ /spyong rgyud yo ga kho nar 'dod bzhin du rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab mi 'dod pa ni shin tu 'gal ba chen po yin la/ spyir nas spyong rgyud kyi cho ga la dam rgya dang las 'chol ba'i phyag rgya ni nges paradagos shing / gzhan rnams med kyang chog pa'i skabs srid de/ de'i tshe sbyong rgyud kyang yo go'i rgyud kho nar mi 'dod de gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /yo ga dang mthun pa'i lugs byed na ni/ dkyil 'khorardzogs pa bsgoms nas chos shin tu bsdu na yang de bzhin gshegs pa lnga la rgya bzhis gdab pa med na/ cho ga'i yan lag chad pa'i nyes pa che bar 'gyur nges so/ /bdun pa dbang bskur ba ni/ gongabazhin rigs lnga'i phyag rgya spyi bor gshugs nas/ tse( badzra a bhi ṇa po yi sogs te/ lha thamasacad la rgyas btab par bsam/ 'dir bsdus pa'i lugs yin pas dbang bskur de tsam gyisachog go /de dag ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog go /gsum pa las rgyal mchog la las bcoladabāmachod brtod gnyis las/ dang po ni/ so so'i dam rgya 'ching bzhin du/ oṃ na mo bha gawatesogs rtsa rig tshar gcig dang / oṃ sarba bid sarba a ba ra ṇa bi sho/ dha ya ha na hūphaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa rnam par snang mdzad kyis semasacan thams cad ngan song las grol bar mdzad cing / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngalathams cad las bsgral te/ myur du mthon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas thob pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ de bzhi du sde shaṃ so so'i mgor/ oṃ na mo jog༅rtsa rig —236—

tshar re dang / gzhug tu las bcol re sbyar te sde tshan sde tshan du las bcol ba lag len yin pas/'di ltar bya ste/ oX na mo sogs/ oX sarba bid huX/ spyod pa'i rgyal po dang / oX sagabid phaṭa rgyal mchoge rin chen dang / oX sarba bid āXdza/kya rigs dbang dang /o sarba bid tra ṭa me tog cher rgyas te/ phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa bzhisakyang sems can thams cad ngan song las grol bar mdzad cing 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las bsgral te myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas thob pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ oX lo tsa na sogs sangs rgyas spyan ma dang / oX mā ma sogs mā ma gī dang / oṃ paṇḍa rā sogs gos dkar mo dang / oX tware sogs sgrolam ste yum bzhis kyang sogs/ oX badzra satwa skyoX rdo rje sems dpa' dang / oX badzrasatwa dzaXrdo rje rgyal po dang / oX badzra satwa hoX rdorje chags pa dang/ oX badzra sa twa dhu rdo rje legs pa ste rdo rje'i rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang sogs/ oṃ badzra satwa truX/ rdo rje rin rṣa dang / oX badzra satwa rya/ rdo rje gzi brjid dang / oX badzra satwa sgri rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / oX badzra satwa ha rdo rje bzhad pa ste rin chen rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang zo sogs/ oX badzra satwa dhīX rdo rje chos dang / lkoX badzrasatwa dhi ༷༷rdo rje rnon po dang / lkoX badzra satwa kruXrdo rje rgyud dang / oX badzra ā bha rdorje smra ba ste padma'i rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang sogs/ lkoX badzra satwa kaX /rdorje las dang / oX badzra satwa raX rdo rje srung ba dang / oX badzra satwa kṣaX rdorje gnod sbyin dang / oX badzra satwa saX rdo rje khu tshur te las kyi rigs kyi sems dpa' bzhis kyang sogs/ oṃ badzra lwa gya huX rdo rje sgeg mo dang / lkoX badzra mā le tyāX rdo rje 'phreng ba dang /oX badzra gi tī sbruXrdo rje glu ma dang / oṃ badzra sgro ti a rdo rje gar ma ste kru chad kyi lha mo —237—

bzhis kyang sogs/ oṃ badzra dhu pe hūX/ rdo rje bdug pa ma dang / oX badzra purnyu sgaX rdorje me tog ma dang / oṃ badzra a lo ke hri rdo rje mar me ma dang / oṃ badzra garnye a rdorje dri chang ma ste grwa bzhi'i lha mo bzhis kyang sogs/ oX badzra aX gu sha dzaXrdorje lcags kyu ma dang / oṃ badzra pa sha huX rdo rje zhags pa ma dang / lkoX badzra slo ṭa baX rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dang / oX badzra u be sha hoXrdo rje 'bebs pa ma ste sgo ma bzhis kyang sogs/ zhes sogs kyis 'phrin las gzhol/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas mchod pa byin gyisabarlabs/ mchod yon phal cher sogs kyi tshigs bcad la/ bdag nyid chen po dkyila'akhore lha tshogs mchod/ ces sbyar te/ mchod yon dang me tog nas rol mo'i phanang/ oX rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa ni/ oṃ badzra satwa su saX gra ha ta/ oX badzra lwa phya zheX.oṃ rdo rje rin chen bla na med/ oṃ badzra ratna ma nu ra ta raX/ oX badzra mya leshrīX/ oṃrdorje chos ni glu blangs pa/ oṃ badzra dharma gā ya ni/ oX badzra gyi ti rmiX oX rdorje las/kun byed par 'gyur/ /oX badzra karma ka ro da bha we/ oX badzra ni ti a/ de7sko du sbyar te/ lkoX rdo rje sems dpa'/ oX badzra sa twa: oṃ badzra dhu pe phoX oX rdorje zin chenangu.oX badzra ratna: lkoX badzra pu spre truX/ oX rdorje chos ni: badzra dharma: oX badzra u lo te 〉 ༷oṃ rdo rje las kun badzra karma: oX badzra ga rnye a/ zhes pas mchod/bstod pa ni/ skyoXsangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas/ /mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa/ /rdorje rdorje 'dzin rgyal po/ /rdo rje rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ rdo rje sku ste sku che ba/ phyag na rdorje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdorje yan lag rdo rje mchog/rdo rje 'bar ba cher 'bar ba/rdo rje shugs te shugs che ba/ /rdo rje mtshon cha rdo rje che/ /phyag na rdorje phyag go po/ /rdo rje mda' ste rab 'bigs pa/ /rdo rje rnon po rno ba che/ /tshe ba'i tsheb rgya —238—

mtsho che/ /rdo rje padma byang chub che/ /byang chub sangs rgyas rang byung ba/ /rdorje rgya chen rgya che ste/ /rdo rje sgyu ma rnam sbyong ba/ /rdo rje rgyu ste gnod sbyin che/ /rdorje padma rnam sbyong ba/ /rdo rje khro bo ma rungs che/ /rdo rje dgra sdang 'joms pa'i ge mi/ /rdorje 'jigs pa srung ba che/ /rdo rje lcags kyu don yod byed/ /rdo rje ro wo lorolangs che/ /rdo rje srin po za ba po/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gnod sbyin che/ /rdorje gdon de gdon gyi bdag /'jigs byed dgra byed drag po che/ /rdo rje le jigasabyed rngam byed pa/ /sgrub dka' sgrub pa legs pa ste/ /rdo rje legs pa dgyesamadzad pa/ /rdo rje dga' ba dga' ba che/ /dga' ba'i rdo rje dbang byed pa/ /rdorje gzi brjid gzi brjid che/ /'bar 'od gshin rje mthar byed pa/ /rdorje drag po drag po che/ /'od sdug pas ni sdug pa che/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa go /reb thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rdorje dbang bskur rin chen mchog /rdorje rgyal mtshan yon tan mtsho/ /rdo rje ye shes ye shes che//rigs sngags bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /ha la ha la nag po che/ /dgra chen zhing ni 'joms pa'i gtso/ /rdo rje 'dod pa 'dod pa che/ /snyigs ma'i lus ngan rnam sbyong ba/ skad cig g.yo ba'i the tshom bcod/ /glog bzhin zhal gyi ljags las 'phro/ /khro rje meste ma rungs 'dul/ /drag po rab snang snang mdzad pa/ /nyi ma stong gis gdungaba'i zhal/ /spyan dmar 'jigs par mdzad pa po/ khro bo du ma'i 'od bzhin 'phro/ /phyag rnams du ma'i mtsho ni cha brgya/ /dus ma'i zhal te sku yang stong/ /'khyil zhing rgyan yang 'khyol ba ste/ /sems kyi chos pas sku mi mnga'/ rnam parartog pa ma lus 'dul/ /ma rig 'joms pa'i tshangs pa ste/ /'dod chags zhe —239—

sdang dri mthar mdzad/ /sgyu ma khyab 'jug rdo rje car// /rtse gsum rtsegasum 'changa'aphrog pa/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che/ /srid dang srid min rnam sbyong ba//zhi zhing dul la dga' ba ste/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rab rtogs byed/ /rbangasargyas bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku/ /rdo rje rab skyes rdo rje sems/ /kun tu bzang po cher bzang po/ /mtshan rnams dam pas rab brgyan pa/ khams gsum bdaganyid khyab pa po/ /thams cad rdo rje bdag nyid gtsang / zhes mtshan bcu ga'adra tā lobastod/ 'di ni dngos su phyag na rdo rje la bstod pa yin la/ de nyid la dkyil 'khor gyi lta༅ 'dus pa'i don gyi bstod pa yin pas dkyil 'khor kun gyi bstod par 'gyur ba kho na'o/ /gnyis pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ bzlas pa mchod bstod nyer bsdu'o/ /dang po bzlas pa ni/ gtso 'bor rnams kyi thugs kar zla ba la rang sngags dang rtsa rig bkod/ snga ma rnams mi bzhed kyang dbus su rang rang gi sa bon bkod na legs so/ /lha rnams kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra dang thugs ke'i sngags 'bru las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snang bar byas/ ngan songarnams sbyangs/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/slar 'dus chos kyi yi ge so so la zhugs par gyur/ oX na mo bha gawa te/ sarba dun ti/ pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te sa myaklaX buddhā ya/ ta5 thā/oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne/ sarba pā paX bi shwa dha ni/ shudhe bi shu sle/ /sarba karma a wa raṇa bi 〈spre/ snya hā/ zhes pa nyid gtso bo rnam snang gi sngags yin yang lha thams cad kyi spyi sngags su'agyur ro/ / oX sarba bid sarba a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na skyoX swatwa zhes ye snying po ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kho na'i 'o/ /rtsa rig dang snying po de nyid gang —240—

mos pa wo ci nus su bzla wo /oX sarba bad hūX/zhes pa nas/oX badzra ā be sha ho'i rdesa' du 'a pa'i 'khor gyi sngags rnams kyang bdud ༷ sogs pa ri bu pa zhing ༷ re bzla'o//mtsho ༵ na/slar yang arghaX la she pa sngags tsam gya mchod pa ram khu/ nga /she taX ༷yi ma da na spri 0 ༷//spra spu las nges yan lag rgya mas bskyud//bstad dbyangs 'a 'jing po/ las//sa par she tyā ༷glang da 'a/da ༵ ra bsngi /kau she she ka nas 'a pa' 'ad zar gyas kyi rnal lo za/ta/dal ji / dzon khyordo gya zhabar la rang la tham/spyo pa'o//bdag bskyed rnal lorargyas par skyu///na na sto/rde/ 'a 'a 'i mu kri/gnyaX pa bum 'a na/cho ga nyan gcag pa' phyogs la/phyin cha tha bskyed sa rjes su byas na bzhi/ ༷ kyas/skabs 'dar byas na'ang 'gal ba 'a/de na chad gong ma' lag ༵ rnyu ba 'dar bya ste/dbang bum lnga/rnal rgyal bum pa gcag mchod bum bcu drug sogs ṇa //ra'os pa bshams/༷sdu na rnam ram̐X bum pa/༷bang bum/mchod bum ste gsus bsham mo/ she tu ༷sdu na rnam rgyal gcag pus kyang chag par 'dad la/las bum ri rdzoX na yang 'gal ba med mad kya/rgyud las gsal bar ma ༷༷/ngas 'a bzi//gan ༷rdelas ri/su bhā ga rdo ri sbyangs/stang sa shi ngang las padma dang zla ba gdan 'a bdu bhu 'a na po tsheX bum la pa she nga rgya che 'a she/lho/ pa kun spangs prong rma rtsa'i/ nyad thams cad yangs su rdzags pa lha rdzas kya gas kyas mgul ba dkras shang /dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i bdud rtsis gang 0re spro ste/ yi mi sdi pha/ 1do/pho re / sgro/baX nga du/'a sum 'a rtsa bdun gya gdan dang /'a bum (sa bshe gar/gas pa rags lnga' gdan rnams 2༵ gyur/dbus kya zla ba 'a dkyal zhabararde

gyi steng du/ oṃ las 'khor lo lko pa nas/ 'bar zhing 'phro ba'o/ /hūX las dbus kyi shar du thams cad rig pa sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ spyo pa nas/ rang ra pa gi phyagamatshan 'dzin pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol byang shar mtshams nas brtsams te/ skyoX las rdo rje sems dpa' nas/ dung chos 'dzin pa/ de dag gi phyi rol shar du nas/rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /lko pa'i bar gong bzhi bskyed/ rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaX ma lus sems can sogs kyi mthar/ pukhre sogs nyer spyod kyisngags tsam kho nas 'bul/ chong/ dbyings ye shes mkha' ltar khyab pa 'as// / thugs rje chen pos rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa/ /sbyang dka' 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ chal sgo/'di dag cho ga bsdud pa'i lugs yin pas rgyas btab mi dgos/ oṃ badzra aX gu sha dzwaXsog༅rdekyis dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya/ tseX( sbo ta sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ badzra a bhi khiñtsa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byed na bshad ma thag pa bzhin dang/rgyas pa byed na rten cing 'brel 'byung ma lta bu'i tshigs bcad dang sbyar zhing / 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ sogs sho lo ka lnga tsam gyi bstod/ rang gi snying gnasa'od zer 'phros gzungs thag la brten nas bum nang du song bas lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pas bum pa ye shes kyi chus gang bar gyur/ rnam rgyal la dmigs nas/ lha thams cad kyi sngags/bzla ste/ rtsa rig dang gtso bo'i snying po brgya rtsa sogs dang / 'khor rnams kyi gsum gsus sogs go /dbang bum la dmigs nas rtsa rig dang rigs lnga'i sngags/ mchod bum la dmigs nas rtsa rig—242—

bzla/ mdor bsdu na thams cad la rtsa rig kho na bzlas pas kyang chog go /mthar a bhi shing ka lta sngags kyang bzlas gong bzhin mchod bstod bsdus pa byas nas/ bum pa'i lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ dung chos kyi chu phul/ yig brgyal na gsum gyisabartan byed bya'o/ /spyir rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi bum pa la/ /lha bskyed mi dgos pa' pa yod mod sgyu /lha bskyed phyin sa bon las bskyed na legs pas de bzhin du sbyar la/ ci ste skad cig gis bskyed par 'dod na/ ye shes spyan 'dren dang / gnas gsum byin rlabs dang / dbang bskur rnams mi dgos so/ /bum bskyed mdo tsam bshad zin to/ /gsum pa mdun bskyed kyi cho ga ni/ spros pa la dga' na/ /mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor labagegs sbyang ba dang / til sbyang dang / khrus gse/pa sogs kyang bya/ /'on kyang nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor/ yaktas bsangs/ oX shu rgya ta ston badzra nas/ zla ba'i gdan re re'o/ /zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed skabs dang 'dra ba las/ gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa phyi nangarim pa gnyis yod pa/ phyi la lha snam rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ phyi rol 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug gis bskor ba/ gnyis ka'ang nang nas rim pa bzhin zhesaso/ /dbus kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oX las 'khore lo nas/ 'od zeradapag tu med pa 'bar zhing 'phro ba'o/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhinasbyong ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhi/ zhes pa nas/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phrog rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang —243—

sangs rgyas dang / gzhan yang dam tshig la yang dag par gnas shing/ dpalardorje sems dpa'i bka' 'bangs su gyur pa ji snyed pa thams cad badzra sa mā dzam lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur zhing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur bzhi /bcomaldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma sa /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnams sbyangs shing/ /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa/ khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus dza de lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabasasna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'iphyir/ /yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las/lhags zhi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drangs bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /cho se/ dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ /tshur byon tshur byon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyesamachoge thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /rmetha/rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ dza hū ba ho bha ga wān/ e hre hi/ mahwa kā ruṇi ka dri khyo ho bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag can bsod namasaskal par ldan/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la de gongs—244—

shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshuragashegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nasakyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta ga gan sam yi hūX/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni ye khrus gsal/ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ oX sa bo ta thugata a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūX/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu'aphrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchog pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta padma ka ma la ya stuX/ /zhing 'di'am rgya chen zhing gzhan na/ /lha rdzas me tog yid 'ong ba/ /chu dang thang las skyes pa rnams/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /lha la sogs pa'i dri yi rdzas/ /phyogs rnams kun na gang yod pa/ /sims byed yid 'ong ldan pa ni/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /phyogs dus kun na bdug spos ni/ /lha rdzasaspos kyi shing la sogs/ /dri zhim yid 'ong gang yod pa/ /thub dbang sras dngabacas la 'bul/ /'jig rten 'di'am phyogs rnams na/ /lha dang mil sogasardepa'i zas/ /yon tan kun ldan gang yin de/ /thub dbang la ni dbul b.rabagyi/ /'jig rten 'di'am phyogs bcu yi/ /rin che mar me la sogs pa/ /snang ba'i khyad par gang yod la/ /thub dbang sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /semasacan sdug bsngal sim byed pa/ sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig ces sogs kyang bya/ sngags dang phyag rgya byas te phul na yang legs so/ /tseX( badzra aX gu sha dzaX sogs bsgo —245—

ba bzhis dgug gzhug bcing mnyes byas te nang du bkug /las dang / tseX( badzra yakta/guX gyisaphyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad pa nas/ tu khri du shwe'i srung ba byas/ mgron thabs kyi lha rnamasagadan la 'khod par gyur pa ni/ gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i snam bu dang pol skalabazang gi sems dpa' bcu drug 'khod de/ shar du byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan dang mun pa nges par 'joms pa'i blo grosarnams rdo rje sems dpa' dang mtshungs pa/ lhor spos kyi glong po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog rnams rdo rje rin chen dang mtshus pa/nub tu 'od dpag med/ zla 'od bzang skyong / dra ba can gyi 'od rnams rdo rje chosadang mtshungs pa/ byang du rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegasapa/ kun tu bzang po rnams sku mdog ljang khu/ lhag ma rdorje las dang mtshungasapa'o/ /lha snam bar pa la nyan thos chen po bcu drug ni/ dga' bo sgra gcan 'dzin dang mchog gnyis so/ /rab 'byor 'char ka ma 'gags kun shes dang //nye 'khor rta dul kun dga' ba lang bdag /ming chen nor 'dzin gang po 'od srungs so/ /lha snam gsum pa la/ sgo'i thad ka bor ba'i gzhan rnams sa gdung sel snang ba brtsegs dang 'jigs pa med/ /dpa' 'dul shes rab mgyogs/chen ri bo'i rgyal/ /smra ba'i sgra gcan bse ru dug sel 'joms/ /rdzu 'phul cher ston yid 'gyu/ra seng ge'i sgra/ zhes te nyan rang gi mtshan ngos 'dzin 'di rnams rgya gar paṇachung dang bod rnying pa la yid brtan bcas pa tsam mo/ /sgo'i thad ka'i lha snam la shar du khro bo 'jig rten gsum snang / lhor 'jig rten gsum 'dul/ nub tu 'jig rten gsum 'chang / byang du 'jig rten —246—

gsum 'jig de bzhi rtsa phyag gis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas hu mdzad kyi phyag rgya can no/ /de dag gi g.yas phyogs su pho nya bzhi rim pas dbyug sngon can/ /migayo ba/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ rta mgrin rnams so/ /mngags pa bo ni ni khro bo rnams kyi g.yon phyogs su dus kyi srin po/ dus kyi dbyug pa ma/ dus mtshan ma/ dus kyi gnod sbyin ma'o/ /bran bzhi ni khro bo rnams kyi rgyab tu dus lcags kyu ma/ dus kyi zhags pa ma/ dus kyi lcags sgrog ma/ dus kyi dril bu tsharnams so/ /de rnams las ming gis gsal ba rnams rang ming gi phyag mtshan g.yas dang por yod pa/ yongs ye thams cad kyang sku mdog dang phyag mtshan mnges pa/ dbu phyag mtha' yas pa/ ma rungs pa'i rgyu ma 'dren zhing gdug pa can thams cad kyi snying ga nas zhabs kyis mnan zhing sdigs par mdzad pa/ khro bo pho mo'i cha byas yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ khyams kyi phyi rol 'jig rten pa'i 'borayug ser po la 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams 'khod pa ni/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor phyi rol du wo pa nas/ dur khrod grong khyer gnas pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs 'dir phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas gdab mi byed na/ skabs 'dir tse( sbo ta sogs kyis gnas gsum byin rlabs bya ste/ rgya bzhi yis lcogasan rung tsam ni yin no/ /'on kyang rgyas btab byed pa nyid bzang bas/ cho ga gzhan thams cad snga mdang 'dra'o/ /skal bzang gi sems dpa' man chad la byed na/ sems dpa' la sde tshan gcig /nyan thos la sde tshan gcig /rang rgyal sde tshan gcig /khro bo sogs la sde tshan gcig /'jig rten pa rnams la sde tshan gcig byed de/ dam rgya'i skabs dmigs bsal gyi skabs med pas/ rtsa rig lan gsum gsum brjod nas / spyi'i dam rgya 'cha' ba sogs gzhan rnams la'ang des rigs 'gre ba—247—

yin no//'on kyang mgron du byon pa yin gyi/rtsa ba'i lha ma yin zhing /dam tshig pa bskyed pa med pas/de dag la phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab ni mi dgos so//de lta mod kyi las bcol gyi skabs sāde rnams la'ang las 'tshol dgos pas des na 'di ltar bya ste/sa ma ya stu/sarba bid nas/sgo ma bzhis kyang spyo nas/sangs rgyas thob pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin de rjes su rtsa rig tshar gcig gam/bzhi 'am bcu drug ston te/byams/pa la sogs pa skal ba bzang po'i sems dpa' bcu drug gis kyang rtsa rig de dang 'dra/'phags pa dga' bo la sogs pa nyan thos dgra bcom chen po bcu drug gis kyang rtsa rig gcig gam bzhi rim bcu gnyis/gdung ba sel ba la jo gos pa 'phags pa rang rgyal bcu gnyis kyas kyang /yang rtsa rig gcig gam bzhi rim gcugardekhro bo bzhi pho nya bzhi/mngags pa bzhi/bran bzhi po dang bcas pa rnams kyisakyang de rnams kyi skabs spros pa la dga' na/bskyed chog gi skabs bzhin so so'i mtshan nasasmos te bya'o//yang rtsa rig lan gzhi'am brgyad dam/bsdu na gcig bzlas te/dkyil 'kho/ra chen po'i bka' 'khor du gnas pa'i sde brgyad mthu chen thams cad kyis kyang /rnala'abyor pa bdag cag sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i thabs la 'jug pa la gnas skabs kun tu bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang /yid la 'dod pa'i don thams cad 'grub pa dang /dge legs rgya chen po sgrub pa'i 'phrin lasamadzad du gsol/zhes 'phrin las gzhol/bzhi pa mchod gtor ni/de nas mchod pa rgya cherazug mas shing /gong gnas yo byin rlabs bzhin la/gnas khang gi bskyed chog bor bas byin gyisabarlabs/rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na//mchod yon ji snyed mchis/pa 248

dang / /bdag gi gus par bshams pa 'di/ /ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas///de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis/ ṣi bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang / /sems can don kun mdzad du ge sol/ osazata thā ga ta argha pratitsā pu dza me ghā sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hu/ de bzhin du/ shabha'i bar du rigs bsgres nas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te 'bul/ de nas mchod pa nyer lnga pa ni/dpag yas bsod nams stobs la byung ba yi/ /lha rdzas las grub zin chen cod pan mchog /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi/ /thugs rjes bzhes shig dngos grub stsal du gsol/ o sarba ta thā ga ta ratna mu ku di pra titsā pu dzamegha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hū/ gzhan thams cad de kho na ltar spyor lka /tshig rkang gnyis pa lha rdzas las grub sogs dang / sngags kyi ratna mu ku ṭa gi gnas su/ so so'i tshog dang ming sngagasabs ste/ rim bzhin sbyar ro/ /de yang / snyan shal mdzes byed rin chen 'khyil ba'i rgyan/ kunda la: mgrin pa dung 'dra mdzes byed mgul rgyan mchog hang : thugs ka'i dpa' be'u mdzes byed se mo do/ a wa hā ra: phyag gi dpung pa mdzes byed dpung rgyan mchog /ke yu ra: phyag gdub nor bu'i phra rgyan mdzes pa 'di/ gti ka ṭa ka yid 'ong sor gdub la sogs sna tshogs rgyan/ pa kab la: rdzu'aphrul zhabs kyi rgyan gyur rkang gdub 'di/ nā phu ra rin chen sa dugs mdzesagaser gyi yu ba can/ tstsha tra ka: mi mthun g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog dhwa dza: snyan grags phyogs bcur g.yo ba ba dan phan/ pa ta ga: yid 'phrog sna tshogs dar gyi lda ldi ni/ pa ṭa dā ma: gdung sel rnga yab nor ba'i yu ba can/ tsa ma ra mkha' dbyings mdzes par byed pa'i bla re 'di/ pi tan mi—249—

'jigs bzhi dang ldan pa'i seng ge'i khri/siṅgā sa na reg 'jam mi bde spangs9ri 'a 9ripa gzams cha'i tsho tshogs/'dal snga ma rnams sgrigs bzhad gdakyi sha ya ā sa na/sha ya sarba na zerayang skad dod rdo bcal ba—gas bzhad gad kya gnas so//des na/padmaX ga lko dra/྅sdo// she 'jijis mongs zur spangs khang bzhi bzang zlum po 'ad/pa maṇḍa la dhwa rguX rgyas pa' khang bzang dam pa gru ba— pa/a tshe ya tsa tu rā praX/khyad 'phags/gtsardebo'i khang 'a nyis brtsegs 'di/dī kuṭa ga 'ir rang 'a 'od gas wa byangasems zla ba 'a gdan/tsaṇḍa sa rnaX' gla slan tshogs byin : ra btadang brdetsho gos/putpaXrde sna tsho gos rten 'brel pa waX sgra snyan tsho gog— nāX rab tu dngab bskyed byed tshul khrims dri/gandhaX dga' dang shin tu sbyangs pa'i zhal/zasamachog/nai bi te ngo tsha khrel yod ldan pa lha yi gos/ba staX 'di dag gi sngags dang phyag rgya gang zag gis sbyar ba'i glo bur ba yin kyang /mchod pa'i ngo bo rnams rgyud 'dir sngon byung lo rgyus kyi i pa du ston pa la mchod pa'i skabs byung ba yin pas/'grel zhing legs pa'ang yin no//de nas/ rdorje sems dpa' bsdus pa ni/zhes sogs gong bzhin lha mo brgyan/bde bar gshegs pa thams cad sdu/'khor lo rin chen 'di 'bul bas chogs/rgyal srid sna bdun dang /kha dog dbyabs legs sogs 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa dang /gos zung 'bul tshul spyi dang mtshungs pas/lha re re bzhin gos zung 'bul ba yang spro na bya'o gzhan yang mchod pa nyi shu pa dang /nyer gcig pa dang /rig ma bcu drug pa la sogs pa'ang bya mo/ gri pa ris ye spros pa ches pa rang mi legs pas mtshams par bya'o//de nas bstod pa ni/cho se da—ngas/ye shes rnam par dag/rnam par snang hu 5 0 bcom ldan 'das//ting nge 'dzen

ldan phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal bcom ldan kun rig la'o/ /me long ye shes rang bzhin las/ /sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ /ngan song thams cad spyod mdzad pa/ /phyag 'tshal sbyong ba'i rgyal po la'o/ /mnyam nyid ye shes yon tan bdag /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen spyin/ /sems can bsam pa skong mdzad pa/ /rgyal mchog rin chen khyod phyag 'tshal/ /so sor kun rtog gsungagobadag/gsung rab padma kha rgyas pa/ khams gsum dbugs dbyung mdzad pa po/shākya rigs dbang khyod phyag 'tshal/ /nan tan ye shes 'phrin las bdag/sna tsho gos sems can sdug bsngal kun/ /ma lus pa ni zhi mdzad pa/ ྅rtag cher rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal/ /grwa yi phyogs ni kun tu yang / /rigs kyi yum bzhi'i skur bstan pa/ /lha mo spyan dang mā ma ki/ /dkar mo sgrol ma khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad na/ /bzhugs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /rdzu'aphul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams/ /rgyud bzhi bdag gis bstod par ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ rdorje dang po kun tu bzang / /phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la/ /rdo rje rgyal po sa pas rgyasamachog /rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin gshegs/ /nges pa'i rgyal po rdorje mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gugs khyod la/ /rdorje chags pa bde chen po/ /rdorje slad 'a ni dbang byed pa/ /bdud kyi 'dod pa rdo rje che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gzhu khyod la/ /rdo rje legs pa'i sems dpa' mchog /rdo rje mgu ba dga' ba che/ /rab dgesardo rje rgyal po mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dges khyod la/ /rdo rje rin wo rdo rje don/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i nor bu che/ /nam mkha' snying po rdorje phyug /phyag 'tshawa—251—

rdo rje snying khyod la/ /rdo rje gzi brjid cher 'bar ba/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i 'od//rdo rje 'od zer gzi brjid che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'od khyod la/ /sems ngo don rab rdo rje dpal/ /rdo rje rgyal mawo rab dga' byed/ /rdo rje wo po ji wo dpal/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dpal khyod la/ /rdo rje bzhad mob 'ad pa zhe /rdorje 'dzum pa ngo mtshar che/ /dga' zhing rab dga' rdo rje ston/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dga' ba la/ /rdorje chos rab de nyid don/ /rdo rje padma ra bdag 'a byed/ /le'i/rten dbang rab rdorje can/ /phyag 'tshal rdorje spyan khyod la/ rdo rje rno ba theg pa che/ /rdo rje ral gri mtshon chen po / /'jam dpal rdo rje rab tu zab/ /phyaga'atshal rdo rje blo khyod la/ /rdo rje rgyu dang snying po che/ rdo rje bro bor lo tshul zhi po/ /rab bskor rdo rje las byung ba/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying khyod la/ /rdorje gsungarab ri rab mchog /rdo rje zlos pa rab grub sbyin/ /mi gsung rdo rje mchen grub pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gsung khyod la/ /rdo rje las rab rdo rje dka'/ /las kyi rdorje kun rab sgrol/ /rdo rje nges pa rgya che ba/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje kun khyod la/ /rdorje srung ba brtan pa che/ /rdo rje go cha sra ba che/ /brtson 'grus mchog ni thub paradaka'/ /phyag 'tshal rdorje brtson 'grus la/ /rdo rje gnod spyin thabs chen po/ /rdo rje mche ba 'jigs pa che/ /bdud 'joms rdo rje mi bzad pa/ phyag 'tshalordorje drag po la/ /rdorje mtshams sbyor rab bsdus nyid/ /rdo rje 'ching ba tha ljakhobyed/ /rdorje khu tshur dam tshig mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje khu tshur la/ /rnam dag rdo rje thugs 'dzin ma/ /mi dmigs rdo rje ting 'dzin gnas/ /rdo rje sgeg yi rnakho'adzin ma/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gying ba la/ /rnam dag yon tan rdorje ste/ /yid —252—

bzhin rdo rje re ba skong / /rdo rje gzugs kyi tshul 'dzin ma/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'phreng ba la/ /rnam dag rdorje gsung mchog ma/ /rdo rje pi wa 'dzin pa'i tshul/ /rdo rje gsung mchog sgrogs pa'i don/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dbyangs mkhan la/ /rnam dag rdo rje las rab ste/ /las kyi rdo rje 'gro don mdzad/ /bdud 'dulardorje'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gar mkhan la/ /sprin bzhin rdorje bdugapa ma/ /tshim byed rdo rje dang ldan pas/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba'i tshul 'dzin ma/ /phyaga'atshal rdo rje bdug pa la/ /rdo rje mdzes pa'i gzugs 'dzin zhing / /rdorje tshetog 'thor ba'i tshul/ /byang chub yan lag me tog ste/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje me tog la/ /'od gsal rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /rdo rje spyan gyis ma rig sel/ /gsal byed rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdorje snang byed la/ /rdo rje wo dan bdud rtsi'i chu/ /rdo rje dri yis rnam rtog 'joms/ /rdo rje dag byed phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dri mchog la/ /rnam dag bskul byed rdorje'i don/ /rdorje sdud mdzad rdo rje don/ /rdo rje 'gugs mdzad phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshalardorje lcags kyu la/ /mi gtod rdo rje chos kyi don/ /rdo rje 'tho pa mi 'gyur don/ /'a mid mdzad rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje zhags pa la/ rdorje mi'agyur brtan pa'i bdag /rdo rje mgyogs byed glog bzhin myur/ /sgrog mdzad rdorje'i phyag rgya 'dzin/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje lcags sgrog la/ /rdo rje dbab pa brtan pa'i bdag /bskyod mdzad rdo rje kun kyi las/ /rdo rje dbab pa'i phyag rgya 'dzin//phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'bebs pa la/ /sgo yi khyams na bzhugs pa yi/ /byams pa lasogs bcu drug ni/ /rab dga' la sogs gnas mdzad pa'i/ /byang sems —253—

rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ ston pa'i rtag 'chang nyan thos mchog /lhung bzed mkhar sil po ti'i phyag /bslab sbyangs yon tan kun ldan pa'i/ /nyan thosarnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rten 'brel don la brtan gnas pa zhi /'phags/pa rang rgyal bcu gnyis ni/ /'byung dang zlog la rab bzhugs pa/ /rang rgyal gtsol phyag 'tshal bstod/ /khro bo srin po'i cha lugs can/ /sprul dang mi sdugamagos brgyan pa/ /stag lpags kyis ni rnam dkris pa/ /'jig rten gsum/snangasogs phyag 'tshal/ /phyi yi khor yug la gnas pa'i/ /'jigs byed lha klugaza' skar dang / /phyogs skyong rgyal chen phyag 'tshal zhing / /'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyi/ bstod pa 'di ni da ltar thams cad la grags pas 'dir bkod do/ /rdze'i sems dpa' bcu drug gi bstod pa ni/ de nyid bsdus pa la 'byung ba'i gtso bo'i mtshan brgya yin pas shin tu bzang shing gal che la/ /rigs lnga yum bzhi sgo skyong rnams paṇḍi ta dran pa ye shes kyi brtsams par grags pa de'i nang gi tshig yin zhing / skal bzang man chad la bstod pa de ni re re bzhin sbyar ba'i rgyas pa zhig 'dug la/ bod kyi cho ga mkhan po rnying pa 'gas bsdus te 'di brtsamasapar snang ngo / /des na rgyal ba'i bka' dang / 'phags yul gyi shing rta chen pos mdzad pa rnams ma gtogs/ gsar du sbyar ba rnams la ji ltar 'os pa la nges pa can gyi rkang tshugs mi dgos so/ /de nas gtor ma btang ba ni/ dkyil 'khor khang pa nyid dam phyi rol du gtong yang rung ste gtor ma chagasum/ rigs drug dang / yi dwags kyi gtor ma rnams mchod par bcas pa bshams/ chagasum gtor ma btang / de rjes byin rlabs 'dra/ de bzhin gshe gas pa rin chen mang la phyaga'atshal lo/ /gzugs dam pa la: sku 'byams klas la: de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na ma sarba ta thā gtawa / —254—

wa lo ki te oX sambha ra sambha ra huX/ni gsum/mchod sbyin gyi ge tor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa 'di/rigs drug gi sems can thams cad laspyin no//'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde ba phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur cig/yang de bzhin du kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyi bsngo ba yan chad 'dra ba las/rigs drug gi zhes pa'i tshab tu yi dwags kyi 'gro( ba thams cad la zhes pa 'gyu//dedagani rigs drug dang yi dwags la gtor ma sbyin pa'o//'di dag phyi rol gtor ma tshul du byed na/phyogs skyong dang 'byung po'i gtor ma song mtshams su/rigs drug dang yi dwags kyi gtor ma sbyin/de nas bgegs gtor btang /mtshams bcad ma thag nang du ldog pa lag len 'dug pa stabs/bde ba'i phyir du snang mod/de ltar yang rung ste/'jig rten pa rnams gtor mas mchod pho tshul lo//de dag gi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga bstan zin to//lnga pa bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/de la dang por dkyil 'khor du 'jug palkasdoms na/gsol btab rgyun zug gas sems bskyed sdom bzung dang /byin rlabs gnyis dang smon lam chos po skad dang //srung dang gdong g.yogs 'jug dang ye shes dbab//brtan byed tshe togador bcings mig dar dbye//lta bar bskul dang lha ngo bstan pa dang //dam tshig bskyed dang ba ho byed dam tshig bsgrags//sdom pa bsgrags pa zhes te nyer gnyis so//zhes blo la bzhag na/don tshan sil bu rnams mi 'dzings par 'gyur ro//dang po gsol btab ni/dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste//slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol//byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa//mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo//dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol//byang chub sems kyangabadag la stsol//sangs rgyas chos daX 5rdu 'dun te//skyabs gsum dag kyang

bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhugatu gsol/ lan gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag med bdag gis sogs lan gsum/ gsum pa ni/ sa ma ya a/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje rtse lnga paragyur/ rdo rjes reg ste/ su ra te sa ma ya stu/ ho sid dhi badzra ya thu su kha/ pe kho ni/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun sogs/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung tshar gsum/lngapa ni/ o za ta sogs rigs gsum spyi'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ drug pa byin rlabasaganyis pa ni/ oṃ badzra a khyu tiṣṭha dzñā na sa ma ye hu/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje khu tshuganyis ba sbyar ba gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis su reg go / snying ga lkog ma kha dang dpral ba dang/ /mdzod spru rna ba 'tshogs ma spyi gtsug dang / /dpung pa sna dang sked pa pusamobol/ /long bu sna rtsa mig dang gsang ba'o/ /bdun pa ni/ bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis/ /'o jigarten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston bgyid cing / /sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol/ 'dra pa ni/'jigarten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum ba ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na ni resa'aga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshuwa'abyung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis sems can mnyam med don//bla med byed par nus pa yin/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma sa /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par yi 'gyur na na/grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas na smos ci dgose/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas nas ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang—256—

gis spyod pa mchogos 'di la//blo tre1sa shin tu mi g.yo na//sdug bsngal thamasacad 'byu 1 pa'i ba ya//ngan 'gro de ya dro ring par 'gyur/sa/bdag nyid rṣa po go rnams kyas/sa/rnyed pa mnyam 'a de sang rnyed//gang di 9 rgyal ba sras bcan(pa//bdag nyad chen po kun gyas na//bstan pa 'a la khyed rnams kun//yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa//de phyir khyed rnams theg wo khyu/sad ni gra tu skye bar 'gyur//theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i//lam mchog 'di ni dpaladang ldan/khyed rnams der ni dong bas ni//rang byung skal pa wo po pa//'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi//de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/da yipabagegs bskrad cing bsrung ba ni/khro bo me ltar 'bar ba'i lti/ rgya spyi bor gtugs te/oX badzrasatwa kro dha sogs lan gsum brjod/bcu pa ni/ā khaX bā ra huX gis mig dar bcings/cwa gcig pa ni/badzra a dhi tiṣṭha huX/rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas me tog bzung lka oXbadzra samāya hūX/zhes dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi nas zhes/zhed ku rmi 9 5 khu / khe tshos gyi dus skabs 'dir yolab bsal/bcu gnyis pa ni/a las byung ba 'a da—la 'khore gya lteb thugs/karardezla ba la rdo rje'i dbus su as mtshan pa/rang nyid huX las gtso bo'i skur gsalardeba'i snying gar hūX las rdo rje/dpral bar truX las rin chen/lkog mar hrīXlasapadma/spyi bor kaX las sna tshogs rdo rje'o//de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyisabyin gyis rlobs la/dpal rdorje sems dpa' bdag la 'bab par gyur/ni gsum/lkoX badzra ud gha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūX/slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i rde.a yig las a yig dpag tu med par byung //rang go snying ga'i rdo rje'i ltebarathim/'od zer gyis lus gang /spro 2 5 rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis/su

med pa'i ye shes huX yig gi rnam par char ltar babs/ bdag gi lus la thim/oX badzra pra be sha ya huX/ mang du brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya/ bcu gsum pa ni/spyi bo re rdo rjergyagram du bzhag la/ tseX( a sa me tri mahā sa ma ya hūX/bcu bzhi pa ni/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag la thugasabartser dgongs nas ni/ /'gro la phan phyir gtso chen gyis/ /sman par dgongasate bzhes su gsol/ oX pra ti grihā twaX/ zhes me tog dor/ bco lnga pa ni/ oX pra stusmo badzra sa ma ya stuX/ me tog rang spo slob ma'i mgo la chang / bcu drug pa ni/ oX rdorje sems/dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ oX badzra hā gya ud gha ṭa ya skyoX stsobadun pa ni/ lkoX badzra pa khyo hoX zhes dkyil 'khor la lta bar bskul/ bco brgyad pa ni/bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ slob ma dbang bskur la skabs 'dir bdag bskyed ltar lha ngo rgyas par bstan no/ /bstodagu pa ni/ tseX( badzra sam ya hūX/ zhes rdzo mang du brjod/ snying gar rdo rje 'bar ba gnas par gyur/ lha rnams kyi dam tshig gis byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ nyi shu pa ni rdo rje snying gar 4ga lka oX badzra sa ma ya hri da ya me/ pra be sha dri ṭa ho tiṣṭha hūX phaṭa/ nyeb༈yo/waṃ/du cos kyi chu'am rnam rgyal gyi chu nas cung zad 'thungs/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshigarde'adas na bsreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni/ rdo/ rje 'dud rtsi'i chu 'dis thob/ /ci ste dam tshig bzlas na ni/ /de ma thag tu bkas nasagashags/ /rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang / /bdun brgyud rigs rnams—258—

brlag par byed//de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyis//rgyal bas gsung pa'i dam tshig/dang //sdom pa dang ni bla mas bka'//shin tu mos pas srung bar bya/lhol spyo5rdepa ni/khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya//ma byin par yang blang mi bya//brdzun dang 'dod la spyod pa rnams//dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba min//chang ni btupabar mi bya zhing //sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya//sems can gnod pa'i sbyor ba ni/nam yang bya ba ma yin no//dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spang//dusakun tu ni byang chub sems//snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang //lha dang gla ma de bzhin no//sdig la sogs pa gang yin dang //bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya//lha la phul ba'i rnying ma dang / /de yi grib ma'ang 'gom mi bya//phyag rgya'i gzugs la'ang de bzhin no//sngags dang lha la smad bya//gdon gyisalasogs bya ba min/mu stegs can la smad mi bya/mdor na yid gnyis/the tsho memibya ste/bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no//zhes te/de rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa bstan zin to//dngos gzhi'i don du maṇḍal phul/slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugasaka nas/sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung zhal nas thon/rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs te snying gar thim/rje zlos byas par mos te rtsa rig ni gsum/bcom ldan bdag la stsalalags kyi//bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol//bcom ldan 'di la stsalalags kyi//'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol//sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol//brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/mgo thog tu rdorje bzungal/o na mo sogs rtsa rig dang /o sarba bid sarba a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hū29

phaṭa/oX sarba bid huX/lkoX sarba bid phaṭa/osarba bid a//chasarba bid traṭa:sprorde :)/ skyo⑥ rde :be/ i rna blu trid/rderde skye yi :trid/rderde.oX sarba da oX/oX sarba da snyu/ sarba da a/ sarba/rde khyuX snyi /nyu 3 ⑥ rderderdetraṭa/oX sha oXbha/dzi brjod/sngags dbang ngo //snroX 'a rtse ge ye ge a da /ṭāX 'a kri la sha a snye kho huX/ltiX phri ka la ri myo bha kho hāX/oXbakra shis bu rma bha khur hruX.oX karma ka la sha she ṣañtsa a//na wo mdzes pa bsri sa bu me ga rnatshaṭā 'das//skal ldan skyes bu khyad la sa sa na//las ye tī 4sasgrab pa kun dag ste/bhi/'a chub ༵mas kya smo gyas ༵tshe zang rdo par (ra/sa la'i rdedabang ngo /sa/snroX 'a a ṣañtsa khamaX/sas a bha ṣañtsa ṇa hāX/ ratna a bha ṣañtsa ṇaX/oX padma a bha ṣañtsa hruXltiX karma a bha ṣañtsa a/lko rigs lnga'i phyag rgyas mgos gsas/rdeskabs su ༷di/ na 'a rgyan ༷si ngo //sa she 'i skyeshe da bzhan gzhags pa' dbu rgyan 'a ༷das//skal sngi te / ris la yi ri/nga bskur bas//sku gsung thugs kya yan tan rab rdzags//gas lnga' sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog/rin wo 'phreng ba 'ching sdu/'di ge cha cheX'i ༷phyagaX rgyaX rna rti wo nas dzes rtsa ༷ ba~X kyi lngo lnga da/gāX ratna mā la a bha tī truX tru tru tru tru/shen mas pa' tag 'phrang ba sa she/skalas baXdzi pa myang mis sbyar ba khams gsum gnas//mdzes pa' yon to phun sumatshagasardegyur cag dar ༵pyangs dngos sam/rdo rje /ra tshur zhes snging mdzub brkyang dhi da~X dgyasarde'aching snrol byed/ brngo pas a wa laX ba na a bha ṣañtsa hruX/mdzes ngad 'ongadar gya spyo pan ༵sa//skal ldan ye ḍi she la dbang bskur bas/khres bya kun la thags pa da pa dang //'a/ ༷ dan la mthu dang ldan par glor

dpyangs kyi dbang ngo / /rdo rje'am rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan lag tu blang ngo / /oṃ buddhā mu dra a bhi khiñtsa oX/ oṃ badzra mu dra a bhi ṣi3ni huX/ oX ratna mu du a bhi ski nyu shrīX/ oX padma mu dra a bhi khri nyu sdiX oX karma mu dra a bhi khiñtsa a// rigs/lnga'i phyag rgya lag tu gtad nas ni/ skal ldan: sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te/ /ye shes lnga ni rab tu rtogs par shog /phyag mtshan gyi dbartso/ phyagamatshan dang cas pa'i dril bu spyi bo sogs dbang gi gnas lngar dkrol la/ lkoX budha nā ma a bhi khiñtsa oX/ oX badzra nā ma a sgyi ṣañtsa huX/ oX ratna na ma a bhi khiñtsa truX/ oX padma nā ma a bhi khiñtsa sdiX oX karma nā ma a bhi ṣañtsa a/ kun rdzob mtshan nyid mtshan mchingagyidabang / /skal ldan: ma 'ongs 'jig rten sangs rgyas zhing khams su/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gyi ming thob shog /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshe/gas pa'o/ /ming dbang ngo / /sna tshogs rdo rje bzung la/ lkoX badzra karma a dzhaikhri nyu aX rdorje rgya gram lag tu gtad nas ni/ skal ldan 'phrin las rnawabardzis 'gro don mthar phyin nas/ /las kyi rigs kyi dngos grub thob par shoga'aphrin las kyi dbang ngo / /'khor lo bang la/ lkoX badzra tsakra a bhi 'a ṣañtsa huX bhāX/ yon tan rab rdzogs gser gyi 'khor lo 'dis/ /skal ldan: rnam par phreng mdzad sku mgo rab thob ste/ /i kyi snyen ra lo myur du bskor bar shog /i kyi lor tsho dbang ngo / /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi snyen ra lo wo tu bskor/ oXbudha tsakra a dhi pa ti stuX a bhi khiñtsa oX oX oX/ chos kyi gnas su/rdo sgob oX badzratsakra a dhi pa ti stuX a bhi khri myu huX hūX huX/ rin chen: oX ratna tsakra a dhi pa ti stuX a —261—

bhi khri myu truX truX truX/ padma'i: oṃ padma tsakra a dhi pa ti stuX a bhi ṣi4 dhīXsgyiXrnyiX las:oṃ karma tsakra a dhi pa ti stuX a bhi khri4te a a a/ rigs lnga'i bdag po yi ni rangabazhin gyis/ skal ldan: rdo rje sems dpa' rigs rnams kun gyi bdag/rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun kyi bdag por shog /bdag po'i dbang rga /tsi rdzo phyag mtshan spyi bo sogs gnas lngar gshugs pa'am/ lag tu bzung nas/ tseX( brnya dha ra ṇa a bhi khiñtsa oṃ/ oX badzra dha ra ṇa a bhi ṣañtsa huX/ oX ratna dha ra ṇa a bhi khi ྅ traX/ oX padma dha ra ṇa a bhi khiñtsa hiX lkoX karma dha ra ṇa a bhi khiñtsa a/ yum lnga'i phyag rgya lagatugatad nas ni/ skal ldan: gsang rgyud mtha' dag shes shing rtogs nas kyang / /'chad cing ston pa'i dbang dang ldan par shog /gzungs kyi dbang ngo/ /rmis rdzo shimatshan spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar reg cing / oṃ buddhā gu phya a bhi sa ṣañtsa oX/ oX badzraguphya a bhi khri shā mi huX/ oX ratna gu hra a bhi khri'u ji truX/ lkoX padma gu phya a bhi khri nyu sdi ༷༷ oX karma gu phya a bhi khiñtsa a/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya gnas lngar gtug/sa nas ni/ /skalaldan: ye shes lnga yi yon tan rab rdzogs te/ /byang sems gsang ba'i dbangadang ldan par shog /sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa rtogasarte'agyur pa/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / /de ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs/ de kho na nyid bcu la sogs pa slob dpon gyi las mtha' dag bsgrub par bya'o/ /gsang ba'i dbang ngo / /de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyi/ /phyag na rdorje nga yin gyi/ /nga yisadziltar bsgo ba bzhin/ khyod kyis de ltar bya dgos so/ /rdor dril bsnol te bzung / oX pra dzñā ud pa ya sa ma yo ga a ghi ṣañtsa huX a/thabs shes spyor ba'i dbang ngo / /oṃ tsakra ratna a bhi tiñtsa rte hāX/ dus gsum rgyal bas—262—

bskor ba'i snyen ra lo 'di//mi khom rgyun gcod rgyu dang 'bras bu wo//zhanaldelos bsgyur ba'i dbang phyug rin po che//bla med 'khor lo dam pa bskor gyuracig/oX ma ṇi ratna a bhi khiñtsa huX/dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan zin po che//'khor ba'i mun sel bde ba'i snying po 'byung //dgos pa mchog spyin nor bdun phun sum tshogs//yid bzhi nor bu rin chen spyod par shog/oX bā sti ni ratna a bhi khri myu huX/pha rol phyin bcus sems can skyod pa'i phyir//shes wo togasa'adzin btsun mo rin po che//bsdu ba rnam bzhi tshad med bzhi po yis//tshe dang longs spyod gter la spyod par shog/oX mahā sti ratna a bhi khiñtsa huX/gang la ci dgos dpag bsam shing lta bu//'gro la snying brtses tshogs gnyis rdzogs/pa dang //dbang phyug btsun pa blon po rin po che//'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyalathabs thob par shog oX hasti ratna a bhi rdzi myu huX/theg pa don dam bla med ston pa'i mchog/yan lag bdun mdzes ku mu ta yi mchog/gdul dka' stobasachen glang po rin po che/khyu mchog rlabs chen stobs lnga rdzogs par shog/oXturāX ga ratna a bhi khri myu huX/'khor ba'i chu bo 'jigs pa bzhi las sgrol//brtson 'grus myur ba'i rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis bskyod//cang shes sprin kyi shugs can rin po che//mi gnas ye shes yid bzhin spyod par shog/oṃ kha ṅga ratna a bhi sne 4lha jirikhrin hūX/gnod pa'i dpung 'joms brtson 'grus go bgos shang // gsapa'i skyabs byed 'gro la mi 'jigs spyin//thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i dmag dpon ni//mthu stobs rdzu 'phyul dpung gis bsrung bar shog zhesaparnams spros pa la dga' na bya/yang na sngags baX gyi mthar/'khor ra los bsgyur rgyal rin

mas 'a shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha gsung 'ab / ma/chen sna bdun ni/skal ldan byang chub yan lag rin chen bdun the bo nag/rig 'dzin 'khor los bsgyur ba'i gco bor shog/ces pa tsam brjod na'ang los te/rin chen bdun kar sdoms pa dbang gcig kho na yin pas/snga ma rnams dang rgyas bsdus mtshungasardepar 'gyur ba'i phan yon yod do//bum pa'i dbang nas brtsams te//'di'i bar gyi smon lam gyi tshigs bcad rnams spros pal dga' ba'i don zhi khro 'dra dpe blangs pa rnying ma ba'i lugs su 'dug cing /gong ma rnams phalacher de dang de'i rjes su tshig lhug pa'i gyur shog re yang mdzad par 'dug ste/blo chung rnams kyi blogros gron du 'gyur ba'i phyir 'dir bkod pa tsam 'tsham la//spyir ni sngags dbang kho nas go rdzo cing /byin rlabs kyang de ngos che bar 'ong ngo //rin rsā bdun gyi dbang ngo //rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug nas//thams cad byas shing kun zosakyang //'gru/ba 'gyur nyes pa'i mi gos na//snying rje ldan pa smos ci dgos/oXsarba ta tha ga ta ā dzñā bya dā gya mi/gro hā badzra su sirnyi ye/oX bsgoṣṭha phoXkhyo de kyis sems can gyi don rgya cher spyod cig bka'i dbang ngo //de dag ni dang mi thosagazhi'o//de nas rjes su gdams pa ni/tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang //'jig rten phyi ma'i bde mchog dang //sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob 'gyur na//lha yi bde ba smosaci dgos//sangs rgyas kun dang bla mar mnyam//rdo rje slob dpon brnyas na ni//rtag tu sdug bsngal thob 'gyu/ra bas//slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya//rdorje sbun dang sring mo dang /rdo rje ma rnams nyid la ni//rnal 'byor can gyis brnyasamibya//rtag tu 'khozhe dang gcugs mi bya//dkon mchog/ gsum la gnon byed na//bzod pa sgom par mi bya ste/// ༷ smod brtson ma rungs dang //dam tshig

'ilas na 'da' ba dang //de sogs byed pa tshar bcad na//'grus 'gyur zhes/ni kun rig gsung //sems can kun la snying rjes chags//bsgrubs na myur du 'gru/ba par 'gyu/ra/zhes so/gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal1 pa/sogs dag gtangarag gi maṇḍal phul/deng nas brtsams ta sogs brjod/spra na/nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/zhes sogs dam tshig gsum gyi glu yang blangs/de rjes/bdag nyid rdo rje shes dpar gyur pa/dkyil 'khor gyi lha rigs lnga dang rnam pa tha dad kyang ngo bo gcag par mos/lkoX badzra dha ra/ratna dha ra padma dha ra/bi shwa dhar sarba ta thāg ta sa ma ya ma ti kra ma ti/ta thā ga ta dha ra sa ma yo ra haX/zhes ye sngags lan mang du brjod cing rdor sems kyi nga rgyal la gnas par bya'o//'di glob ma dbang bskur ram/gshin po'i sgrib sbyong gi bya ba la 'jug pa'i skabs su gtso bor 4zhad pa yin mod kyi//cho ga'i yan lag chad par mi 'gyur ba'i dgos pa dang /dbang bskur blang zin pa'i 'bras bur yang snang ba'i phyir/bdag 'jug gi 'jug tu yang nges par bya'o//bdag 'jug mi len na yang sgrub mchod kyi mthar 'di bsgom dgos la/kha cig sngags dbang dang /gnas gsum byin rlabs da bsrung bgasum po'ang byed zer de/nges par dgos pa ma yin no//slob ma la dbang bskur na'ang skabs 'dir byed cing /skyon po'i don du lho sgo'i bya brnams kyang skabs 'dir sgrub pa yin no//de nas rjes chog ni//mchod pa rnying pa yod na kha gso/gsar pa bshams/bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/spyir dkyil 'khokhro gyi lha tshogasathams cad dang /khyad par du sngags rgyud kyi bdag po phyag na rdo rje nyid lha thams cad la khyab pa'i tshul gyi bzhugs pa dang /khyad par rdo rje sems dpa' nyid der mos pa la/mchod bstod byas parabasams la/gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyaX rdo yi//lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon

'di//mchog tu dad pas 'bul lags kyi//ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol//o sarba ta thā ga ta argha/gong sgrub mchod kyi skabs bzhin/chu dang thang las skyes pa yi//me tog dam pa 'di dag ni//mchog tu dad pas khyed la 'bul/khyi bde bar purdze lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi//bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni//mchogo tu gus pas khyed la 'bul/tsi bde ba badzra dhu pe mun pa'i sdugabasngal 'joms byed cing //phyogs kun gsal byed mar me 'di//kun mkhyen ye shes stsol bya'i phyir/ci bde bar badzra ā lo ke sbyar las byung dang lhan cig skyes//dri zhim mchod pa 'di dag ni//rang byung nyid la 'bul lags kyi//kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol/badzra ga rje kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i//bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan//thams cad sbyar ba'i bshese 'di dag/chos dbyings ye shes brnyes la 'bul badzra nai bi te bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston zhing //shes rab mchog gi rjes 'gro ral mo'i sgra//bdud kyi wologazhoms phyir dbul bar bgyi//don dam dbyings la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhesashig/shabha de rjes snyod pa 'gro ba rgyud lnga ma dang /sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas sogs/phyag na rdo rje'i bstod pas bstod//rjes chog gi skabs 'dir 4wo brgyas stod na//sngon byung bya rgyud gsungs tshul dang mthun pas shin tu legs go/bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyang ba dang //mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gso le/spro na gas yang gsol btab ji ltar 'os pa bya/bdag bskyed mdun bskyed kyi phyag rgya rnams dus gcig tu 'grol zhing /bus bskyed 266

la'ang phyag rgya bzhis rgyas rdo/rdeb na/mnyam du 'grol/sa ma ya stuX/zhes/ gtso bo'i dmargyabacas la/rtsa rig gsum/ badzra muXzhes se gol gtogs sngar bcings pa'i phyag rgya dkrolkade bzhi du rtsa rig gi ra tu oṃ sarba bid huX la ji /ra bas phyag rgya dkrol bar bya ste/mtharas ma ya stuX/rdo rje 'bebs pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ badzra ā be sha ho / ༷lan gsum badzramuXzhes se gol gtogs pas dkrol ba'i bar du'o//phyi rol gyi lha rnams la phyag rgyas ma btab pas dkrol rgyu med la/lha gzhan rnams la 'angadam rgya dkrol ba nyid kyis phyag rgya thams cad dkrol ba yin pas phyag rgya gzhan rnams la mi dgos so//de nas yi ge brgya pa shka gsum la sogs pa 'a/ma 'byor ra pa dang jo gos/gangayang bdag blo gti mug pas//legs dpyad 'ad la nyes byas snang//gang phyiralus can skyabs gyur pa//mgon khyod de kun bzod mdzad gas//gtso bo/ nus pa ma mchis pas//ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang ba//'dir ni bgyi ba gangabagyis rnams//gang yang de dag bzod par mdzod/gzha yang nongs pa sgod wogasol ba ji ltar 'os pa'ang spro na bya/ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor yin na de dang /gas yang tshe gyi pa yod na brtan bzhugs spyi dang mthun par bya/oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad nas/muXzhes pa ga gsum gyis rdulasto gyi dkyil 'khor yin na dkyil 'khorabadang /gzhan yang bdag bskyed dang /bum pa'i ye shes pa dang /mgron gyi tshogs rnams gshegasardesu gsol/ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa//sangs rgyas phyag 'tshaladeng 'dir bde legs shog/sems can gang dwag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba//de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog/zha ba chags bral chos la sems can de dag tshogs mcho/ 6/ma pa dge 'dun sems can sgro de

dag: de la sogs pa bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ji ltar 'os pa brjod cing / dza ya dza ya zhe༅rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /de dag gis ni thams cad kyi thun mong du gyur pa rtsa ba'i cho ga rnams bstan no/ /da ni tshe 'das kyi sdig pa spyong ba phyir zlog gi cho ga bshad de/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su stegs bu'i steng du padma 'dab brgyad bri/ der mi byang sogs rten bzhag /brab rdzas bye mdang yu7sa kar sogs la bzlas pa'i skabs su yang sngags kyis brabs/ sgos su yang sngags mang du bzla sbyangachas sogs 'og tu dgos pa rnams tshang bar byas la/ cho ga'i rim pa ni/ bgegs bsgrad rtenabaskyed rnam shes dgug /sdig pa dral zhing sngags kyis brab/ khrus bya dug sbyang skyabs 'gro dag /dbang bskur rdzas gtang phung po sbyang / /lam sbyang lam bstan mchod 'bul dang / /ched bro rjod rang gnas spar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mtheb kyu bskor la/ tsho( sarba bu snyan na ma sarba sogs/ gsum gyisazhibs sbyangs/ ting lo chad bur bcas pa bskor zhing / hu/ bzhi pa gsum gyis zhi drag phyed mar sbyangs/ khro bo spyan 'dren nas/ dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod kyi bar spro na drag roladang4sa te yang bya/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi dgo'adun gyi: gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi: bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba la las kyi dbang gis 'chi kha dang / bar do dang / tshe rabs g.yin thams/cad du gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang / sdig pa sbyong zhing dge ba'i chos bskyed pa las bar du gcod par byed pa dang / 'brel pa can shul na gnas pa laganod —268—

cing 'tshe bar byed pa la sogs pa/ gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gnod sems zhi zhing / dge ba'i sems dang ldan pas dmigs yul bsgrub bya 'di'i than 'khor du ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /gal te mi 'gro na/ ye shes kyi rdo rje 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas pa bya'o/ /zhes gtor ma dor/ rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/ sbyang rṣa laphyogs bcur yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug ste drag po'i sbyang ba'o/ lta ltes pa ni/rtenade nyid yaktas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yi ge ṇiXlas tshe 'das che ge mo zhes bya ba/ gson po'i dus kyi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ sga༅la ni/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ gong bzhin las bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ tshe 'das che ge mo zhes bya ba/ khams gsum gang na gnas shing rigs drug gang du skyes sam/ skye gnas bzhi gang gi bsdus te 'dug kyang / skad cig thang cig yud tsam 'di nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig ces ni gsum stsod/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba pā paX ā na ya huX/ zhes pas de'i sdig pa rnams kyang bkug par bsam/ bzhi pe ne/dral ba'i phyag rgya dang / lkoX badzra pā ṇi bi spo ta sarba a pā ya banta ni pra mokta ya/ sarba a pā ya ga ti khyuXsarba satwaX sarba ta thā ga ta badzra sa ma ya traṭa/ gsum/ tseXte / sarba bid sarba pā paX bi shodha ni huX phaṭa/ ces pas sdig pa sbyangs/ oX sa bo bid thog/ sogasakyis ngan song sbyangs/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang / badzra a dhi tidzi'i sngags kyis ba nas nyeraganyis byin rlabs gong du sand pa bzhin byas/ rnam par shes pa a yig dkar poragyur/ lnga pa ni/ oṃ sarba pā paX da ha na badzra hūX phaṭa/ chasarba a pa ya bi sho/ dha na badzrahuX phaṭa/ oṃ sarba karma a ba ra ṇa ni bhasmi ku ru huX phaṭa/ lkoX khriX bi na sha ya ā ba ra—269—

ṇa ni badzra huX phaṭa/ oṃ druX bi sho dha ya a ba ra ṇa ni huX phaṭa/ oṃ tshwal dzol dha ka dha ka ha na ha na ā ba ra ṇa ni huX phaṭa/ oX sruX sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra sarba a ba ra ṇa ni hūX phaṭa/ oṃ hūX ha ra a ba ra ṇa ni hūX phaṭa/ oṃ huX phaṭa sam ā ba raṇa ni bi hpho ṭa ya hūX phaṭa/ oṃ bi dra ba bi dra ba sarba a pa ya/ ta ta to na ni huX phaṭa/ oXd ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tu na huX phaṭa/ lkoX pa tsa pa tsa sarba pra te ka gte hetu na hūX phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tirla kka te he tu na huX phaṭa/ ces pa rnams bzla zhingabrab rdzas kyis brab/ drug pa ni/ lag len spros pa la dga' na/ dkyil 'khor la khrus gsol byas te de'i bum chus ming byang la khrus byed/ bsdu na dkyil 'khor la khrus gsol ma byas kyang chog /ming byang gi gzugs bas me long la shar ba la bkru zhing / 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing / sogs/ phar phyin drug gi tshigs par re re'i mthar rtsarig brjod cing bkru/ spro na/ chu bo drug gi khrus byas pas sogs kyang bya/ 'dun pa ni/ bu5chunas sbyang rten la ca zad 'thor zhing / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug ste/ /'di dag 'jigarten dug gsum yin/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyasabaden pas dug bcom mo/ / de bzhi du/ dam chos bden pa yo dge 'dun bden pas: sa 'di dug gi pha yin te/ /sa 'di dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis/ /dus gsum sa yin nang du song / de bzhi du chu me rlung la'ang sbyar/ de nas spro na/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa sogs/yang༅pe pho grong khyeradu 'jug pa'i mdo las 'byung ba'i shis brjod kyang mdzad pa'i srol 'dug pa ltar bya/ bsdu na slabyas kyang chog go /brgyad pa ni/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /'gro ba'i skyob pa'i don brtson pa/ /stobs chen 'jigs pa che sel la/ /tshe 'das skyabs sumachi—270—

lags so/ /de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang / /de bzhin tshe 'das skyabasasumachi/ /tshe 'das 'jigs pas rnam skrag ste/ /kun du bzang la bdaganyid 'bul/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la tshe 'das kyis/ /lus 'di bdags dbulabar bgyi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i/ /sbyan ras gzigs mgon de layang / /nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod/ sdig ldan 'di la skyabs su gsol/ /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang / /sa yi snying po dag dang ni/ /thugs rje tshemagon thams cad la/ /skyabs 'tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod/ /gang zhig mthong na gzhin rje yi/ /pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams/ /skrag nas phyogs bzhina'abyer byed pa/ /rdorje can la skyabs su mchi/ /sngon chad khyod kyi bka' lasa'adas/ /da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas/ khyed la skyabs su mchil gas kyi/ /'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs pas1/'debs su gzhug /dgu pa ni/ gal te dbang mi bskur na/ skabs 'dir lam sbyang bstan byed lkadabang bskur byed na'ang skabs 'di nyid du byed de/ dga' chen khyod bdag /sogs kyisagasol ba 'debs pa nas/ bsgrubs na myur du 'gru/ba par 'gyu/ra/ zhes pa'i bdag 'as/gi skabs bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'am/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag sogs/ khyed kyi srog chags bsad mi bya/ sogs dang / bka'i dbang bskur man chad bor bas lhag masngar bzhin byas na'ang legs te/ ye shes dbab pa'i skabs rang gi zhes pa tshe 'das kyi zhes 'o don pa bsgyur dgos pa sogs phra mo rnams rig pas dpyad de shes par bya'o/ /bcu pa ni/ zas gtad dang gos lham sogs gtod dgos na yang dbang bskur ba'i rjes —271—

'dir byed de/rten bsgrub byar mos pa la dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib dag sde rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa la mchod par bsam/zas gos rnams yaktas bsangs swabha sa sbyangs/na masarba sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/kha dogadabyibs legs sogs 'dod yon lnga'i tshigs thod las/rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas thob khyod la 'bul//zag med dga' ba des rtag tu tshim par shog khe mi rkang pa gyi5gnyis bsgyur/o badzra satwa hūṃ pa ka ma gu ṇa sogs sngags kyang bsgyur/bstogacig pa phung po sbyang ba ni/dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi 'od zerabyung /'di zhes bya ba'i phung khams skye mched 'khor ba'i chos thams cad ye shes chen po'i dbyings su sbyangs par gyur/rtsa rig lngo gsum dang //snying po ni gsu5gyime ngar tsos sbar zhing /stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i mes/tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang //'khore ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus pa//ye shes snang ba 'bar gyuracig/gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu//phung po lnga yi bud shing la//rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me spar ro//'byung ba bzhi'i bud shing la//lha mo bzhi yi me spar ro//dbang po drugagi bud shing la//sems dpa' drug gi /yul rnams drug gi bud yi ta ril//lha mo drug gi /lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la//rgyal ba sku gsum mo spar rdo/sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du//'gro ba'i don du 'byung bar shog stsel zhe/hrūganyis pa lam sbyang ba ni/dkon mchog rin wo dpal zhing du//dkon yon gi chen las byung ba//dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis//rin chen 'phreng ba rnam dag pa//tshogs kyis lam dang sbyor ba'i lam//mthong ba'i la5dang sgotsha272

pa'i lam/ /byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam/ /bla na med pa'i khyad par lam/ /rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la/ /brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te/ /'phags pa'i lam 'dir 'gro bar shog oṃ ra sne ra sne mahā ra sne ratna sambha we/ /ratna ni tsā ratna mā la bi shurnye ye rdo dha ya sarba pā pa hū phaṭa/ bcu gsum pa lam bstan pa ni/ padma 'dab gyis ma gos ltar/ srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i/ srid pa'i padmo las byung ba/ bde bcan du skye bar shog /tse rna padme padme padma sambha we mahā su kha ba te ga rta sko swāhā/ 'a rgyabazhi pa mchod pa'abul ba ni/ der padma la brdzus te skyes nas/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong / /gdams pa dang rje bstan thob/ de'i rgyu brtags pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi cho ga'i mthu yin par shes nas rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dir 'ongs te slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la lan du mar bskor ba byas te/ /mchod pa nyer lnga la sogs pa mchod pa dpag tu med pas mchod/ bstod pasakyang bstod par 'gyur/ na mo bha ga wa te badzra sa ra sogs mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs 'don zhing rol mo bya/bco lnga pa ched du brjod pa ni/ e ma sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /sngags kyi byin rlabs ya mtshan che/ /gang phyir mtshams med lhung ba yi/ /sems can lha gnasamyur du skye/ /e ma shākya mgon po yi/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa ya mtshan she /gangaphyir ngan song lhung ba yi/ /sems can glog bzhin myur du grol/zho 'ad du stse par gyur/ bcu drug pa rang gnas su spar ba ni/ slar yang bsgrub bya de nyid bdeb can gyi zhing khams su song bar bsams la/ o padme padme sogs brjod la rol modangabacas me tog dor/ skabs 'dir byang bu bsregs pa'i lag len yang yod mod kyi/ dkyus nyid —273—

legs par mngon no/ /de dag gis ni phyir bzlog gi cho ga rnams bstan zin to/ /cho ga yongs rdzogs 'di dag kyang bsnyan pa sngon du song bas byar rung gi /g.yin gyi ma yin na/ bsnyen pa ji ltar bya zhe na/ 'di la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang / /ras bris kyi bsnyen pa sogs kyi tha snyad mdzad pa ni/ sgrub pa la bsnyen pa'i ming btags pa tsam yin la/ 'ga' cig bdag bskyed rgyas pa sbyar ba'i sgrub mchod la/ bsnyen pa rgyas pa gtong ngo zer ba ni/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i dbye ba ma rig pas bsnyen pa gang la zer ro ma shes shing da lta'i cho ga sgrigs sgrub mchod 'di rnams sgrub pa'i 'dra 'bag tsam yin gyi/ bsnyen pa'i 'dra 'bag tu mi 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan tshago ba'i cal col du 'dug la/ bdag bskyed rgyas pa la bsnyen pa'i tha snyad sbyar ba'ang cho ga rgyasapa'i rgyud 'ga' la yod mod kyi/ de ni dbang bskur la sogs pa dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i don gyi gnas bzhu ba'i bsnyen pa yin la/ 'di ni cho ga rgyas pa'i rgyud min zhing bsnyen pa'i cho ga ni nyung ngures rung ste/ dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di'i zur 'debs su phyogs mthong tsam 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar ngan song spyong ba'i cho ga ni/ shin tu blo dman don du ngag 'don bsgrigs/ /dge des mtha' yas 'gro ba srid mtsho las/ /legs par drangs te byang chub sar 'god shog/ //ces pa thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs dang mthun par bkral ba/ 'khore ba kun grol zhes bya ba 'di yang / gzhan mang pos nan tan du bskul ba las/ tā ra nā thas zhor byung du brjod pa'o// // dge'o/ /—274—

gyi zur 'debs bzhugs/oX snyu sti/ thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'khor ba kun grol gyi zura'adebs cung zad brjod par bya'o/ /de la bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /gnyisalas/ dang po bsnyen pa'i cho ga ni/ tseX( swa bhā wa sogs nang khrus nas/ sdigs par mdzad po rdo /zhes pa'i bar yongs rdzogs sam/ bsdu na lce lag byin gyis brlab pa med kyang chog pas/swe/nga pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du huX las/ rang nyid rdo rje khro bo me ltar 'bar ba/nas/ sdigs par mdzad pa'o/ /oṃ badzra satwa kro dha nas hūX phaṭa/ lan dgu oX badzra tsakra huX/ nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi snying gar thim/ shu rgyu to༅stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ skyoX lasarderdo rje huX gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar gtod cing /g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/rab tu dges pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyisabargyan pa'o/ /'di dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po thams cad kyi thun mong gi dbang du byas pa yin la/ kun rig kho na ltar na skye( dang 'khor lo la rnam par snang mdzad du bskyed pa nyid bzang bas/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs dzaXskyoX—275—

nas dri khyo hoX.arghaX nas/shaga'i bar gyi mchod/oṃ badzra aX gu sha chogs kyis dgugagazhug bcings mnyes bya/rdor sems sam rnam snang nyid kyis phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab bya/de rjes tseX( rdzu ta sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa dang /rigs lnga'i phyag rgyas dbang bskurab rnams dang po sbyor ba bzhin du bya/de rjes bzlas pa ci 'grub bya ste/rnam snang du bsgos na/lkoX sarba bid sogs gtso bo'i sngags 'bum phrag ba ni'am/bcu drug dang /rdor sems su bsgom na/glu( badzra sa tā skyoX 'bum phrag drug go/gnyis ka'ang rtsa ba'i rig pa bzhi 'bum 'kho(gsapabazla ba yin zhing /thun 'jog khar arghaX sogs kyis mchod/mtshan brgya'am/mnyam/nyid migayo mas bstod/thun mtshams kyi 'phral spyod ji ltar byed pa dang bstun te phyag rgya bgrowaba'am mi bgrol ba skabs su gang bab bya/ma bkrol na thun snga ma rnams la thun 'arda sdug tu bsnyenapa'i lha rang gnas su bzhugs/thugs ka nas lha gnyis pa spros nas/thun mtshams kyi bya ba mdzad/thun phyi ma rnams kyi mgo la de thugs kar bzhugs nas/mchod bstod sngon du 'gro ba'i bzlas par bya/gal te phyag rgya bkrol na/thun re re bzhin mgo nas skyor/thun tha ma la ni ces par phyanargyabakrol te/gshegs su gsol nas smon lam btab/me ltar 'bar ba'i sngags lan dgus bsrungab byas nas/gnyid kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya zhing /gang ltar yang thun mtshams su gsungarderab bklag pa dang /tshwa tshwa gdab pa dang /kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang /gtor ma gtong ba la sogasapa bya'o//tshul des rtsa rig 'bum phrag bzhi 'am/rdor sems sam rnam snang gi snying po kho na byed tshe'abum phrag bcu drug bzla ba'ang yod do//snying po rkyang pas kyang go chod tsam yin mod kyi/de dag kyang rtsa rig bzang la/lag lho la gnyis kar bzla ba'ang mdzad cing /nges par yang gal che'o//de tsam gyis dbang bskur bsogasadakyil 'khor gyi las byed pa la dbang bar ba 2 / /nga /dngos grub kyi don du ni de tsam gyis mi

chog ste mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa'o/ /bsgom bya lha'i dbang du byas na/ rdor sems ni rgyud 'dilasagasungs pa'i dkyil 'kho ra bcu gnyis po thams cad kyi spyi khyab yin zhing / rnam snang shāka thubasogs dkyil 'khor so so'i gtso bo ni/ dkyil 'khor gzhan tha dad la mi 'jug pas sgos 'angayin la/ rang rang gi dkyil 'khor der gtogs pa'i lha thams cad 'jug pas spyi ru yang gtogasaso/ /'khor gyi lha me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i bsnyen pa ni sgos kyi bsnyen pa kho na yin par shes par bya'o/ /sngags kyang rtsa rig kun 'gro dang / gtsa bo bcaganyis dang / rdor sems ma gtogs me tog phog pa'i lha'i de sgos kyi dang / dkyil 'khor so so'i gtso bo ni gnyis ka'i cha la brten pa yin no/ /de'i phyir rab tu rdor sems kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song nas rtsa rig dang / dkyil 'khor 'gaganyis po'i gtso bo mtha' dag gi bsnyen pa legs par byas nas/ de'i 'og tu rang 'dod pa'i lha de bzung bar bya'o/ /'bring du na/ rdor sems dang kun rig nyid do/ /gnyis ka ma grub na rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa la kun rig gi dkyil 'bor gyi skabs su/ rdor sems dang rnam snang gang byas kyang 'dra mod kyi/ dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la 'jug che ba'i dbang du byas na/ lha rdor sems dang sngags rtsa rig kho na bsngags mod kyi/ rdor sems su bskyed phyin ni rdorasems nyid kyi sngags 'bum phrag drug tu bzla ba nges par dgos pas/ de yang rtsa rig gi thog marabazlas na legs so/ /yang rnam snang du bskyed na/ rnam snang sgos kyi bstod pa re yang byas na legs te/ des g.yin la'ang mtshon no/ /rgyud sde 'di nyid la gtso bor byed na/ spyi bsnyen sgos bsnyen tshangam bskyal na legs la/ 'di la gtso bor mi byed pa dag gis ni/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khotshor gyi bsnyen pas/ dkyil 'khor g.yin bcu gnyis kyi'ang dkyil 'khor kyi bya ba la 'jug tu rung bar shes parabya'o/ /ci ste bdag bskyed rgyas pa bsgoms te bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad skyel du mi rung ba zhig gam/khyod bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i tha snyad mi 'dod pa ci zhe na/ spyir mi rung ba dang ta ma yin zhing/ bsnyen—277—

pa'i dod thub pa'ang yin srid la/ der ma zad gang zag gi khyad par 'ga' zhig la/ bsnyen pa dngos lha rkyang re bsgoms pa las bzang bar 'gyur ba'ang srid mod kyi/ de 'dra de sgrub pa rje mthun pa tsasayin pas bsnyen pa gzhan sngon du ma song na sgrub pa'i 'dra lcog ces bya la/ bsnyen pa dang bsnyen parjes mthun pa gnyis kar ma yin pas/ lugs 'di la bsnyen par mi bsdu ste/ rgyud sde gong me'i bsnyen pa la dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yod pa'i rigs 'gre 'dir mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum ste/ dang po las chog dang sta gon no/ /dang po ni sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs su spund pa ltar gtor ma bto/ de nasakhyad par bka' bsgo drag tu byas te bgegs rnams bskrad/ drag sngags brjod cing rol mo dang bcas sa gzhi la yungs kar gyis brabs/ sa gzhi lag pas mnan te/ skye( ha na ha na tre| dha huXphaṭa/ mang du bzlas/ sa phyogs nam mkha'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur/ oX bhu khaX mang du brjod/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hūX laX smyaX 4du bslag de nas mchod pa byin rlabs dang / lce lag byin rlabs nas/ /mtshan brgya yan chad bzlas pa dang bcas/ pa'i bar bya/ hāX zhes sa gzhi g.yas bskom ra du lan gsum bcags/ tseX( badzra satwa 1ke dhe'isngags lan gsum gyi bsrung ba bya'o/ /gnyis pa stagon la/ sa'i lha mo'i sta gon spyi dang mthun/ oṃ tshur byon sogs bla med kyi khyad chos yin pas brjod mi dgos so/ /skyobs pa sangs rgyasasogs kyi gsol ba 'debs/ lha lhag gnas ni/ thig chen brgyad dang skya thig ji ltar 'os tsamabatab nas/ lha gnas rnams su dri bzang thig le bya/ mchod pa bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/sa gzhi/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlud gi dkyil zhe borardenas/ zla ba'i gdan re re'o/ ma lus sems can kun gyi nas/ kam la ye stuX gyi bar/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams so so'i gdan la 'khod pa gi dbus—278—

su bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa nas/'bar zhing 'phro bzho/snying po'o dkyil lubor gyi phyogs bzhir zhes pa nas/thams cad skad cig gis/grub paragyur/gyi gas 'dra ba las sa tho rnams dor/rab 'byams rgya mtsho ma dag bca ringagis bstod/rnam par snang mdzad bcom lda~X /'das//rigs sngags rgyal/la phyaga'atshal bstod/sogs kyis snyan gsan phab/ khyod kyi sogs gshe/gas su gsolakhaba'am/lkoX badzra u ( rnye khris nam mkhar btegs pa gang rung bya/gtor ma cha gsum ga khyo sgyung/busapa sta gon ni/dkyil chog las bshad pa'i bum sgrub byed pa ste/'dir byas zin pas geng khag ni nyi ma dang po la bum sgrub mi dgos so//glob ma sta gon ni/sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyeragang sogs kyis bsam pa brtan po bskyed/dga' chen khyo de bdag sogs kyis gsol ba btab/bu tshur theg pa chen po yi sogs sngags kyis che ba brjod/rtog pa thaman(cad legs par bsdud nas ni//shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pa'i nyon//brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs//bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobe sa/ces nyan par gdams/dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang /zhes sogs rgyun bshags bya/skye( bhi ta sbo ta sogs gnas gsum byin rlabs bya/badzra sa twa/badzra ratna/badzra dharma/badzra karma/zhes gnas bzhir dri bzang gi thig le bya/spro na cwas nyi shu rtsa gnyis byin rlabs kyang bya/dri chab la sogs pa mchod pa bzhis mchod kyang legs/rdorjeb tsā pa'i sngags kyis so shing dang /rnon pos ku sha dang /oṃ badzra satwa huX shi/spyi mthun gyisakhyor chu dang /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag sogs kyis zab mo'i i bshad dang /oṃ badzra rakṣa haX/zhes pas dpung skud byin/oṃ badzra satwa gi zhi sto ṣa huX phaṭa/ces pa sgo rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya slob ma'i spyi bor bas rdo ༷srung ba byas la/kye bzhin bzang rnams/

longs la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phyag byos shig /nang par dkyila'akhor chen po mthor bar 'gyur ro/ /go brjod do/ kha cig dkyil wor du 2ga pho sngon 'gro la slob ma sta gon du 'dod pa ni/ blun pa las kyang tshes blun pa'i rtags bstan pa yin lkagal te de de 'dra yin na/ bdag 'jug la slob ma sta gon nges par byed dgos par thal ba dbācho ga nyin gcig ma la sa chog dang sta gon gyi rim pa g.yin gang yang mi dgos shing / slob ma stagon kho na dgos pa'i khyad par yod par thal ba dang / tshad ldan nas bshad pa'i slob ma sta gon gyi cho ga gang yang de na med cing / de na yod pa rnams cig shos na med pas de 'dra slob ma sta gon yin pa sogs skyon du ma 'jug go /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga dang / sgrub cing mchod pa dag 'as/cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ thig tshon bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/oX hūX truX hiX.a las byung ba'i dam tshig gi thig tsho ni rnams sa bon lnga po de dag gis mtshan par gyur/ rang gi mig gnyis su ma dang ḍā las nyi zla huX gis mtshan pa/lkoX dis dṛ giX aX gu sha dzaX'abar ba'i lta bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig ཿzhi bkug ste dam tshig pa la thim/ oṃ a no rgya sogs bu1zhid thig skud bsgril/ tseX( badzra sa mā ya su draX mā ti kra ma hūX/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ pulpe/dhape/ ka rnye/ gsum gyis mchod/ rdul tshon la/ oX badzra tsi tra sa ma ye phoX rdul tshon lnge'i snangs su brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ kha cig re re bzhin bdun bzla zer ba'ang yod/ hiX zhes lan mang du bzlas pas spar/ pukhrel sogs gsum gyis mchod/ de nas thig gdab cing rdul tshon gyisabri'o//thig rtsa dang tshon thob ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa sgrub cing mchod pa dag gsum pa gzhug cing dbang blang ba ni/ dkyil chog nyid na gsal bar yod pa de kho na'o/ /da ni phyagargya—280—
